title: Vi søger en lungemedicinsk speciallæge til Sjællands Universitetshospital, Nykøbing F.
description:
Har du en bred interesse for lungemedicin, holder et højt fagligt niveau og holder dig opdateret? Så læs mere her.

Vi søger en lungemedicinsk speciallæge til Nykøbing F. Da stillingen er nyoprettet, har du god mulighed for at påvirke indhold og arbejdstilrettelæggelse efter ønske og efter aftale med ledende overlæge.

Vi ønsker at ansætte en læge, som mestrer tværfagligt samarbejde og som kan bidrage til udviklingen af lungeafsnittet. Du skal deltage i arbejdet med lungemedicinske indlagte patienter samt arbejde i klinik for lungesygdomme.

Har du emner indenfor det lungemedicinske område, som du ved særligt meget om, så vil vi understøtte din mulighed for at arbejde med disse områder, evt. i samarbejde med SUH, Roskilde.

Du skal deltage i supervision af yngre læger og rådgivning af læger fra andre specialer.

Lungesygdomme, sengeafsnit består aktuelt af 26 pladser. Hovedparten af de indlagte patienter har lungemedicinske problemstillinger.

Vi har også patienter med andre intern medicinske problemstillinger end lungesygdom. På sengeafsnittet behandler vi med NIV (KOL exacerbation), High flow, perkutan CO2 måling og anlægger pleuradræn.

Lungesygdomme, klinik har i løbet af ugen cirka syv lægespor. Her udreder og følger vi patienter med f.eks. KOL, astma, uafklaret åndenød og hoste.

Vi foretager også den initiale udredning af lungefibrose (ILS), ligesom vi følger patienter med sarkoidose i stabil fase.

Vi udreder og behandler for tuberkulose.

Vi følger patienter med nodulus-kontrol.

I lungeklinikken foretager vi spiometri, bodybox-undersøgelse, diffusionsmåling, Mannitoltest og Metakolintest.

Vi har aktuelt cirka 45 patienter i hjemme-NIV.

Vi har mulighed for at for at foretage allergivaccination (SLIT).

Indenfor kortere tid har vi planer om at kunne foretage søvnapnøudredning på egne patienter.

Der er aktuelt tilknyttet cirka 250 patienter med hjemme-ilt til lungeklinikken. Vi har fem lungesygeplejesker i klinikken.

Du skal søge denne stilling, hvis du

  • synes, det lyder som en spændende opgave, der matcher din kompetencer
  • er speciallæge i lungemedicin med interesse for faglig udvikling
  • brænder for tværfagligt samarbejde – på tværs af specialer og faggrupper
  • ser værdi i at støtte yngre kollegers faglige udvikling
  • er fleksibel og beslutningsdygtig og har gode kommunikationsevner
  • deltager aktivt i at fastholde et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • har lyst til at være med til at udvikle fremtidens tilbud til patienter med lungemedicinske sygdomme

Vi tilbyder en stilling

  • med stor selvstændighed
  • med kontinuitet og afveksling i hverdagen
  • med sparring af ledelsesmæssig og faglig karakter
  • med faglige udviklingsmuligheder
  • hvor der er et tæt og velfungerende tværfagligt samarbejde med sygeplejersker og sekretærer

Generelle forhold

Vi er aktuelt seks speciallæger i lungemedicin. Herudover har vi to læger i hoveduddannelsesforløb i fællesdelen og to læger i hoveduddannelsesforløb, som er på 5 år.

Medicinske Sygdomme er en del af det samlede Sjællands Universitetshospital (SUH) på matriklen i Nykøbing F. med egen akutfunktion og ambulant funktion.

Medicinske Sygdomme i Nykøbing F. består af fire enheder: Lungesygdomme, Mave-, Lever- og Tarmsygdomme, Hjertesygdomme og Ældresygdomme.

Vi forventer i forbindelse med sundhedsreformen at få et tættere samarbejde med sygehusene i Roskilde og Køge.

Praktisk info

SUH, Nykøbing F. tilbyder gode rammer for pendlere fra København og Køge, hvor der på alle ugens dage morgen og aften kører gratis direkte busser.

Derudover er der oprettet et personalehotel, hvor overnatninger kan bookes.

Læs mere på Et arbejdsliv i balance

Læs mere om dine karrieremuligheder inden for netop dit speciale og hør, hvorfor andre af dine kolleger allerede har valgt Region Sjælland på Det Gode Lægeliv

Yderligere oplysninger

Fås hos ledende overlæge Villads Bønding Jacobsen, tlf. 56 51 85 91, e-mail: vbj@regionsjaelland.dk

Ansøgning

Du bedes i en motiveret ansøgning forholde dig til de syv lægeroller (Medicinsk ekspert/lægefaglig, Kommunikator, Samarbejder, Leder/administrator/organisator, Sundhedsfremmer, Akademiker/forsker og underviser, Professionel), medsende CV og redegøre for, at dine faglige kompetencer matcher de faglige krav til stillingen.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og tillæg efter forhåndsaftaler.

Stillingen er vagtbærende. Antal vagter efter individuel aftale.

Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Ansættelse 1. december 2026 eller efter aftale.


Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.

title: Data Migration Engineer
description:
Data Migration Engineer

The Role

We are seeking an experienced Data Migration Consultant to manage end-to-end data delivery for a leading data solutions company in Auckland. This hands-on role involves translating business requirements into scalable cloud data migration strategies. You will engage with stakeholders to design conceptual and physical data models, while remaining actively involved in the technical implementation of migrating and modernising data on cloud platforms.

Key Duties

  • Migration Delivery: Develop ingestion, transformation, and presentation layers to support enterprise data migration to modern cloud platforms.
  • Data Transformation: Build and maintain scalable dbt models, Snowflake schemas, and modern ELT transformation pipelines.
  • Data Quality & Governance: Profile source system data quality, identify data issues, and implement data validation and reconciliation frameworks for the migration.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Run requirements discovery workshops, document data mapping specifications, and manage executive-level business expectations.
  • Technical Quality: Provide practical technical leadership across projects and apply software engineering best practices, including version control and CI/CD processes.

Skills & Experience Required

  • Experienced Professional: Proven track record of delivering end-to-end data solutions, including managing enterprise data platforms, cloud data warehouses, and complex data migration projects.
  • Technical Stack: Advanced SQL development skills combined with extensive hands-on experience using Snowflake and dbt.
  • Data Architecture: Practical experience implementing modern ELT frameworks, dimensional models, and robust data testing/quality principles.
  • Stakeholder Management: Effective consulting and communication skills to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Analytical Mindset: Pragmatic approach to problem-solving, identifying underlying data patterns, and implementing remediation strategies.

Please Note:

We are unfortunately unable to offer work visa sponsorship for this position, for overseas applicants. To be considered, you must currently reside in New Zealand and hold valid working rights.

At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background.

title: Alumni Network Coordinator
description:
Position: Full Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Reports To: Sophia Benrud Nybroten, Associate Director of Training

Starting Salary: $74,000

Work Location: Remote within the United States

Travel Required: 10% (for team retreats and organizational events)

This position is an exempt, full-time, union-eligible position, represented by Communication Workers of America Local 1180

About Caring Across Generations:

Caring Across Generations is a national organization working to make care more affordable and accessible at every stage of life while making sure caregivers are treated with respect and dignity. Founded in 2011 by Sarita Gupta and Ai-jen Poo, our campaign is focused on creating change in three ways: organizing a powerful movement of the Caring Majority — the majority of Americans who are directly affected by the need for care; fighting for groundbreaking policy at the state and federal level; and changing hearts and minds through storytelling, pop culture interventions, and cultural organizing.

Position Summary:

The Alumni Network Coordinator serves as the primary coordinator for the Care Fellowship alumni network, keeping former Fellows connected to the organization and to one another. Reporting to the Associate Director of Training, the Coordinator will work closely with the Training Manager and other internal staff to carry out alumni engagement goals and programs, tracking priorities, timelines, and next steps so that projects move forward on schedule. They will manage alumni outreach and communication, coordinate logistics and scheduling for network events, calls, and trainings led by staff and partners, and host regular conversations with the Care Fellow Network. Working with the Digital, Campaigns, Communications, and Culture Change teams, the Coordinator will connect alumni to storytelling, campaign, and leadership opportunities, and will join internal meetings to keep alumni engagement aligned with organizational goals and to report on progress.

Key Role Responsibilities:

Alumni Network Coordination & Program Implementation (55%)

  • Coordinate and maintain the Care Fellowship alumni network, including an up-to-date alumni database, contact information, and engagement history.
  • Implement alumni engagement goals and programs in partnership with the Associate Director and the Training Manager, tracking priorities, timelines, and next steps.
  • Support the development and maintenance of a ladder of engagement that gives alumni ongoing opportunities to grow their skills and take on leadership roles.
  • Manage alumni outreach and communication, including newsletters, invitations, and follow-up, and identify and reduce barriers to participation.
  • Coordinate logistics and scheduling for network events, calls, and trainings led by staff and partners, and support them with materials, registration, and follow-up.
  • Host regular conversations with the Care Fellow Network to build community and gather feedback and ideas.
  • Connect alumni with campaign programs and opportunities, such as 1 Million Care Conversations, and support their participation.
  • Incorporate language justice and disability justice into access tools for network events and communications.

Storytelling & Cross-Team Collaboration (20%)

  • Work with the Digital, Communications and Campaigns teams to track, identify, and share high-potential clips, excerpts, or snippets of alumni stories for campaign and media/press storytelling.
  • Support the creation of, and contribute to the ongoing upkeep of, a storybank of alumni and Fellow stories, helping gather, tag, and organize story content for the team to draw on for campaigns and communications.
  • Coordinate with the Communications, Culture Change, and Development teams, to connect storytellers from the alumni network with opportunities.
  • Join internal meetings to keep alumni engagement aligned with organizational goals.

Fellowship Team Support (10%)

  • Support the overall Care Fellowship team with day-to-day program operations during intensive work moments, working closely with the Training Manager and the Associate Director.
  • Manage the fellowship inbox in collaboration with the Fellow team, responding to applicant, Fellow, and alumni emails in a timely way and escalating questions to the right team member.
  • Support alumni contracts and payment requests by working with the internal operations team and Associate Director.
  • Maintain organized fellowship files, trackers, and templates in Asana and shared drives so information stays current and accessible.
  • Support team meetings by preparing agendas, taking notes, and following up on action items.

Reporting & Communication (10%)

  • Strengthen internal project management systems and tools to improve efficiency and communication.
  • Share regular updates through weekly check-in calls with the Associate Director of Training
  • Keep cross-functional teams informed through Slack, Asana, and other project management tools.
  • Track alumni engagement, attendance, and participation data to help the Associate Director measure the impact of alumni programs.

Caring Across – 5%

  • Participate in staff retreats, staff meetings, and staff learning opportunities.
  • Attend supervision and team meetings.
  • Demonstrate growth in policy knowledge on care issues.
  • Complete work plans and reports in a timely manner.
  • Engage in ongoing training and professional development

Qualifications and Skills:

We're seeking candidates who excel in relationship-building, are results-oriented and self-directed, and have strong organizational and project coordination skills. You should have:

  • 4-6 years of experience working for causes and movements, with experience in organizing, community outreach, or program coordination.
  • Experience coordinating networks, events, or programs, including scheduling, logistics, and tracking multiple deadlines.
  • Proficiency in project management tools and in digital tools for outreach and storytelling, such as Asana, Slack, or a constituent database.
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines. This includes thoroughness: ensuring your work and information are complete and accurate, preparing carefully for meetings and presentations, and following up with others to ensure that agreements and commitments are fulfilled.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, including the ability to ensure that information is passed on to others who should be kept informed.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with shifting priorities, with flexibility and openness to new ways of doing things and willingness to modify your preferred approach.
  • Proven ability to learn quickly, work independently, meet multiple deadlines, and problem solve with keen attention to detail, a high level of maturity, grace, sound judgment, and discretion.
  • Ability to work effectively with diverse groups of people and in a team environment.
  • Commitment to the organization's mission, values, and aspirations, and the ability to render these values into practice.
  • A demonstrated commitment to racial equity and gender justice, and to building a multicultural, anti-racist organization.
  • Familiarity with incorporating language justice and disability justice into access tools.
  • Must have access to strong WiFi and good phone reception.

Caring Across Generations is committed to fostering and maintaining a work environment where diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) are fully integrated into everything we do. As such, we strongly prioritize and embrace Black, Indigenous, and people of color; a multigenerational workforce; LGBTQ+; those across religious and spiritual affiliations; and people with disabilities to join our representative and highly talented team.

Salary: $74,000/year

title: Environmental Engineering / Hydrogeology Specialist
description:
The Generation Engineering (GE) Planning & Environmental (P&E) Group is seeking a senior environmental engineer / contaminated land specialist to join the Environmental Engineering Team. The primary responsibility of the role will be managing and delivering services and solutions related to land remediation, pollution control and waste management across the Generation and Trading (GT) project portfolio. The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert in land remediation and hydrogeology, leading environmental site investigations, risk assessments and remediation programmes, while ensuring compliance with environmental legislation, regulatory requirements and industry best practice.

Through specialist expertise in contaminated land, groundwater protection, environmental risk assessment and remediation, the successful candidate will help deliver resilient low-carbon infrastructure while protecting the environment, managing risk and supporting ESB's commitment to environmental excellence and sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage environmental site investigations, assessments and hydrogeological studies for development, operational and demolition/decommissioning projects.
  • Procure and manage external consultants and contractors, review technical reports, and provide expert recommendations to project teams and senior management in relation to Conceptual Site Models (CSMs), Generic Quantitative Risk Assessments (GQRA), Detailed Quantitative Risk Assessments (DQRA) and Remedial Options Appraisals.Manage existing and/or new contract frameworks with relevant industry specialist contractors.
  • Assess groundwater quality data and identify potential impacts to controlled waters, water supplies, ecosystems and sensitive receptors.
  • Provide specialist advice on contaminated land management, land remediation, resource and waste management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Manage environmental incident investigations involving land, groundwater or surface water contamination events.
  • Undertake environmental compliance activities, including construction site environmental compliance and resource and waste management audits, for ESB construction projects.
  • Contribute to the continual improvement of environmental management systems, technical standards and guidance documents.

Experience and Qualifications

  • A minimum of 7 years of relevant experience within the area of environmental management / environmental compliance / programme management or equivalent
  • Level 8 Environmental Engineering/Science Degree or equivalent qualification
  • Demonstrated experience in contaminated land with exposure to a wide range of environmental and engineering situations including:
  • Knowledge of and successful delivery of projects in accordance with the following: EPA Guidance on Contaminated Land and Groundwater at EPA licenced sites, 2013 & Environment Agency Land Contamination and Risk Management (LCRM) 2020; Guidance on the classification and assessment of waste (1st edition v1.1, WM3) & BS 10175:2011 + A2:2017 Investigation of potentially contaminated sites.
  • Knowledge of and experience in soil and waste management, waste classification, hydrogeological assessment, due diligence, Licensing and Permitting, Generic Quantitative Risk Assessments (GQRA’s), Detailed Quantitative Risk Assessments (DQRA’s) and Remedial Options Appraisals.
  • Working knowledge of Irish and EU environmental legislation and industry best practice standards /guidelines required.
  • Experience with working in multi-disciplinary teams and delivering small to large scale projects.
  • Strong project management skills, including excellent communication, collaboration and report writing skills.
  • Full driving licence and access to a car.

Desirable

  • Project management qualification
  • Level 9 Environmental Engineering/Science Degree or equivalent qualification
  • Chartership within a relevant professional institution / body.

Location

The successful candidates may be based in either:

  • E&MP Offices, The Sidings Building, Dublin 2
  • E&MP Offices, Eastgate, Little Island, Cork

Travel to project locations as required, is a key requirement of the role.

Reporting To

Environmental Engineering Senior Team Lead in the Gen Eng Planning & Environmental Group.

Smart Working at ESB is designed to make ‘in-person’ time together as purposeful as possible while also enabling the effective use of digital tools and hybrid arrangements to preserve our commitment to flexibility. The successful candidate may work flexibly within the jurisdiction where they have been employed, with attendance at the workplace for in-person collaboration at least two days per week. All Smart Working arrangements are subject to regular review based on the operational requirements of the role, the team, and the business.

Why Work with Us?

  • Opportunity to lead Ireland's transition to a net-zero carbon future
  • Career development through mentoring and training
  • Corporate Social Responsibility opportunities
  • Sports and Social Clubs
  • Networking opportunities
  • Credit Union
  • Generous Pension
  • Access to staff wellbeing programmes
  • Generous parental leave entitlements
  • Strong values-based and inclusive culture
  • Strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion
  • Great team environment working to our Core Values: Courageous, Caring, Driven and Trusted

Salary

€59,000 - €70,000 per annum

Closing Date

21st October 2026

Interview

  • Accountable and Ethical
  • Collaborative
  • Growing and Adaptive
  • Proactive
  • Respectful and Supportive

More information available on Our People Promise

Notes

Your application will be held in reserve for 6 months should you be suitable for the role.

The successful candidate will be required to evidence their right to work in the Republic of Ireland / UK prior to commencement of employment.

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Cherry Creek - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Data Engineer
description:
This full-time, on-site Data Engineer role is based in Medellín and focuses on designing, building, and maintaining robust data infrastructure to support analytics and business intelligence. The Data Engineer will develop and optimize data pipelines, collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements, and ensure data quality, reliability, and security across systems. Daily tasks include implementing ETL processes, modeling data structures for reporting and analysis, and managing data warehousing solutions to enable scalable data access. The role also involves monitoring data workflows, troubleshooting performance issues, documenting technical solutions, and contributing to continuous improvement of data engineering best practices within nearShift Group.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong skills in Data Engineering and Data Warehousing for building and managing scalable data platforms.
  • Candidates should possess skills in Data Modeling and Data Analytics to design effective structures and support insights-driven decision-making.
  • Candidates should possess skills in Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes to create, optimize, and maintain reliable data pipelines.
  • Candidates should have proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language commonly used in data engineering (e.g., Python, Java, or Scala).
  • Candidates should have experience with relational and non-relational databases, and familiarity with modern data platforms or cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) is beneficial.
  • Candidates should demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Candidates should ideally hold a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or possess equivalent practical experience.

More information: https://nearshift.co/jobs/data-engineer

title: Senior Applications Specialist
description:
Medison offers hope to patients suffering from rare and severe diseases by forming partnerships with emerging biotech companies to accelerate access to highly innovative therapies in international markets.

As the creator and leader of the global partnership category in the pharma industry, we strive to be Always Ahead and work relentlessly to bring therapy to patients in need, no matter where they live.

Our values are at the core of every action we take, and we are committed to going above and beyond to benefit the patients we serve.

We are a dynamic, fast-paced company operating in over 34 countries on 5 continents. We are looking for out-of-the-box thinkers, people who are passionate, caring, agile, and adaptive, to join us on our mission. If you are looking to make a difference in people's lives, we invite you to join us!

We are looking for a Senior Applications Specialist to join the Business Applications team.

The role focuses primarily on the ongoing management and continuous improvement of existing systems and the implementation of new business applications under the role’s responsibility.

The Senior Business Applications Specialist will manage application-related projects from requirements gathering and planning through implementation, testing, deployment, and post-go-live activities, while working closely with business stakeholders, internal IT teams, and external vendors.

  • Monitor project and application-related tasks, dependencies, risks, timelines, and action items, and provide clear status updates to relevant stakeholders.
  • Participate in cross-organizational technology initiatives and Business Applications projects.
  • Support departmental and OCIO-related activities when required, including information gathering, coordination, reporting, and preparation of management materials.

Requirements

Required education and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.

title: Medicinske Sygdomme på SUH, Nykøbing F tilbyder lige nu en unik mulighed for ansættelse i Hjertesygdomme, sengeafsnit og klinik, til dig der allerede er speciallæge i for eksempel anæstesiologi, akutmedicin eller intern medicinsk speciale
description:
Medicinske Sygdomme på SUH, Nykøbing F tilbyder lige nu en unik mulighed for ansættelse i Hjertesygdomme, sengeafsnit og klinik, til dig der allerede er speciallæge i for eksempel anæstesiologi, akutmedicin eller intern medicinsk speciale.

Vi søger en læge med dansk, svensk eller norsk speciallægeanerkendelse indenfor anæstesiologi, akutmedicin eller et andet relevant klinisk medicinsk speciale, som har lyst til at arbejde indenfor det kardiologiske område og som er motiveret for at dygtiggøre sig indenfor området.

Du bliver ansat som speciallæge eller overlæge, afhængig af anciennitet og kvalifikationer, og afdelingen tilbyder et omfattende onboardingforløb samt et personligt tilpasset fagligt udviklingsprogram.

I takt med din faglige udvikling indenfor området kommer du til at fungere på lige fod sammen med afdelingens øvrige seniorlæger.

Det er et nyt tiltag med henblik på at give speciallæger mulighed for at bevæge sig ind i andre fagområde end deres oprindelige speciale. Det mener vi kan være nødvendigt generelt i forhold til lægers jobmuligheder, og vi tænker også at det måske nogle steder kan bidrage til at skabe en ny dynamik indenfor specialerne.

Den rigtige kandidat er selvsagt motiveret for at opkvalificere sig indenfor området, og afdelingen vil hjælpe med optimale muligheder for, at det kan lykkes.

Stillingen omfatter funktion ved stuegang, ambulant aktivitet og medicinske vagter, tilpasset dine kliniske kompetencer og løbende faglige udvikling.

Om os

Medicinske Sygdomme, SUH, Nykøbing F. består af fire enheder: Lungesygdomme, Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygdomme, Hjertesygdomme og Ældresygdomme.

Hjertesygdomme, sengeafsnit har 30 sengepladser i sygehusets nyeste bygning, vi råder over moderne udstyr og en klinik med stor aktivitet, hvor der blandt andet laves TTE og EKKO og hjerte-CT.

Vi har selvstændige sygeplejeklinikker indenfor hypertension, lipidforstyrrelser og hjertesvigt.

Vi er en arbejdsplads med dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere.

Afsnittet består af 20 læger, inklusive læger i hoveduddannelsesforløb i kardiologi, og introduktionslæger i rotation med de øvrige medicinske specialer.

Sygehuset har et samarbejde med Københavns Universitet, og bidrager til undervisning af medicinstuderende, der har klinikophold på sygehuset. Hjertesygdomme har to lektorer, og bidrager til nationale og regionale forskningsprojekter.

Afsnittet har det sidste år gennemgået en sund udvikling og fremstår som et stærkt hold. Vi har en stor passion for specialet, og Hjertesygdomme har et godt omdømme som uddannelsessted for læger.

Afsnitsledelsen består af en ledende overlæge og to oversygeplejersker, som refererer til cheflægen og chefsygeplejersken.

Vores forventninger til dig

  • Du er speciallæge i anæstesiologi, akutmedicin eller et andet relevant klinisk medicinsk speciale med dansk, svensk eller norsk speciallægeanerkendelse
  • Du er motiveret for at erhverve specialekundskaber indenfor kardiologien
  • Sprog: Du behersker dansk, svensk eller norsk i skrift og tale
  • Du er positiv og samarbejdsorienteret og leder efter løsninger på nye problemer

Vi kan tilbyde en stilling, der indeholder

  • kontinuitet og afveksling i hverdagen
  • sparring og faglige udviklingsmuligheder
  • godt arbejdsmiljø og et velfungerende tværfagligt samarbejde
  • en fleksibel arbejdstilrettelæggelse
  • fastansættelse som speciallæge eller overlæge afhængig af anciennitet

Praktisk info

Medicinske Sygdomme, SUH, Nykøbing F. tilbyder gode rammer for pendlere fra Køge og København, hvor der på alle ugens dage morgen og aften kører gratis direkte busser.

Derudover er der oprettet et personalehotel, hvor overnatninger kan bookes.

Hvis du overvejer et nyt sted at bo, er det værd at nævne, at der omkring Nykøbing Falster findes mange meget fine boliger, som sammenlignet med andre steder i landet er prissat overordentligt fornuftigt og naturen i området er virkeligt dejlig.

Læs mere på Et arbejdsliv i balance - Sjællands Universitetshospital, Nykøbing F.

Forskning

SUH, Nykøbing F. har en Forskningsstøtteenhed, som kan være behjælpelig med, at man kommer i gang med forskning.

Yderligere oplysninger

Ring eller skriv til os for at høre mere om netop dine muligheder

Cheflæge Kenneth Hofland

+45 23374252 / kefh@regionsaelland.dk

eller

Ledende overlæge Ramshanker Ramanathan

+45 93 56 85 17 / ramra@regionsjaelland.dk

Ansøgning

Du bedes i en motiveret ansøgning forholde dig til de syv lægeroller (Medicinsk ekspert/lægefaglig, Kommunikator, Samarbejder, Leder/administrator/organisator, Sundhedsfremmer, Akademiker/forsker og underviser, Professionel), medsende CV og redegøre for, at dine faglige kompetencer matcher de faglige krav til stillingen.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er vagtbærende. Antal vagter efter individuel aftale.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og tillæg efter forhåndsaftaler.

Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Ansættelse 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.

La conoscenza di COBOL non è vincolante: verranno valutati anche candidati che non hanno mai lavorato con COBOL ma che dimostrino interesse e disponibilità ad apprenderlo.

COSA OFFRIAMO?

The world needs you

In ADENTIS crediamo che la tecnologia possa contribuire concretamente alla trasformazione delle organizzazioni e alla costruzione di un futuro più sostenibile e innovativo.

Entrare a far parte del nostro team significa contribuire a progetti di trasformazione complessi, mettendo a disposizione competenze, esperienza e capacità di collaborazione.

ADENTIS promuove le pari opportunità e valorizza la diversità e l’inclusione. La ricerca è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi, nel rispetto della normativa vigente.

title: Senior Estimator - Remote
description:
Econolite® is an innovator of Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) solutions, products, and services. Our technology is helping save lives and making the Smart City a reality. If you want to be at the forefront of this intelligent technology revolution, we want to talk to you about being part of our team. Econolite is committed to employing the best talent that will make significant contributions to building a safer, connected world.

Econolite’s ITS solutions ease traffic congestion, provide safer mobility, and improve quality of life. As the one-stop-shop leader for traffic management systems, sensor products, and services, Econolite is committed to the advancement of connected and autonomous vehicles, smart cities, and cybersecurity.

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to utilize your technical knowledge of electrical circuits, fundamental electronic design, and electrical theory, while also gaining valuable knowledge and experience in the Traffic industry, particularly with NEMA traffic cabinets.

In addition to your technical expertise, you will also need to be familiar with many of Econolite's product lines and have some software experience. As a high-level architect of traffic cabinet designs, you will play a vital role in shaping our company's future.

We are seeking someone who has excellent communication skills, personal management, and prioritizing skills, and who is excited about working within a close team environment. In return, you will have the opportunity to interface with many Econolite Sales Personnel, Distributors, and customers throughout the United States, Canada, and some international agencies.

DUTIES

  • Read and interpret customer bid documents, specifications. and intersection plans.
  • Convert customer specifications/special provisions and requirements into a complete estimated quotation for sales to be able to quote the specific bid or customer request.
  • In the process, work to ensure that all technical questions about the request are asked and answered so that an accurate quotation can be completed.
  • Using our Agile software system, you will need to open a quote ECO, create a bill of materials for the intended cabinet, and perform costing activities to obtain the total estimated cost of the cabinet.
  • Create a formal quotation letter using a template.
  • In addition to creating the estimate, you must be able to communicate the information needed for cabinet engineering to review the documents provided so they can create a working set of production documents when needed.
  • Participate in any communication from cabinet engineering and production about the cabinet quotation provided and the information therein when they have questions about the bill of materials provided to them by the estimating department.
  • Perform the task of completing an item card in our D365 ERP system after the quotation is completed for use by sales.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in a technical field or at least 4 years traffic related work experience in a relevant technical Traffic Signal role.
  • Must have a clear understanding of, and ability to work with, plan sheets, bid documents, engineering documents and specifications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, problem solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong computer software skills including word processing, spreadsheets, and database applications, such as MS Office programs, including Outlook, Word, Excel.
  • Excellent verbal and written presentation skills

• Basic AutoCad skills are a must

PRE-EMPLOYMENT

All candidates who accept employment will be subject to a background investigation and drug screening. For applicable roles, candidates who accept employment will also be subject to a Motor Vehicle/Driving Record screening.

COMPENSATION

The base pay range for this full-time exempt position is $75,000-$85,000 per year plus benefits. Pay ranges are determined by various factors, including role, experience, and location. The pay range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire base pay rates for this position. Within the range, actual individual compensation is determined by various factors, including location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

BENEFITS

This role is eligible for benefits: weekly pay, weekly PTO accrual, paid holidays. Various medical plans, dental, vision, flexible spending accounts, direct deposit. Basic life, LTD, 401k discretionary match. Other voluntary benefits include: identity theft protection.

They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, skills, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

title: Pædagogmedhjælper til Saksild børnehus
description:
Pædagogmedhjælper til Saksild Børnehus søges


Med start senest d. 1. november, men meget gerne før søger vi i Saksild børnehus en pædagogmedhjælper til en stilling på 35-37 timer til vores vuggestuegruppe.

Som pædagogmedhjælper i Saksild børnehus vil du blive en del af et hus, som er optaget af at skabe kreative og udviklende rammer.

Vi er en personalegruppe der vægter udeliv, leg og bevægelse højt i vores dagligdag.

Vi er ude hver dag og tilbringer gerne hele dage ude, når vejret tillader det. Vi er ikke bange for at få jord og ormeslim på fingrene!



I vuggestuen arbejder vi ud fra en stukturet og forudsigelige ugeplan. Det giver tid til ro og fordybelse og aktiviteter i mindre grupper. Børnene fordeles hver dag i mindre grupper, så der er tid og nærvær til alle børn. Vi har planlagte turdage, kreative aktiviteter, tons og tummel i gymnastiksalen, musik og dage med plads til spil og læsning, MEN også dage hvor vi sidder på gulvet og lader legen udvikle sig med børnenes fantasi og tempo.

Udelivet bruges også dagligt – her har vi mulighed for at bruges vores egen legeplads til vuggestuen, men nyder også at udforske børnehavens store naturlegeplads med bål, eventyr i vores egen skov, hygge i shelter.

Vores omgivelser i Saksild indbyder til meget bevægelse og udvikling af fin og grov motorik. Vi benytter i dagligdagen skolens gymnastiksal, fodbane, multibane samt de nærliggende skove og stranden.



Derfor søger vi en aktiv og engageret medhjælper, som også brænder for udeliv og som kan igangsætte og fuldføre sine ideer og aktiviteter.

Du ansættes primært i vuggestuen, men da vi er en integreret institution og arbejder meget tæt sammen i dagligdagen – skal du også være frisk på at have timer i børnehaven.



Vi tilbyder:

  • Dygtige og engagerede kollegaer og en mangfoldighed af skønne børn
  • Et godt forældresamarbejde og -engagement
  • Faglig sparring og vejledning i forhold til opgaven
  • Et bredt samarbejde mellem grupperne - med meget plads til leg, kreativitet og læring
  • Et sted hvor venskaber på tværs af alder og det sociale fællesskab altid i højsædet
  • Fokus på at skabe gode overgange
  • Vi har Østjyllands bedste natur lige udenfor vores ellers store og skønne legeplads.


Din profil:

  • Du har meget stor lyst til at arbejde med børn i alderen 0-3 årige.
  • Du har forståelse for aldersgruppens behov for tryghed, bevægelse og sproglig opmærksomhed
  • Du møder børnene i øjenhøjde, er optaget af og nysgerrig på børnenes verdener og børns intentioner
  • Du har overblik og er ansvarlig i f. h. t. pædagogiske som de praktiske opgaver
  • Du er altid klar til udeliv og naturaktiviteter
  • Du må meget gerne have institutionserfaring
  • Du er stabil og fleksibel - og har en positiv og humoristisk tilgang til dit arbejde
Vil du vide mere om jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte: pædagogisk leder Mille Da på 23 31 14 16

Ansøgningsfrist: 27. oktober 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler: afholdes løbende



Bemærk: Der vil blive indhentet straffe- og børneattest.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem KL og BUPL / FOA. Det er Odder kommunes politik at indhente straffe- og børneattest ved alle ansættelser.

title: Associate Database Administrator
description:
Are you ready to join a growing team that puts a premium on productivity and has an award-winning culture centered around transforming talented employees into effective business leaders? Then BHG Financial is the place for you.
In 2001, we started with an idea, an opportunity, and $25,000. Back then, our focus was strictly  on serving those in the medical industry. With healthcare in our heritage, we soon expanded  to serve high-earning professionals in many  other industries, providing all with leading-edge financial solutions, including our extensive network of community banks.
Today, BHG Financial has firmly established  its legacy as a leader in the financial services space. Founded on the philosophy of a better way to borrow, we are dedicated to helping accomplished professionals, small businesses, and institutions build upon their success through innovative financial solutions, a hassle-free process, and personalized concierge service.
Our relentless commitment to the success of our customers is part of what has made BHG Financial thrive. We take a 360-degree view of our customers to tailor the best solutions for their financial aspirations. Today's professionals have multiple sources of income, not just their paycheck. Therefore, it is essential to factor those in when making responsible lending decisions. Our continued focus on data, analytics, and proprietary modeling has enabled faster funding for our customers.
From business to personal loans to relationships with community banks, the country’s top professionals and business owners rely on us for our exceptional financial solutions and concierge service to continue their success and legacy.

Who You Are

You are an early-career database administration professional with a strong foundation in SQL Server and a desire to grow your technical skills across on-premises and Azure environments. You are detail-oriented, curious, and dependable, with an interest in database monitoring, backup and recovery, security, troubleshooting, and performance fundamentals. You work well with established procedures, communicate clearly, and know when to escalate issues while continuing to learn from senior team members.

What You'll Do

    • Perform routine administration and health checks for SQL Server databases in on-premises and Azure environments under the guidance of senior DBAs
    • Monitor database availability, capacity, performance, jobs, and alerts; investigate common issues and escalate complex incidents appropriately
    • Support backup, restore, recovery validation, database refresh, and migration activities by following documented procedures
    • Assist with user access, permissions, patching, maintenance, and security controls in accordance with company standards and change-management processes
    • Use T-SQL and approved tools to gather diagnostic information, perform query and index analysis, and automate repeatable tasks
    • Maintain accurate documentation, runbooks, inventory, and operational records; collaborate with senior DBAs, developers, infrastructure, and security teams
    • Participate in scheduled maintenance and an on-call rotation as assigned, with appropriate team support

What You'll Need

    • 1-3 years of relevant experience in database administration, systems administration, or a closely related technical role; equivalent education and practical training may be considered
    • Foundational knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, relational database concepts
    • Working knowledge of T-SQL, including writing queries and understanding stored procedures, execution plans, and indexes
    • Understanding of database backups, restores, recovery models, security permissions, and routine maintenance
    • Knowledge of PowerShell Scripting and automation
    • Troubleshooting skills and the ability to analyze logs, alerts, and performance information
    • Strong documentation, communication, organization, and collaboration skills
    • Ability to follow operational procedures, change controls, and security requirements while handling sensitive financial data responsibly
    • Travel requirement: All roles require travel during the first 6 months of employment to attend the BHG Oars in Experience. After the initial 6 months, ongoing travel is expected at approximately ~5% annually for periodic team on-sites, team meetings, and cross-functional collaboration.
    • Work Authorization: This role is not eligible for employer-provided immigration sponsorship. To be considered, applicants must already possess valid U.S. work authorization that will not require sponsorship now or in the future.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Exposure to Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, or other cloud database services
    • Familiarity with SQL Server Agent, Availability Groups, Transparent Data Encryption, and database monitoring tools such as Redgate SQL Monitor or Fog light
    • Experience using PowerShell, source control, or ticketing and change-management systems
    • Awareness of financial services compliance and data-protection requirements, including SOX and PCI DSS
    • Microsoft Azure Database Administrator Associate certification or progress toward a relevant Microsoft certification

Life at BHG Financial

At BHG Financial, we work hard and aren’t afraid to take risks. Since the beginning, our core values of PMA (positive mental attitude), team player, and loyalty have been the driving force behind every interaction we have between each other and our customers. We have a healthy respect for the daily grind, yet we value work/life balance. We believe that all employees should have the opportunity to lead and that good ideas can come from anyone. From the top down, our leaders are actively involved not only in strategic oversight and running the business, but also in the well-being and growth of all employees. We consider people our #1 asset, and help employees realize their full potential, set and exceed their goals, and explore new opportunities for personal and professional development.

Why You Should Join BHG Financial

We strive to offer amenities, opportunities, events, and programming that support the interests of our teams, while furthering the culture that makes us Great Place to Work® certified. Some of the benefits you can expect when you join BHG Financial include:
•Medical/Rx/Dental/Vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members
•Competitive PTO and vacation policies
•1 Friday off each month for Wellness Weekends
•Company 401(k) plan with employer contributions after one year
•Company-sponsored training and certification opportunities
•Quarterly award ceremonies where top achievers are celebrated and receive additional bonuses
•Ongoing volunteer opportunities to give back to the community through our BHG Cares program
If you’re ready for a career where you can exercise your passions, be surrounded by co-workers who are relentlessly committed to service, and have a team-player mindset, apply today!
BHG Financial is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. BHG Financial is an equal opportunity employer; committed to a community of inclusion, and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

title: Applicator - Agriculture
description:
WHO WE ARE

Helena Agri-Enterprises, LLC is an innovator and service provider for agricultural and professional markets in the United States and around the world. We are one of America's only retailers and distributors with expertise in formulation, research and development, precision technology, data solutions, professional application and manufacturing. ABOUT THE JOB

Our Applicators are responsible for applying herbicides and pesticides to labeled crops as directed by their leader. This position also operates and performs maintenance to all applicator equipment.

WHAT YOUR DAY WILL LOOK LIKE

  • Correctly mixes pesticides, fertilizers and chemicals for application.
  • Maintains accurate logs and reports on applicated acres.
  • Performs maintenance and calibration on application equipment.
  • Performs maintenance on other equipment.
  • Wears proper safety protection gear.

  • Attends applicator equipment workshops.
  • Drives a company vehicle.
  • Provides excellent customer service to all internal and external customers.

  • Follows all company policies and procedures.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Mechanically inclined.
  • Qualified Applicator Certificate (QAC) is preferred.

  • Basic knowledge of ag pesticides.
  • Ability to read field maps and use tractor-mounted field computers.
  • Professional competence to safety.
  • Ability to pass a CDL physical examination.

  • Valid U.S. driver's license is required and must meet all company requirements to drive a Helena vehicle.
  • Applicants for positions requiring operation of a moving vehicle or interaction with heavy equipment must meet the legal age requirement.
Pay rate is $18-23/hr

Successful completion of a drug test and background check is required for all positions at Helena.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL ASPECTS OF THE JOB

At Helena, safety is our highest priority. We seek out extensive safety measures and put them in place to minimize exposure to anything that could be potentially harmful to our employees.

The work environment for this position will be in an outdoor setting in all types of weather conditions with exposure to outdoor elements. When working outdoors and possibly around moving equipment/mechanical parts, you may be exposed to fumes, airborne particles, chemical and biological hazards, vibrations and a risk of electrical shock.

This position requires you to use your hands for many different tasks and to talk, hear, walk, sit, stand (8 hours a day or more), lifting, carrying, pushing or pulling (up to and including 50lbs or more), reaching overhead (up to and including 25lbs), climbing, gripping, grasping and twisting using hands and wrists, bending and stooping for long periods of time, working below knee levels for short periods of time and working above shoulder level for short periods.

  • Up to four weeks of paid Parental Leave.
  • Education Assistance.
  • And much more!

For more detailed information about our benefits, visit helenacareers.com/benefits.

STAY CONNECTED TO HELENA!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:

title: EV Charger Service Industry Advisor
description:
About the Workforce Intelligence Lab (WIL)

The Workforce Intelligence Lab (WIL) is an applied workforce research initiative. WIL builds methodology-transparent workforce intelligence, including labor demand signals, occupational and credential pathways, and training-to-employment outcome measures, and works with education, employer, and labor partners to turn that evidence into grant and sponsored-project collaborations. Learn more:

WIL is assembling a California team to respond to the California Energy Commission's Charger Service Skills Accelerator grant solicitation (GFO-26-601). The solicitation funds training that leads to portable, industry-recognized credentials for servicing electric vehicle (EV) charging equipment: installation, commissioning, verification and testing, maintenance, repair, technical support, and decommissioning. Funded projects must provide training, collaborate with worker, employer, and educational provider partners, and offer a clear path from training to quality jobs.

Opportunity type: this is a contingent proposal opportunity in WIL's expert-collaborator network, not a funded vacancy. Applications to the CEC are due October 30, 2026; awards are competitive and none has been made. If an award proceeds, WIL may offer full-time employment or a project-based contract engagement, depending on the award and staffing model. There is no guaranteed work, and any engagement would be scoped by project. Engagements are remote-first, with travel as required for California partner and training sites. We will ask your permission before including your name or resume in any proposal.

WIL is seeking an EV charger field service technician or electrician to advise the training program on what charger service work actually requires on the job.

What you'll do

  • Advise the training partner on the real job tasks of EV charger service (installation, commissioning, verification and testing, maintenance, repair, technical support, and decommissioning) for Level 2 and DC fast chargers
  • Review curriculum and lab exercises against industry standards and employer needs, including electrical safety practices such as lockout/tagout
  • Help define entry-level and advancement roles in charger service for the proposal's career pathway
  • Advise on which credentials carry weight with employers, including EVITP, electrician certifications, and manufacturer-specific training
  • Support instructor development by transferring field knowledge to instructors and curriculum developers
  • Share field perspective on common failures, diagnostics, tools, and uptime practices so training reflects current equipment
  • With your permission, contribute a short resume and experience summary to the proposal

Apply to be considered.

Requirements

Required

  • Hands-on field experience installing, commissioning, maintaining, or repairing EV charging equipment (Level 2 and/or DC fast charging)
  • Journeyman electrician status, a California DIR electrician certification, EVITP certification, or a comparable documented trade credential
  • Working knowledge of electrical safety practices, including lockout/tagout, and applicable electrical codes
  • Ability to explain technical work clearly to instructors and curriculum developers

Nice to have

  • California C-10 electrical contractor license or EV charger field experience in California
  • Instructor, apprenticeship, or manufacturer training experience
  • Experience with charge point operator or EVSE operations and maintenance service programs

title: Data Analytics Engineer
description:
Functieomschrijving
Meer dan dashboards bouwen? Word Fullstack Data Analytics Engineer bij ilionx en combineer techniek, advies en impact in één rol.

Niet alleen bouwen aan dashboards, maar echt richting geven aan hoe organisaties met data werken, dát is waar jij energie van krijgt. Als Data Analytics Engineer bij ilionx pak je die rol. Je denkt mee over architectuur, helpt klanten hun data beter benutten en zorgt dat inzichten ook echt gebruikt worden. Daarbij kijk je nadrukkelijk verder dan traditionele analytics en zet je steeds vaker AI en machine learning in om processen te automatiseren en voorspellende inzichten te realiseren. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen business en techniek en neemt collega’s daarin mee. Hier ben je niet alleen uitvoerend, maar maak je daadwerkelijk het verschil.

jouw functie als Data Analytics Engineer

Als data analytics engineer ben jij de drijvende kracht achter de ontwikkeling van complexe analytics oplossingen bij onze klanten. Binnen multidisciplinaire teams neem je eigenaarschap over het ontwerp en de implementatie van datagedreven toepassingen, waarbij je altijd streeft naar duurzame en schaalbare oplossingen. Je bent niet alleen technisch sterk, maar ook communicatief vaardig, en weet als geen ander de brug te slaan tussen business en IT.

Je begeleidt en coacht collega’s met minder ervaring en stimuleert kennisdeling binnen en buiten je team. Je denkt actief mee over de opzet van data architecturen in bijvoorbeeld Azure, waarbij je tools als (vooral) Fabric/Databricks/Snowflake, Synapse, Data Factory en Data Lake inzet. Daarnaast werk je met tools zoals Power BI en Tabular Editor aan het bouwen van krachtige datamodellen en dashboards.

Performance optimalisatie, heldere datamodellering en een scherp oog voor datakwaliteit zijn voor jou vanzelfsprekend. description:
Job Description:

PN Climate & Impact Program Lead

Segment: Mars Petcare (Pet Nutrition Europe)

Reporting Line: European Sustainability Lead

Location: Paddington or Slough, UK (hybrid)

Salary: £,76,100 - £91,000 (depending on the experience), annual bonus, benefits, annual car allowance


Role Purpose

As the PMO Lead for Climate & Impact, you will be the strategic and operational leader of Mars Pet Nutrition Europe’s climate transition. Your mission is to ensure we meet our science-based carbon targets while transforming sustainability into a core business competency and a driver of regional growth. You will embed climate accountability and value creation across all business functions—from financial planning and S&OP+ to brand storytelling and customer collaboration—to drive a unified and commercially savvy climate strategy.



What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Climate Program Governance: Lead the Program Management Office (PMO) for Europe’s climate action plan. Govern and track the portfolio of sustainability initiatives across Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions, serving as the central hub for our regional climate agenda (primary focus decarbonisation, with water and biodiversity expected to follow).
  • Performance & Financial Integration: Establish and manage robust tracking to monitor progress against carbon targets. Integrate carbon performance and risk into core business rhythms, including S&OP+ and long-term financial planning (AEP, IVCP).
  • Business Case & ROI: Partner with functional teams to build compelling business cases for sustainability investments, considering ROI, marginal abatement costs and business resilience.
  • Commercial & Brand Integration: Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to unlock value from our climate actions. Develop a program to upskill associates to support customer engagements with major European retailers and help translate complex sustainability data into credible, high-impact brand/portfolio stories that resonate with downstream partners.
  • Stakeholder & Enterprise Alignment: Act as the primary liaison to Global and Central Mars Sustainability teams to align on priorities and scale best practices.

What are we looking for?

  • Experience: Substantial experience leading a PMO or managing large-scale, cross-functional programs, preferably in an FMCG, manufacturing, or retail environment.
  • Commercial Acumen: Proven experience working at the intersection of sustainability and commercial functions (e.g., Sales, Marketing, Category), with a track record of driving business-oriented sustainability goals.
  • Climate Expertise: Strong technical understanding of carbon accounting (GHG Protocol, Scope 3), science-based targets (SBTi), and climate risk frameworks.

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

  • Define and implement core business metrics (e.g. activation, engagement, retention) as reusable, versioned data assets- ensuring consistent definitions across analytics, product, and AI use cases.
  • Model complex SaaS data by integrating product events, CRM (Salesforce), and support data into clean, well-defined fact and dimension models.
  • Build and evolve our semantic layer - creating a reliable abstraction over our data that enables consistent KPI definitions and supports downstream consumers, including LLM-based analytics agents.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers on upstream data contracts and event schemas - ensuring raw data is structured in a way that supports scalable, reliable analytics.
  • Establish and enforce best practices in testing, documentation, and data quality- making these part of the standard development lifecycle.
  • Document models, metrics, and lineage clearly - enabling self-service and reducing ambiguity across teams.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering or data engineering with a strong focus on data modeling.
  • Strong proficiency in dbt and SQL- building modular, well-tested models.
  • Solid understanding of dimensional modeling and metric design.
  • Experience working with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift).
  • Experience with metrics / semantic layers (e.g. dbt metrics, MetricFlow, Cube).
  • Strong data quality mindset (testing, validation, monitoring).
  • Comfortable working with event-based data and cross-functional teams.
  • Able to turn ambiguous business questions into clear data models.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to challenge metric definitions and ensure they reflect real business outcomes.
  • Fluent in English.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with how LLMs consume structured data- e.g. semantic layers, metrics registries, YAML-based context- and an interest in building data infrastructure that serves AI agents, not just BI tools.
  • Experience modeling product usage data (event-based or session-based).

What we offer

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days
  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts
  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups
  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ
  • *Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample- you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe , we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence. Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us. If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Westfarms - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free

  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.
