title: Executive Director, California College Guidance Initiative
description:
Executive Director, California College Guidance Initiative

100% Remote within California; must reside in California


The Foundation for California Community Colleges (FoundationCCC) is the official nonprofit auxiliary to the California Community Colleges, the largest and most diverse system of higher education in the nation. Founded in 1998, FoundationCCC has served as a catalyst for student success, workforce development, and community impact across California. The organization manages over 70 programs and initiatives that expand opportunity and accelerate pathways to economic and social mobility for all Californians — piloting new approaches, replicating promising practices, and scaling sustainable methods to support all 116 California community colleges and 2.2 million students.


Since its founding, FoundationCCC has delivered hundreds of millions in grants, support, and cost savings to colleges, and 86% of every dollar that comes into FoundationCCC directly supports programs and services that benefit the colleges and their students. FoundationCCC plays a pivotal role in forging new partnerships and accelerating bold approaches to advance the California Community Colleges and the communities they serve.


About CCGI

The California College Guidance Initiative (CCGI) manages CaliforniaColleges.edu, the state's official college and career planning platform. CCGI is a legislatively authorized service provider to all California school districts as established in California Education Code Section 60900.5. CaliforniaColleges.edu helps students explore college and career options, launch their college and financial aid applications, and access financial aid lessons, all on one site. It helps educators utilize data-driven guidance and streamline student support, while allowing parents and guardians to view and monitor their student's progress. By connecting information, planning, and application processes, CCGI strengthens college and career readiness and expands access to postsecondary opportunities statewide.


CCGI partners with K-12 school districts across the state to give students, families, and counselors the tools they need to ensure that all California students, especially those who have been underrepresented in higher education, can move seamlessly from K-12 to college and career. The organization serves more than 650 local educational agencies, transmitting transcript data, powering transcript-informed tools, and streamlining applications for college admissions and financial aid.


CCGI operates as a structurally embedded project under the fiscal sponsorship of FoundationCCC and is a Collaborative Impact Partner of the organization. This partnership allows CCGI to focus entirely on its data-driven mission to support California students while leveraging the robust administrative infrastructure of the community college system's official nonprofit partner. The fiscal partnership model reflects how FoundationCCC works across California's education landscape: incubating and scaling high-impact initiatives that strengthen the pipeline from K-12 into the California community colleges and beyond.

The organization employs roughly 80 staff distributed across four divisions: Programs, CaliforniaColleges.edu, Data and Strategy, and Operations, with regional teams spanning the state.


The Role

CCGI's next Executive Director will guide the organization's strategic direction, strengthen its statewide relationships, and oversee a leadership team accountable for delivering its mission and statutory responsibilities. This leader will connect education policy, partnerships, organizational resources, and execution to reduce barriers and expand students' access to college and career pathways. The role reports to FoundationCCC as the most senior CCGI leader and serves as CCGI's most critical and influential advocate with leadership at the state's public educational institutions, the state legislature, the Governor's office, and the Department of Finance.


What We Are Seeking


Strategic Direction and Execution

Sets clear priorities, articulates a compelling future for CCGI — expanding into areas like deepening platform adoption and leveraging data more powerfully — while simultaneously managing the practical realities of funding constraints, statutory compliance, and intersegmental coordination. Translates strategy into measurable outcomes and resource decisions and adjusts direction as student needs and statewide conditions evolve.


Statewide Relationship-Based Leadership

Builds and deepens trust across education systems and government partners — including 650+ K-12 Local Education Agencies, the California Department of Education, the California Community Colleges, California State University, the University of California, the California Student Aid Commission and the Cradle-to-Career Data System. Navigates competing priorities with diplomacy and develops coalitions that advance shared outcomes through influence rather than positional authority.


Team-Centered Stewardship

Honors the deep expertise of the existing team, provides clarity and resources so divisions can execute, builds strong retention, and enters the organization with humility. Leads through senior leaders, clarifies decision-making authority, strengthens accountability, and develops leadership capacity across the organization.


Financial and Organizational Stewardship

Accountable for both long-term financial sustainability through continued state funding, philanthropy funding opportunities, and cybersecurity and risk management


Student-Centered, Equity-Informed Judgment

Uses evidence and stakeholder perspectives to identify barriers and make decisions that improve educational access and opportunity — especially for students most harmed by misalignment between education systems.


Communication and Culture

Communicates clearly across audiences, welcomes constructive disagreement, provides direct and respectful feedback, and models collaboration, learning, and accountability.


Essential Responsibilities

MISSION AND STRATEGIC ALIGNMENT

  • Provides executive leadership to position CCGI to effectively achieve its mission, statutory responsibilities, and long-term strategic objectives.
  • Establishes CCGI's medium- and long-term strategic direction in alignment with its mission, statutory responsibilities, FoundationCCC's mission, and evolving statewide education priorities.
  • Translates strategic direction into clear annual and multi-year priorities, outcomes, and resource commitments.
  • Holds executive leaders accountable for organizational performance and uses data, results, and changing conditions to assess progress and adjust strategy.
  • Anticipates changes in the external environment and positions CCGI to respond effectively to emerging policy, funding, technology, and educational priorities.
  • Champions innovative, scalable solutions that reduce systemic barriers, lessen administrative burden, and improve student access to college and career pathways.

ORGANIZATIONAL STEWARDSHIP

  • Provides overall executive leadership, direction, and accountability for CCGI's strategy, operations, organizational performance, and impact.
  • Leads and supports CCGI's leadership team, providing direction and counsel to division leaders on strategic, financial, operational, and organizational decisions.
  • Establishes clear decision-making authority, accountability, and expectations across the executive team and organization.
  • Builds and develops a cohesive, high-performing leadership team capable of advancing shared priorities.
  • Ensures organizational structures, leadership capacity, systems, and resources support effective execution of CCGI's mission and strategy while maintaining alignment with FoundationCCC's mission.
  • Maintains an organizational culture grounded in CCGI's mission and values, reinforcing collaboration, accountability, innovation, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
  • Proactively oversees legal, financial, operational, cybersecurity, compliance, and reputational risk and ensures appropriate controls and practices are in place.

EXTERNAL ENGAGEMENT

  • Serves as a principal executive representative for CCGI with education leaders, state officials, policymakers, partners, funders, and other key stakeholders.
  • Cultivates and sustains long-term strategic relationships with leaders and organizations across education segments, state agencies, governmental entities, and other key partners.
  • Builds and sustains strategic coalitions that strengthen alignment across education systems and advance CCGI's mission and statewide impact.
  • Exercises diplomacy, political acumen, and executive communication to navigate complex stakeholder environments and strengthen CCGI's visibility, credibility, and influence.
  • Leads the annual and multi-year budgeting process in coordination with the Department of Finance, Legislature, and other appropriate stakeholders.
  • Ensures CCGI fulfills its statutory purpose and responsibilities as established in California law and applicable state requirements.
  • Maintains executive accountability for legislative reporting, funding requirements, governmental commitments, and other state oversight obligations.
  • Ensures the Cradle-to-Career Data System Governing Board and other appropriate state constituents are informed of CCGI's work, priorities, progress, and significant organizational developments.

Experience and Knowledge

  • Organizational leadership — Experience leading a distributed team of 50+ through an executive leadership structure.
  • Equity-centered strategy — Demonstrated ability to translate equity commitments into organizational policy, hiring, and partnerships.
  • Government relations — Experience working with or within the Legislature, Governor's office, or Department of Finance on education policy or funding.
  • California education ecosystem — Deep familiarity with K-12, community colleges, CSU, UC, and the state agencies that connect them.
  • Government relations — Experience working with or within the Legislature, Governor's office, or Department of Finance on education policy or funding.
  • Intersegmental/Cross-Sector coordination — Track record of building alignment across institutional boundaries with competing priorities.
  • Organizational leadership — Experience leading a distributed team of 50+ through an executive leadership structure.
  • Data-informed operations — Comfort with data systems, student data privacy and related legal requirements, and using evidence to drive strategy.
  • Financial stewardship — Budgeting, forecasting, resource allocation, and managing state funding relationships.
  • Equity-centered strategy — Demonstrated ability to translate equity commitments into organizational policy, hiring, and partnerships.
  • Nonprofit and public-sector context — Understanding regulatory compliance, contracting, and the constraints of operating as a public-facing nonprofit.

Leadership Qualities

  • Integrity and trustworthiness — Authentic, transparent, and consistent in word and action.
  • Relationship-first approach — Builds coalition through genuine engagement, not positional authority.
  • Humility and curiosity — Enters with respect for what the team has built; listens before acting.
  • Political sophistication — Comfortable in ambiguity; reads institutional dynamics and acts accordingly.
  • Courageous advocacy — Willing to champion CCGI's mission and its team in high-stakes settings.
  • Communication clarity — Can articulate complex intersegmental work to legislators, educators, and students alike.
  • Vulnerability and self-reflection — Models the feedback culture CCGI values, including Nonviolent Communication.
  • Long-term commitment — Sees this as a calling, not a stepping stone.

Cultural Alignment

CCGI's team culture is built on nine characteristics that are deeply embedded in how the organization works. The next leader must not only endorse these qualities but model them daily:

Collaboration and learning · Data-driven practices · Direct feedback

Documentation · Due diligence and preparation · Professionalism and kindness

Self-reflection · Strategic thinking · Vulnerability

The Executive Director sets the tone for this culture and is expected to model, provide, and receive feedback using the Nonviolent Communication framework.

What we Offer

FoundationCCC is fully committed to a “remote-first” philosophy, and recruits and hires talent across the state in fully remote positions, where virtual work is possible. Our headquarters are located in Downtown Sacramento, just blocks from California’s State Capitol.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, generous PTO, and paid holidays
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts (HSA), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Wellness offerings
  • CalPERS retirement program and optional 403(b) and 457 Retirement plans
  • Carrot reproductive health and fertility support
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness certified employer

Working Hours, Location, and Travel

Hours: Full-time position, 40 hours per week, with additional hours needed to address the organization’s needs.

Location: California-based with the flexibility to work remotely (in California).

Travel: Regular daytime travel and in-person attendance at events and meetings within the state to align with the needs of the institutions in the state. Overnight travel (up to 20%) by land and air.


For the full job description,.

$220,000.00 - $240,000.00

JOB TITLE: Emergency Preparedness and Response Consultant

TYPE OF CONTRACT: CST

UNIT/DIVISION: Venezuela Country Office

DUTY STATION (City, Country): Caracas, Venezuela

DURATION: 3 months, with the possibility of renewal.


ABOUT WFP:

The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) is the world's leading humanitarian organization addressing hunger and promoting food security. WFP saves lives in emergencies and supports people in building resilient livelihoods and achieving sustainable food security and nutrition outcomes. Every year, WFP assists more than 100 million people worldwide.

In Venezuela, WFP operates under its Interim Country Strategic Plan (iCSP) 2023-2026, aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2023-2026, the Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP), and the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. WFP’s objective is to support vulnerable populations in improving their food security, nutrition, resilience and livelihoods through integrated and complementary interventions.

BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:

The World Food Programme (WFP) in Venezuela is strengthening its emergency preparedness and response capacities to address current and emerging humanitarian needs while supporting national systems and government counterparts. The Country Office is currently managing multiple preparedness and response priorities, including earthquake response and recovery efforts, anticipatory action implementation, preparedness for the potential impacts of the El Niño phenomenon, and the continuous enhancement of contingency planning and institutional readiness.

Against this backdrop, WFP seeks an Emergency Preparedness and Response (EPR) Consultant to provide technical leadership and coordination support to ensure the CO maintains a high level of preparedness and operational readiness while advancing strategic initiatives in disaster risk management and emergency response.


KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Under the direct supervision of the Head of Programme, the EPR Officer in coordination with the EPR team based in Caracas and field offices will support the design, coordination, implementation of preparedness and response activities, ensuring WFP and partners are equipped to effectively anticipate, prepare for and respond to humanitarian emergencies in Venezuela. Main responsabilities will include:

1. Lead and support WFP’s emergency preparedness and emergency response activities, including earthquake response and the design and implementation of early recovery interventions.

2. Support preparedness, contingency planning and operational readiness for potential El Niño impacts in 2027, including scenario development and response planning.

3. Support with the development, update and maintain CONOPS, contingency plans, preparedness tools and emergency response frameworks to strengthen institutional readiness.

4. Provide technical guidance and support to the EPR team and WFP Field Offices in the planning, implementation, reporting of emergency preparedness and emergency response activities.

5. Strengthen disaster risk management systems and preparedness capacities through collaboration with government counterparts, UN agencies, humanitarian clusters, NGOs and other strategic partners.

6. Coordinate with LACRO, Regional Bureau and relevant headquarters technical units to ensure timely information sharing, access to technical support, surge capacity and alignment with regional and corporate EPR priorities.

7. Monitor evolving humanitarian, climate, socioeconomic and operational risks, providing analysis and recommendations to strengthen WFP’s preparedness and response capacity.

8. Support resource mobilization efforts through the identification and follow-up of funding opportunities related to preparedness, anticipatory action and emergency response.

9. Prepare strategic and operational inputs for internal and external reporting, donor briefings, resource mobilization materials, after-action reviews, lessons learned exercises and senior management decision-making.

10. Perform any other duties necessary to support the Venezuela earthquake response and broader emergency preparedness and response priorities of the Country Office.


DELIVERABLES:

• Updated emergency preparedness and response framework for the Country Office.

• Updated CONOPS and contingency planning documents for priority risk scenarios.

• Operational preparedness plan for potential El Niño-related impacts in 2027.

• Develop earthquake response and early recovery interventions plan.


QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE

Education: Advanced university degree (master’s degree or equivalent) in international affairs, economics, agriculture, business administration, social sciences, development studies, humanitarian action, disaster risk management, public policy, or another field relevant to international humanitarian assistance. A first university degree with additional years of relevant experience may be accepted in lieu of an advanced degree, where applicable.


Experience:

• At least five years of progressively responsible postgraduate professional experience relevant to emergency preparedness, humanitarian response, programme management, food security, coordination or related fields.

• Demonstrated experience supporting emergency preparedness and response operations, preferably in sudden-onset disasters such as earthquakes, floods, hurricanes or other large-scale shocks.

• Experience working with government counterparts, UN agencies, NGOs, donors and community-based actors in complex operational environments.

• Experience supporting programme design, operational planning, information management, reporting, partner coordination and field-level implementation support.

• Experience in Latin America and the Caribbean, Venezuela or comparable contexts is desirable.


Knowledge and skills:

• Strong understanding of food security, emergency food assistance, shock-responsive social protection, community-based assistance and early recovery approaches.

• Knowledge of the UN system, humanitarian coordination architecture, inter-agency response planning and government-led emergency response systems.

• Ability to coordinate across multiple functions and partners, manage competing priorities, synthesize complex information and support timely management decisions.

• Strong information management, analytical writing and presentation skills, including the ability to produce concise briefs, trackers, dashboards and operational updates.

• Ability to work independently, take initiative, manage sensitive coordination processes and maintain constructive relationships under pressure.

• Good understanding of protection, gender, disability inclusion and accountability to affected populations in emergency response planning.

• Willingness and ability to travel frequently to affected areas, subject to security and access conditions

Languages:

Fluency in Spanish and English, both oral and written, is required.

$118,000 - $125,000 per year

title: Events Lead
description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to growth, we are seeking an experienced Events Lead to take complete ownership of our events programme and build CuspAI's events function from the ground up.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building the global events engine that accelerates CuspAI and the AI Materials Foundry, which is critical for driving real-world impact of our work across international markets.

Your main focus initially will be executing our flagship in-person Foundry event and subsequent international roadshows across Asia and Europe. Over time you will build out a repeatable event model, assemble an agile agency and vendor network, and establish CuspAI’s experiential presence across global scientific and machine learning conferences. As the team scales, the function will also own internal events.

What You Will Do

Foundry Events & Global Roadshows

  • Own our flagship in-person Foundry event end to end, establishing the core gathering for our global partner network.

  • With our Partnerships team, design, plan, and deliver a regional roadshow of Foundry events across Asia, Europe and North America, creating a repeatable execution model for international expansion.

  • Establish and manage a regular cadence of virtual events to keep the global Foundry ecosystem engaged between physical moments.

Customer & Partner Experiences

  • With Comms/Marketing and Partnerships, conceptualise and execute high-touch events for industrial partners and enterprise customers (e.g. executive dinners, interactive virtual showcases, and partner roundtables).

  • Align event formats with commercial and ecosystem goals to deepen partner trust and engagement.

Conferences, Sponsorships & Internal Events

  • Own CuspAI's strategic presence at major industry and machine learning conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, and materials science summits).

  • Evaluate sponsorship packages, oversee booth design and recruitment stands, manage on-site logistics, and report on return on investment.

  • Partner with internal operations teams to help deliver internal company moments (e.g. CuspCon, company offsites, and all-hands).

Event Operations & Physical Brand Experience

  • Source, negotiate with, and direct external production agencies, AV suppliers, local vendors, and freelance event staff.

  • Partner closely with Communications, Product Marketing, and Creative teams to bring CuspAI's visual brand identity into physical spaces.

  • Own event budgets, timelines, and post-event analytics, providing clear reporting to leadership on performance and cost efficiency.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You are someone who gets excited about enabling world-class scientists and industry partners to collaborate on global sustainability and materials challenges.

  • 5+ years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or event operations within a high-growth tech, deep-tech, or B2B environment.

  • Track record of delivering high-touch physical and virtual events internationally across EMEA and APAC regions.

  • Strong vendor management experience, with a history of sourcing, negotiating with, and directing production agencies, AV teams, and freelance staff.

  • Proven ability to balance strategic planning (e.g. budget management, roadmap design, ROI measurement) with hands-on, on-site event execution.

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder skills, with experience collaborating directly with executive leadership, sales, partnerships, and creative teams.

  • Flexibility to undertake regular UK and international travel for events, conferences, and site visits.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment building an event function or operational processes from scratch.

  • Direct experience engaging scientific, research-led, or highly technical audiences.

  • Familiarity with event management software, virtual event tools, and CRM systems (e.g. HubSpot, event platforms).

  • An eye for spatial design, environmental branding, or experiential production.

Additional Considerations

This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

title: Supply Chain Coordinator – indkøb, logistik, leverandørkontakt
description:
Gasoline Grill serverer 100 % økologiske burgere af helt friske råvarer. Bøfferne hakkes hver morgen på vores lokationer, er håndformede og burgerne er made-to-order. På den måde serverer vi altid fuldstændig friske burgere og spilder så lidt råvarer som overhovedet muligt.

Det stiller store krav til vores supply chain. Vi modtager dagligt leverancer ude i lokationerne og vi stiller store krav til vores leverandører. Den nye Supply Chain Coordinator skaber struktur og opfølgning omkring indkøb og er det daglige bindeled mellem Gasoline Grill, vores leverandører og vores logistikpartner.

Supply Chain Coordinator er en nyoprettet rolle i organisationen, der skaber struktur og opfølgning omkring indkøb og er det daglige bindeled mellem Gasoline Grill, vores leverandører og vores logistikpartner.

**SUPPLY CHAIN COORDINATOR FÅR DET OVERORDNEDE PRIMÆRE ANSVAR FOR:

**

  • At vores lokationer altid har de rigtige varer i den rigtige kvalitet til den rigtige tid i alle vores lokationer.
  • At vi har styr på leverandører, priser, aftaler og ikke mindst claims samt de mange praktiske detaljer omkring vores vareindkøb.
  • Daglig opfølgning på leverancer og bestillinger.
  • Daglig kontakt og opfølgning med leverandører.

**HERUDOVER ER SUPPLY CHAIN COORDINATOR ANSVARLIG FOR:

**

  • Mindre leverandører og mindre varekategorier.
  • At indhente tilbud og forhandle priser og vilkår på mindre indkøb.
  • At sikre at aftalte priser, betingelser og specifikationer bliver overholdt.
  • At vedligeholde overblik over leverandører, produkter, priser, kontrakter og aftaler.

Og er desuden supporter til de større og vigtigste leverandørforhandlinger, som varetages af CEO.

**HANDS-ON SUPPLY CHAIN-/INDKØBSPERSONLIGHED

**Vi leder ikke nødvendigvis efter en person med mange års ledelseserfaring. Vi leder efter en person, der er:

  • Erfaren fra et lignende job med logistik, indkøb og/eller leverandørkontakt
  • Meget struktureret. Det vil sige har orden i sine ting, kan planlægge og tænke flere dage frem
  • God til at følge op
  • Kommercielt tænkende
  • Stærk med tal og Excel
  • Vedholdende over for leverandører
  • Komfortabel med at stille krav og følge dem til dørs
  • Detaljeorienteret uden at miste overblikket
  • God til at kommunikere med både leverandører og interne kolleger

Erfaring fra foodservice, restaurant, retail, FMCG, procurement eller supply chain er en fordel.

Og så skal man kunne tale og skrive dansk og engelsk og kunne begynde dagens arbejde med at tale med lokationerne, når de modtager varer omkring 07:30/08:00 hver morgen.

**What We Offer

**Du bliver en del af Gasoline Grill på et spændende tidspunkt i vores udvikling.

Supply Chain Coordinator er en nyoprettet rolle, og du får derfor en reel mulighed for at være med til at bygge funktionen op og sætte retningen for, hvordan vi arbejder med supply chain fremover.

Vi tilbyder firmabetalt pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring og betalt forældreorlov.

**DERUDOVER TILBYDER VI:

**

  • En ny rolle med reelt ansvar og mulighed for at gøre en synlig forskel.
  • Muligheden for at bygge noget op fra bunden og skabe struktur, processer og bedre arbejdsgange.
  • Et job med stor variation, hvor du både arbejder operationelt og kommercielt.
  • Mulighed for at udvikle rollen og dit ansvar i takt med, at Gasoline Grill vokser.
  • En dynamisk og entreprenant arbejdsplads, hvor beslutninger bliver truffet hurtigt, og hvor gode idéer kan blive til virkelighed.

Vi kan tilbyde et spændende job i en meget dynamisk organisation i vækst, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på jobbet og hvor du kan gøre en forskel og tydeligt se resultaterne af dit arbejde.

Har du spørgsmål, så skriv til HR-manager Marcus Bak på bak@gasolinegrill.com.

title: VASTAAVA SAIRAANHOITAJA (määräaikaisuus), Hyvinvointieskoti Pereensaari - Ikifit, Pirkkala
description:
MÄÄRÄAIKAINEN VASTAAVA SAIRAANHOITAJA (määräaikainen työsuhde 7.12. - 28.2.2028)

Meille on tärkeintä, että jokainen asukas saa elää turvallista, arvokasta, yksilöllistä elämää ja että työntekijämme viihtyvät ja voivat hyvin työssään. Työkavereiksi etsimme hyviä tyyppejä.

Perustehtäväsi on vastata yksikön hoidollisesta osaamisesta ja lääkehoidosta. Toimit johtajan apuna ja kykenet sijaistamaan yksikön johtajaa mm. loma-aikoina. Osallistut myös asukkaiden hoitoon ja kuntouttavaan hoivatyöhön.

Edellytämme sairaanhoitajan koulutusta sekä hyvää suomen kielen taitoa, vähintään B2. Sinulla on aiempaa kokemusta sekä vanhusten parista asumispalveluissa että vastuutehtävistä. Ammattioikeus on oltava todennettavissa Valviran rekisteristä. Tehtävään valittavan henkilön on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

Tarjoamme avoimen ja joustavan työilmapiirin, toimivan työympäristön, lakisääteistä laajemmat työterveyspalvelut, ateriaedun sekä ePassin ylläpitämään työkykyäsi. Palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES G24 D mukainen + tehtäväkohtainen lisä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuajalla ja haku sulkeutuu, kun valinta on tehty. Kyseessä on vuoden määräaikainen työsuhde, joka mahdollisesti jatkuu tämän jälkeen.

Olemme savuton työpaikka. Myös hyvinvointikeskusten ja -kotien pihapiirit kuuluvat savuttomaan alueeseen.

Hyvinvointikoti Pereensaari aukeaa joulukuussa 2026. Koti sijaitsee rauhallisella alueella Pyhäjärven läheisyydessä, hyvien kulkuyhteyksien äärellä. Pereensaari on suunniteltu ja tehty kodiksi 30 ikäihmiselle. Yksikerroksiset ja esteettömät tilat yhdistettynä toimivaan pihaan tekevät arjesta sujuvaa ja tarjoavat asukkaille mahdollisuuden omaan rauhaan ja yhdessäoloon.

Ikifit on täysin kotimainen, ikäihmisten palvelujen ammattilainen. Päätehtävämme on tuottaa korkealaatuista, kokonaisvaltaista ja yksilöllistä palvelua asiakkaillemme. Monipuoliset palvelumme parantavat ikäihmisen arkea ja elämänlaatua.

title: Principal Planner
description:
Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Planning & Execution, the Principal Planner will be responsible for executing all elements of end-to-end material planning to support existing product as well as newly launched products with the primary objective of meeting/surpassing customer expectations. The successful candidate will collaborate in the development of rolling 24-month demand forecasts and will be responsible for the planning of material and the transition to Operations Planning.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop the final demand forecasts (operational forecasts) at multiple levels of aggregation for the full-time horizon by channels and by key accounts (if applicable).
  • Play a key role in monthly S&OP development and work closely with the internal sales team key customer representatives in the development of the collaborative forecast.
  • Responsible for providing training or leadership for team members, and planning & assigning personnel to projects or tasks.
  • Ability to capture risk(s) and develop mitigations.
  • Accurate processing of customer demands in the system.
  • Cooperate with Customer Focus Teams for problems of materials availability.
  • Collaborate with Program Manager, Manufacturing Program Manager, and production control for production rescheduling in case of design changes, insufficient materials or labor, backlog, and other potential causes for plan failure.
  • Controls configuration release into the manufacturing BOM via Initial Release, Incremental Release and Engineering Change process in a manner that minimizes impact on execution, customer on-time delivery and inventory.
  • Methodizes the manufacturing BOM that is conducive to the manufacturing execution strategy.
  • Analyze data, including enterprise requirements planning information and prepares consolidated managerial reports as needed to facilitate and recommend/take action to ensure organization/product line optimal supply chain execution.
  • Manage schedule impact of proposed engineering change orders in addition to taking necessary actions to ensure successful implementation and execution of approved engineering product releases/changes.
  • Work closely with the Materials Management team to evaluate product inventory planning and reporting along with detailed level actions to drive improvement and minimize Excess and Obsolete Inventory in assigned programs.
  • Be a liaison between the New Program teams and Operations for all assigned products.
  • Manage tight deadlines in a low volume, high mix, fast paced, matrixed environment.
  • Monitoring and report metrics including, on time delivery, missing allocations, and production throughput.
  • Meet deadlines to avoid material shortages and delays on assigned tasking based on the master build plan.
  • Partnering with inventory, Quality, Engineer, program office, and production to communicate changes in material demand, facilitate effective material/WIP movement, and maintain appropriate level load plan.
  • Minimize risk of exposure to excess/overstock finish goods.
  • Provides commitment dates and updates to Program Office and Management.
  • Complete other duties as assigned by your supervisor in support of customer deliveries.

This position requires you to access information that is subject to U.S. export regulations. You may only access such information if you are a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. government.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
  • Typically requires minimum of 6+ years’ experience in planning and/or scheduling, inventory control in a manufacturing environment.
  • Thorough understanding MRP systems and SIOP process is preferred.
  • Experience with electronics manufacturing preferred.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Products, with heavy emphasis on Excel required.
  • Experience reading a multilevel BOM, drawings, and specifications is required.
  • Familiarity with outside processing preferred.
  • Must be able to comprehend and perform duties in accordance with an AS9100D Quality System.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • CPIM or CSCP certified

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

title: Regional Director, Intermountain West (Idaho, Montana, Wyoming)
description:
The Jed Foundation (JED) is a nonprofit that protects emotional health and prevents suicide among the nation’s teens and young adults. JED’s School Programs and Consulting (SPC) division partners with high schools, districts, colleges, and community-based organizations to assess student needs, build customized strategic plans, and provide sustained technical assistance that leads to measurable improvements in student mental health. The Regional Director, Intermountain West will serve as JED’s representative and relationship-builder across Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming; three frontier states where geographic distance, workforce shortages, and fragmented local systems make coordinated, trusted regional infrastructure essential. This is a hybrid strategic and operational leadership role: the Director will build JED’s brand and network across the region, generate and cultivate new partnership and business opportunities, and help lead and support, in a matrixed capacity, the region’s Consultants delivering JED’s District Mental Health Initiative (DMHI) and other school-based programming, and represent the full breadth of JED’s work — schools and districts first, alongside JED’s programming for community-based organizations (CBOs) to education leaders, state agencies, coalitions, funders, and (as JED’s merger with AFSP progresses) AFSP chapters across the three states. The Director generates leads for new school and community partnerships, opens doors, and builds the relationships that make new opportunities possible, then coordinates closely with JED’s School Partnerships team to convert those opportunities into signed engagements. Success in this role depends on deep relationship-building instincts, comfort operating as a public-facing ambassador, and the management skill to lead a small, geographically dispersed regional consulting team. This is a remote, Intermountain West–based position with regular travel across Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming (approximately 40–50%) and periodic travel to JED’s NYC headquarters. Candidates should reside in the Mountain West Region

Key Responsibilities

Regional Brand-Building, Relationship Cultivation & Convening (30%)
  • Serve as JED’s primary face and voice across Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming, building JED’s name recognition and credibility among education and mental health leaders in a region where JED’s brand is still emerging.
  • Build and steward relationships with key state and regional entities, including state Departments of Education, Departments of Health and Human Services, Tribal education authorities, and regional education associations.
  • Cultivate relationships with community-based organizations (youth-serving, school-adjacent) and local nonprofits, and with philanthropic partners active in the region, including funders such as The Ortus Foundation.
  • Represent JED in influential relationship-building spaces, including community coalitions, advisory boards, task forces, and public forums positioning JED as a convener that brings together local partners, CBOs, and funders around shared youth mental health goals, not only as a service provider.
  • Serve as JED’s regional liaison to AFSP chapters across Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming as JED’s merger with AFSP advances, identifying opportunities for AFSP chapters to engage in and support JED’s regional work.
New Business Development & Lead Generation (20%)
  • Identify and cultivate new leads and partnership opportunities with districts, high schools, and CBOs across the region.
  • Coordinate closely and consistently with JED’s School Partnerships team, handing off qualified leads and supporting the relationship context needed to close new district and school engagements.
  • Track and manage the regional pipeline of prospective partners, using Salesforce or other CRM tools to document engagement and coordinate handoffs.
  • Identify opportunities to align JED’s work with existing state initiatives and funding streams to expand reach and long-term sustainability.
Team Leadership & Program Oversight (30%)
  • Matrix-manage JED’s regional Senior Consultants/Consultants delivering the District Mental Health Initiative and other school-based programming across Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming in close partnership with the Senior Director, District Programs.
  • Provide mentorship, coaching, and performance management; monitor caseloads and ensure program milestones and quality standards are met across the regional portfolio.
  • Coordinate across the region’s consulting team to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery of JED’s Comprehensive Approach to Mental Health Promotion and Suicide Prevention for Districts.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and future scaling of regional consulting capacity as JED’s presence in the Intermountain West grows.
Ambassador for JED’s Full Program Portfolio (15%)
  • Serve as spokesperson and ambassador for the full range of JED’s programs and relationships including JED High School, JED and AASA’s District Mental Health Initiative, JED Campus, and JED’s CBO-focused trainings and programming with the deepest focus on JED’s work in schools, and specifically districts and high schools.
  • Attend and present at regional conferences and convenings, sharing JED’s model and advocating for comprehensive, systems-based mental health programming.
  • Serve as a thought leader on emotional health promotion and suicide prevention tailored to the frontier and rural context of the Intermountain West.
Division-Wide Support (5%)
  • Work closely with SPC leadership on regional strategy, team culture, and cross-team initiatives.
  • Contribute regional insight to the design and refinement of JED’s programmatic and consulting materials, particularly as they relate to frontier, rural, and tribal communities.
  • Other duties as assigned by JED leadership related to regional programming and partnerships.
Competencies:
  • Scope and Execution: Operates as a subject matter expert who drives regional strategy and independently identifies stakeholders and resources needed to advance JED’s work.
  • People Leadership & Management: Builds and actively supports matrixed management of a high-performing, geographically dispersed team; coaches, sets expectations, and gives timely feedback.
  • Relationship Building & External Representation: Prioritizes relationship-building as a core function of the role; comfortable convening diverse partners (government, nonprofit, philanthropic) around shared goals.
  • Communication: Communicates JED’s mission and program model clearly to varied audiences, from district superintendents to state agency leaders to funders.
  • Collaboration and Cross-Team Impact: Coordinates seamlessly with School Partnerships, SPC program teams, and JED’s broader leadership to convert relationships into results.
  • JED Citizenship: Represents JED’s mission and Comprehensive Approach with credibility and cultural humility, particularly when engaging Tribal nations and frontier communities.

Skills Knowledge and Expertise

  • Master’s degree in education, educational leadership, counseling, psychology, social work, public health, or related field.
  • Minimum of 7+ years of experience in PK–12 mental health programming, youth-serving nonprofit work, or education leadership, with a focus on suicide prevention preferred.
  • Minimum of 2+ years managing teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
  • Deep knowledge of the Idaho, Montana, and/or Wyoming education and youth mental health landscape, including experience working with frontier, rural, and Tribal communities.
  • Demonstrated track record of building relationships with state agencies, nonprofits, and funders, and identifying new business or partnership opportunities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including comfort presenting to senior leaders, state officials, and community groups.
  • Experience with Salesforce or other CRM/project management tools.
  • Passion for youth mental health and alignment with JED’s Guiding Principles and Shared Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Antiracism.

title: Senior applikationstestare inom SCADA
description:
Om jobbet

Victory Current söker en senior applikationstestare för ett längre konsultuppdrag hos en internationell aktör inom energi- och elkraftsindustrin. Du anställs av Victory Current och får arbeta med tekniskt avancerade system och projekt i en internationell miljö.

Victory Current är ett företag baserat i Västerås som erbjuder tekniska konsulttjänster inom elektroteknik, elkraft och IT.

Rollen passar dig som har flera års erfarenhet av system- och applikationstestning och som har god förståelse för SCADA-system, gärna i stora och komplexa industriella miljöer.

Om tjänsten

Som senior applikationstestare arbetar du med att planera, genomföra och följa upp tester av nya och förändrade IT- och automationslösningar. Du säkerställer att systemens funktionalitet och prestanda uppfyller definierade krav innan leverans och release.

Du kommer att arbeta nära utvecklare, produktägare, projektorganisationer och kunder samt bidra till att utveckla testmetoder och arbetssätt för kontinuerlig kvalitetsförbättring.

Arbetet omfattar bland annat:

  • Genomföra testscenarier och systemtester inför release
  • Ta fram, dokumentera och underhålla testscenarier utifrån definierade krav
  • Testa och verifiera funktionalitet i större och komplexa SCADA-system
  • Testa både frontend-applikationer och backend-servrar
  • Genomföra funktionella tester samt prestanda-, säkerhets- och automationstester
  • Verifiera korrigeringar och säkerställa att identifierade fel är åtgärdade
  • Delta i framtagning av teststrategier och testplaner
  • Utvärdera testprocesser och identifiera möjligheter till testautomation
  • Samarbeta med utvecklare, produktägare, projektledare och kunder
  • Bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar av testprocesser och kvalitet
  • Stödja kollegor och bidra till en stark kvalitetskultur
  • Arbeta med testning i agila utvecklingsmiljöer

Vi söker dig som har

  • Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom datavetenskap, elektroteknik eller motsvarande relevant utbildning
  • Minst 3–5 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom system- eller applikationstestning
  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av SCADA-system
  • Erfarenhet av att utforma och underhålla systemtestscenarier
  • Erfarenhet av funktionell testning, systemtestning och testmetodik
  • Erfarenhet av prestandatestning, säkerhetstestning och/eller testautomation
  • Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt, exempelvis Scrum
  • Praktisk erfarenhet av verktyg som Azure DevOps, Jira och Confluence
  • Goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift
  • Förmåga att kommunicera tekniskt komplex information på ett tydligt och strukturerat sätt
  • Erfarenhet av Linux
  • Kunskap om nätverksprotokoll

Kunskap och praktisk erfarenhet av SCADA är ett krav för tjänsten.

Det är meriterande om du har ISTQB-certifiering eller motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet inom testområdet.

Personliga egenskaper

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara strukturerad, analytisk och kvalitetsmedveten. Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och har förmåga att självständigt planera och genomföra tester.

Du är kommunikativ och trivs med att samarbeta med utvecklare, projektorganisationer och andra tekniska specialister. Du har också lätt för att sätta dig in i komplexa tekniska system och förklara testresultat och tekniska frågeställningar på ett tydligt sätt.

Vi värdesätter att du är:

  • Noggrann och analytisk
  • Lösningsorienterad
  • Självständig och ansvarstagande
  • Kommunikativ och samarbetsinriktad
  • Strukturerad och kvalitetsmedveten
  • Bekväm med att arbeta i komplexa tekniska miljöer

Anställning och omfattning

Du anställs av Victory Current och arbetar som konsult i uppdraget.

  • Anställningsform: Särskild visstidsanställning
  • Placeringsort: Västerås
  • Omfattning: Heltid, 100 procent
  • Anställningsperiod: 2 november 2026 till och med 29 oktober 2027
  • Arbetsform: Arbetet utförs på plats i Västerås


Inför anställningen behöver slutkandidaten genomgå en bakgrundskontroll och ett drogtest samt underteckna ett sekretessavtal. Intyg för SSG Entré kommer också att krävas.

Ansökan

Skicka din ansökan och ditt CV på engelska i Word-format till Victory Current.

Ditt CV ska tydligt beskriva din utbildning och erfarenhet av applikations- och systemtestning, SCADA-system, testmetodik, testscenarier samt relevanta testverktyg och tekniker.

Ta bort eventuella fotografier och företagslogotyper från dokumentet.

Urval och intervjuer genomförs löpande, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag.

title: TRIRIGA Business Analyst- India (Remote, WFH)
description:
Job Title: TRIRIGA Business Analyst- India

Location: India- Remote
Job Type: Full-time

About Quantum Strides LLC

Quantum Strides LLC is a premier System Integrator and IBM Gold Business Partner specializing in IBM TRIRIGA and IBM Maximo implementations. Headquartered in Glen Allen, Virginia, with a global presence across India, the Philippines, and Canada, we deliver innovative enterprise solutions by leveraging emerging technologies, including AI-driven automation, cloud, and digital transformation strategies.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced TRIRIGA Business Analyst to join our team. The Business Analyst will act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that TRIRIGA solutions align with organizational needs and industry best practices. The role requires strong TRIRIGA functional knowledge, business process mapping expertise, and familiarity with integration frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document business requirements for TRIRIGA implementations and enhancements.
  • 5+ years of experience in the designing the IBM TRIRIGA System leveraging Out of Box as a baseline.
  • Map business processes into TRIRIGA functional workflows across multiple modules (Lease Administration, Space Management, Capital Projects, Operations & Maintenance, etc.).
  • Prepare functional documentation, user stories, and process flows to guide technical teams. In addition creation of Mock-ups would be required.
  • Support TRIRIGA upgrades, migrations, and deployments, ensuring smooth adoption.
  • Work with technical teams to define and validate integrations using MREF (Maximo Integration Framework), APIs, and web services.
  • Participate in UAT, training, and change management activities to ensure user adoption.
  • Responsible for developing Test strategy, plan and test cases for System testing.
  • Act as a liaison between clients, functional consultants, and developers to ensure project alignment.
  • Ensure solutions follow IBM TRIRIGA and IWMS industry best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 5-8 years of experience as a Business Analyst, with at least 3+ years of TRIRIGA functional consulting.
  • Strong understanding of TRIRIGA modules: Lease Administration, Space & Move Management, O&M, and Capital Projects.
  • Proven experience in TRIRIGA implementations, upgrades, and migrations.
  • Ability to design business process flows and develop functional documentation.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelors degree in Business, Information Systems, or related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with TRIRIGA integrations with ERP, GIS, Workday, or IoT systems.
  • Experience in SQL and Oracle database management is a plus.
  • Knowledge of MAS (Maximo Application Suite) 8.0 and IWMS best practices.
  • Familiarity with MREF (Maximo Real Estate and Facilities) for TRIRIGA integrations.
  • Certifications such as IBM TRIRIGA, PMP, or ITIL.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a globally recognized IBM Business Partner with leading TRIRIGA expertise.
  • Work on enterprise-grade TRIRIGA projectsacross industries.
  • Opportunity to work on enterprise-level IWMS projects with global clients.
  • Collaborative work culture with exposure to cutting-edge AI and enterprise solutions.
  • Flexible remote-first culture with collaboration across global teams.

title: Software Engineer II (Full-Stack)
description:
Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation.

Who we are

We’re Super Group, the NYSE-listed digital gaming company behind some of the world’s leading Sports and iGaming brands, including Betway and Jackpot City. We’re a powerhouse built on ecades of expertise and we’re changing the game for good. Our mission is to give our customers a superclass entertainment experience.

Who we’re looking for

We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At Super Group International, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish and your career can soar.

Ready to become a game-changer? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary.

Why we need you

We’re building experiences that wow our customers – and that starts with bold, curious people who want to do work that matters. If you’re hungry to grow, excited by impact and ready for a challenge that will supercharge your career, this could be your moment. As a software engineer, you will focus on designing and developing robust, scalable, and efficient software solutions on the Javascript and .NET (C#) frameworks. You will be a key contributor to custom software solutions, working closely with other team members to deliver seamless integrations and high-quality products. Your drive and ideas will help us move faster, improve smarter, and stay ahead of the game.

What you’ll do

  • Software Development & Engineering Design, develop, maintain, and enhance front-end and back-end applications in accordance with established software engineering standards and best practices.
  • Develop high-quality, scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Maintain existing systems while proactively identifying opportunities for modernization, enhancement, and performance improvement.
  • Utilize current and emerging technologies to deliver innovative and efficient software solutions.
  • Ensure software architecture and code quality align with organizational standards and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architects to implement architectural designs and technology strategies.
  • Collaboration & Delivery: Collaborate with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Enterprise Architects, and Quality Engineers to deliver software solutions that meet business objectives. Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, sprint planning, and agile development ceremonies. Contribute to the continuous improvement of development methodologies, standards, and engineering practices. Provide technical input into solution design, effort estimation, and delivery planning activities.
  • System Support & Incident Management: Provide second and third-line technical support for software applications deployed within the organization’s technology ecosystem. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical issues impacting production environments. Perform root cause analysis for incidents and implement sustainable corrective actions. Support system upgrades, patches, releases, and deployment activities. Ensure minimal disruption to business operations through effective incident and problem management practices.
  • System Monitoring & Performance Management: Monitor application performance, system stability, and service availability. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, system inefficiencies, and reliability issues. Ensure systems meet defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and operational performance standards. Support proactive monitoring and alerting mechanisms to maintain optimal system health and availability.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Management: Create, maintain, and update comprehensive technical documentation. Ensure documentation remains accurate, current, and accessible for operational support and future development activities. Contribute to knowledge sharing and technical capability development within the engineering team.

This list covers your core responsibilities – with plenty of room to stretch, explore and take on new challenges as we grow.

What you’ll bring

  • 3 to 5 years’ practical experience in the full software development life cycle as a software engineer or software developer.
  • Demonstrates solid understanding of Software Engineering design patterns and/or methodologies.
  • Strong proficiency in object-oriented programming (OOP) principles, with a preference for experience in C# and the .NET framework.
  • Proficient in multiple languages, libraries & frameworks (e.g. C#, JavaScript, Angular, React, Vue, Node.js)
  • Demonstrated experience in designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Designing the database schema to store application data efficiently
  • Proficient in working with relational and nonrelational databases (e.g. SQL Server & MongoDB) and writing efficient TSQL queries.
  • Hands on experience with containerization technologies (e.g. Kubernetes & Docker)
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Strong knowledge of Devops practices, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.
  • Demonstrates solid understanding of Software Testing fundamentals.
  • Demonstrates consistent passion for Technology and keeping up with the industry.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, ensuring high standards of quality in all outputs
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing environments and priorities, maintaining effectiveness in dynamic situations
  • Excellent problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to accurately estimate effort and take ownership for time management and delivery.
  • Strong collaboration and communication abilities.

Desirable skills you’ve got up your sleeve

  • Previous experience in the online gaming or casino industry, with a strong understanding of player behaviour and industry regulations
  • Experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) and writing unit/integration tests.
  • Experience with mobile application development using React Native.
  • Knowledge of in memory datastores (e.g. Redis or Valkey).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g. Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Experience as part of an Agile software engineering team.
  • A good understanding or security principles, Develop reusable Terraform templates for infrastructure as code to improve deployment speed and consistency.
  • Computer Science related degree, diploma, or similar qualification in software engineering.

Our values are non-negotiables

Our culture is underpinned by core values that are linked to key behavioural competencies. Along with the below behavioural competencies, these are essential for all employees in order for you to embed in and drive our culture forward. These competencies are: Adaptability Ownership and accountability Initiating action Resilience Team orientation Integrity Innovation

What you’ll get back

  • Supergrowth is real here. Our learning and development programmes give you the tools, training and opportunities to level up fast.
  • Your progress matters. Our Performance tool ensures you get meaningful feedback to support your development and superdrive your career.
  • Support that has your back. Our Employee Assistance Programme offers resources for you and your family.
  • Group Life Cover

Ready to feel superclass? At Super Group, your experience matters. We’re honest, fair, and focused on helping you succeed – and your work will have real impact from day one.

title: Senior AWS Engineer/Platform Engineer |
description:
Functieomschrijving
Als Platform Engineer heb je ervaring met operations, automatisering en software development. Met die kennis help jij teams om hun werk zo goed mogelijk te laten landen op het cloud native platform.

Jouw functie als Platform Engineer

Als Platform Engineer werk je aan uiteenlopende projecten van meerdere klanten. Je werkt vanuit kantoor, vanuit huis of een paar dagen in de week bij de klant op visite. Wat doet een Platform Engineer hoor je wel eens, maar de vraag is eerder wat doet hij/zij niet? De Platform Engineer vult de grote leegte tussen een blanco cloud, container of CI/CD omgeving en de functionaliteit die DevOps team nodig heeft voor het voortbrengen van software. Je helpt de organisatie graag met alle tooling omtrent CI en CD met in het achterhoofd standaardisatie voor een voorspelbaar cloud landschap. Je hebt dan ook een brede ervaring met automation en scripting in moderne container en public cloud omgevingen. Metrieken zijn jouw vriend en helpen je om pro-actief te acteren. Jouw interesse stopt niet bij een platform, maar je ademt DevOps en wilt het verschil maken bij succesvolle implementaties. Precies daarom hebben we jou graag in ons team. En aangezien je zelf een vakidioot bent, werk jij ook graag samen met andere vakidioten.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een salaris van tussen de €3.600,- en €6.000,- o.b.v. 40 uur aangevuld met bonussysteem, afhankelijk van jouw achtergrond en ervaring

  • Een omgeving waarin het hybride werken compleet omarmd wordt

  • Duik in moderne projecten en opdrachten die jouw expertise en creativiteit uitdagen

  • Werken in een team waar jouw ideeën en initiatieven worden gewaardeerd en gestimuleerd

  • Technische trainingen op maat met certificaten die jouw expertise onderstrepen

  • Persoonlijk loopbaantraject, met alle ruimte om je eigen carrière pad te bewandelen

  • Samenwerking met ervaren collega’s in data, cloud en security

Wat vragen wij van jou?

  • Een afgeronde hbo of wo opleiding, of autodidact met de juiste werkervaring

  • Goede zelfkennis, weten wat je kunt en vooral ook wat je niet kunt

  • Sterke affiniteit met techniek

  • Analytisch denkvermogen

  • Kritisch op kwaliteit, maar waar nodig pragmatisch

  • Goede communicatieve en sociale vaardigheden, we praten graag

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal

Verder heb je

  • Je kunt uiteraard de weg vinden binnen Linux

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal

Deze eisen geven een richting aan het profiel dat wij zoeken voor deze functie. Voldoe jij niet aan alle eisen maar denk je wel dat dit de functie voor jou is? Dan nodigen wij je graag uit om te solliciteren.

Het team

Naast dat jij de juiste skills en interesses hebt, vinden we het belangrijk dat je past in het team. Wij zoeken iemand die het fijn vindt om in een hechte en fijne sfeer bezig te zijn met zijn of haar passie. Deze passie heeft bij iedereen een andere uiting. De een is wild van Cloud, de ander is gek van Development of Integratie. Een andere groep zit met smart te wachten op datasets waar ingedoken kan worden. Ons uitgangspunt is dat jij je goed moet voelen in wat je doet en met wie je werkt. Alleen dan kunnen wij als kennisclub namelijk de kwaliteit leveren die we beloven.

Ons kennisarsenaal is onderverdeeld in drie elkaar overlappende disciplines: Integratie & API, Applicatie Modernisatie en Data Driven. Binnen deze specialismen wordt er voortdurend verkennend gekeken naar de nieuwste en natuurlijk coolste technologieën. Directe en nauwe samenwerking onderling is ook hierin ‘a way of life’.

We're looking for a backend engineer to join the Repeats team. You will work on the services that decide which repeat customers get a loan, at what price, and how much they can borrow. The Repeats team is one of iwoca's funnel teams. We grow customer lifetime value after a business's first loan. You will own backend features end-to-end, from design through to shipping and monitoring them in production. Over time, you will pick up frontend work and grow into a full-stack role.

Impact on customers

Work on the systems that shape every repeat customer's offer, and move the metrics behind iwoca's back-book performance. Ship features that make it faster and clearer for small business owners to access follow‑on funding.

Ownership and delivery

Work through the full development lifecycle - from technical design and implementation to rollout behind a split test - on well-defined components. Show up to team rituals - stand-ups, retros, planning - with context and questions. Write clean, well‑tested Python, and take part in code reviews to learn from teammates and keep quality high. Pick up frontend work in Pandora (React, TypeScript) so you can own features end-to-end over time.

You care how your work affects customers, and use experiments and metrics to guide decisions. You have experience of writing automated tests and take code quality and safe releases seriously. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour and high‑stakes decisions. description:
Salgs- og Helserådgiver til Helsam i Amager Centret

Salgs- og Helserådgiver til Helsam i Amager Centret

Har du fingeren på pulsen indenfor helsebranchen?_
Og kan du give vores kunder den bedste oplevelse, når de handler vores skønne helseprodukter?_

Vi har travlt og søger derfor en dygtig og ansvarsbevidst Salgs- og Helserådgiver på 37 timer til vores Helsam butik i Amager Centret. Hvis du er energisk, smilende og kan lide at arbejde i et højt tempo, er du måske den rette for os.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde?

  • En travl og lærerig hverdag, hvor trivsel og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd med din motivation for at skabe resultater sammen med resten af teamet.
  • Engagerede kollegaer, som du kan sparre og videreudvikle dig sammen med.
  • Inspirerende miljø med fokus på sundere livsstil.

De salgs- og Helserådgivere, som trives rigtig godt i Helsam, har

  • erfaring med salg og brænder for mersalg og rådgivning af kunder
  • et højt energiniveau og en positiv livsindstilling og forventer en travl og til tider uforudsigelig hverdag
  • stor interesse i sunde alternativer

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • har viden om og interesse for helsekost
  • er ansvarsbevidst og selvkørende
  • trives i et dynamisk miljø med højt tempo
  • er proaktiv og tager initiativ

Arbejdssted

Helsam, Amager Centret, Reberbanegade 3, 2300 København S

Arbejdstider

Vi har brug for, at du efter nærmere aftale kan tage vagter i tidsrummet - hverdage mellem kl. 10-19.00, samt weekend mellem kl. 10-17.00

Tiltrædelse

Hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på de rette medarbejdere.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Butikschef June Ahlstrand på telefon 32 57 52 00

Samtaler foregår løbende og annoncering stoppes, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vær med til at forme fremtidens Helsam
Hos Helsam arbejder vi for en naturlig tilgang til sundhed og velvære. Vi ved, at krop og sind hænger sammen, og har fokus på at støtte kroppens egne processer. For os handler sundhed ikke om én vej – men om at finde det, der passer for den enkelte. Derfor er personlig, faglig rådgivning en central del af vores tilgang.

Med mere end 40 års erfaring er vi blandt de førende i Danmark inden for kosttilskud, økologiske fødevarer og personlig pleje. Gennem vores 30 butikker og Helsam.dk er vi tæt på vores kunder – både fysisk og digitalt.

Vi er i gang med en transformation, hvor vi styrker forbrugerfokus, sortiment og kundeoplevelse. Som medarbejder er du med til at forme næste kapitel.

Helsam er en del af Helsam Gruppen, som også rummer Mecindo og en B2B-forretning for behandlere og forhandlere. Vi er 250 medarbejdere fordelt mellem vores 35 butikker og kontorer i Sønderborg og København – alle med en fælles ambition om at gøre en naturlig tilgang til sundhed til en ny standard.

title: Van Data Analist naar Data Engineer
description:
Je bent data analist en wil meer bouwen aan de achterkant: stabiele datapipelines, slimme modellen en betrouwbare platforms. In ons 1,5-jarig programma groei je stap voor stap naar de rol van volwaardig Data Engineer. Je werkt projectmatig bij een opdrachtgever, met ruimte om jouw route te kiezen. Blijf jezelf voor: we helpen je vooruit, op jouw manier. Na 1,5 jaar kun je na jouw opleiding in dienst treden bij de opdrachtgever!

Dit ga je doen
  • Je volgt een leerroute richting Data Engineer en past die direct toe in je opdracht.
  • Je ontwerpt en bouwt datapipelines (batch en/of realtime) en zet ETL-processen op, dit zodat je geen frustratie meer ervaart omdat je zelf bepaalt hoe duurzaam en robuust het gebouwd wordt. Dit doe je samen met collega’s.
  • Je werkt mee aan het ontwerpen en bouwen van een dataplatform binnen een Microsoft Azure omgeving, waarbij je data uit verschillende bronnen samenbrengt en ontsluit. Dit doe je middels de Medaillion architectuur.
  • Je modelleert data en levert datasets op die klaar zijn voor rapportages en analyses.
  • Je borgt kwaliteit met testen, monitoring en heldere documentatie, bijvoorbeeld via Microsoft Purview.
  • Je stemt af met stakeholders; de inhoud verschilt per opdrachtgever en project

Je bent fit for the job als je...
  • je minimaal 3 jaar ervaring hebt als data analist, data scientist of BI developer.
  • je een hbo- of wo-diploma hebt behaald in Informatica, Data Science, (Technische) Bedrijfskunde, (Toegepaste) Wiskunde, Econometrie of vergelijkbaar.
  • je een stevige basis hebt in Power BI en Python en/of SQL
  • je ervaring hebt opgedaan met data modelleren binnen een cloud (Microsoft Azure) omgeving is een pré.
  • je enige ervaring hebt met Azure Datafactory, Databricks/Spark, dbt, CI/CD (Azure DevOps), Tests & Monitoring en/of Git workflows of soortgelijke tools zijn een sterke pré.
  • Je jezelf committeert aan een ontwikkeltraject van 1,5 jaar en beschikbaar bent voor 36-40 uur per week.

Dit krijg je van ons

We bieden een salaris tussen de 3.800 en 6.000 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week passend bij je ervaring en expertise.

Vanuit jouw rol als data analist groei je op opdracht naar een data engineer. Wij zorgen voor passende opdrachten die deze ontwikkeling stap voor stap mogelijk maken. Het ontwikkelprogramma ondersteunt je hierin en versnelt jouw groei naar een volwaardig data engineer. Je volgt praktische trainingen waarin je erkende certificeringen behaalt richting de Azure stack, krijgt coaching van je performance manager en maakt deel uit van een groep die dezelfde ontwikkeling doormaakt. Juist door samen te leren en ervaringen te delen, versnellen jullie elkaars groei.


Klik hier voor onze onepager met alle belangrijke informatie die je nodig hebt voordat je besluit te solliciteren op dit programma!

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist
Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is, of het nu gaat om een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis. Dat doen we door slimmer te werken, ideeën van papier naar praktijk te brengen en de juiste mensen op de juiste plek te zetten. Voor grote transformaties én snelle oplossingen. Van start up tot multinational: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Binnen team Technology werken we in twee focusgebieden: Data & Analytics en IT. Jij maakt onderdeel uit van Team Data & Analytics, samen met zo’n 35 professionals binnen een unit van 100 specialisten. Onze cultuur is business casual: hard werken, veel humor en volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

title: Data Engineer, Ad Data
description:
Responsibilities

Ad Data is the cornerstone of every business decision that millions of advertisers make every day on TikTok. Therefore, we are tasked with innovating on a daily basis to create and maintain complex systems at large scale and continue expanding the capacity to better serve advertisers growing at an exponential pace.

You will share in the ownership of the technical vision and direction for advanced Ad Data products. You will be a part of a team of top notch technical professionals developing scalable systems and with a focus on sustained operational excellence. We are looking for people who are highly motivated by aiming for the highest, moving fast, and changing the way customers use data to drive profitability.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, Computer Science or Mathematics.
  • At least 2 years of experience in the data warehouse space.
