  • At least 2 years of experience working with big data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark, etc., and a minimum of 2 years of experience with SQL statements.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one programming language, e.g., Python; familiarity with AI tools and hands-on experience applying them to improve productivity and problem-solving.
  • Good communication skills, including the ability to identify and communicate data-driven insights.

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

title: Director of Wholesale Operations
description:
Company Overview

Welcome to Timewise, where great people power great experiences! Shell Mobility & Convenience proudly operates more than 200 Timewise convenience stores and Shell fuel stations across Texas and New Mexico. As part of the Shell Group since 2022, we combine the strength of a global organization with a welcoming, team-oriented culture. We are committed to providing exceptional customer experiences while creating meaningful career growth opportunities for our employees.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Director, Wholesale Operations to lead the operational performance, dealer relationships, and growth of our wholesale fuel network across a multi-state fuels and convenience retail business.

Reporting to the VP of Wholesale Operations, this leader will be accountable for executing the wholesale strategy across our dealer network, with a strong focus on network growth, dealer retention, fuel volume and profitability, operational excellence, and dealer satisfaction.

The successful candidate will combine strong fuels and convenience retail knowledge, commercial acumen, dealer relationship management, and operational discipline to grow and strengthen the wholesale network while improving the performance of the existing portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Wholesale Network Growth: Develop and execute plans to grow the dealer network through new-to-network dealers, competitive conversions, acquisitions, and other strategic growth opportunities.
  • Dealer Acquisition & Onboarding: Partner with commercial teams to identify and pursue prospective dealers, develop compelling dealer value propositions, and ensure effective onboarding of new locations.
  • Dealer Performance & Retention: Build strong dealer relationships and proactively improve site performance, fuel volumes, profitability, customer experience, and dealer retention.
  • Wholesale Operations: Lead day-to-day operational management of the wholesale network, translating business priorities into clear processes, standards, and performance expectations.
  • Field Leadership: Lead and develop the wholesale field organization, establishing clear accountabilities and building a high-performance, customer-focused culture.
  • Network Optimization: Assess portfolio performance, identify growth and competitive opportunities by market, and develop actions to strengthen the quality and profitability of the dealer network.
  • Contract Execution & Renewals: Ensure effective execution of dealer agreements and commercial commitments and proactively support contract renewals and retention of high-value dealers.
  • Brand & Site Standards: Drive consistent execution of brand, image, customer experience, and operating standards while effectively supporting independently operated dealer businesses.
  • Dealer Programs: Drive dealer adoption of fuel, loyalty, payment, marketing, technology, and other enterprise programs that strengthen the overall dealer value proposition.
  • Issue Resolution: Lead cross-functional resolution of dealer issues involving supply, transportation, pricing, payments, technology, maintenance, marketing, and other operational areas.
  • Performance Management: Establish and monitor dealer and network KPIs, identify performance gaps and growth opportunities, and implement action plans to deliver results.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Supply, Pricing, Transportation, Marketing, Finance, IT, Legal, Real Estate, and other teams to deliver an integrated dealer experience and support network growth.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant leadership experience in fuel wholesale, dealer operations, petroleum marketing, convenience retail, or a related multi-site business.
  • Demonstrated experience in growing and managing a dealer/wholesale network, including dealer acquisition, retention, and competitive conversions.
  • Strong understanding of dealer business models, fuel retail economics, contracts, and site operations.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen with a focus on volume, margin, profitability, network growth, and return on investment.
  • Proven ability to build trusted dealer relationships and negotiate mutually beneficial commercial arrangements.
  • Experience leading and developing geographically dispersed field teams.
  • Strong negotiation, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution capabilities.
  • Ability to influence across functions and mobilize teams around complex growth and operational opportunities.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Finance, Marketing, or related discipline preferred.

description:

We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. As a member of our Solutions Architecture team, you’ll play a critical role in the success of our customers, products and position in the marketplace. Our Architects tackle the most difficult business and technology problems across a vast array of industries and technologies. As a Solutions Architect at ExtraHop, you will never be bored again.

  • Analyze customer network topologies and application stacks; develop strategies to acquire high-value data from the wire.

  • Conduct root cause analysis of high-profile technology problems and advise customers on their resolution.
  • Develop custom tools using Python and JavaScript-based APIs to extend the functionality of the ExtraHop platform.

  • Create automated tools to streamline repeatable processes and maximize time spent building intelligent solutions.
  • Conduct hands-on learning sessions with key customer personnel.

Required Qualifications

  • 6-8 years of relevant experience

  • Experience in customer-facing positions; excellent interpersonal skills
  • Understanding of core networking principles (layers 2 through 4 of the OSI model) and application protocols (HTTP, SQL, CIFS/NFS, HL7, Memcache, DNS)
  • Familiarity with principles of internet worked applications and related technologies (HTTP, databases, caching, distributed systems, etc)
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python and JavaScript
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Independence, motivation, and desire for practice ownership

The salary range for this role is $150,000 - $163,000 + bonus + benefits

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

  • Pipeline Development: Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Gitlab, ensuring efficient, reliable, and repeatable build, test, and deployment processes.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Provision and manage cloud infrastructure on Azure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, ensuring environments are scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient.
  • Continuous Monitoring & Observability: Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions to ensure system health and rapid incident response.
  • Security Integration: Embed security practices across the DevOps pipeline, including vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and adherence to Azure security best practices.
  • Incident Response: Participate in incident response activities, contributing to root cause analysis and the implementation of preventative measures.
  • Compliance: Support compliance with industry standards and regulations (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001) through appropriate infrastructure controls, access management, and audit readiness.
  • Collaboration & Enablement: Provide guidance and support to development teams on DevOps best practices, tooling, and workflows.
  • AI Innovation & Adoption: Opportunity to work with AI-driven technologies, contribute to building AI-powered solutions, and leverage AI tools to enhance automation, engineering efficiency, and DevOps practices.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience in DevOps or Platform Engineering, with experience owning and improving production cloud infrastructure at a senior level.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Deep, hands‑on Microsoft Azure expertise is essential, with substantial production experience across Azure compute, networking, storage, and identity (Entra ID).
  • Strong hands‑on CI/CD engineering experience, including designing, building, troubleshooting, and improving production pipelines, repositories, and deployment workflows.
  • Strong hands‑on Infrastructure as Code (IaC) experience managing production cloud infrastructure. Terraform is preferred; strong experience with comparable IaC technologies will also be considered.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently investigate unfamiliar or complex environments, identify technical gaps, and drive solutions with limited direction.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash).
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, AKS).
  • Solid understanding of observability (e.g., MELT) and related tools.
  • Familiarity with Azure security tooling, including Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Key Vault, and RBAC.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals in Azure (VNets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, DNS).
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across development, operations, and stakeholder teams.

Nice to Have

  • Hands‑on experience with GitLab/GitLab CI
  • Microsoft Azure certifications (e.g., AZ-104)
  • Experience with repository and CI/CD pipeline migrations, particularly to GitLab
  • Exposure to security and code quality scanning tools such as SonarQube, or similar
  • Experience working in regulated industries or with compliance frameworks

Compensation

Annual base salary gross: : 70,000-85,000 EUR plus variable. The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Company's contemplated salary range for this position. title: Nutrition Strategy Consultant 2026-2030- SSA10
description:
DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS

7 October 2026-23:59-GMT+02:00 Israel Time (Jerusalem)

WFP celebrates and embraces diversity. It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability.


ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of extreme weather shocks.


At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.


WHY JOIN WFP?

  • WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.
  • WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.
  • WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.
  • A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.
  • We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).




📌 Type of Contract: Special Service Agreement SSA10- When Actually Employed

➡️ Unit / Division: Programme and Policy / WFP Palestine

📍 Duty Station: Remote

➡️ Duration: 10-15 days estimated ( maximum 20 days)

❗You are required to fill in all mandatory fields on Workday in English and upload your English CV as an attachment. Your application would be otherwise disqualified.

What will you do in this position?

Malnutrition in all its forms remains a significant public health challenge in Palestine, compounded by protracted humanitarian crises, socioeconomic vulnerabilities, restricted access to essential services, and recurrent shocks affecting food systems and health service delivery. Women, infants, young children, school-aged children, and other vulnerable population groups continue to face nutrition-related risks that require coordinated, evidence-based, and multisectoral interventions. In parallel, growing concerns of triple burden of malnutrition related to micronutrient deficiencies, suboptimal infant and young child feeding practices, and the emerging burden of overweight and diet-related non-communicable diseases highlight the need for a comprehensive national response.

The current nutrition landscape necessitates a renewed strategic framework that aligns with national development priorities, the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), and global nutrition commitments, while responding to the evolving context in the West Bank and Gaza. To guide and coordinate national nutrition actions over the coming years, the Ministry of Health, in collaboration with key government institutions, United Nations agencies, academia, civil society organizations, and development partners, is leading the update of the National Nutrition Strategy for State of Palestine 2026-2030.

To support this process, the Consultant will provide specialist technical advice and lead the technical revision and drafting of the National Nutrition Strategy 2026–2030 and its costed Action Plan. Specifically, the Consultant will translate national priorities into a coherent and feasible strategic framework with clear objectives, interventions, implementation arrangements, M&E frameworks, and a detailed budget by incorporating lessons learned from previous strategies, existing evidence and policies, stakeholder inputs, and recommendations of the Fill the Nutrient Gap (FNG) exercise.

Why work with WFP Palestine?

For decades, Palestine has been facing a protracted and complex protection and humanitarian crisis. The humanitarian situation worsened alarmingly after an upsurge in violence from October 2023.

WFP, through our dual mandate in humanitarian and development, provides life-saving food assistance to the most vulnerable and food insecure non-refugee Palestinians.

WFP provides logistics support to humanitarian and development partners, allowing them to reach more people faster, and at a lower cost to donors and the environment. By offering our cash-based transfer platform to the wider humanitarian and development community, coordinating logistics, and developing an inter-agency common feedback mechanism, WFP contributes to wider humanitarian efforts.

How can you make a difference?

The consultant is expected to work remotely and participate in meetings and consultations as required. In person meetings may be required on an as-needed basis.

Under the leadership and overall guidance of the Ministry of Health (MoH) Nutrition Department, the Consultant will report to WFP’s Nutrition Officer. She/He will work closely with WFP and UNICEF technical teams, the National Nutrition Technical Working Group and relevant stakeholders to support the update of the National Nutrition Strategy for State of Palestine 2026-2030.

The consultant will be responsible for the following:

  • Conduct a comprehensive review and analysis of existing nutrition-related policies, strategies, assessments, surveys, programme reports, and other relevant documentation to inform the strategic framework.
  • Integrate the current nutrition and humanitarian context in both the West Bank and Gaza, including the implications of the ongoing emergency, food insecurity, health system constraints, and vulnerabilities affecting nutritional outcomes.
  • Incorporate findings and recommendations from the Fill the Nutrient Gap (FNG) assessment and other available evidence to ensure the strategy is evidence-based and context-specific.
  • Review and synthesize recommendations and feedback received during stakeholder consultations (a workshop has already taken place and the stakeholder recommendations were collected) and ensure their appropriate reflection in the strategy document.
  • Develop a clear strategic framework, including vision, goal, strategic objectives, priority outcomes, and intervention areas aimed at addressing malnutrition in all its forms.
  • Ensure a multisectoral approach by identifying and defining the roles and contributions of relevant sectors, including health, food security, education, social protection, water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH), and other key stakeholders.
  • Develop realistic, prioritized, and achievable strategic objectives, interventions, and targets, taking into consideration available resources, implementation capacity, and the prevailing context.
  • Design a results framework and monitoring and evaluation (M&E) framework, including indicators, baselines, targets, means of verification, and reporting arrangements.
  • Develop a detailed and costed Action Plan for the implementation of the National Nutrition Strategy 2026-2030, including timelines, responsible entities, key milestones, and resource requirements.
  • Produce and submit the final National Nutrition Strategy 2026-2030 and accompanying costed Action Plan, incorporating all agreed comments and recommendations from the Ministry of Health and stakeholders.
  • Provide technical guidance throughout the strategy development process to ensure consistency, quality, feasibility, and alignment with international best practices in nutrition programming and strategic planning.

Deliverables at the end of the contract:

  • Inception note summarizing the document review findings, key information gaps, proposed methodology and workplan;
  • Draft and final National Nutrition Strategy 2026-2030 and Action Plan;
  • Draft and final M&E framework, including indicators, baselines, targets, means of verification and reporting arrangements, aligned with the Strategy and Action Plan;
  • Synthesis of stakeholder consultation recommendations, FNG results and recommendations, with the integration reflected in the updated Strategy and Action Plan.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:

Education: Advanced university degree in Nutrition, Public Health (i.e. Epidemiology or Biostatistics) or other related fields are required.

Experience:

  • Minimum five (05) years of professional work experience in nutrition or public health in emergency context is required
  • Demonstrated experience in developing or revising national nutrition strategies and multisectoral action plans, with substantive responsibility for technical analysis and drafting is required
  • Experience in developing M&E frameworks, action plans, and integrating assessment findings and stakeholder input into practical recommendations is highly desirable.

Language: Fluency in Arabic and English language is required

You are comfortable taking ownership of complex data pipelines and working through legacy logic, reporting requirements and dataquality issues. Vi har vundet plads i danskernes hjerter – og ikke mindst maver – med en simpel opskrift: en velforsynet grillbuffet tilberedt med masser af kærlighed og de bedste råvarer.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Sikrer gode gæsteoplevelser og sikrer tilfredse og engagerede medarbejdere
  • Indfrier omkostnings- og indtjeningsbudgetter
  • Varetager den daglige drift med øje for gæst og koncept
  • Har gode kommunikationsevner og evner personaleudvikling
  • Har faglig stolthed og følger arbejdsopgaverne til dørs
  • Kan og har lyst til at indgå i vagtplanen i køkkenet
  • Er pragmatisk og struktureret i din tilgang
  • Evner at samarbejde på tværs
  • Har forståelse for branchen samt almen IT og systemer

Dit overordnet ansvar bliver, at:

  • Sikre, at gode gæsteoplevelser leveres, hver gang
  • Pleje og udvikle dine medarbejdere
  • Kvalitetssikre konceptet og restauranten som helhed
  • Opnå og indfri indtjenings- og omkostningsbudgetter
  • Sikre, at procedurer og arbejdsgange er optimale
  • Varetage daglige driftsopgaver som vagtplanering, leverandørkontakt og vedligehold

Vi tilbyder:

  • En masse dygtige og læringsivrige medarbejdere
  • Et godt, sundt og travlt arbejdsmiljø, hvor tillid er i højsædet
  • En varierende arbejdsuge med stor indflydelse på dagligdagen
  • En udfordrende hverdag med et fast koncept, men hvor ingen dage er ens
  • Tiltrædelse snarest muligt

Vi inviterer løbende til samtale, så send os dit motiverede CV vedhæftet ansøgning, billede og relevante bilag allerede nu ved at trykke på ”Søg job” nederst på siden.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig :)

title: Foundry Technical Program Manager (Materials Foundry)
description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with a strong technical or scientific background (Natural Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering and/or AI/ML) to join our team. You will be a key driver in our global partner ecosystem that accelerates the adoption of our AI Materials platform, which is critical for delivering next-generation semiconductor and advanced materials to market.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that drives the activation of our AI Materials Foundry members towards real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs.

As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our AI Materials Foundry team on coordinating Foundry initiatives, events, and materials generation campaigns. You will also be involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for Foundry member engagement with our internal teams to drive to end to end technical delivery.


What You Will Do

Program Leadership & Research Integration

  • Lead AI Materials Foundry programs across a global network of industry and lab partners towards materials discovery.

  • Translate scientific and business objectives into executable plans, aligning commercial, research and engineering teams.

  • Own planning and delivery of Foundry initiatives and events; managing resources & dependencies, mapping out timelines, and managing risks to ensure successful outcomes.

Partner & Customer Collaboration

  • Lead technical programs with industry partners and research institutions, serving as a primary program contact for our external partners during the execution and delivery of projects.

  • Facilitate technical discussions between internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Drive project scoping and proposal writing in collaboration with the partnerships and technical teams.

  • Manage joint development initiatives and coordinate customer pilot programs from conception through to deployment.

Process & Operations

  • Work closely with the rest of the global TPM team to refine scalable processes.

  • Implement metrics for tracking milestones and program outcomes.

  • Coordinate compliance and regulatory considerations across programs.

  • Support intellectual property (IP) and scientific publication processes.

  • Foster interdisciplinary team culture and own change management to successfully scale the organisation.

  • Use data to drive continuous improvements to internal and customer facing processes.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You possess a strong background in a Natural Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or related field.

  • Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager in a scientific or AI/ML environment, with a clear sense of where the opportunities and challenges in the field lie.

  • The ability to navigate high levels of ambiguity and maintain cohesion across multi-disciplinary teams (AI, Chemistry, and Engineering).

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both highly technical researchers and non-technical partners at varying levels of seniority.

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities.

  • Strong leadership and facilitation capabilities for managing cross-functional teams.

  • Experience managing technical external-facing customer projects.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Practical experience or an academic background in Materials Science, Experimental Chemistry, or Physics.

  • Experience managing joint ecosystem programs alongside major hardware tech giants like NVIDIA or Meta.

  • Direct professional background working within a semiconductor foundry, design firm, or electronics materials supplier.

  • Technical fluency across model architecture, cloud infrastructure, and the software development lifecycle.

  • Experience with molecular simulation software, quantum chemistry packages, or cheminformatics tools.

Additional Considerations

This role will be based in our London/Cambridge offices or our U.S. Bay Area office, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for internal/external collaboration work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. Advanced Analytics & Innovation

title: Fullstack Engineer
description:
Fullstack Engineer

We hire this role at both Senior and Staff level.

  • Dublin
  • Full-time
  • Hybrid

You own features end to end, from the pipeline that captures the activity to the surface where someone approves what the agent did about it. Ahoy is a system of action, not just a system of record, so the interesting work here crosses the seam: the data model, the agent reasoning over it, and the interface that makes both legible enough to trust.

What you'll do

  • Ship whole features - the ingestion path, the data model, the API, and the surface a customer actually touches.
  • Build the capture path - email, calendar, calls - and the pipeline that turns raw activity into records people trust.
  • Build the surfaces where agent work becomes visible - review queues, one-tap approval, the diff between what the CRM knew and what it knows now.
  • Work on how agents reason over CRM data: retrieval, tool use, evals, and the guardrails that keep a human in the loop.
  • Own production. Instrumentation, on-call, and cost and latency budgets that hold under load.

What you bring

  • Strong TypeScript and React on one side, strong Python on the other. Real depth in one, real competence in both.
  • Distributed-systems fundamentals: databases, queues, idempotency, async work.
  • API design you'd be happy to hand to another team without a meeting.
  • A real eye for interface detail. Give you a rough spec and a Figma file and you come back with something better than both.
  • You've debugged something in production that no runbook covered, then written the runbook.
  • Hybrid out of Dublin. We work in person several days a week.

Senior or Staff?

  • Senior. 5+ years shipping production software across the stack. You own features end to end, including the operational reality that comes with them.
  • Staff. 8+ years, including time at Staff / Principal / Tech Lead level. You set architecture across services and surfaces, and you've shipped systems at meaningful scale rather than just diagrammed them.
  • Not sure? Apply anyway and say so. We'll work it out on the call.

Bonus

  • Production experience with LLM agent systems - orchestration, retrieval, evals, cost and latency tuning.
  • You've built CRM, sales tech, or other data-dense B2B products.
  • Open-source work, writing, or talks that show how you reason about systems.

title: Staff Network Systems Engineer - Network Automation & DevOps
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role overview

We're looking for a Staff Network Systems Engineer to help drive the transition of our global network infrastructure from manually managed and inconsistent configurations to a standardised, version-controlled and increasingly automated operating model.

This hands-on staff-level individual contributor will establish Infrastructure as Code practices, reusable automation, automated validation and safe delivery pipelines. The role will reduce configuration drift, make changes repeatable and auditable, and help the wider team adopt modern software-engineering practices.

Working across network engineering, security, architecture and platform teams, you'll help frame and influence technical direction, create practical standards and guardrails, and remain actively involved in enterprise network engineering and operational delivery.

What you'll be doing:

  • Assess the network estate, toolchain and operational workflows; identify sources of configuration variance, manual effort and change risk; and help define a phased modernisation roadmap.
  • Establish the Infrastructure as Code operating model, including the authoritative source of truth, configuration standards, source control, peer review, testing, release governance and secure handling of credentials.
  • Build reusable automation using object-oriented or comparable programming languages such as Python and Go (Golang), together with Terraform, Ansible, APIs and configuration-management tooling.
  • Develop CI/CD pipelines with automated linting, testing, intended-state validation, drift detection, policy checks, approvals, controlled rollout and reliable rollback patterns.
  • Partner with engineering, architecture and security teams to translate network intent into version-controlled implementations and influence reference architectures, standards, lifecycle plans and service roadmaps.
  • Lead the safe migration of existing services into the automated model while remaining hands-on during complex delivery, business-as-usual operations, critical changes, troubleshooting and major incidents.
  • Participate in technical authority and design-review forums, mentor engineers, and ensure automation becomes a sustainable team capability rather than knowledge held by a single specialist.

What we are looking for:

  • A strong track record of modernising network infrastructure through automation or Infrastructure as Code in a large, complex production environment.
  • Strong software-engineering skills in object-oriented or comparable programming languages such as Python and Go (Golang), including maintainable code, structured data, API integration, testing, error handling and documentation.
  • Practical experience with Terraform, Ansible or comparable tooling, including reusable, idempotent automation components and controlled infrastructure delivery.
  • Strong working knowledge of Git, pull-request workflows, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, release controls, policy enforcement and secrets management.
  • Deep enterprise networking knowledge across routing, switching, wireless, resilient design, network access control and secure remote connectivity, together with advanced Juniper Mist, EX Series and Junos experience or equivalent platform expertise.
  • Expert troubleshooting and engineering judgement, with experience supporting operational delivery, complex changes, major incidents and root-cause improvement.
  • Staff-level influence and communication skills, including shaping technical direction across teams, building consensus, contributing to governance forums and developing other engineers.

Desirable Experience

  • Network APIs and data models, including REST, NETCONF, RESTCONF, JSON, YAML and YANG-based workflows.
  • GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, automated policy enforcement, artefact management and developer enablement.
  • Azure or AWS networking, enterprise authentication, Zero Trust principles and network observability platforms.
  • Architecture governance, technical authority panels, strategic vendor engagement and globally delivered service operations.
  • High-availability gaming, digital-media, creative or similarly demanding production environments.

Work Expectations and Measures of Success

This is a staff-level role combining hands-on engineering with technical leadership across a global network environment. You'll build production automation, guide others and remain engaged with operational delivery. The objective is to establish an engineering system the team can operate and improve over time while maintaining secure, resilient and supportable network services.

Success will be demonstrated through:

  • Increased coverage of network infrastructure managed through version-controlled automation.
  • Reduced configuration drift, manual intervention, operational toil and dependency on individual subject-matter experts.
  • Shorter and more predictable change lead times, with improved auditability, validation and rollback confidence.
  • Lower change-failure rates, maintained service reliability and faster recovery from configuration-related incidents.
  • Sustained adoption of automation standards, modules and delivery practices across the wider engineering team.

At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

Base $109,400 - $164,000 + Bonus & Benefits.

title: El- & Telekonstruktör till Bravida Engineering Design
description:
Bravida Engineering Design är Bravidas projekterings- och ingenjörsverksamhet med 65 specialister inom bland annat VVS, ventilation, industrirör, el, tele, automation och process, och verksamheten ska växa kraftigt de kommande åren. Här kombineras spetskompetensen från traditionella teknikkonsulter med styrkan hos Nordens största installationskoncern. Det innebär att man inte bara projekterar komplexa anläggningar utan följer lösningarna hela vägen till installation och driftsättning. Uppdragen finns över hela Norden inom datacenter, industri, energi och samhällskritisk infrastruktur. Organisationen är fortfarande tidigt i sin resa och har startupens nyfikenhet och driv, kombinerat med resurserna och genomförandekraften hos ett stort bolag. Bravida har byggt förtroende hos sina kunder sedan 1922, och säkerheten kommer alltid först.

Vill du projektera teleanläggningar och sedan se dem byggas, på riktigt? Hos Bravida Engineering Design arbetar du nära installation och produktion, i projekt inom datahallar, industri och samhällsviktig infrastruktur. Teleområdet ska växa kraftigt, och du får chansen att vara med från början och forma hur det byggs upp.

Information om tjänsten

Professionals Nord söker i samarbete med Bravida Engineering Design en El- & Telekonstruktör. Tjänsten är en direktrekrytering, vilket innebär att rekryteringsprocessen sker genom Professionals Nord och att du anställs direkt hos Bravida. Den här rekryteringsprocessen hanteras av Professionals Nord och Bravidas önskemål är att alla frågor kring tjänsten går till info@pn.se.

Du erbjuds

• Att vara med och bygga upp ett teleområde som ska växa kraftigt, med stort inflytande över arbetssätt och utveckling

• Projektering nära Bravidas installationsteam, där du samordnar med produktionen och följer dina projekt live

• Erfarna kollegor och ledare som själva gått från fält till projektering, förmånligt pensionsavtal, friskvårdsbidrag och goda möjligheter till vidareutveckling

Arbetsuppgifter

Gruppen EL- och Teledesign är idag 17 personer, varav tre inom tele, och ambitionen är att teleområdet ska växa de kommande åren. Projekten är stora och varierade, med fokus på datahallar och industribyggnader och samhällsviktig infrastruktur. Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm, men Göteborg eller Skellefteå är också möjligt.

Du kommer bland annat att:

• Projektera teleinstallationer och telesystem för datahallar, industri och infrastruktur

• Ta fram ritningar och BIM-modeller i AutoCAD, ElCAD och Revit som underlag för produktion

• Säkerställa att projekteringen följer gällande standarder och regelverk

• Samordna med Bravidas installationsteam och övriga discipliner under projektets gång

• Följa upp projekten ute i produktion

Vi söker dig som

• Har flera års erfarenhet av teleprojektering, eller en teknisk utbildning inom el/tele i kombination med flera års praktisk erfarenhet från telebranschen

• Har bred förståelse för telesystem, t.ex. datanät, larm, brand eller passagesystem (du behöver inte vara erfaren inom alla områden)

• Har god vana av att projektera i AutoCAD, ELcad eller Revit

• Talar och skriver svenska och engelska obehindrat

Det är meriterande om du har:

• Erfarenhet från fält som telemontör eller installatör

• Erfarenhet av projekt inom datahallar, industri eller myndigheter

• Behörighet inom området

Vi tror att dina personliga egenskaper är avgörande för hur väl du kommer trivas i rollen hos Bravida Engineering Design. Du är självgående och tar ansvar för dina leveranser, vilket är viktigt i ett team som växer och där du får stort eget ansvar från start. Du är noggrann, eftersom säkerhets- och teleanläggningar kräver att varje detalj blir rätt redan på ritningen. Du är också samarbetsinriktad och trivs i dialogen med installatörer och kollegor från andra discipliner, eftersom det nära samarbetet med produktionen är det som gör projekteringen här unik.

START: Enligt överenskommelse

OMFATTNING: Heltid

STAD: Stockholm (Göteborg eller Skellefteå är också möjligt)

URVAL: Sker löpande

KONTAKT: Lucas Bryggman Lumare

Sök tjänsten nedan genom att fylla i din information samt bifoga dokument. Logga gärna vidare in på "Mina sidor" efter att du bekräftat ditt konto, här kan du skapa din kandidatprofil vilket utökar din chans till drömjobbet! Vi går igenom urvalet löpande och kan därför ha gått vidare med kandidater innan annonsen stängs ner. Vi tar tyvärr inte emot ansökningar via mail men har du frågor kring tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta oss på info@pn.se

title: FullStack Engineer
description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow,Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description:

You will be responsible for developing, deploying, and maintaining robust and scalable web applications that integrate seamlessly with our advanced AI models and agentic systems. You will work collaboratively with our software engineers, designers and researchers to deliver high-quality solutions. Your work will directly impact the efficiency and effectiveness of our AI products, enabling developers to spend less time fixing issues and more time innovating. You will contribute to the creation of scalable, reliable, and performant solutions that integrate seamlessly with our existing infrastructure.

What You Will Do:
  • Design, develop, and maintain 0-to-1 applications for AI-powered solutions focusing on automation, high performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Participate in all aspects of agile software development, from design to deployment.
  • Build and integrate RESTful APIs to support dynamic web and cloud applications.
  • Develop scalable backend services and databases to enhance application performance.
  • Architect and design end-to-end systems optimized for speed and scale.
  • Ensure responsive design and seamless user experience
  • Maintain best practices by following TDD and ensuring unit/integration tests are synced
  • Debug and troubleshoot reported issues and incorporate feedback from other stakeholders
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to other developers
Experience and qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • At least 3 years of experience as a Software Engineer or in a similar role.
  • Experience working with Agentic technologies (e.g. Codex, Claude, CoPilot)
  • Experience in building web applications and designing and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • Experience in developing using Java Spring framework or similar
  • Experience developing in Agile practices and principles (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies, i.e Docker/Kubernetes.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.
  • Excellent debugging, optimization skills, communication, and teamwork skills.
In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

title: Generalist
description:
We are seeking a talented generalist operator with the raw talent and grit to join our team and grow into a leader and innovator in sales, marketing, customer support, and management operations that drive 10x value by leveraging automation, LLMs, and offshoring to run multiple departments. We expect you to have the drive, and will give you the tools to lead the industry with novel best practices. Versatility is required as you will need to wear many hats and adapt to the company's needs on an ongoing basis.

An ideal candidate does not necessarily have a long resume, but can show a sharp growth trajectory with the ambition to push further. We are looking to develop someone into an industry leader without the constraints of needing to unlearn how it's been done. You will be given the opportunity and the mission to drive new best practices that any company or startup would be envious of.

About Us

Waterlily uses AI to help families prepare for the largest financial and medical event in their lives, long-term care (LTC). Through comprehensive care planning and optimization, Waterlily is bending Americas multi-trillion dollar LTC cost curve.

Our Team & Culture

We've built a high-performance team culture based on three core principles:

Mission-Driven Excellence

  • We're deeply committed to transforming how families prepare for long-term care
  • Every team member genuinely believes in our mission and understands its importance
  • We prioritize work that drives meaningful impact for our customers and company

Be a Potato: Growth & Resilience

  • We embrace challenges and adapt quickly - like potatoes that grow under any circumstances
  • We make decisions swiftly while remaining thoughtful and open to iteration
  • We focus on execution and results rather than just effort, recognizing that input doesn't necessarily equal output
  • We value team members who show unlimited potential for growth and understanding

Radical Transparency & Support

  • We practice direct, honest communication while maintaining empathy and respect
  • Feedback flows freely in all directions - from intern to leadership and back
  • We begin meetings with brief check-ins to understand each other's context
  • We create safe spaces for vulnerability and authentic collaboration
  • We maintain high standards while supporting each other's growth and wellbeing

Our team comprises some of the brightest, most ambitious, playful, and friendly people you'll meet. You'll be working closely with our founding Waterlily team, including Lily, Evan, and Tim, and have direct access to a support team in the Philippines.

‍️Lily Vittayarukskul, our CEO, is a patented inventor who started college at 14, attending UC Berkeley, was working at NASA when she was 16, and lead product and engineering at IoT medical device startups for years before founding Waterlily.‍️

Evan Ehrenberg, our COO, is a member of Forbes 30 Under 30, started college at 11, also attending UC Berkeley, and then continued on to his Ph.D. in computational neuroscience at MIT at 16 before dropping out at 21 to found Clara Health, a clinical trials SaaS platform and B2B2C marketplace, which he sold 7 years later before joining Waterlily.

‍Tim Chung, our founding engineer and data scientist, holds a Masters of Computer Science from UPenn and is midway through a Data Science Masters at Georgia Tech. Tim excels in a trio of roles: data scientist, machine learning engineer, and full-stack software engineer. At his previous companies, he led teams to launch pioneering machine learning models.

How We Work

  • We optimize for remote-first collaboration while maintaining high productivity
  • We emphasize contextual decision-making and practical solutions
  • We prioritize deep work and focused execution over unnecessary meetings
  • We consistently validate that we're working on the highest-impact initiatives
  • We maintain a healthy, growth-oriented mindset while pushing for exceptional results

We're looking for teammates who share our values of integrity, empathy, and intelligent hard work - people who can see beyond their immediate role to understand both company needs and customer impact.

About You ⭐

Growth Mindset & Adaptability

  • You're a "potato" - able to grow and thrive under any circumstances
  • You have a track record of rapidly learning complex industries and business domains
  • You proactively dive deep into industry knowledge, leveraging tools like LLMs to accelerate your learning
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can navigate complex enterprise relationships with confidence

Innovation & Execution

  • You have a history of building strategic relationships that challenge traditional approaches
  • You can point to specific examples where you've used automation or AI to multiply your impact
  • You focus on delivering value while building long-term partnerships
  • You have experience or strong interest in using technology to scale your effectiveness

Leadership & Relationship Building

  • You give and receive direct feedback with grace and professionalism
  • You can build deep, trusted relationships with enterprise executives
  • You're equally comfortable in formal boardrooms and informal social settings
  • You naturally build trust through consistent execution and thoughtful relationship management

Mission Alignment

  • You're drawn to meaningful work that impacts families' lives
  • You understand that sustained high performance requires maintaining personal wellbeing
  • You're excited about becoming a thought leader in the long-term care industry
  • You're genuinely passionate about transforming how families prepare for long-term care

The Ideal Background

While we value potential over experience, you likely have:

  • Demonstrated ability to manage and grow enterprise relationships
  • Experience navigating complex sales cycles and stakeholder relationships
  • Track record of improving team efficiency through process innovation and automation
  • History of taking initiative and driving results without extensive oversight
  • Comfort with technical concepts and ability to do light scripting/automation
  • Experience managing both high-level strategic relationships and detailed execution

We're not looking for someone who's done it all before we're looking for someone who has the raw talent and drive to help us pioneer new approaches to enterprise relationship management. If you're excited about pushing boundaries, learning rapidly, and making a real difference in people's lives, we want to talk to you.

About The Role

You will be tasked with owning and scaling mission-critical operations within customer support, sales, marketing, and general operations management. The goal will be to often push beyond industry best-practices by innovating new strategies that leverage LLMs and offshore teams to achieve company-defining results for a fraction of the time and cost of what other companies have previously achieved.

You will be working with our founding US-based team and report directly to our co-founder and COO, Evan Ehrenberg, and you will grow to manage a team of 40+ in the Philippines. You will collaborate on new ideas and implement quickly to test and iterate. Many ideas will not work and will be thrown away. Many ideas will need to be imperfect so that we can implement them faster. Everything will be iterative, no challenge will be too ambitious.

You will be challenged to produce meaningful results every week. It will likely take you more than 40 hours per week to drive industry-leading results. We do not think that 80 hour weeks are effective, and we expect you to limit yourself to 50-60 hour work-weeks. If you want to push harder we will urge you to reflect on ways to be more effective with your time so that you can dedicate your remaining time to benefit your mental and physical health.

We will be in the trenches with you, and together we will create one of the most impactful companies that will help families prepare for what has historically been one of the most devastating times in their lives so that they can face long-term care with confidence and calm.

Key Responsibilities ️

  • Customer Success: Your mission is to surprise and delight our customers through product and customer support initiatives that go above and beyond to make Waterlily their favorite company to work with.
  • Marketing & Sales Operations: Think creatively to implement non-traditional growth hacking strategies that outperform paid marketing and elevate our brand.
  • Process Automation: Super-charge your impact by leveraging large offshore teams, LLMs, and no-code/low-code solutions to automate workflows to scale low-cost strategies that outperform traditional approaches.
  • Team Management: Oversee and coordinate the efforts of an offshore team of over 40 individuals.
  • Content Creation: Craft and fine-tune communications to users and industry executives to combine scale with personalization and high standards of communication quality.

Key Skills & Qualifications

  • Voracious Learner: Eager to rapidly learn about new industries and departments with the passion and grit to dive deep in specific verticals to gain sufficient context to push the boundaries and improve upon historic best-practices.
  • Highly Motivated and a Self-Starter: Ready to take initiative and drive projects forward with minimal supervision or structure.
  • Adaptability and Problem-Solving: Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment by quickly adapting to new challenges and finding innovative solutions with minimal direction.
  • Extraordinary Copywriting and Email Writing: Ability to create clear, persuasive, and engaging content that resonates with audiences ranging from families to industry executives.
  • No-Code/Low-Code Proficiency: Experience with tools like Zapier, Airtable, Google Apps Script, PhantomBuster, or similar to automate tasks and streamline processes.
  • GenAI Prompting: Strong skills in creating and tuning GenAI prompts to reliably produce high-quality results.
  • Strong Communication Skills: Both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex ideas simply.

Why Join Us?

  • Backed by top VCs: Our investors are renowned for backing innovative companies and helping them grow to become industry leaders.
  • Customers Love Us: Check out some of our latest success case studies and customer testimonials and see why our customers love us so much.
  • Industry Giants Onboard: After launching in early 2024 we've already closed 3 Fortune 100 customers, 4 insurance carriers, one of the largest LTC providers in the Midwest, and one of the largest insurance distributors in the US.
  • Direct Mentorship and Development from our Co-Founders: Receive guidance and resources to develop your skills and become a 10x operator.
  • Growth Opportunities: Learn to operate multiple functions and gain diverse experience that will propel your career forward.
  • Dynamic Environment: Work in a fast-paced, innovative startup culture that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.
  • Impact: Play a key role in shaping the future of our company and making a tangible difference for families across America and the world.

title: ESD Worker A-6120
description:

Under the supervision of the Environmental Services Supervisor, performs manually and by machine, housekeeping duties which contribute to the cleanliness and safety of the residents, patients, guests, visitors and other personnel.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

RESPONSIBILITIES

title: DevOps Manager
description:
• Databases: Elasticsearch, MongoDB

Everseen: A leader in vision AI solutions for the world’s leading retailers.


The Role


As a DevOps manager you will lead and grow a distributed, follow-the-sun DevOps Operations team that owns the L3 support function for our Edge/on-prem (OpenShift, k0s) and cloud platforms (AKS and GKE). Your primary responsibility is to deliver reliable operations at scale by establishing the processes, standards, and capabilities that enable fast, high-quality L3 resolution.


You will foster tight, day-to-day collaboration between Operations and the DevOps engineering teams to ensure unified incident and change management across time zones.


The primary objective is to deliver fast, regionally aligned L3 support for DevOps-related incidents and changes, streamline DevOps–Ops handoffs, and equip Ops with the tooling and automation needed to resolve more L1/L2 issues.


Having a good understanding of our product, its components and their interactions is essential in troubleshooting and problem remediation.


You will partner with DevOps engineering to automate and streamline existing workflows and processes.


Ensuring timely, high-quality handling of requests will reduce incident duration and directly improve customer satisfaction.


This role will allow you to take your career to the next level, working alongside industry experts and scaling an already successful global organization. You will work with cutting edge technologies in both Cloud and Edge environments.


What You'll Do



  • Develop team capabilities in automation, cloud and edge deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting and DevOps CI/CD pipelines.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and ensure alignment with business goals.


Leadership



  • Manage and lead the global DevOps L3 team. Manage the day-to-day running of the team and the projects.

  • Overall responsibility for the projects that the team is working on. Acts as a point of escalation for the team.

  • Works with senior leadership to create strategic goals for their team. Measures the performance of those goals.


Teaching and Sharing Culture



  • Shares skills, knowledge, and expertise with the team.

  • Fosters a culture of collaboration and continuous learning by organizing training sessions, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

  • Writes and maintains standard operations procedures (SOP) for new and existing applications and services.

  • Keeps up-to-date on best practices and new technologies.

  • Collaborates on technical architecture and system design.

  • Evaluates existing components or systems to determine integration requirements and to ensure the final solutions meet organizational needs.

  • Interacts with cross-functional management on high-profile technical operations while providing clear feedback and leadership to support teams.

  • Authoring knowledge-base articles and driving internal knowledge sharing.

  • Works in off-routine hours occasionally. Works with customers and travel to international customer or partner locations.


Collaborating With



  • Operations (Customer Deployment) teams: Collaborate with the Operations teams for troubleshooting and solving L3 tickets, create automations to reduce and optimize workload.

  • DevOps Cloud and Edge teams: Work closely with the wider DevOps engineering teams, your manager, developers and QA engineers to understand requirements, provide technical guidance, and ensure smooth integration and deployment of our product.

  • Security Team: Collaborate with the team to ensure the security of our cloud and edge solutions.


Our Tech Stack



  • At Everseen, you will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology. Our stack includes:

  • CI/CD Tools: GitLab CI/CD

  • Cloud Platforms: Azure (AKS, Registry), GCP (GKE)

  • Edge Platforms: Docker, Podman, Kubernetes(k0s) and Openshift

  • Edge OS: RHEL, Ubuntu

  • Automation Tools: Ansible (AWX), Jinja, Terraform

  • Deployment Tools: Helm, Flux CD

  • Observability: Prometheus, Loki, Grafana alloy, Grafana dashboards, Thanos

  • Databases: Elasticsearch, MongoDB

  • Authentication: Keycloak

  • Scripting Languages: Python, Bash


Profile And Skills



  • Experience: Proven 3+ years experience as a DevOps Manager and previous experience as a DevOps/Automation Engineer, Linux Administrator or a combination of them.

  • Management experience: Experience in building new teams and establishing processes and procedures.

  • Linux & System Services: Basic understanding of local and distributed filesystems (ext4, xfs, NFS), storage migration, SSH tunneling, SCP, SFTP, web servers (Nginx, Apache), reverse proxying, and troubleshooting (logs, performance, connectivity).

  • Containerization & Orchestration: Basic knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift, and virtualization solutions.

  • Configuration Management & CI/CD: Experience with Ansible/Ansible Tower (or similar tools like Salt, Puppet, Chef), Jenkins/GitLab CI/CD (or equivalents like CircleCI, TeamCity), and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform (or alternatives like Azure Automation, CloudFormation).

  • Cloud & Version Control: Familiarity with Azure Cloud (or AWS, GCP), GIT for system versioning, and basic understanding of backup solutions.

  • Scripting & Programming: Experience in Bash scripting and Python for automation and development tasks.

  • Monitoring & Logging: Experience with monitoring tools like Node exporter, Prometheus, Grafana, and log collection solutions (e.g.,Prometheus, fluentd, logstash).

  • Databases: Basic understanding of relational (MySQL, MariaDB) and NoSQL (Elasticsearch, MongoDB) databases, with hands‑on experience writing queries.

  • API & Data Formats: Hands‑on experience with JSON and making Restful API calls.

  • Software Engineering & Architecture: Broad understanding of software engineering principles, architecture, programming languages, frameworks, and industry trends, particularly in the AI space.


Analytical And Problem-Solving Skills



  • Possesses strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, leveraging data to inform product decisions. This skill is essential for identifying market opportunities, optimizing product features, and addressing challenges effectively.


Communication Skills



  • Excellent presentation, oral, and written communication skills. Fluent business English is a requirement.


Customer Focus



  • A passionate advocate for determining and delivering solutions with a high level of customer satisfaction.

  • Ability to prioritize customer experience as a top priority in solution delivery.


Interest in Learning and Growth Mindset



  • Demonstrated interest in learning and a strong desire to expand knowledge in their respective field.

  • Eagerness to explore new technologies, methodologies, and best practices to enhance skills and capabilities.

  • Results-oriented attitude, with a drive to achieve objectives efficiently.


Technical Leadership



  • Capable of leading and engaging in technical discussions with stakeholders and beginning to lead smaller projects. Provide strategic and thought leadership to the team and stakeholders.

  • AdviseS technology leaders, our product team, and other internal stakeholders to make technology decisions that grow and improve our products.


Leadership



  • Leads matrixed project teams from across the organization

  • Coaches and mentors less experienced members of the team


About Everseen


Shrink and inefficiency cost global retailers more than a hundred billion dollars each year. But Everseen is changing that equation. We are a leader in vision AI, transforming business operations for global retailers by reducing shrink, improving operations, and delivering a better customer experience. Supporting 11 of the top 20 global retailers, Everseen’s AI innovations help retailers save millions of dollars every month. Its flagship product, Evercheck, is deployed in 10,000 retail stores and 150,000 checkouts globally. Everseen operates at unmatched scale, processing over 15 million transactions, and more than six petabytes of video data, daily. Trusted by major food, drug, mass, and specialty retailers around the world – including Kroger, Meijer, and Woolworths – we also partner with leading hardware, AI, and cloud computing providers such as Google, NVIDIA, NCR, and Dell. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Cork, Ireland, Everseen has over 700 employees globally, with a European headquarters in Cork, Ireland, a U.S. headquarters in Miami, and hubs in Romania, Serbia, India, Australia, and Spain. We are a dedicated team of inventors, research scientists, engineers, AI experts and retail industry veterans. Our culture is built on accountability, collaboration, and high standards. We take ownership of outcomes, prioritise our customers, operate as one team, move quickly with purpose, and continually raise the bar in everything we deliver.


Our Culture


Our culture is built on ownership and accountability, we own outcomes, not tasks. We stay relentlessly customer-first, letting their needs shape our priorities and decisions.


Our Values



  • We OWN THE OUTCOME. No silos, no excuses.

  • We ARE CUSTOMER-FIRST. They guide our decisions.

  • We ARE ONE TEAM. Debate, decide, commit.

  • We MOVE WITH PACE. With simplicity and quality.

  • We RAISE THE BAR. On talent, innovation and impact.


Our Commitment


Everseen is committed to creating an environment where everyone can succeed. Our employees should feel a sense of belonging, have an opportunity to grow their careers, and feel free to be their most authentic selves. Everseen takes great pride in the diversity of its global workforce, and insists upon a safe, inclusive workplace where our differences are our collective strength. We treat each other with dignity, and respect, and require all employees, officers, and directors to seek to understand the importance and value to Everseen of diversity, and inclusion. Everseen is committed to creating a safe environment for all employees and has a zero tolerance policy for bias and discrimination of any kind. Our work environment is one without offensive, hostile, or intimidating conduct, whether verbal, written or physical, in nature. Everseen will not tolerate prejudice or discrimination of any kind including without limitation, where based on aspects such as, race, colour, sex, gender, religion, age, family status, disability of any kind, sexual orientation.

title: Software Engineer (DevOps) - Observability Platform
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.


We're looking for an Observability Platform Engineer to create a platform that continuously monitors thousands of applications, databases, and other systems. You'll be delivering a product solution our engineering teams will rely on for crucial information about logging, metrics, and tracing.


Your work will ensure applications can be continuously optimised, incidents are quickly solved, and friction is reduced in onboarding, normal usage, and sunsetting.


What You'll Be Doing



  • Designing, implementing, and assembling scalable and resilient observability solutions across logs, metrics, and traces, leveraging existing market solutions or technologies from scratch

  • Building robust APIs and data pipelines to ingest, process, and expose observability data to product teams

  • Collaborating closely with product teams to understand their observability needs and integrate solutions that empower them to monitor, alert, and debug their components effectively

  • Optimising the observability infrastructure for performance, accuracy, cost-effectiveness, and an exceptional user experience

  • Developing and maintaining tooling to automate the onboarding/sunsetting of components to the observability platform and streamline data collection

  • Contributing to the strategic roadmap of the observability platform, identifying and implementing new features and improvements


What You'll Need



  • 7+ years of experience as a software engineer, with 3+ years focused on building and maintaining observability platforms or highly distributed systems

  • Familiarity with monitoring, alerting, and incident response best practices

  • Expertise in designing and implementing APIs and data pipelines for high-throughput, real-time data ingestion

  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform)

Nice to have



  • Previous experience in a DevOps, SRE, or developer experience role

  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and their native observability services

  • Contributions to open‑source observability projects

  • A track record of prototyping and sketching new solutions to complex problems


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday.
