title: Workforce Management Analyst (Philippines Remote)
description:
The Workforce Management Analyst plays a critical role in the day-to-day operational management of Turnitin’s global Technical Support organization. This role is responsible for ensuring customer demand is effectively managed by aligning staffing, schedules, and workload across products, support tiers, channels, regions, and time zones.

Serving as a central point of operational coordination, the Workforce Management Analyst actively monitors Support and Escalation queues, assigns and distributes tickets, manages real-time staffing and coverage, and identifies customer issues at risk of escalation. The role is expected to take proactive action to ensure tickets have clear ownership, workloads remain balanced, and customer issues continue progressing toward resolution.

The Workforce Management Analyst also supports forecasting, scheduling, and capacity planning to ensure resources are aligned with anticipated customer demand and service-level expectations.

Key Responsibilities:

Queue, Ticket & Escalation Management

  • Actively monitor Support and Escalation queues throughout the day, including new, unassigned, pending, hold, aging, high-priority, and escalated tickets.
  • Assign and distribute tickets to agents based on availability, skill set, product expertise, priority, workload, and customer impact.
  • Proactively identify tickets at risk of becoming customer complaints or escalations based on age, priority, customer sentiment, repeated contacts, lack of progress, or established risk indicators.
  • Ensure high-risk and escalated tickets have clear ownership and are actively progressing toward resolution.
  • Monitor ticket handoffs across agents, tiers, regions, and shifts to prevent gaps in ownership or delays in progression.
  • Balance workloads across agents and teams and redistribute work when necessary to maintain queue health.
  • Escalate significant customer, queue, or operational risks to the appropriate Team Lead or Manager when leadership intervention is required.
  • Provide visibility into queue trends, recurring bottlenecks, aging patterns, and escalation risks.

Real-Time Workforce & Coverage Management

  • Monitor staffing levels, agent availability, queue demand, and service-level performance in real time across customer contact channels.
  • Coordinate intraday staffing adjustments in response to volume changes, unexpected absences, service-level risks, and changing queue conditions.
  • Manage and coordinate agent break and lunch schedules to maintain appropriate customer coverage throughout the day.
  • Monitor meetings, training, coaching, and other offline activities and recommend adjustments when customer demand requires additional coverage.
  • Monitor schedule adherence and provide Team Leads and Managers with timely visibility into adherence concerns requiring follow-up.
  • Coordinate workforce coverage and workload transitions across global regions and time zones to support continuity of service.

Forecasting, Scheduling & Capacity Planning

  • Develop short-, medium-, and long-term forecasts based on historical demand, contact arrival patterns, seasonality, product trends, and anticipated business changes.
  • Develop schedules that align staffing with forecasted customer demand across regions, products, support tiers, and customer contact channels.
  • Analyze customer demand and contact patterns to identify staffing and coverage requirements.
  • Identify current and future capacity gaps and provide recommendations regarding staffing levels, shift structures, schedules, and resource allocation.
  • Support workforce planning for peak periods, examinations, product releases, planned events, and other anticipated increases in customer demand.

Reporting & Operational Insights

  • Prepare and distribute intraday, daily, weekly, and monthly workforce and operational performance reporting.
  • Monitor and report on key workforce and queue metrics, including staffing coverage, queue volume, ticket aging, backlog, service levels, workload distribution, schedule adherence, and forecast accuracy.
  • Identify operational trends and emerging risks and provide actionable recommendations to Support leadership.
  • Partner with Support Operations and leadership to continuously improve queue management, scheduling, forecasting, and workforce-management processes.

Key Outputs

The role will be expected to deliver:

  • Healthy Support and Escalation queues with clear ticket ownership and minimized aging.
  • Timely assignment and distribution of customer tickets across available resources.
  • Proactive identification and intervention on tickets at risk of becoming customer complaints or escalations.
  • Appropriate real-time staffing coverage across channels, regions, and operating hours.
  • Effective break, lunch, meeting, and offline scheduling that protects customer coverage.
  • Accurate workforce forecasts and schedules aligned with anticipated customer demand.
  • Timely visibility and escalation of staffing, capacity, queue, and customer-impact risks.
  • Actionable workforce and operational reporting that enables Support leadership to make informed decisions.

Essential:

  • 2–4 years of experience in Workforce Management, contact center operations, queue management, resource planning, or a related customer support environment.
  • Experience managing or monitoring customer support queues in a multi-channel environment, including phone, chat, email, and/or ticket-based support.
  • Experience with real-time workforce management, workload distribution, scheduling, and staffing coverage.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess queue conditions, prioritize work, and make timely operational decisions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret operational data and translate findings into action.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to simultaneously monitor multiple queues, priorities, and operational conditions.
  • Ability to recognize potential customer-impacting risks and proactively intervene before they result in service failures or escalations.
  • Strong judgment and decision-making skills in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate risks, required actions, and recommendations.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with agents, Team Leads, Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets and experience using workforce management, ticketing, CRM, contact center, or reporting platforms.
  • Ability to work effectively within a global organization supporting teams across multiple regions and time zones.

Desirable:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Experience with Zendesk or a comparable customer support/ticket management platform.
  • Experience with workforce management and forecasting platforms.
  • Experience supporting a global, 24×7 Technical Support or contact center operation.
  • Experience with capacity planning and short-, medium-, and long-term workforce forecasting.
  • Experience developing or improving workforce-management processes, dashboards, and operational reporting.
  • Experience within SaaS, technology, education technology, or Technical Support.
  • Experience supporting multiple products, customer segments, tiers, or geographically distributed Support teams.

Total Rewards @ Turnitin
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. title: DevOps Engineer –Kubernetes/OpenShift, OpenTelemetry & Enterprise Observability (ROTATIONAL SHIFTS)
description:
DevOps Engineer - Kubernetes/OpenShift, OpenTelemetry & Enterprise Observability

Successful applicants must be comfortable with weekends and shifts as and when required.

Job Description

We are seeking a hands‑on DevOps Engineer to support the deployment, automation, monitoring and operational reliability of enterprise microservices within a large-scale banking technology environment.

The role focuses on Kubernetes/OpenShift container platforms, CI/CD engineering and distributed observability, including application metrics, logs, traces and telemetry pipelines.

The successful candidate will collaborate with development, platform engineering, infrastructure and production support teams to implement observability solutions, troubleshoot complex deployment and telemetry issues, and improve application reliability across development, testing and production environments.

Key Responsibilities

Kubernetes, OpenShift & Microservices

  • Deploy, configure, maintain and troubleshoot containerised microservices running on Kubernetes and OpenShift platforms.
  • Support Kubernetes workloads, Helm deployments, namespaces, resource management, service connectivity and container lifecycle operations.
  • Investigate pod failures, deployment issues, application health problems, resource constraints and service communication errors.
  • Support application onboarding, environment configuration and deployment automation across SIT, UAT and production environments.

CI/CD & Automation Engineering

  • Develop, maintain and optimise CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions or equivalent platforms.
  • Integrate monitoring configurations, application instrumentation and deployment validation into automated delivery workflows.
  • Automate environment provisioning, configuration management, application deployment and operational tasks.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline failures, container deployment issues and environment‑specific release problems.
  • Support production deployment preparation, release execution, cutover planning and post‑deployment verification.

Enterprise Observability & Telemetry

  • Implement, configure and support observability platforms using Grafana, Prometheus and related monitoring technologies.
  • Support OpenTelemetry Collectors and application instrumentation for metrics, logs and distributed traces.
  • Work with telemetry storage and analytics platforms such as Grafana Mimir, Grafana Tempo and ClickHouse.
  • Support Kafka‑based telemetry ingestion, event streaming and integration with distributed applications.
  • Investigate missing telemetry, incomplete traces, ingestion failures, log‑processing issues and monitoring inconsistencies.
  • Develop operational dashboards, monitoring alerts and service‑health visibility across containerised applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate application observability into CI/CD and production delivery processes.
  • Support performance validation, monitoring optimisation and enterprise observability adoption.

Production Reliability & Troubleshooting

  • Investigate and resolve application, Kubernetes, infrastructure and observability‑related production incidents.
  • Perform root‑cause analysis, log investigation, service‑health validation and performance troubleshooting.
  • Support production stabilisation, deployment verification and post‑implementation activities.
  • Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, incident records and troubleshooting runbooks.
  • Coordinate with development, infrastructure and support teams to resolve complex technical issues.

Essential Technical Requirements

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in DevOps Engineering, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering or related roles.
  • Hands‑on experience deploying and supporting containerised applications using Kubernetes or OpenShift.
  • Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Practical experience with Grafana, Prometheus or comparable observability technologies.
  • Working understanding of application instrumentation, metrics, log aggregation and distributed tracing.
  • Experience with Docker, Helm and Linux‑based application environments.
  • Experience troubleshooting microservices deployments and production application issues.
  • Working knowledge of Python, Bash or Node.js for scripting and automation.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation using Terraform or Ansible.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical skills.

Specialised Technical Experience - Advantageous

  • OpenTelemetry SDKs, OpenTelemetry Collectors and OTLP‑based telemetry ingestion.
  • Grafana Mimir for metrics storage and Grafana Tempo for distributed tracing.
  • ClickHouse for high‑volume telemetry analytics.
  • Apache Kafka for telemetry ingestion and event‑streaming pipelines.
  • Prometheus exporters, distributed trace correlation and metrics optimisation.
  • Application instrumentation involving Python or Node.js microservices.
  • GitOps deployment workflows using ArgoCD.
  • Enterprise‑scale production monitoring, alerting and reliability engineering.

Qualifications & Additional Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Experience in banking, financial services or other regulated enterprise environments is advantageous.
  • Relevant Kubernetes, cloud, DevOps or observability certifications are advantageous.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with technical stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of production support, incident management and change‑management processes.

title: Applied Scientist
description:
About the team

The Specialist II, Applied Science applies advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to solve moderately complex business problems, improve customer experiences, and strengthen Zillow’s data-driven products and services. In this role, you collaborate with cross-functional partners to design, build, and deploy scalable machine learning models and experiments in the domain of computer vision that translate data and research into measurable impact.

title: AI Product Designer
description:
About ThriveCart:

ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.

We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.

Location:

Remote (EU)

Job Overview:

This role combines product management and product design. You own the outcome from the first customer conversation to the shipped result: you find the problem, validate it, design the solution, and write the tickets engineering builds from.

You'll work across the ThriveCart product ecosystem, shaping how entrepreneurs sell, market, teach, and create with AI built in. AI is both your subject and your toolset. You'll use it to research, prototype, and design faster than a traditional team can.

You write clearly, you're comfortable with ambiguity, and you have the judgment to say no.

What You'll Do:

  • Discover: Talk to customers, analyze usage data, and size opportunities. Decide what's worth building and what isn't.
  • Define: Write the brief: problem, audience, success metrics, scope, and what we're not building. Own prioritization and make the tradeoffs.
  • Design: Create the flows, interactions, and visuals, including how the AI behaves: prompts, outputs, confidence, errors, and recovery.
  • Prototype: Build working prototypes with AI tools and test them with real inputs and real users before engineering commits.
  • Specify: Write clear, build-ready tickets with acceptance criteria that engineers can pick up without a meeting.
  • Ship: Work with engineering through delivery, make scope calls as you go, and review the result against the design and the goal.
  • Measure: Track outcomes after launch and decide what to iterate on next.
  • Define quality for AI output and set the bar for what ships.
  • Keep the design language consistent so the ecosystem feels like one product.

What You Bring To This Role:

  • 3-5 years of shipped product work you can walk us through end to end, from the problem to the outcome.
  • Product management skills: discovery, prioritization, briefs, tickets, and working with engineers through delivery.
  • Real experience designing with or for AI, and daily use of AI tools in your own work. Show us how you work, not just what you made.
  • E-commerce experience: you understand checkout, conversion, payments, and the merchant and buyer sides of selling online.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SaaS, marketing tools, or creator-economy products.
  • Front-end skills sufficient to build functional prototypes in code.
  • Experience building marketplaces or two-sided platforms.

What success looks like

  • In 30 days: you understand our products and customers well enough to name the three biggest opportunities for AI, and you've prototyped at least one of them.
  • In 90 days: you've taken a project from discovery through shipped, and teams are bringing you problems early because you help them figure out how AI should work in their product.

Learn More About ThriveCart:

Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth. We foster an open environment with regular knowledge-sharing sessions and encourage active participation in shaping the platform. Our values include:

  • Commit to Excellence – We believe in delivering high-quality work and continuous improvement.
  • User-Focused Problem Solving – Every design should contribute to solving a real problem for our users.
  • Team Collaboration – We work better together, valuing input from every team member.
  • Growth Mindset – We embrace challenges as opportunities to learn and grow.

Our team and product are growing rapidly- we achieved YoY growth of 64% from 2022-2023, and we’re just getting started. We believe in open communication, clear goal setting, and that people do best when they have a growth mindset and want to get things done. Our team comes from diverse backgrounds and companies like Shopify, Salesforce, and BigCommerce, and we are running like an independent SaaS company within a PE fund.

title: Tjener
description:
“På Rungstedgaard gør vi os umage – for gæsten, for kollegaen og for hele huset. Vi er nærværende, vi hjælper hinanden, og vi er stolte af vores faglighed. Vi værner om den gode tone og ved, at et godt grin gør en forskel. Det’ måden vi gør det på.”
– Jens Frank-Mikkelsen, hoteldirektør

Der var engang… sådan starter mange gode eventyr – og det gør vores også.

For der var engang et sted ved kysten lige nord for København, hvor fuglene kvidrede, bølgerne stille bruste, og duften af lækre retter svævede i luften. Stedet er der stadig, og det hedder Rungstedgaard.

Rungstedgaard, der har historiske rødder helt tilbage til Karen Blixens barndom, danner i dag rammen om et helt unikt hotel og konferencested, hvor hundredvis af gæster dagligt kommer for at nyde det bedste af dansk gastronomi kombineret med en varm og imødekommende atmosfære i smukke og eventyrlige i omgivelser.

Til dette særlige sted søger vi nu en talentfuld tjener, som ønsker at blive en del af vores dygtige og dedikerede team. Som tjener hos os bliver du den, der er med til at skabe de eventyrlige oplevelser for vores gæster og sørge for, at de får gode minder med hjem, som de sent vil glemme.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Vi er en arbejdsplads, hvor vi alle er stolte af vores faglighed, og ønsket om at være en del af en kultur, hvor vi også ser hinanden både som kolleger og som mennesker. Derfor har vi forskellige tiltag, som vi alle er en del af, så det ikke glemmes. Tiltag der både skal styrke samarbejdet i teamet og på tværs af teams. Derudover tilbyder vi:

  • En attraktiv månedsløn, så du kan føle dig tryg og værdsat.

  • Ansættelse som funktionær, der sikrer dig stabilitet og tryghed.

  • En arbejdsuge på 36,5 timer, så du får balance mellem arbejdsliv og fritid.

  • Fri mellem jul og nytår, så du kan nyde højtiden med dine nærmeste.

  • 5 ugers ferie (og 8 omsorgsdage) til at slappe af, udforske nye steder og lade op.

  • Sundheds- og tandforsikring, så du kan tage hånd om dig selv.

  • Kun 30 minutters kørsel fra København samt i gåafstand til Rungsted station.

Vi søger dig, som

Du kan lide den rolige og eventyrlige stemning på Rungstedgaard og har lyst til at være med til at skabe den for vores gæster – både i de små detaljer og i mødet med dem. Du:

  • Bliver glad af kontakten med gæsterne og lægger mærke til de små ting, der får dem til at føle sig set og godt taget imod. For ofte er det netop de små detaljer, gæsterne husker bagefter.

  • Kan læse både gæsten og situationen. Du ved, hvornår du skal være til stede, hvornår du skal træde et skridt tilbage – og hvornår der lige skal lidt ekstra til for at gøre oplevelsen særlig.

  • Bevarer overblikket, når tempoet stiger. For også når der er travlt bag kulisserne, skal gæsten opleve nærvær, overskud og følelsen af at være i gode hænder.

  • Har øje for dine kolleger og det, der sker omkring dig. Du ser, når nogen har brug for en hånd, tager fat, hvor der er behov for det, og ved, at de bedste oplevelser skabes sammen.

Tiltrædelse

Snarest muligt og efter aftale.

Sådan bliver du en del af eventyret

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte restaurantchef Jannick Dupont på tlf. 2332 2736

Send din ansøgning og CV via portalen her senest den 25. oktober 2026 og vær med til at skrive næste kapitel i eventyret om Rungstedgaard.

På Rungstedgaaard bliver du en del af et eventyr, hvor vi hver dag ønsker at skabe ikke blot den bedste oplevelse for gæsterne, men også den bedste arbejdsplads for vores kollegaer.

Det’ måden vi gør det på.

title: Mission Staff Next Gen Leader Coachella Valley
description:

Because of Young Life’s exclusive Christian purposes of evangelism and discipleship as set forth in its Articles of Incorporation and in these Bylaws, and to reflect what has always been and will continue to be the position of Young Life, specifically the Christian belief that each and every employee and volunteer of the corporation should minister as a servant of God with the primary responsibility of proclaiming the gospel of Jesus Christ and, as such, is an integral part of the Christian mission and ministry of the corporation,

Job Specific Working Conditions:

ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of extreme weather shocks.


At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.


WHY JOIN WFP?

  • WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.
  • WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.
  • WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.
  • A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.
  • We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).




CONTEXTE ADMINISTRATIF


Ce poste est à pourvoir dans le bureau de terrain de Adre au Tchad. Le/la titulaire relève généralement d'un ou d'une Chargé(e) des politiques concernant les programmes ou du de la Chef du bureau de terrain considéré. On attend du/de la titulaire à ce niveau qu'il/elle fasse preuve de responsabilité et d’esprit d’initiative pour répondre en toute autonomie à des questions alors qu’il/elle ne dispose que d’orientations générales. Il/elle doit faire preuve de jugement pour faire face aux problèmes opérationnels imprévus au quotidien. Ils sont censés gérer des ressources et accompagner et coordonner le personnel d'appui.


OBJECTIFS ATTACHÉS AU POSTE


Fournir un appui spécialisé et des analyses techniques dans le cadre d'activités relatives aux politiques et aux programmes qui répondent efficacement aux besoins d'assistance.


PRINCIPALES FONCTIONS ET RESPONSABILITÉS (liste indicative et non exhaustive)


A. Intégration de la Protection, du Genre, de l'Inclusion


  • Assurer l’identification, l'analyse et l'atténuation des risques liés à la protection, au genre et à l'inclusion dans les activités du PAM dans la zone de couverture du bureau de terrain.

  • Veiller à l'intégration des considérations de protection, de genre et d'inclusion dans les activités programmatiques ainsi que dans les processus d'évaluation, de suivi, d'analyse et de collecte de données.

  • Mettre en œuvre et assurer le suivi des actions prioritaires de Protection, Genre et Inclusion définies par le Bureau Pays au niveau du bureau terrain.

  • Effectuer des visites régulières de terrain afin de suivre la mise en œuvre des mesures de protection, d'inclusion et d'atténuation des risques dans les opérations.

  • Assurer le suivi de la mise en œuvre des recommandations issues des missions de terrain, des évaluations des risques, des activités de suivi et des consultations communautaires.

  • Fournir un accompagnement technique et contribuer au renforcement des capacités des équipes du PAM et des partenaires afin de renforcer l'intégration de la protection, du genre et de l'inclusion dans la mise en œuvre des activités.

  • Fournir un accompagnement technique et contribuer au renforcement des capacités des équipes du PAM et des partenaires afin de renforcer l'intégration de la protection, du genre et de l'inclusion dans la mise en œuvre des activités.



B. Redevabilité envers les Populations Affectées (AAP) et Engagement Communautaire


  • Consulter les communautés affectées de manière régulière afin d’identifier leurs besoins, préoccupations, préférences et recommandations relatifs aux interventions du PAM.

  • Contribuer à l’élaboration, à l’adaptation et à la diffusion d’informations accessibles, inclusives et adaptées aux différents groupes de populations affectées.

  • Appuyer le fonctionnement, le suivi et la promotion des mécanismes de retour d’information et de gestion des plaintes conformément aux procédures établies.

  • Assurer le suivi de l’accessibilité et de l’utilisation des mécanismes de retour d’information par les groupes les plus vulnérables, notamment les femmes, les enfants, les personnes âgées et les personnes vivant avec un handicap.

  • Contribuer à l’analyse des retours communautaires et au suivi des actions correctives en coordination avec les unités concernées.

C. Protection contre les Exploitations et les Abus Sexuels (PEAS)


  • Mettre en œuvre et assurer le suivi des actions du bureau terrain en lien avec le Plan d’action PEAS du Bureau Pays.

  • Veiller à la sensibilisation des communautés, du personnel et des partenaires sur les principes de PEAS, ainsi que sur les mécanismes de signalement disponibles.

  • Assurer la visibilité et l'accessibilité des messages PEAS et des mécanismes de signalement dans les sites d'intervention du PAM et de ses partenaires.

D. Coordination, Suivi et Rapportage


  • Assurer la coordination régulière avec les équipes du PAM, les partenaires coopérants et les acteurs communautaires afin de favoriser l'intégration des considérations de protection, de genre et d'inclusion dans les activités.

  • Participer aux mécanismes de coordination locaux pertinents et représenter le PAM sur les questions de protection, de genre et d'inclusion à la demande du Chef de Bureau.

  • Préparer les rapports périodiques spécifique sur les activités GPI, les, tout en assurant la qualité, l'exactitude et la confidentialité des données et informations liées aux activités de protection, d'inclusion, d'AAP et de PEAS.

  • Exécuter toute autre tâche pertinente confiée par le superviseur.

EXPÉRIENCE SOUHAITÉE


  • Minimum six (6) années d'expérience professionnelle pertinente dans les programmes humanitaires, la protection dans la sécurité alimentaire et la nutrition.

  • Expérience avérée dans l'intégration de la protection, du genre, de l'inclusion et de la redevabilité envers les populations affectées (AAP) dans les programmes humanitaires.

  • Expérience dans la conduite d'évaluations des risques de protection, d'activités de suivi terrain et d'engagement communautaire.

  • Expérience de travail avec les partenaires de mise en œuvre, les autorités locales et les structures communautaires.

  • Expérience dans la facilitation de formations, le renforcement des capacités et l'accompagnement technique des équipes et partenaires.

  • Expérience dans la collecte, l'analyse et le rapportage de données relatives à la protection et aux programmes humanitaires.

  • Bonne connaissance des principes de protection humanitaire, de l'AAP, du genre, de l'inclusion et de la PEAS.

  • Une expérience dans les contextes d'urgence humanitaire constitue un atout.

QUALIFICATIONS ET COMPÉTENCES


Formation

    • Avoir un diplôme universitaire en droit, en sciences sociales, en relations internationales, en action humanitaire, en protection humanitaire, études de genre ou dans toute autre discipline connexe.

    • Avoir une combinaison équivalente de formation académique et d'expérience professionnelle pertinente pourra être prise en considération.

  • Connaissances techniques
    • Avoir une bonne connaissance des principes de protection humanitaire et de l’intégration de la protection dans les programmes humanitaires.

    • Connaissance des approches liées au genre, à l’inclusion et à la violence basée sur le genre dans l’action humanitaire.

    • Bonne maîtrise des principes de Redevabilité envers les Populations Affectées (AAP) et des mécanismes communautaires de retour d’information.

    • Connaissance des principes et exigences relatifs à la Protection contre l’Exploitation et les Abus Sexuels (PEAS).

    • Bonne maîtrise des approches participatives, de l’engagement communautaire et de la communication avec les communautés.

    • Expérience dans l’identification et l’analyse des risques de protection ainsi que dans la mise en œuvre de mesures d’atténuation.
    • Connaissance des principes de gestion confidentielle et sécurisée des données et informations sensibles de protection.
    • Bonne compréhension des principes humanitaires et des normes applicables aux interventions humanitaires.
  • Langues
    • Excellente maîtrise du français oral et écrit.
    • Connaissance de l’arabe et autres langues locales de la zone d'intervention.
    • La connaissance de l'anglais constitue un atout.

Il/elle encadre plusieurs membres du personnel d'appui pour gérer les entrepôts avec efficacité.


OBJECTIFS ATTACHÉS AU POSTE


Coordonner la réception/l'envoi et la vérification des marchandises afin de maximiser la qualité des opérations d'entreposage et de limiter les pertes, et veiller à l'application des meilleures pratiques de gestion des stocks et au respect des normes et directives du PAM en la matière.


PRINCIPALES FONCTIONS ET RESPONSABILITÉS (liste indicative et non exhaustive)


1. Coordonner et/ou assurer la réception et l'envoi des marchandises, y compris leur transbordement (entre camions) et se référer aux documents officiels approuvés (lettres de transport, notes de livraison, etc.) de façon à garantir l'exactitude du comptage physique des marchandises, notamment en vérifiant que la qualité est conforme aux normes établies.


2. Examiner, vérifier et valider les documents d'entreposage et de transport et veiller à la bonne gestion des fichiers confidentiels ainsi que des données sur les opérations d'entreposage, afin d'établir sans délai des rapports sur les mouvements des produits conformément aux exigences du PAM.


3. Effectuer quotidiennement, à la fermeture de l'entrepôt, les rapprochements et les vérifications de stock concourant aux systèmes de contrôle interne, conformément aux exigences en matière de gestion des entrepôts.


4. Effectuer les inspections quotidiennes et établir des rapports sur la quantité et la qualité des marchandises reçues/envoyées et manutentionnées, détecter rapidement les écarts de stock ou les dégâts occasionnés aux stocks et en analyser les raisons, enquêter sur les quantités manquantes et produire des rapports sur les pertes en entrepôt en recommandant les solutions appropriées, afin de permettre une prise de décisions en connaissance de cause.


5. Aider à réaliser un inventaire physique régulier des stocks pour assurer la conformité avec les normes IPSAS et les exigences opérationnelles standard.


6. Appliquer les mesures appropriées de protection des articles alimentaires et non alimentaires pour assurer le contrôle de la qualité en utilisant les mesures standard de prévention conformément aux procédures établies du PAM.


7. Surveiller l'état de l'entrepôt et des marchandises et prendre les mesures appropriées, afin d'aider à planifier l'espace de stockage de manière efficiente et à stocker les marchandises avec méthode en respectant les normes établies par le PAM en la matière.


8. Superviser les membres du personnel de l'entrepôt, leur donner des indications et les former en cours d'emploi pour les aider à se perfectionner et à être efficaces.


EXPÉRIENCE SOUHAITÉE


  • Avoir au moins cinq (5) années d'expérience dans le domaine de l'entreposage

  • Avoir une experience des bases de données logistiques utilisées pour assurer le suivi des expéditions en cours, des approvisionnements, des demandes d'indemnisation et des stocks alimentaires.

  • Avoir une expérience de l'analyse des données (sur les marchandises, les fonds, etc.) et de l'établissement de rapports.

  • Avoir une expérience de l'évaluation des résultats obtenus par les prestataires de services au regard des indicateurs de performance clés définis.

  • voir une expérience de l'aide à l'établissement des documents contractuels. • Expérience de la fourniture d'une assistance technique à l'utilisation des systèmes internes.


NIVEAU D’ÉTUDES MINIMAL REQUIS


Formation:

Avoir achevé le cycle des études secondaires et obtenu un diplôme/certificat d’études post-secondaires dans le domaine de la Logistique.


Connaissances linguistiques:

Avoir la maîtrise du francais (niveau C) et de l'arabe local

I'm working with an exciting software start-up in Dublin that is continuing to grow its engineering team and is looking to appoint a Senior DevOps Engineer.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working closely with software engineers, improving cloud environments, deployment processes and reliability across a modern microservices based product.

The company is still at a stage where good ideas can have a real impact, so they are looking for someone experienced who can come in, get involved quickly and help improve how things are done.

(Hybrid - Dublin City Centre - 3 days per week on-site)

The role...

You'll work closely with the wider engineering team across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability and production support.

This is not a management role and there is no expectation to build or lead a Platform function. The focus is on finding a strong Senior DevOps Engineer who wants to stay hands-on and have real ownership across the environment.

Responsibilities...

  • Support and improve cloud infrastructure across AWS and/or Azure
  • Work with Kubernetes and containerised applications
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines
  • Support microservices-based applications in production
  • Improve reliability, scalability and operational performance
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure and production issues
  • Support monitoring, logging and observability
  • Work with software engineers to improve deployment and release processes
  • Use Infrastructure as Code to manage cloud environmentsSupport cloud security and access controls
  • Work with basic networking including VPCs/VNets, subnets, routing and security groups
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational tasks
  • Contribute to incident resolution and root-cause analysis

Technical environment...

  • AWS
  • Docker
  • Terraform
  • CI/CD
  • Microservices
  • Monitoring and observability
  • .NET-based applications

AWS is preferred, but strong Azure experience will also be considered.

About you...

You’ll likely come from a DevOps, Cloud Engineering, SRE or Infrastructure Engineering background and have strong hands‑on experience across cloud environments and modern deployment tooling.

You’ll ideally have experience with:

  • Docker
  • Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code tool
  • Monitoring and observability
  • Production support and troubleshooting
  • Working closely with software development teams

Experience with technologies such as ECS, EKS, Grafana, Prometheus, Argo CD, Azure DevOps, Python, PowerShell or Bash would also be useful.

Why apply?

This is a great opportunity to join a growing software company at a stage where your experience can make a real difference.

You’ll have plenty of hands‑on ownership, work closely with senior engineering leadership and help improve the systems and processes that support the company's next stage of growth.

Negotiable salary of €80,000-€90,000 depending on experience.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. Please let us know if you require any adjustments.

title: Data Engineering Senior Associate
description:
Digital Enterprise Technology blazes the trail for enterprise IT at Salesforce. Built on our core values—Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, Equality, and Sustainability,we go beyond traditional IT by partnering closely with the business to deliver exceptional outcomes.
Our organization oversees enterprise technology strategy, Salesforce on Salesforce, customer and partner enablement, application engineering, data platforms, infrastructure, collaboration, enterprise operations, architecture, and program enablement. We operate one of the world’s most sophisticated Salesforce implementations and enable our global Ohana to do their best work through secure, scalable, and innovative technology.

About the Team and Technology Environment

This role is part of the Digital Enterprise Technology team supporting enterprise data, application integrations, and business-critical production services for the IT Finance & Employee Success team .
The team develops and operates cloud-based solutions connecting Salesforce with finance, HCM, and other enterprise platforms. Our technology environment includes Salesforce APIs, Workday and other data models, Snowflake, Apache Airflow, Python, SQL, ETL/ELT platforms, and modern monitoring and service-management tools. The team works closely with engineering, business, security, infrastructure, both Internal and External SoX and operations partners to deliver reliable data flows, resilient integrations, and continuous improvements across the enterprise technology landscape.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop, enhance, and support data ingestion and ETL/ELT solutions using Python, Snowflake, SQL, Informatica, or BusinessObjects Data Integrator.
  • Design, maintain, and monitor Apache Airflow DAGs for scheduling, workflow orchestration, dependency management, retries, and failure recovery.
  • Develop and support MuleSoft APIs and integrations connecting Salesforce, enterprise applications, databases, and data platforms.
  • Provide production and agentic support using AI-assisted monitoring, troubleshooting, knowledge retrieval, incident summarization, and resolution recommendations.
  • Monitor scheduled jobs, APIs, interfaces, data availability, data quality, and upstream/downstream dependencies to meet operational SLAs.
  • Perform incident triage, restore failed services, coordinate with stakeholders, and track Time to Resolution (TTR).
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end activities by assisting with the SoX process in collaboration with Internal and External Auditors
  • Knowledge of Finance and HCM systems is a significant advantage.
  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring or critical incidents. Document corrective and preventive actions and track them through closure.
  • Support release management activities, including deployment planning, release validation, production verification, rollback readiness, and post-release monitoring.
  • Create and maintain operational run lists, production schedules, release checklists, job inventories, dependency details, and escalation contacts.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), runbooks, support documentation, knowledge articles, and RCA reports.
  • Perform operational activities such as system patching, password and credential rotation, certificate renewal, access management, configuration changes, and environment migrations.
  • Support Salesforce-related integrations with an understanding of Salesforce objects, APIs, authentication, batch interfaces, data flows, and integration troubleshooting.
  • Perform data validation, source-to-target reconciliation, completeness checks, and failed-job recovery to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Collaborate with data engineering, Salesforce, application, infrastructure, security, database, and business teams to resolve issues and deliver stable solutions.

Required Skills

  • Strong SQL development, data analysis, and production troubleshooting skills.
  • Hands-on experience with Python and Snowflake.
  • Experience with Apache Airflow workflow development, scheduling, and monitoring.
  • Experience supporting MuleSoft APIs and enterprise integrations.
  • Understanding of ETL/ELT processes, API integrations, job monitoring, incident management, release management, and SLA-based production support.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce platform concepts, objects, APIs, authentication, and integration patterns.
  • Knowledge of data warehouse concepts, including fact and dimension tables, star and snowflake schemas, conformed dimensions, and Slowly Changing Dimensions.
  • Ability to create clear SOPs, runbooks, RCAs, operational reports, and technical documentation.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Informatica or Data Integrator.
  • Tableau reporting and dashboard-development experience.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce data models and tools such as Bulk API, REST API, Platform Events, or Change Data Capture.
  • Experience with AI-assisted or agentic support solutions for monitoring, incident analysis, automated remediation, and knowledge management.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git, automated deployment, release controls, and rollback procedures.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, observability tools, service-management platforms, and enterprise alerting solutions.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery, ITIL processes, change management, and problem management.

title: AI Platform, Backend Software Engineer
description:
We’re growing and looking to hire a Backend Software Engineer, AI Platform who embodies our core values: People First, Customer Obsession, Strive for Excellence, and Integrity

Claroty is a global leader in cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast-growing, award-winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity.

At Claroty, our technology strategy is focused on solving real-world cyber-physical security problems at scale through robust, distributed, cloud-native architectures. We design and evolve a unified platform that serves as the technological backbone for all Claroty products, delivering deep visibility across CPS environments—without disrupting critical operations. Our architecture emphasizes scalability, resilience, and extensibility to support both cloud and on-prem deployments.

About the Role:

As a Backend Software Engineer, AI Platform at Claroty, you will design and build high-performance backend systems and production-grade AI solutions that secure critical cyber-physical environments. You will solve complex architecture, networking, and data challenges, integrating cutting-edge LLM and AI technologies directly into our core product platform.

Responsibilities

As a Backend Software Engineer, AI Platform your impact will be:

  • Feature & Architectural Ownership: Take end-to-end ownership over complex features from initial architecture to global deployment implementing scalable architectures across cloud and on-prem environments.
  • AI & LLM Integration: Design, build, and deploy production-grade LLM applications, RAG systems, and AI agents to enable intelligent natural language interfaces and automated security workflows.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Integrate modern AI development platforms (specifically Cursor, Claude, or GitHub Copilot) into daily workflows to accelerate code generation, optimize refactoring, and automate complex problem-solving.
  • Code Excellence: Promote engineering best practices, system resilience, and clean code architecture.


Requirements

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • Backend & Python Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience in server backend design and development, with a strong track record of building complex production applications in Python.
  • AI & LLM Applications (Hands-on): Practical experience building and deploying production-grade LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, or natural language interfaces.
  • Distributed Systems Architecture: Proven experience building distributed, high-availability, large-scale systems handling real-time data traffic and networking protocols.
  • AI-Driven Workflows: Proficiency in utilizing AI development tools (specifically Cursor and Claude) to streamline software development workflows and root-cause defect analysis.
  • Bonus Points: Cloud-Native experience (AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes), cybersecurity background (ZTNA, IAM, VPN), and deep networking/security knowledge (TCP/IP, SSH, RDP, Encryption).


About Claroty

Claroty empowers organizations to protect the mission-critical infrastructure that underpins modern life. The AI-powered Claroty Platform serves as the single source of operational truth, providing the deepest visibility and broadest protection across cyber-physical systems (CPS), leveraging five core solutions: asset inventory, exposure management, network protection, secure access, and threat detection. Claroty helps organizations operationalize CPS protection through a programmatic approach designed to reduce risk, maintain operational integrity, and meet compliance–whether in the cloud with Claroty xDome or on-premise with Claroty Continuous Threat Detection (CTD). Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. To learn more, visit.

title: MOX RPS Bander
description:
The Bander / Corner Board Operator is responsible for safely operating banding and packaging equipment to prepare finished steel products for storage and shipment while ensuring products are accurately identified, counted, labeled, protected, banded, and packaged according to customer requirements, quality standards, and shipping schedules. This position plays a critical role in maintaining product quality and shipment accuracy through the operation of the bander, insta-sheeter, and corner board equipment, ensuring materials are packaged securely and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

Banding & Packaging Operations

  • Set up, operate, and monitor the bander, insta-sheeter, corner board equipment, and related packaging machinery.
  • Accurately identify products and direct finished materials to the appropriate staging or shipping location.
  • Verify material counts and ensure products are properly tagged and labeled according to customer specifications.
  • Package, band, and secure finished steel products to prevent damage during storage and transportation.
  • Apply corner board, protective materials, and packaging components as required by customer and company standards.
  • Fill customer orders accurately and in a timely manner to support shipping schedules and production requirements.
  • Handle steel sections and finished products safely using approved procedures and equipment.
  • Serve as backup for stacker operations as needed to support production flow.
  • Maintain adequate supplies of packaging materials, labels, corner board, banding materials, and other required resources.
  • Follow run sheets and production schedules to ensure packaging accuracy and efficiency.
  • Assist with material movement and staging activities as assigned.

Quality & Safety

  • Responsible for the quality of materials being processed and packaged.
  • Inspect products for visible defects, damage, or packaging discrepancies prior to shipment.
  • Ensure packaged materials meet customer specifications and company quality standards.
  • Report quality concerns, equipment malfunctions, and process issues to appropriate personnel.
  • Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and safe work practices.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work area utilizing housekeeping and 5S principles.
  • Properly wear and maintain required personal protective equipment (PPE).

Teamwork & Continuous Improvement

  • Work effectively with production, quality, and shipping team members.
  • Participate in departmental training and job rotation activities.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, efficiency, and productivity.
  • Maintain a positive attitude and contribute to a team-oriented work environment.
  • Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to learn additional departmental responsibilities.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Position Requirements

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred.
  • Ability to read and follow work instructions, packaging specifications, labels, and production requirements.
  • Ability to accurately count, inspect, package, label, and palletize products according to established standards.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to safely lift, carry, move, and handle products and packaging materials throughout the workday.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with production, quality, and shipping personnel.
  • Willingness to learn new processes and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience operating banding, packaging, labeling, or material handling equipment.
  • Experience in steel, metal fabrication, or manufacturing environments.
  • Experience working with inventory identification, labeling, and packaging systems.

Other Job Responsibilities and Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to stand and walk for the duration of the shift.
  • Frequent bending, reaching, stooping, twisting, and lifting required.
  • Must be able to lift, carry, and handle materials weighing up to 50 pounds independently.
  • Team lifting is required for loads exceeding 50 pounds.
  • Must be capable of safely handling steel sections and packaging materials.
  • Must be able to push, pull, and move material as required to perform job duties safely.
  • Manual dexterity required to operate banding equipment, packaging machinery, computers, scanners, and measuring devices.
  • Must be able to perform repetitive hand, wrist, and arm movements throughout the shift.
  • Ability to work safely in a manufacturing environment with exposure to noise, moving equipment, and varying temperatures.
  • Ability to wear required PPE, including safety glasses, gloves, hearing protection, and steel-toed footwear.
  • Must be able to safely work around automated packaging and material handling equipment.

title: Senior Planner
description:
Job Description

The Office of Public Health Preparedness (OPHP) is a program of the Boston Public Health Commission (BPHC). The mission of OPHP is to enhance community, public health, and healthcare system resilience to prepare for, respond to, and recover from emergencies that impact the health of the public. OPHP envisions a resilient Boston through healthy, informed, and connected communities that are supported every day and during emergencies by strong, integrated public health and healthcare systems.

Role

OPHP seeks a Senior Planner to lead and coordinate emergency planning and preparedness activities across the office. The Senior Planner works with OPHP and BPHC staff and programs, City agencies, and external partners to ensure plans are collaborative, integrated, operational, current, and responsive to the needs of Boston residents. Working under the direction of the Associate Director of Planning & Community Resilience, the Senior Planner serves as a lead resource for emergency planning and supports BPHC’s responsibilities for coordinating public health and healthcare services during emergencies, including its role under Emergency Support Function 8 (ESF-8).

Duties

Emergency Planning & Preparedness

  • Works to help BPHC advance as an antiracist organization by meeting or exceeding the standards set by the BPHC Anti-Racism Policy.
  • Lead and coordinate collaborative emergency planning efforts across OPHP and BPHC.
  • Maintain working knowledge of BPHC emergency plans, relevant City of Boston Plans, and Boston Healthcare Preparedness Coalition plans.
  • Coordinate development, review, maintenance, and integration of BPHC emergency plans and annexes, including integration with ESF-8 and other relevant City plans.
  • Maintain a master inventory and review cycle for emergency plans and identify planning gaps, dependencies, and priorities.
  • Coordinate Continuity of Operations (COOP), recovery, Medical Countermeasures/Emergency Dispensing, and other hazard-specific or functional planning activities, as assigned.
  • Support hazard vulnerability and capability assessment and incorporate identified risks and lessons learned into planning priorities and plan updates.
  • Coordinate planning with City agencies, healthcare organizations, community partners, universities, businesses, and other public and private partners.
  • Support training and exercise activities, including after actions and improvement plans, to test and validate emergency plans and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Research federal, state, and local requirements, guidance, and best practices to inform planning and preparedness activities.
  • Represent OPHP on preparedness planning groups and initiatives, as assigned.

Response & Recovery Operations

  • Serve as Duty Officer for the Stephen M. Lawlor Medical Intelligence Center (MIC) following required onboarding and training.
  • Staff the MIC during emergencies, planned events, and other activations affecting public health and healthcare.
  • Provide planning support during activations, including situational awareness, incident planning, documentation, and development of planning products.
  • Maintain working knowledge of relevant emergency plans, protocols, and procedures.
  • Maintain readiness by participating in required emergency responses, training, drill, and exercises.

+ Proven experience coordinating technical interfaces across clients, contractors, operators and engineering disciplines.
+ Experience in one or more of the following ITS systems: traffic management systems; roadside equipment including CCTV, variable message signs, lane use signs, variable speed limit signs, vehicle detectors, weigh-in-motion systems, vehicle classifiers and field cabinets; communications and fibre optic networks; incident detection systems; connected and smart mobility infrastructure; street lighting and electrical infrastructure; and LV distribution for ITS equipment.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer

Location: Singapore or Kuala Lumpur

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Opportunity

You will own and improve the infrastructure, deployment systems and operational reliability behind a high-traffic production platform. The role covers cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, incident response, infrastructure automation and production security.

This is a deeply hands-on individual-contributor position. You should be comfortable designing infrastructure, writing automation, deploying changes, investigating production incidents and taking ownership of systems from implementation through ongoing operation.

The ideal candidate is an experienced DevOps or SRE engineer who also possesses strong security fundamentals. You should be able to keep production systems reliable and scalable while ensuring that infrastructure, access controls, deployment processes and developer environments remain appropriately secured.

This role does not cover smart-contract auditing or protocol-level security reviews, which are handled by a separate internal team.

What You’ll Own

Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering

  • Design, build and operate highly available production infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.
  • Manage and improve Kubernetes clusters, networking, compute, storage, databases and other managed cloud services.
  • Build reusable infrastructure through infrastructure-as-code and automation.
  • Improve the scalability, reliability, performance and cost efficiency of production systems.
  • Establish consistent infrastructure standards across development, staging and production environments.
  • Identify and resolve infrastructure bottlenecks, configuration issues and operational risks.
  • Evaluate and implement new infrastructure tools where they provide clear operational value.
  • Maintain clear documentation and runbooks for critical systems.

CI/CD and Deployment Automation

  • Own and improve CI/CD pipelines, build systems and deployment workflows.
  • Automate testing, builds, releases, environment provisioning and production deployments.
  • Improve deployment speed and reliability while maintaining appropriate safeguards.
  • Secure source-code repositories, build environments, automation systems and deployment credentials.
  • Implement branch protections, approval workflows, rollback processes and deployment auditability.
  • Review infrastructure-as-code and deployment configurations for reliability and security issues.
  • Work closely with engineers to make deployments simple, repeatable and safe.

Reliability, Monitoring and Observability

  • Build and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting and observability across infrastructure and applications.
  • Define service-level indicators and operational metrics for critical production systems.
  • Improve visibility into system health, application performance and infrastructure utilisation.
  • Detect and investigate abnormal service behaviour before it becomes a major incident.
  • Reduce alert noise and ensure that operational alerts are clear and actionable.
  • Identify recurring production issues and implement long-term preventive improvements.
  • Conduct capacity planning and prepare systems for periods of increased activity.

Production Operations and Incident Response

  • Respond to production incidents involving infrastructure, services, APIs, databases and deployment systems.
  • Lead technical investigations from initial alert through containment, diagnosis and resolution.
  • Coordinate recovery efforts across DevOps, SRE, backend and frontend engineering.
  • Perform root‑cause analysis and lead post‑incident reviews.
  • Develop and maintain incident‑response and disaster‑recovery playbooks.
  • Improve system resilience, redundancy, backup and recovery processes.
  • Participate in an appropriate production support or on‑call rotation.

Infrastructure and Operational Security

  • Apply security best practices across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD and developer environments.
  • Manage IAM, service accounts, privileged access and least‑privilege policies.
  • Improve the management of credentials, secrets, API keys and deployment permissions.
  • Monitor infrastructure and production systems for suspicious access, configuration changes and abnormal activity.
  • Identify exposed services, excessive permissions, insecure configurations and other infrastructure weaknesses.
  • Introduce network segmentation and appropriate controls around sensitive systems.
  • Strengthen software‑supply‑chain security across repositories, dependencies and build environments.
  • Support the investigation and remediation of infrastructure or application security incidents.
  • Establish secure infrastructure baselines and monitor environments for deviations.

Engineering Collaboration

  • Partner with backend and frontend engineers to improve application deployment, reliability and performance.
  • Provide infrastructure guidance during the design of new services and products.
  • Help engineers diagnose production and performance issues.
  • Review backend architecture from an operational, scalability and security perspective.
  • Contribute to backend or DevOps code when additional engineering support is required.
  • Improve service‑to‑service authentication, API security and production configuration.
  • Make infrastructure and security practices practical and easy for engineers to adopt.

What We’re Looking For

Essential Experience

  • At least 7 years of hands‑on experience across DevOps, SRE, cloud infrastructure or production engineering.
  • Strong production experience with Google Cloud Platform or another major cloud provider.
  • Deep experience deploying and operating Kubernetes in production.
  • Strong knowledge of networking, Linux systems, containers, DNS, load balancing and cloud architecture.
  • Experience with infrastructure‑as‑code tools such as Terraform.
  • Strong experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience building monitoring, logging, alerting and observability systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and resolve complex production incidents independently.
  • Strong understanding of IAM, authentication, authorisation, secrets management and infrastructure security.
  • Ability to navigate infrastructure configurations, application code, logs and distributed production systems.
  • Proficiency in at least one relevant programming or scripting language, such as Go, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Java or Rust.
  • Strong debugging, automation and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fast‑moving engineering environment.
  • Working knowledge of cryptocurrency, blockchain, DeFi and exchange infrastructure.

Security Experience Required

This is primarily a DevOps and production‑infrastructure role, but candidates must have practical security experience, including:

  • Securing cloud and Kubernetes environments.
  • Implementing least‑privilege access controls.
  • Managing secrets and privileged credentials.
  • Securing CI/CD and deployment pipelines.
  • Monitoring systems for suspicious activity.
  • Supporting security‑incident investigation and remediation.
  • Identifying infrastructure and application misconfigurations.

A dedicated cybersecurity background is not required if you have demonstrated experience incorporating security into the systems you have built and operated.

Bonus Experience

  • Previous experience supporting cryptocurrency, blockchain, DeFi, exchange or financial‑technology infrastructure.
  • Significant production experience with GCP and Google Kubernetes Engine.
  • Experience operating high‑throughput, high‑availability or financially sensitive systems.
  • Experience with backend services, APIs and distributed systems.
  • Experience conducting security reviews or collaborating with security researchers and auditors.
  • Relevant cloud, Kubernetes or security certifications.
  • Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Security or a related discipline.

Who You’ll Work With

  • Backend and frontend engineering.
  • DevOps and SRE.
  • Product and operations.
  • Internal security specialists.
  • External infrastructure or security partners where appropriate.

This is a high‑ownership role with significant autonomy and direct responsibility for the reliability and security of production systems.

Scope Clarification

The role focuses on DevOps, cloud infrastructure, production reliability and operational security. Smart‑contract auditing and protocol‑security reviews are outside its scope.

Location Requirement

Candidates must be based in Singapore or Kuala Lumpur.

Application

Shortlisted candidates will receive further information about the company and opportunity directly from Nodeworthy.

description:
Brug din faglighed, gør en forskel for patienter med kræft – og bliv en del af et fællesskab, der vil hinanden.

Er du lægesekretær eller sundhedsadministrativ koordinator, og har du lyst til at bruge din faglighed et sted, hvor overblik, ansvarlighed og samarbejde gør en reel forskel?

Kan du lide at fordybe dig, blive dygtigere til dit fag og være en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at få hverdagen til at fungere?

Så er det måske dig, vi mangler i vores sekretærgruppe i Afdeling for Kræftbehandling på SUH i Køge. Vi søger en kollega til en fast stilling på 37 timer om ugen.

Hos os kan du opbygge specialiseret viden, der gør en forskel

Noget af det, der gør vores sekretærgruppe særlig, er, at vi har valgt at integrere henvisningsopgaven i de enkelte teams frem for at samle den i en særskilt enhed.

Det giver dig mulighed for at opbygge en dybdegående viden om blandt andet kræftpakker, maksimale ventetider, behandlingsgarantier og korrekt registrering af patientforløb.

Det er et komplekst og specialiseret fagområde, hvor regler, tidsfrister og registreringer skal forstås og håndteres korrekt. Når patienterne kommer til os, er de færdigudredte, og vi varetager deres videre behandling. Vi skal derfor kunne validere, at de forudgående registreringer er korrekte, så vi har et retvisende grundlag at arbejde videre med.

Det kræver faglig fordybelse, præcision og ansvarlighed. Til gengæld får du mulighed for at opbygge en særlig ekspertise og blive rigtig dygtig inden for et område, der har stor betydning for kvaliteten i patientforløbene.

Vi synes, det er noget af det, der gør jobbet hos os særligt spændende: Du får mulighed for at udvikle en faglighed, der rækker langt ud over de daglige administrative opgaver.

Vi arbejder med patienter med prostata- og blærekræft, lungekræft, kræft i tyk- og endetarm, brystkræft, bugspytkirtelkræft og kræft i livmoderen.

En tydelig retning – og plads til at blive dygtigere

Vi er i gang med at udvikle vores sekretærgruppe med fokus på tydelige arbejdsgange, stærke faglige kompetencer og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Som sundhedsadministrativ leder er det vigtigt for mig, at vi har en hverdag med ro, retning og tydelige rammer. Du skal vide, hvad der forventes af dig, have mulighed for at udvikle din faglighed og opleve, at der er sammenhæng mellem ansvar og opgaver.

Jeg tror på, at vi lykkes bedst, når vi har tillid til hinanden, deler vores viden og hjælper hinanden med at finde løsninger. Derfor prioriterer jeg både faglig udvikling, ordentlig kommunikation og et arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi kan være forskellige, men arbejder mod fælles mål.

Det betyder også, at vi hver især har et ansvar for den arbejdsplads, vi er en del af. Jeg sætter pris på medarbejdere, der tager initiativ, er nysgerrige på deres fag og bidrager konstruktivt til samarbejdet.

Mit mål er, at du både skal kunne mærke, at din faglighed gør en forskel, og at du er en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi vil hinanden og lykkes sammen.


Hvad bliver din hverdag?

Du bliver en vigtig del af patienternes behandlingsforløb og samarbejder tæt med læger, sygeplejersker og sekretærkolleger.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Modtagelse, validering og håndtering af henvisninger
  • Koordinering og planlægning af patientforløb
  • Booking og opfølgning på undersøgelser og behandlinger
  • Kontakt med patienter, pårørende og samarbejdspartnere
  • Registrering og opfølgning på kræftpakkeforløb og forløbstider
  • Journalføring og administrative opgaver i Sundhedsplatformen
  • Deltagelse i tværfaglige konferencer, herunder MDT
  • Varetagelse af call-center

Vi tilpasser introduktionen til dine erfaringer og kompetencer. Du skal ikke kunne det hele fra første dag, men du skal have lyst til at lære, tage ansvar og blive dygtig til dine funktioner.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet lægesekretær eller sundhedsadministrativ koordinator
  • Arbejder struktureret og følger dine opgaver til dørs
  • Har blik for kvalitet og sammenhæng i patientforløbene
  • Har lyst til at udvikle dine kompetencer og tage ansvar
  • Trives med faglig fordybelse og komplekse administrative opgaver
  • Bidrager aktivt til samarbejdet og hjælper dine kolleger
  • Møder andre med respekt, ordentlighed og en konstruktiv tilgang


Et godt arbejdsmiljø skaber vi sammen

Vi vil gerne være en arbejdsplads, hvor man har lyst til at møde ind, hvor man kan spørge om hjælp, og hvor man oplever, at kollegerne bakker op om hinanden.

For os handler et godt arbejdsmiljø om mere end gode intentioner. Det handler om, hvordan vi møder hinanden, deler viden, løser opgaver og håndterer de dage, hvor planen ikke holder.

Vi forventer, at du bidrager til fællesskabet og tager medansvar for, at hverdagen fungerer. Til gengæld arbejder vi for tydelige rammer, godt samarbejde og en kultur, hvor vi spiller hinanden gode.

Og selvfølgelig skal der også være plads til et grin undervejs. Vi arbejder med alvorlige sygdomsforløb, men det betyder ikke, at vores arbejdsdag skal være alvorlig hvert eneste minut.

Det får du hos os
  • En grundig introduktion med tydelige forventninger og løbende opfølgning
  • Mulighed for faglig fordybelse og udvikling af specialiserede kompetencer
  • En varieret hverdag med ansvar og tæt tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Kolleger at sparre med og dele viden med
  • En arbejdsplads, der aktivt arbejder med trivsel, arbejdsmiljø og gode arbejdsgange
  • Mulighed for hjemmearbejde, når opgaverne og afdelingens drift tillader det, inden for afdelingens gældende rammer
Praktisk information
  • Stilling: Fast stilling, 37 timer om ugen
  • Arbejdssted: SUH, Køge
  • Tiltrædelse: 1. Januar eller efter aftale
  • Ansøgningsfrist: 27.10.2026
  • Samtaler: forventes afholdt i uge 45

Har du lyst til at bruge din faglighed et sted, hvor vi både tager patientforløbene og hinanden alvorligt? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.


Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.

title: Senior Solution Analyst - Banking
description:
About CodeNinja

CodeNinja is a global software and AI infrastructure company delivering full-stack technology solutions across AI, software engineering, data, and digital transformation.

With operations across Saudi Arabia and global technology hubs, CodeNinja works with organizations across multiple industries to deliver technology solutions that support business transformation and innovation.

Our teams work across areas including AI, software engineering, data and analytics, cloud, enterprise technology, and digital transformation.

CodeNinja is looking for a Senior Solution Analyst with strong experience in the banking domain, payment systems, and core banking platforms.

About the Role

In this role, you will be embedded within a banking IT delivery environment. You will translate business requirements into clear functional and technical specifications, and support solution design, integration, and testing through strong documentation and stakeholder engagement.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with BRD analysis, functional and technical specifications, Low-Level Design (LLD), APIs, and integrations across payment and core banking systems. They will ensure solutions stay aligned with strategic goals and regulatory frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders.
  • Analyze and interpret Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and break them down into solution components.
  • Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications, including SRDs.
  • Contribute to the preparation and validation of Low-Level Designs (LLDs).
  • Work across APIs, integrations, and architectural components to shape and validate solutions.
  • Ensure domain alignment across payment systems and core banking platforms.
  • Support solution design, integration, and testing phases with clear, structured documentation.
  • Collaborate with business, architecture, development, and QA teams to drive business–IT alignment.
  • Ensure solutions align with strategic objectives and applicable regulatory frameworks.
  • Provide implementation support and maintain up-to-date solution documentation.

Requirements

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in solution analysis or business analysis within the banking domain.
  • Proven experience analyzing BRDs and producing BRD/SRD documentation and functional specifications.
  • Hands-on exposure to Low-Level Design (LLD) and development environments.
  • Demonstrated experience working in KSA’s banking sector is preferred.

Domain Knowledge

  • Strong domain expertise in payment systems and core banking platforms.
  • Understanding of banking business portfolios and product structures.
  • Awareness of banking regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.

Technical Skills

  • Ability to work across technical aspects including APIs, system integrations, and system architecture.
  • Ability to translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
  • Experience supporting integration and testing phases.

Core Competencies

  • Strong requirement gathering and functional analysis skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to drive business–IT alignment and document solutions professionally.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent field.

Language

  • Fluent in English; Arabic is preferred.

Key Competencies

Solution Analysis | Business Analysis | Banking | Payment Systems | Core Banking | BRD | SRD | LLD | APIs | Integrations | Stakeholder Management | Functional Specifications

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.
  • Opportunity to work on enterprise-scale technology and digital transformation projects.
  • Exposure to banking, financial services, payments, and emerging technology environments.
  • Professional growth and learning opportunities.
  • Collaborative and technically driven work environment.
  • Opportunity to work with experienced technology and consulting professionals.

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the role and is not exhaustive of all responsibilities, skills, or qualifications required. CodeNinja reserves the right to modify duties and responsibilities at any time.

Within a highly skilled engineering environment, you will work across the full technology stack—from hardware and networking to Kubernetes and automation—helping to design, build, and operate a secure, reliable, and developer-friendly private cloud platform.

Your Profile

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field — or equivalent practical experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with Linux system administration and infrastructure engineering
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools (Terraform, Ansible or similar)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, scripting or programming (Python, Go, Bash or similar)
  • Understanding of observability tools and reliability concepts
  • Strong problem-solving mindset, ownership, and willingness to learn
  • Swiss citizenship is required
