title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
Own the data platform from source ingestion through operational analytics and registry reporting. You will assess the existing codebase, shape the architecture and deliver improvements incrementally while supporting current operations. The responsibilities include re-architecting where needed, not simply maintaining existing pipelines.

This role combines platform engineering, data engineering and analytics engineering. We are looking for strong platform judgment and hands‑on Python and SQL skills, supported by solid analytical modeling. You should be comfortable choosing a managed capability, building a domain‑specific component, or simplifying a workflow based on reliability, correctness, cost and the team's capacity to operate it.

You will use AI coding assistants as part of everyday engineering, with responsibility for the design, correctness and maintainability of everything delivered. You will also help operate AI-based document extraction and human review within the data workflow.

What you will own

  • Architecture for multiple plants. Design shared capabilities, facility configuration, access boundaries and data isolation. Establish a practical path from a few plants to many plants, using representative workloads and operational needs to guide decisions. Make each additional plant easier to onboard without creating separate code forks.
  • Managed-service and build-versus-buy decisions. Evaluate compute, storage, databases, orchestration, connectors, identity and monitoring. Consider engineering time, service limits, recurring cost, recovery, vendor dependencies and exit options. Prefer managed services when they meet requirements and reduce ongoing operational work.
  • Reliable ingestion and processing. Build reusable integrations for operational sheets, sensors, APIs, documents and laboratory results. Handle duplicates, late or missing data, schema changes, retries and historical reprocessing. Make source failures visible and recoverable.
  • Shared data models and analytics. Model plants, equipment, production batches, feedstock deliveries, samples and evidence with explicit grain, stable identifiers, units, time semantics and history. Create tested datasets and consistent metrics for plant operations, portfolio analysis and reporting.
  • Traceable calculations and evidence. Preserve source provenance, human corrections, calculation versions and approval states. Implement carbon and reporting rules with domain specialists, reconcile outputs and assess the effect of changes on historical results. Distinguish estimates, submitted evidence and accepted registry outcomes.
  • Improve identity, authorization, service permissions and secrets management across APIs, internal tools and automated workloads. Make sensitive data access and reviewer actions attributable to the right people and services.
  • Operate and improve our GCP and container infrastructure, including Cloud Run services, Dagster execution, PostgreSQL connectivity, storage and caching. Establish useful monitoring, alerts, recovery procedures and cost visibility.
  • Make development and releases repeatable through dependency management, automated tests, CI/CD, configuration management and infrastructure automation. Provide documented deployment and rollback paths.
  • Create operations and delivery that a small team can sustain. Establish automated checks, CI/CD, infrastructure configuration, useful monitoring, cost visibility and recovery procedures. Deliver migrations in bounded steps and document the system so another engineer can deploy, diagnose and recover it.
  • Effective AI-assisted engineering. Use coding assistants and agents for codebase exploration, implementation, refactoring, test development, documentation and debugging. Build repeatable ways to provide context, review changes and verify results while keeping ownership with the engineer.

What you bring

  • Experience owning production data systems through design, architectural change, migration and operation. You can explain the trade‑offs and measurable outcomes of your decisions.
  • Strong Python and SQL, including maintainable interfaces, APIs, relational databases, warehouse transformations, numerical correctness and production debugging.
  • Strong data modeling: record grain, keys, temporal relationships, schema evolution, lineage, units and consistent metrics across heterogeneous sources.
  • Experience with orchestration, incremental processing, idempotency, backfills, reconciliation, monitoring and recovery. You understand how a successful pipeline can still produce incomplete or incorrect data.
  • Practical cloud engineering experience with managed compute, databases, object storage, event or queue services, identity and observability. GCP experience is valuable; comparable cloud experience is transferable.
  • Sound build‑versus‑buy judgment and experience making systems operable by a small team. You can justify both adopting a managed service and building a custom component.
  • Experience generalizing integrations or platform capabilities across multiple customers, sites, facilities or source systems, with configurable behavior and clear access boundaries.
  • The ability to prioritize, communicate architecture decisions clearly and work directly with plant operators, reviewers and domain specialists.

We expect practical fluency with AI coding assistants and a disciplined approach to their limitations. You should be able to:

  • Turn an engineering task into a verifiable workflow. Supply relevant repository context, define constraints and acceptance criteria, break work into reviewable changes and use agents where they improve the outcome.
  • Evaluate generated code independently. Review architecture, dependencies, SQL, migrations and security implications. Test important behaviors and failure cases, inspect actual outputs and catch plausible but incorrect assumptions. Do not treat generated tests or an assistant's completion statement as proof of correctness.
  • Debug beyond the assistant's suggestions. Trace a problem through logs, data and source code; reproduce it; and explain the root cause. Maintain the Python, SQL and systems skills needed to resolve failures when AI assistance is ineffective.
  • Use tools with appropriate access. Protect credentials and sensitive operational data, follow approved tool and data‑handling policies, and apply deliberate review to production changes, database writes and external submissions.
  • Make AI‑assisted work maintainable. Produce focused diffs, meaningful tests, clear documentation and understandable code. Share reusable workflows with the team and assess their value through delivery time, defects, rework and maintenance effort.

We welcome experience with different coding assistants and agent tools; expertise in one vendor is not a prerequisite. This role does not require training foundation models. It does require the judgment to use AI effectively and remain accountable for the resulting system.

Useful additional experience

  • BigQuery or a comparable cloud warehouse; PostgreSQL, object storage, Pub/Sub or similar messaging, and managed application hosting.
  • Dagster, Airflow, Prefect or managed orchestration; dbt, Dataform or comparable transformation practices; Docker and infrastructure‑as‑code tools.
  • Industrial sensor data, intermittent connectivity, laboratory records, carbon accounting, lifecycle assessment or registry integrations.
  • OCR and LLM extraction pipelines, representative evaluation datasets, field‑level accuracy measurement, model/prompt versioning and human review workflows.
  • Building practical analytical interfaces and operational dashboards, and helping nontechnical users interpret data‑quality exceptions.

Our current stack is a starting point for informed decisions. You will help determine which components to retain, replace or obtain as managed services. Carbon‑domain expertise is welcome and can be developed with our specialists.

How we will work together

You own the engineering implementation and technical reliability of the platform. Plant operations and reviewers own source‑data verification; MRV specialists interpret and approve carbon methodology, eligibility rules and reporting decisions. You will make those responsibilities explicit in the system and work with their owners to resolve exceptions.

We will prioritize a bounded set of outcomes rather than expect every integration, dashboard and platform improvement at once. We will review engineering capacity as plant onboarding, support and reporting demand grows. Shared documentation, deployment practices and recovery exercises will help avoid dependence on one person.

Your first 90 days

We will agree scope and baseline measures together. Initial outcomes should include:

  • An architecture and migration plan: assess the existing platform, identify the highest‑impact correctness and operational risks, and propose a staged path toward 10s of plants with assumptions to revisit before 100s. Include managed‑service decisions and indicative costs.
  • One reusable source‑to‑reporting workflow: demonstrate it with representative data from more than one plant configuration, including data contracts, reconciliation, provenance, human review where needed and a safe historical reprocessing exercise.
  • A repeatable onboarding and operating path: document configuration, access, monitoring and recovery; measure manual engineering effort and demonstrate that another team member can follow the process.
  • A verified AI‑assisted development workflow: show how repository context, implementation, review and meaningful checks fit together, with examples of catching and correcting assistant errors.

Success will be measured through data correctness, reporting traceability, reduced onboarding and operational effort, reliable recovery and sustainable cost. The first 90 days are a foundation for scaling, not a commitment to make the platform scale to 100s plants within that period.

JOB TITLE : Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Advisor

TYPE OF CONTRACT : Regular International Consultant Level 2 (CST-II)

UNIT/DIVISION : Programme Management

DUTY STATION (City, Country) : Juba, South Sudan

DURATION : 11 months (renewable subject to performance and budget availability)


BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:

The World Food Programme (WFP) South Sudan has over 700 staff working in Juba and field offices Aweil, Bentiu, Bor, Kuajok, Malakal, Renk and Rumbek in South Sudan and operated in an extremely fragile security situation.

WFP has a Zero Tolerance Policy to sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA) and recognizes that it is a gross violation of power and a form of gender-based violence that all humanitarian partners have to prevent and respond to. Sexual exploitation and sexual abuse (SEA) are extreme forms of abuse of power for sexual purpose where aid workers take advantage of the people they are meant to serve, in particular those in positions of greater vulnerability. SEA can happen wherever people are in dire need and require assistance in settings ranging from full humanitarian crises to peace and development contexts.

WFP is committed to taking all reasonable steps to protect from SEA communities receiving WFP assistance - whether carried out by WFP Employees or any other individuals associated with the work of WFP, whether acting on a paid or voluntary basis and regardless of context or operation. WFP is committed to ensuring that the community rights to dignity, respect and integrity are protected and met.

Given South Sudan's ranking as the fourth-highest SEA risk context globally and the continuing vulnerabilities associated with conflict, displacement, and humanitarian assistance delivery, maintaining a dedicated PSEA Advisor is critical to ensure effective risk management, inter-agency coordination, community-based reporting mechanisms, survivor-centred response, and organizational accountability. Furthermore, WFP South Sudan has had a PSEA Advisor since May 2021 and this has been an essential role to operationalize and implement the ED PSEA Circular on PSEA (2026) and build WFP personnel and partners capacity on PSEA.

PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:

Under the direct supervision of the Country Director, the Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Advisor will support WFP South Sudan to implement the Executive Directors Circular on PSEA (OED2026/009)). The PSEA Advisor will develop and implement the WFP South Sudan PSEA Action Plan, which focuses on scaling up and taking forward prevention and response efforts to sexual exploitation and abuse. This will include conceptualizing and implementing SEA prevention activities, responding and escalating to OIGI SEA allegations, and ensuring appropriate victim support, liaising with the PSEA Taskforce and other inter-agency bodies working on PSEA. The Advisor will also be expected to make contributions to inter-agency PSEA response and monitoring, liaising with senior management at national, regional and international levels on the same. The PSEA Advisor will be also responsible for designing and implementing targeted capacity building activities for staff and partners across different sectors, producing and disseminating relevant technical guidance, tools and resources. PSEA initiatives should be planned and implemented in coordination with relevant technical areas in the country office or regional bureau, including but not limited to Protection, AAP, Gender and Monitoring. As far as possible, collaboration with the In Country PSEA Network and/or other protection and gender partners should be undertaken.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

• PSEA Risk Assessment - Undertake a comprehensive risk assessment of WFP presence, operations and activities to identify existing and emerging risks and present mitigations for adoption by the Country Office. Identified risks and mitigations should also be integrated into relevant risk documents in Country Office and in programme and operational approaches. Define root causes of SEA related risks in the Monitor and adjust existing mitigation and prevention measure accordingly to inform programme adjustments.

• Strategic PSEA Guidance and Advisory-In collaboration and coordination with the Senior Country level PSEA Focal Point (Deputy Country Director), advise senior management on meeting PSEA obligations and recommend improvements to prevention strategies and response mechanisms.

Action Plan and Standard Operating Procedure - Develop, update, implement a country specific PSEA Strategy and Action Plan that reflects and responds to current country context with clear timelines and budget requirements, and engage relevant colleagues across AAP, Protection, Gender, Human Resources, Partnerships, all programmatic activity leads, supply chain and logistics and other technical areas according to their responsibilities. The advisor will also be responsible to review and update the existing Standard Operating Procedure for Responding to Allegations of SEA in South Sudan Country Operations. The SOP should reflect dear roles and responsibilities, resources and community preferences and feedback on WFP prevention, mitigation, response and support.

• Mainstreaming of PSEA - Identify existing good practice, gaps and opportunities for mainstreaming of PSEA across all WFP programmes and activities and support progress accordingly. This may require resource mobilization, capacity building, strengthened interagency collaboration and enhanced referral pathways. This should be delivered in collaboration with related cross-cutting topics including protection, gender, accountability to affected populations and monitoring and evaluation.

• Interagency Collaboration - Represent WFP in the Interagency PSEA Taskforce, ensuring that the needs of WFP’s affected populations are addressed in inter-agency forums, plans and outputs. Ensure alignment between WFP and inter-agency practices on risk, prevention, mitigation, response and support, including community-based complaint mechanisms. Work with WFP colleagues, the In-Country PSEA Network, partners and communities to identify and implement effective SEA reporting options that protect confidentiality and are safely accessible to all community members, particularly those who are marginalized or in positions of greater vulnerability. Collaborate with relevant technical areas, the In-Country PSEA Network and partners to establish or strengthen WFP and inter-agency mechanisms for receiving SEA reports.

• Partner capacity - Oversee the implementation of the Interagency PSEA Partner Assessment Tools (developed by IASC with WFP support). Assessments should Include partner capacity support plans and be periodically reviewed to ensure achievement of capacity needs and to reflect any context and partner changes. Where possible, interagency collaboration should be adopted to streamline assessments and support plans.

• Survivor - centered approach – Roll-out regular training sessions for PSEA Focal Point (FP) to build their understanding and capacity on how to receive and escalate allegations of SEA as well as how to facilitate access to assistance for victims and survivors of SEA. Acquire and update as required PSEA referral pathways to ensure an up-to-date list of services available in all areas of operations for victim/survivors of SEA. Strengthen capacity of WFP Cooperating Partners to meet survivor-centered good practice.

• Reporting and management of allegations- Receive reports and queries about alleged acts of SEA, and support reporting allegations through corporate mechanisms. Ensure that SEA reporting mechanisms and protocols are clearly understood by all staff, implementing partners and Community Feedback Mechanism (CFM) personnel are familiar with the Guidance on the management of sensitive allegations. Once an allegation is received, ensure that all related information is handled confidentially and referred to strictly in line with agreed protocols and established global SOPs, both within WFP and at the inter-agency level.

• Response to Reports of SEA - Immediately report all allegations, suspicions and concerns of alleged SEA to Office of Inspections and Investigations (OIGI), providing as much information as is available at the time. Refer victims of SEA to available support and assistance services in line with in-country referral pathways and relevant PSEA Network SOPs and provide anonymized information on SEA allegations in accordance with the In-Country PSEA Network SOPs and Information Sharing Protocol.

• PSEA Focal Points - Oversee the network of WFP South Sudan PSEA Focal Points, ensuring that their roles and responsibilities are well understood and performed, their capacity development needs and opportunities are regularly reviewed and addressed, and their identities and contact details are widely known and easily accessible. Ensure that all Focal Points collaborate with inter-agency PSEA networks in their locations to establish community-based complaint mechanisms and that SOPs for inter-agency and WFP complaint handling meet survivor-centered standards.

• Awareness raising - Develop and implement innovative awareness-raising approaches that reflect the roles and responsibilities of each audience and their communication, information and language needs and preferences. Regularly train WFP employees on PSEA and SEA reporting mechanisms, including through induction briefings and training for newcomers.

Raise awareness among WFP staff, Cooperating Partner staff, vendors and contractors, authorities, local leaders, communities and other key stakeholders. Support Cooperating Partners and other partners to conduct awareness-raising sessions jointly with WFP and relevant Field-Office and CO technical areas. Work with colleagues and partners to ensure that communities receiving WFP assistance are routinely informed of their rights, what SEA is and how to report it, including during each pre-distribution meeting and other relevant events.


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:


Education:

Advanced University degree (Master’s or above) in social sciences, psychology, gender, protection, humanitarian law, GBV, social work or related, or first university degree (Bachelor’s) in the above field with additional relevant experience. Additional training in relevant fields is desirable.

Experience:

  • For the master’s degree holder, at least Eight (8) or more years of experience in PSEA, gender, Protection, GBV or related areas. For the bachelor’s degree holder, at least Ten (10) years of the above experience is required.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of working with communities in deep-field locations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate multi-cultural, cross-functional teams.
  • Experience working in emergencies, humanitarian operations or other complex operational environments, conflict-affected context is required

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Proven Integrity, objectivity and professional competence.
  • Demonstrated sensitivity to cultural diversity, protection and gender Issues
  • Strong familiarity with UN policies and practices around gender, PSEA, Protection, GBV and related Issues
  • Excellent research and analytical skills
  • Excellent writing and interpersonal skills
  • Experience in working directly with local communities will be an asset.

Languages:

Fluency (level C) in English language is required

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

The Operator 2 serves as a system expert in their assigned production area while demonstrating high functional capability across multiple packaging and conversion work centers. This role is responsible for safely and efficiently operating equipment, executing equipment changeovers, maintaining strict product quality and food safety standards, performing basic preventive maintenance (Clean-Inspect-Lubricate routines), and driving continuous improvement on the line.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operate high-speed manufacturing, packaging, and conversion equipment to package finished pet food products safely and efficiently prior to distribution.

Perform real-time troubleshooting, clear mechanical jams, reset machine faults, and conduct structured equipment changeovers.

Complete autonomous maintenance and basic preventive maintenance routines, including Clean-Inspect-Lubricate (CIL) checklists.

Maintain strict adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP), and Quality & Food Safety (Q&FS) policies.

Monitor, verify, and log product quality attributes and process parameters using computer systems and digital logs.

Maintain strict compliance with safety regulations and personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements; proactively report and resolve safety hazards.

Conduct routine sanitation and 5S activities to maintain a clean, standardized, audit-ready work area.

Manage in-process inventory and raw material staging for assigned production lines.

Provide peer coaching and informal leadership to team members and temporary associates on operating standards and safety protocols.

Perform other production duties as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Requirements:

title: Mixer
description:
The Mixer position accurately combines raw ingredients into batches to create finished baked goods. This position performs duties in a safe and sanitary manner to ensure optimum quality and food safety.

title: Data & Intelligence Engineer
description:
Are you a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer or technically minded data professional looking for your next opportunity? Want to build your skills across data engineering, analytics, cloud and AI while working with a varied mix of clients and projects? This is your chance to join MBM as a Data & Intelligence Engineer.

MBM is one of New Zealand’s leading media agencies, combining media, digital, data and technology to help clients make smarter decisions and deliver better results. Our Data & Analytics team builds practical solutions that turn complex data into something useful.

About The Role

You’ll work within MBM’s Data & Analytics team, helping develop the data solutions that underpin reporting, analytics and decision-making across the agency and our clients.

The role spans data pipelines, integrations, reporting solutions and cloud platforms. Using tools such as Python and SQL, you’ll bring together data from different sources, build and maintain reliable pipelines and APIs, and help create reporting and analytics solutions for both MBM and its clients.

You’ll work across a range of client and agency projects, with the chance to contribute ideas, experiment with new approaches and see the solutions you build being used in practice. You’ll also work closely with internal stakeholders and clients, giving you plenty of opportunity to understand different business challenges and translate technical ideas into practical solutions.

As MBM continues to grow its capability across AI, automation and advanced analytics, you’ll have the opportunity to get involved in new and emerging areas while developing your skills over time. We’re not looking for someone who already knows everything. If you have a strong foundation, enjoy building things and are keen to keep learning, there’s plenty of scope to grow in the role.

About you

We’re open to a range of backgrounds. You might be early in your data engineering career, currently working in an analytics or technical data role, or coming from a strong computer science background and ready for your next step.

Ideally, you’ll bring:

  • A solid foundation in Python and general coding fundamentals
  • Experience with SQL, or the technical ability and interest to develop your SQL skills quickly
  • Exposure to data pipelines, integrations, APIs or ETL/ELT processes
  • Strong problem-solving skills and an interest in building practical data solutions
  • Excellent communication skills and confidence working with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Curiosity and a genuine interest in data, automation and AI
  • Experience in media, marketing or digital environments would be a bonus, but it’s not essential

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone with a good technical base who enjoys learning and is confident working with people across the business. If you’re passionate about the space but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Our offer to you

You’ll be supported by an experienced Data & Analytics team, with plenty of opportunity to learn through hands‑on work, collaboration and formal development. You’ll also have the chance to build your capability across cloud data engineering, analytics, automation and AI while working on a genuinely varied mix of projects.

Whether you’re already working in data engineering or have the right technical foundation and are ready to grow, we’d love to hear from you.

Diversity. Inclusion. Equity. More than just words, these are part of our DNA. At Publicis Groupe we are committed to the inclusion and recognition of all people; regardless of race, age, culture, ability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status and religious affiliation. description:
Albany Engineered Composites, Inc. (AEC) designs, develops, and manufactures advanced composite components. Our core strength is our ability to produce highly customized, complex composite parts, with a focus on AEC’s unique 3D reinforced composite technology. Our products often enable our customers to use lightweight, high-performance composites in applications where they previously have been unable to because of complex performance or geometry needs. For example, we help customers in aerospace and transportation replace heavier metallic components with highly durable, lightweight composite components to reduce weight and improve fuel efﬁciency.

AEC manufactured composite fan blades and cases are used exclusively in Leading Edge Aviation Propulsion (LEAP) engines, which power the Boeing 737-MAX and Airbus A320neo aircraft. The F-35 Joint Strike Fighter uses more than 200 AEC manufactured parts across all variants of the aircraft.

Please visit to learn more about AEC products and technologies. AEC is headquartered in Rochester, New Hampshire, home to AEC’s Research & Technology Center as well as LEAP and other production facilities. As well as assembling structural subassemblies such as, attaching clip and brackets, adding nutplates and using adhesives. Aligns parts on jigs using templates, molds and fixtures. Performs such minor part-fitting operations as filing, de-burring, crimping, trimming, riveting, drilling and reaming. Measures parts with micrometers and calipers to verify dimensions. May modify incomplete and complete assemblies to incorporate changes to structure. May monitor and verify quality in accordance with statistical process or other control procedures.

Train and mentor level I-III assemblers. Work with Senior assemblers, peers, and support group members to facilitate process improvements. Reporting of daily/weekly throughputs vs goals (SQORE metrics) to direct supervisor and higher levels of management in the event that the direct supervisor is unavailable.

  • Lead the effort for the assembly and fit of pre-fabricated metallic and composite parts to form assemblies, working at benches or directly on a structure assembly fixture. Read and interpret aircraft assembly instruction plans, diagrams, drawings and other documentation in order to perform and direct others on the assembly function with accuracy with little
  • Assemble, fit, shim and install pre-fabricated parts and subassemblies such as aircraft spars, rib, skins and
  • Utilize hand and power tools such as drills, to assemble and fabricate components with fasteners and bonding Instruct, train and oversee quality workmanship of lower level technicians. Utilize measuring equipment in order to meet specifications for the installation process.

Work with quality department personnel in order to keep production assemblies in proper sign off levels and within inspection procedure and/or specifications. Troubleshoot ideas for improvement and intervene when necessary on issues or concerns with process, schedule and quality needs.

title: Remote Health Insurance Advisor
description:
Remote Licensed Health Insurance Advisor — No Cold Calling, No Lead Buying

My client is growing their remote advisor team and looking for experienced, licensed Health Insurance Agents to support members through scheduled health plan advisements. They handle 100% of the prospecting and scheduling. You handle the conversation.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • $40 per completed advisement, plus $5 more for eligible Spanish-language advisements ($45 total)
  • 100% of appointments provided and scheduled for you
  • No cold calling, no door knocking, no buying leads, no outbound prospecting
  • Advisements typically run 10-20 minutes
  • Fully remote, 1099 independent contractor structure
  • $500 OEP completion bonus for eligible agents who finish the season in good standing
  • Training, ongoing support, and access to required enrollment platforms
  • Multi-state member opportunities, with potential for continued work based on performance

What You'll Do

You'll conduct scheduled phone or virtual health insurance advisements, reviewing each member's healthcare needs, budget, eligibility, and available plan options. That means explaining coverage, benefits, premiums, and limitations clearly, helping members make informed decisions, and assisting with enrollment when applicable. Each advisement gets documented accurately, with any necessary follow-up completed afterward. You'll show up on time for scheduled appointments, communicate professionally with members and partner teams, and follow all applicable carrier, state, federal, privacy, and compliance requirements, along with required training and product updates.

What You'll Need

This is not an entry-level position. Candidates must have an active Health Insurance Producer License, active licenses in a minimum of 5 states, and previous health insurance experience, including consultations with consumers by phone or virtually. You should have a strong grasp of health insurance terminology and enrollment processes, solid communication and client-service skills, and the ability to explain coverage clearly and compliantly. You'll also need to be dependable with scheduled appointments, comfortable working independently and remotely, and set up with a reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a quiet, professional workspace. Candidates must be able to work as a 1099 independent contractor.

Nice to Have

  • Bilingual English/Spanish, with the ability to run a complete advisement in Spanish
  • Individual & Family Plan, ACA/Marketplace, Medicare, private insurance, or short-term medical experience
  • Remote insurance or telesales experience
  • 10-12+ active state licenses (more licenses means access to a larger pool of appointments)

Compensation

This is a 1099 independent contractor role paid per completed advisement. You'll earn $40 for each completed, eligible advisement, with no hourly wage or guaranteed appointment volume; volume varies with member demand, scheduling, licensing, seasonality, and business needs. Eligible agents also receive a $500 bonus at the close of OEP for completing the season in good standing, and an additional $5 per eligible Spanish-language advisement.

Who Thrives Here

Agents who know how to run a consultation start to finish, communicate clearly, and build trust quickly over the phone. People who show up consistently, take documentation and compliance seriously, and explain plan options without high-pressure tactics. If you're organized, dependable, coachable, and want scheduled appointments instead of a day spent prospecting, this is built for you.

To Apply, Please Include

Your current résumé, state of residence, Health Insurance Producer License information, all states where you're currently licensed, a summary of your health insurance experience and the products you've worked with, whether you're fluent in Spanish, and your availability during OEP.

A minimum of 5 active state licenses is required to be considered; candidates with 10-12+ states will be prioritized.

Spend less time chasing prospects and more time doing what licensed health insurance professionals do best. Apply today to join this remote OEP advisor team.

The Controls Technician will also collaborate with the Automation Engineers to support continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Experience with control networks and troubleshooting fieldbus issues.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in an industrial automation environment.
  • Working knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in industrial automation, controls, or electrical maintenance.
  • Experience working in food processing or a similar manufacturing environment.

  • Basic programming skills in PLC software (Studio 5000, Connected Components Workbench, and FactoryTalk Viewpoint) are a plus.

What will be your key responsibilities? ​​

  • Troubleshoot and repair electrical control circuits, PLCs, motor circuits, and other automation components.
  • Perform preventive and predictive maintenance on electrical systems, sensors, actuators, and motor control centers (MCCs).Support production teams by diagnosing and resolving issues with automated equipment to minimize downtime.
  • Conduct regular inspections of electrical panels, VFDs, HMIs, and control networks to identify potential failures.

  • Train maintenance personnel on basic troubleshooting techniques for electrical and control systems.
  • Report to the Maintenance Manager while receiving daily direction and priority assignments from the Automation Engineers.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We’re CarTrawler, the global travel tech company behind seamless connections between people, places and possibilities. From powering car rental to creating smarter ways to move, we make travel smoother for millions worldwide. Our culture is built on curiosity, collaboration and craic where every idea counts and every journey matters. Ready to make an impact?

Let’s go places together.

The Senior Data Engineer – Digital & Behavioural Telemetry owns the engineering and evolution of the digital behavioural and telemetry data that explains how customers interact with CarTrawler products and partner experiences. Sitting within Data Engineering, the role combines behavioural telemetry, web-engine telemetry, Real User Monitoring (RUM) and conversion data with practical standards for instrumentation, event contracts and governed downstream use.

The role works closely with Product & Technology engineering teams to ensure new features, products and journeys produce consistent, contextualised data enabling analytics. Working with Data Engineering to turn signals into reusable data products and certified metrics. The role provides senior technical ownership for the digital & behavioural telemetry domain, operating within the Data Engineering platform architecture. Working with product and domain teams to convert trusted behavioural data and digital telemetry data into governed analytical products.

What you will do as a Senior Data Engineer:

  • Digital & Behavioural Telemetry Data Engineering: Shapes the unified behavioural data models that connect customer actions, journey stages, product interactions and technical telemetry, enabling consistent analysis of how users move through digital experiences across partners, products and channels. Integrate web-engine telemetry, real user monitoring and related event data so that behavioural patterns, friction points and conversion opportunities can be understood reliably.
  • Instrumentation, Tagging & Event Contracts: Partner with P&T engineering teams to define how product and web events are tagged, named, contextualised and versioned. Establish reusable event taxonomies, identifiers, metadata and testable contracts so new features and journeys produce reliable data. Evolve the digital behavioural data implementation, including development and debugging capability.
  • Conversion Performance & Digital Journey Data Products: Engineer and evolve governed data products that measure performance across key digital journeys and acquisition and revenue funnels. Provide the behavioural data foundations required to measure session and search activity, availability, funnel progression, booking conversion, ancillary and revenue outcomes, and agreed attribution measures.
  • Data Enablement & Analytics Enablement: Turn product, engineering and business data needs into reusable, governed data structures that can be consumed safely downstream. Contribute event definitions, technical context, lineage and KPI guidance to the central definitions repository, using documentation-as-code and Markdown for business and metric definitions.
  • Observability Engineering: Connect behavioural and customer-journey data with real user monitoring and relevant operational telemetry so teams across CT can understand how technical performance influences customer experience, conversion and journey progression.
  • Quality, Security & Lifecycle: Set and implement expectations for data quality at creation, automated testing, breaking-change controls, ownership, classification, access, privacy, retention and handling of sensitive data. Ensure critical telemetry and conversion data products are monitored, documented, discoverable and safe to evolve.
  • Partner, Analyst & Product Enablement: Act as the senior technical SME for analysts, P&T teams and partner questions relating to telemetry, tagging and digital behavioural data. Maintain a digital measurement and data roadmap that identifies the data capability required to quantify behavioural friction, conversion performance, technical performance and website or product experience opportunities.

What you’ll bring to the team:

  • 5-7+ years' experience in data engineering, digital analytics engineering, product telemetry or a related technical role, with evidence of senior ownership across production data products and cross-team delivery.
  • Strong hands‑on experience engineering digital behavioural or telemetry data in a production environment, using an event collection platform such as Snowplow, Adobe Experience Platform , Google Analytics or a comparable technology.
  • Practical experience with event tracking and telemetry concepts such as schemas, enrichments, event contexts, processing pipelines and warehouse data models, including local development, debugging and testing approaches.
  • Advanced SQL and strong Python skills, with hands‑on experience using modern cloud data platforms and transformation tooling; such as Snowflake, dbt , AWS or similar technology stack.
  • Experience designing event taxonomies, schemas, data contracts, versioning and metadata for web or product telemetry, including semi‑structured JSON data.
  • Strong understanding of digital analytics and conversion measurement, including behavioural funnels, search and booking progression, landing and entry‑point performance, attribution, journey progression and behavioural KPIs.
  • Experience modelling high‑volume event data into reusable facts, dimensions and data products that support both detailed investigation and governed business reporting.
  • Understanding of RUM(real user monitoring) and observability concepts including metrics, logs, traces, correlation, instrumentation and the relationship between technical performance and customer experience.
  • Experience implementing data quality, automated testing, schema‑change controls, privacy, classification, access, retention and lifecycle practices for telemetry or behavioural data.
  • Strong stakeholder and partner communication skills, with the ability to explain complex event and telemetry data to analysts, engineers, product teams and non‑technical consumers.
  • Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD, automated testing and documentation practices, with a track record of improving engineering standards and enabling others to work independent

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Olympia Capital - Part Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Senior Solution Development Engineer
description:
Job Title

Senior Solution Development Engineer

About the team


The AI Assistant Speedboat is Amadeus' AI-native organisation, built to move at startup speed and make Amadeus the trusted travel infrastructure that leading AI Assistants — Gemini, Copilot, ChatGPT and others — rely on. It operates as a Bridge that sets direction, customer crews facing the AI Assistants, and use-case and platform squads owning delivery end to end. Requirements arrive unstable and partly undefined; the value of this role is precisely to make them tractable.



About the role

Understand, identify and define needs

  • Interact with Product Managers — and directly with customers where relevant — to ensure a full understanding of business needs, customer constraints and product intent.
  • Transform high-level product vision into detailed, unambiguous functional and technical requirements, working with the full range of stakeholders including security, legal, operations, finance and support.
  • Perform sufficient analysis to ensure requirements are complete, consistent and ready to be worked on, with explicit acceptance criteria, edge cases and open questions surfaced early.

Analyse and design solutions

  • Participate in the design of solutions across the Speedboat's use cases, ensuring consistency, reuse and usability across capabilities and squads.
  • Convert business requirements into functional specifications and high-level designs; run feasibility studies and propose viable options with their trade-offs.
  • Analyse cross-functional requirements and contribute to cross-organisation solutions by interacting with all stakeholders — architects, technical and functional experts, platform teams and delivery squads.
  • Ensure proposed solutions meet business objectives and comply with Amadeus standards, including non-functional requirements: performance, reliability, security, data protection and cost.

Stay hands-on

  • Develop prototypes and proofs of concept according to Amadeus standards to de-risk design choices and validate feasibility.
  • Model and review data structures, APIs and integration contracts where they are structuring for the solution.
  • Contribute to the validation phase and support the debugging of existing solutions alongside Product Management, in order to stay close to the reality of the system.

Recommend transversally and align stakeholders

  • Act as the functional and technical expertise entry point for the products and use cases handled within the department.
  • Issue transversal recommendations that improve consistency, remove duplication and anticipate dependencies across squads and platform teams.
  • Communicate progress on solutions and agreements at any stage of the mission within the core team.
  • Document and present solution recommendations to stakeholders in solution review forums, with the ability to explain complex technical information in simple ways to a diverse audience.

Secure delivery and handover

  • Hand over validated solutions to the delivery squads when entering the development phase, and remain the reference for functional clarifications throughout the build.
  • Work closely with delivery teams to ensure the right functionality is built, in a timely manner and in line with the intent.
  • Produce and maintain the functional and technical documentation required by the requesting departments.

Who we look for


  • Curious and adaptable professional who enjoys bringing structure to ambiguity and solving new problems.
  • Strong bridge-builder able to connect customer needs, product vision, and technical implementation.
  • Systems thinker with a solid understanding of software platforms, integrations, APIs, and modern digital architectures.
  • Hands-on contributor who is comfortable prototyping, validating ideas, and working closely with engineering teams.
  • Collaborative and influential communicator capable of aligning diverse stakeholders around practical, scalable solutions.



Diversity & Inclusion


Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.


Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

Be aware of recruitment scams


Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

title: Senior Solutions Consultant (m/f/d) - Growth & Strategy
description:
The Role

This is a senior role combining consulting, technology and commercial responsibility. You’ll work directly with customers to understand their processes and challenges, then turn those requirements into practical Smartsheet solutions. You’ll build and present proof of concepts, scope consulting projects, discuss pricing and ultimately help win the work.
You’ll play an important role in AMX’s continued growth, with an initial focus on the DACH market. You’ll work with opportunities from Smartsheet, our partner network and existing customers, while also helping develop new relationships over time. The focus is on building trust, understanding where AMX can add value and turning strong customer relationships into sustainable growth.
There’s also real scope for this role to grow. With proven success, you’ll take on broader responsibility for how AMX develops opportunities and goes to market, initially through greater ownership of customers, regions and commercial strategy. Over time, this can also develop into mentoring and guiding the team as it grows.What You’ll Be Doing

  • Manage customer opportunities end-to-end, from discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, proof of concepts, scoping, pricing and commercial discussions, before handing over to the implementation team.
  • Build strong relationships with existing customers, identifying new use cases and opportunities to expand successful solutions across other teams, departments and markets.
  • Work closely with Smartsheet Account Executives and the wider Smartsheet team on joint account planning, developing opportunities and identifying growth accounts across DACH and AMX’s wider markets.
  • Help develop new opportunities through targeted account research, strategic outreach, events and collaboration with AMX’s marketing and partner network.
  • Contribute to and help shape AMX’s wider consulting and commercial approach, including how we develop opportunities, work with partners and take solutions to market.
  • As you progress, mentor other consultants and take on increasing responsibility across AMX’s commercial activities.


Your profile

  • You have strong experience in technology consulting, solutions consulting, SaaS or digital transformation.
  • You’re commercially minded and comfortable taking a customer conversation from discovery through solution design, scoping, negotiation and close.
  • You’re equally technically hands-on and comfortable actually building and demonstrating what you propose. Smartsheet experience is a big advantage, but strong Excel skills or experience configuring SaaS, workflow, low-code or business applications can also be a great fit.
  • You’re good at asking the right questions and turning complex or unclear business problems into structured solutions.
  • You’re confident presenting to senior stakeholders and can explain technical solutions in terms of business value.
  • You enjoy building customer relationships and spotting new opportunities.
  • You’re comfortable working without a perfect playbook. You like bringing your own ideas, testing what works and helping shape the processes and approach that will make AMX successful as we grow.
  • You’re interested in growing beyond an individual contributor role, mentoring others and taking on broader responsibility over time.
  • You speak German at native/C2 level and English fluently.
  • You’re ideally based in Germany and comfortable travelling for customers, partner meetings and events, typically up to five days per month.
  • A relevant degree is welcome, but your experience and what you’ve actually delivered are much more important to us.


Why us?

  • You’ll join an established and successful consultancy that is still small enough for you to have a real influence on how things are done.
  • You’ll have genuine flexibility around where you work, with a remote-first setup and only occasional travel for customers, partner meetings and team events.
  • The role comes with a strong fixed salary, with regular salary reviews as your responsibilities and seniority grow.
  • You’ll receive a €3,000 annual learning and development budget, home-office support, a flexible €50 monthly benefits allowance, wellness and technology allowances and regular team retreats.
  • You won’t simply be executing somebody else’s playbook. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, shape how we work and help define what successful growth looks like.
  • Most importantly, there’s room for this to become much more than a typical Senior Consultant position. If things go well, we want you to take on broader commercial responsibility, help develop the team and play an important role in AMX’s continued growth across DACH and beyond.

description:

This position is with Diversified Applications, Inc. (DAI). DAI is our aerial application business and operates under several different names throughout the U.S. as we continue to acquire small companies to actively expand this segment of our business. The goal of DAI is to become the leader of the agricultural aviation industry by continuously growing our fleet of fixed wing aircraft and helicopters.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Aerial Applicator provides aerial application services with our aerial application business which operates under the name Diversified Applications, Inc. or DAI.

WHAT YOUR DAY WILL LOOK LIKE

  • Ensures all flights are conducted with safety as the primary consideration and that operation of the aircraft complies with applicable Federal Aviation Regulations and established company policies and procedures.
  • Maintains at least 500 feet AGL when ferrying an aircraft or transitioning between sites.
  • Uses utmost care to survey each site prior to dispensing to become familiar with all characteristics and conditions. This includes terrain, natural and man-made obstructions, wind turbines, power lines, antennas, guy wires, buffer zones, sensitive crops, dwellings, livestock, domestic animals, vehicles, people, waterways, ponds and aquatic life, beehives, etc. Suspends dispensing when acceptable conditions cannot be maintained.
  • Is thoroughly familiar with existing and forecasting weather prior to each flight. This is critical for both aircraft performance as well as acceptable dispensing conditions.
  • Handles the load and supervises the handling of the load with great care to avoid spillage, aircraft damage, and product contamination. Reads and follows label instructions and cautions. Dispenses in accordance with label instructions. Rinses hopper appropriately.
  • Briefs handlers and ground crews assigned to the pilot's dispensing operation for expectations and cautions to be observed.
  • Communicates promptly with the chief supervisor regarding any irregularities or difficulties encountered in training or agricultural aircraft operation.
  • Provides for proper handling of the aircraft where company ground handling and/or service employees are not available.
  • Arranges for appropriate level of security of the aircraft when left unattended at a location away from the home base operations.
  • Personally fuels or supervises aircraft fueling and other transient services. Participates in hot fueling only after training and approval from the chief supervisor.
  • Maintains a high degree of proficiency and a thorough knowledge of the procedures and systems of the operating aircraft.
  • Prepares and participates in training and checks maintenance test flights when authorized.
  • Completes and supervises the proper completion of all required assignments, flight records, and dispensing records.
  • Provides input as necessary to ensure records required by 14 CFR § 137.71 and the applicable state can be maintained. Submits other required input and paperwork in a timely manner.
  • Maintains book of business through the Ag retailer or through a direct relationship with the clients.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Must have at least 200 hours of AG time and be certified to fly the assigned aircraft.
  • Must be currently qualified as a commercial certified pesticide applicator by the state(s) that the product will be applied in.
  • Must have passed the National Aerial Pesticide Applicator Pilot Certification Examination.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Organizational skills.
  • Ability to travel by various means up to 50% is required.

  • Handles confidential information.

Successful completion of a drug test and background check is required for all positions at Helena.

At Helena, safety is our highest priority. We seek out extensive safety measures and put them in place to minimize exposure to anything that could be potentially harmful to our employees.

The work environment for this position will be in an outdoor setting in all types of weather conditions with exposure to outdoor elements. When working outdoors and possibly around moving equipment/mechanical parts, you may be exposed to fumes, airborne particles, chemical and biological hazards, vibrations and a risk of electrical shock.

Titre du poste: Stagiaire - Appui à la section "Préparation et Réponse aux Urgences"

Type de contrat: Stage

Durée: Six (06) mois

Unité / Division: Programme - Urgences

Lieu d'affectation: Antananarivo, Madagascar

Nombre de position: Deux (02) stagiaires

Date de publication: 09 octobre 2026

Date limite de soumission: 23 octobre 2026


Dans le cadre d’un programme de stage, le Bureau du Programme Alimentaire Mondial à Madagascar recrute deux (02) stagiaires pour la section « Préparation et réponse aux urgences ».

Contexte

Le Programme Alimentaire Mondial (PAM) est la plus grande organisation humanitaire au monde dédiée à la lutte contre la faim et à l'amélioration de la sécurité alimentaire et nutritionnelle des populations les plus vulnérables. À Madagascar, le PAM soutient les efforts du Gouvernement pour répondre aux besoins humanitaires immédiats tout en renforçant la résilience des communautés face aux chocs climatiques, économiques et sociaux.

Madagascar demeure confronté à des niveaux élevés d'insécurité alimentaire, de malnutrition chronique et de vulnérabilité aux aléas climatiques, notamment les sécheresses, les cyclones et les inondations. Ces défis sont exacerbés par la pauvreté structurelle, les fragilités des moyens d'existence et les effets croissants du changement climatique, qui affectent particulièrement les populations rurales et les ménages les plus vulnérables. Dans le cadre de son Plan Stratégique Pays, le PAM met en œuvre un portefeuille intégré d'interventions couvrant l'assistance alimentaire d'urgence, la nutrition, l'alimentation scolaire, le renforcement des moyens d'existence, la protection sociale, l'adaptation au changement climatique et l'action anticipatrice. L'Unité Programme joue un rôle central dans la conception, la coordination, la mise en œuvre et le suivi de ces interventions, en étroite collaboration avec les autorités nationales, les partenaires techniques et financiers, les agences des Nations Unies et les organisations de la société civile.

Au sein de l’Unité Programme, la section « Préparation et Réponse aux Urgences » (EPR) est responsable de coordonner le design, l’implémentation et le suivi des activités de préparation aux urgences, actions anticipatoires, réponse d’urgence précoce et conventionnelle, relèvement précoce, renforcement des capacités du Gouvernement et financement des risques de catastrophes (macro-assurance, etc). La Section EPR agit par ailleurs en tant qu’équipe surge en cas de catastrophe survenant dans les zones du pays où le PAM ne dispose pas du Bureaux Terrain.


Objectifs du stage

Le stage vise à offrir une expérience pratique et enrichissante dans la gestion des programmes du PAM – notamment dans les domaines de la préparation et réponse aux urgences. Tout en appuyant les activités courantes du PAM et certains projets spécifiques qui lui seront attribués, le/la stagiaire pourra développer ses compétences en gestion de programmes, analyse, rédaction et autres connaissances et savoir-faire clés du travail humanitaire et de développement.

Missions principales

Le/la stagiaire sera impliqué(e) dans diverses activités, notamment :

  • La contribution à la préparation logistique et opérationnelle (réunions, ateliers, missions, etc) des activités de l’Unité Programme.
  • La participation à la collecte et à l’analyse de données sur la gestion des risques de catastrophes, les enjeux humanitaires et de développement, les aléas climatiques et leurs impacts.
  • La production de rapports, notes de synthèse et recommandations pour améliorer la rapidité et l’efficacité des interventions.
  • La collaboration avec les autorités locales, ONG et partenaires internationaux pour renforcer la coordination.
  • La contribution au développement de projets et propositions financières.
  • L’appui à la coordination interne à l’Unité Programme et avec les autres Unités du PAM Madagascar.

Profil recherché

  • Étudiant(e) actuellement inscrit(e) dans un programme d’études supérieures en gestion des risques de catastrophes au niveau Bac+4/+5, et avoir suivi des cours au cours des 12 derniers mois, ou récemment diplômé(e) dans les six mois précédant la candidature au programme de stage, et avoir suivi des cours durant les 12 derniers mois de son inscription universitaire.
  • Bonne capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et de rédaction.
  • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Bonne maitrise du malagasy et du français.
  • L' anglais serait un atout.
  • Sens de l’organisation, de l’écoute, de l’autonomie et esprit d’équipe.
  • Intérêt marqué pour les thématiques humanitaires, climatiques et de résilience.
  • Une expérience (y compris stage/volontariat) avec des agences gouvernementales de la GRC ou une agence des Nations Unies/ONG est une valeur ajoutée sans constituer un requis obligatoire.
  • Le/la candidat.e doit être de nationalité malagasy.

Conditions du stage

  • Modalité : En présentiel. Stage à plein temps.
  • Lieu: Bureau du PAM sis à Ivandry, Antananarivo, Madagascar, avec possibilité éventuelle de missions sur le terrain.
  • Encadrement : Sous la supervision d’un.e Chargé.e de Programme
  • Indemnité : Oui. Selon les règles internes du PAM.
  • Avantages : Opportunité de travailler dans un environnement international, d’acquérir une expérience concrète dans le domaine humanitaire et de contribuer à des projets à fort impact au service de la population malagasy et en particulier des plus vulnérables. Missions sur le terrain possibles selon pertinence.

Modalités de candidature

Les candidats intéressés sont invités à envoyer :

  • Un CV détaillé en français.
  • Une lettre de motivation
  • Un certificat de scolarité, copie des diplômes obtenus avec date d’obtention, ou copie du relevé des notes officiel.

Modalité de sélection

Les candidats dont les dossiers de candidature auront été retenus seront invités à passer un entretien de sélection en présentiel au Bureau du PAM à Antananarivo.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Job Description

Location: Remote (US); Central to Pacific time zones preferred

Salary: $152,000 - $170,000 plus 10% bonus


Sniffies is a location-based, interactive web app designed to help gay, bi, and curious individuals connect in a safe, judgment-free environment. Using an innovative map interface, users can discover nearby individuals and popular meetup spots and join live video chats. The platform is accessible on any device with a browser, so users can engage without downloads. Sniffies fosters an open, team-driven culture that focuses on creativity, collaboration, and a commitment to positively impacting the community.


About the Role

Sniffies is growing its engineering team in the US, and this is a senior hire into our product engineering team. As Senior Backend Engineer, you will build and run the systems behind a platform with around 3 million monthly users and 20 million messages a day.


Our backend is built in Node.js and TypeScript on AWS, with MongoDB as our primary database. It powers location-based discovery on the live map, real-time messaging, subscriptions, ads, analytics, and the privacy-sensitive workflows our users rely on every day. We are also rolling out ScyllaDB as a new database layer alongside MongoDB, so you will help shape how data is modeled, stored, and served as the platform scales. You will own features from technical design through release and iteration, make pragmatic architecture calls, and help raise the quality of the code and the team around you.


You will join a fully remote product engineering team of backend, frontend, and full-stack engineers. This role suits someone already well established at a senior level, who moves quickly, knows database architecture inside out, and knows how to keep a high-traffic platform fast and reliable.


This is an individual contributor role suited to someone with deep backend expertise, strong production instincts, and the judgment to balance speed with quality.


Key Responsibilities

Product Delivery

  • Own backend features end-to-end, from technical design through implementation, release, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Build and maintain APIs, services, data models, background jobs, and integrations in Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Translate product requirements into maintainable, well-structured backend systems.
  • Build systems that perform reliably under real-time load in a fast-moving production environment.


Architecture and Technical Design

  • Write and review technical designs for backend systems.
  • Identify architecture tradeoffs and recommend pragmatic solutions that balance speed, quality, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Lead complex initiatives involving data modeling, database performance, asynchronous processing, and platform services, including the rollout of ScyllaDB alongside MongoDB.


Performance and Production Quality

  • Optimize queries, data access, and service performance for a high-traffic, real-time platform.
  • Diagnose production issues using Sentry, CloudWatch, logs, metrics, and alerts, and follow through with fixes that last.
  • Reduce regressions and make backend systems easier to understand, operate, debug, and extend over time.


Collaboration

  • Partner closely with product, QA, and frontend and mobile engineers to shape what gets built and how.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance.


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience building, scaling, and supporting backend systems in production.
  • Deep experience with Node.js and TypeScript is strongly preferred; senior backend engineers from other languages who can ramp up quickly will also be considered.
  • Hands-on experience with MongoDB, including data modeling, indexing, and query performance.
  • Strong database architecture skills and a track record of optimizing backend performance on a high-traffic, user-facing product.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and services, preferably AWS.
  • Experience with Docker and containerized development or deployment workflows.
  • Experience with background jobs, queues, Lambdas, event-driven workflows, or asynchronous processing.
  • Strong debugging skills across services, databases, logs, metrics, and production systems.
  • Clear communication with engineering, product, and QA partners.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a social media, dating, or other consumer platform, particularly one with real-time or location-based features.
  • Experience with distributed wide-column databases such as ScyllaDB or Apache Cassandra.
  • Experience with messaging, subscriptions and billing, ads, analytics, or privacy-sensitive user data.
  • Familiarity with frontend or mobile development workflows, especially Angular, Capacitor, iOS, or Android.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, observability tooling, and release operations.

title: Senior Data Engineer at The Warehouse

Senior Data Engineer at The Warehouse in Auckland City, N, NZ.


This Full time on site position offers great opportunities for career growth.


Company Description


The Warehouse Group (TWG) is a Kiwi household name, and we proudly recognise the role that we play in communities throughout New Zealand. We are the largest general merchandise retailer in NZ across The Warehouse, Warehouse Stationery & Noel Leeming. We continue to have our customers top of mind as we work purposefully together, “Helping Kiwis live better every day”. Brand-led and retail-focused, we’re continuing our drive to deliver quality products and unparalleled experience for our customers, in a retail world that is dynamic and ever-changing! Our Technology footprint is extensive and underpins the successful running of our group operation. From our digital presence to our warehouse and order management systems and everything in between, we’re a place Technologists want to be and we’d like you to be a part of that.


Job Description


Sitting within our Data function and reporting to the Tech Team Lead: Data Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and evolving our enterprise data platform. As a Senior Data Engineer, you'll be responsible for designing, building and optimising scalable data solutions that enable trusted insights across the business. You'll bring deep technical expertise and a passion for data engineering, while also acting as a trusted advisor to stakeholders and a mentor to other engineers. Working across a modern cloud-based data ecosystem, you'll help drive engineering best practices, influence technical direction, and ensure our data platforms continue to meet the evolving needs of the business.


Key aspects of your role



  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes

  • Lead the design and implementation of data architecture, models and integration patterns

  • Drive best practices for data engineering, including code quality, testing, documentation and observability

  • Optimise data platforms and solutions for performance, scalability, reliability and cost efficiency

  • Partner with architects, analysts, data scientists and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions

  • Champion data quality, governance and security across our data ecosystem

  • Mentor and support other Data Engineers, fostering continuous improvement and knowledge sharing

  • Contribute to strategic planning and the ongoing evolution of TWG's data platform and capabilities

  • Troubleshoot complex data issues and provide technical leadership in resolving challenges

  • Stay ahead of industry trends and identify opportunities to improve our data engineering practices and tooling


Qualifications


First and foremost, you're passionate about building modern, scalable data solutions that create meaningful business outcomes. You're equally comfortable getting into technical detail as you are engaging with stakeholders to understand business challenges and shape the right solution. You'll be a collaborative senior practitioner who enjoys mentoring others, influencing technical decisions and continuously improving the way data engineering is delivered. We envisage you will bring the following to the role: 5+ years' experience in Data Engineering, with demonstrated experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data solutions Strong expertise in modern data architecture, data modelling and cloud-based data platforms Advanced SQL development and performance optimisation Strong Python development skills Extensive experience with Snowflake and modern data warehousing practices Expert-level dbt development and data transformation experience Strong experience with Azure cloud services and data technologies ETL/ELT design and implementation. Data warehousing and dimensional modelling. CI/CD and DevOps practices. Source control using Git/Azure DevOps. Airflow or similar orchestration tools.


Additional Information


We are intentional about finding the right people, allowing us to perform work as a team that truly makes a difference for the business and or customers. What we can promise in return is work that will challenge & excite, working with passionate like-minded people. Our teams balance a hybrid working approach (Fridays as work from home). Conveniently located in Northcote, we offer free car parking on-site plus EV charging! We'll also give you your birthday off, great discounts across our brands and excellent career opportunities within the business!

description:

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions.
