POSITION OVERVIEW

KKR is building out an enterprise Data Operations group to collect, manage, and harness the power of data across our diverse business activities. The Data Operations Center of Excellence (CoE) is a cross-functional team dedicated to formulating and driving KKR’s enterprise data strategy while also providing the operating leverage required to bring these strategies and frameworks to life.

We are hiring an Associate within the Data Operations CoE to support Financial Reporting & Data. This individual will be part of a team that is responsible for driving a transformation program to consolidate financial reporting across multiple internal sources and external fund administrators, creating a unified and scalable reporting model for Finance.

The individual will balance strategic initiatives and hands-on execution, helping shape the roadmap for finance reporting while also designing, implementing, and running the processes and solutions required for BAU reporting on an ongoing basis. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITY

  • Data Integration : Oversee integration of administrator and third‑party data into core Finance reporting models to enable consolidated views
  • Metrics & Transparency : Define and publish KPIs on reporting timeliness, accuracy, and process efficiency for senior stakeholders

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in finance reporting, financial operations, or data/reporting management within asset management with a preference towards alts.
  • Deep expertise in finance reporting processes, including management reporting, fund/investor reporting, and regulatory reporting
  • Hands‑on experience with Snowflake (or equivalent cloud data warehouse) and BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Sigma, Tableau)

  • Demonstrated leadership skills, including team management, stakeholder influence, and cross‑functional collaboration

· Research and integrate cutting-edge tools and platforms to enhance data management capabilities and streamline processes.

Develop and execute a technology roadmap to ensure the team is using the best tools available to meet both current and future data needs.

Optimization & Performance Management\:

· Monitor and optimize database performance, query execution, and storage efficiency.

Monitor performance and quality control plans to identify improvements.

· Act as a bridge between business units and IT, ensuring that data architecture and engineering solutions meet both technical and business needs.

Lead efforts to optimize data workflows and processes across departments, driving efficiency and alignment in data operations.

Reports on Training Activities

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Summary

At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs.Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.

FuzeRx provides an easier, more efficient and more affordable pharmacy experience for patients, providers, and partners. Our full-service, digitally-powered pharmacy makes it simple for patients to live their healthiest life, while our technology empowers partners with automated and customizable solutions for the entire pharmacy value stream. To learn more about FuzeRx, you can review our Founders’ Story and our Values.



Job Description

As a Senior Software Engineer for FuzeRx, you will join a team that is working to improve patients’ lives through a better pharmacy experience. The Care Team owns the services that manage all of prescription processing from intake up to the moment we send an order to our pharmacies for fulfillment.

The key focus areas for the Care Team include:

Preparing prescriptions for fulfillment and delivery as quickly and accurately as possible through a combination of automation and efficient manual task coordination when third party input is required to advance a fill.

Enabling the growth of the business by enabling partners like drug manufacturers, insurers, and individual providers to easily configure billing, benefits, and clinical workflows tailored to their use cases.

Example Projects:
Increase FuzeRx’s intake automation rate by leveraging LLMs to parse unstructured data from prescriptions.

Accelerate pharmacist workflows by integrating controlled substance dispensing history and risk scores into our pre-dispense clinical safety and review step.

Optimize the selection of which drug to dispense to find patients the best price.

Our engineering teams own the critical services that power our entire platform—managing everything from prescription intake and processing up to the moment we send an order to our pharmacies for fulfillment.

Key focus areas for our engineers include:

  • Preparing prescriptions for fulfillment and delivery as quickly and accurately as possible through a combination of automation and efficient manual task coordination.

  • Enabling business growth by allowing partners (like drug manufacturers, insurers, and individual providers) to easily configure billing, benefits, and clinical workflows tailored to their specific use cases.

Examples of High-Impact Projects You Might Work On:

  • Increase FuzeRx’s intake automation rate by leveraging LLMs to parse unstructured data from prescriptions.

  • Accelerate pharmacist workflows by integrating controlled substance dispensing history and risk scores into our pre-dispense clinical safety and review step.

  • Optimize the selection of which drug to dispense to find patients the best price.

Accelerate Your Career As You:

  • Optimize Systems: Balance low inventory on hand with high availability.

  • Architect Platforms: Establish the foundations for an extensible inventory management platform to fuel business growth.

  • Lead & Mentor: Mentor other engineers, encouraging best practices in software development and design.

  • Innovate: Solve complex technical problems at the intersection of healthcare and e-commerce.

  • Drive Strategy: Act as a thought leader on how to build world-class predictive systems.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent experience.

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience in a high-volume, high-throughput production environment.

  • Core Technologies: Deep background in Backend or Full Stack technologies, operating within modern environments (like our core stack of Ruby on Rails, TypeScript/JavaScript, and PostgreSQL).

  • System Design: Expertise in architecting complex systems for long-term maintainability, performance, and scalability.

  • Technical Fundamentals: Strong engineering fundamentals with experience building high-volume, resilient systems.

  • Quality & Best Practices: Proven track record of technical best practices, including code style, documentation, code review, bug fixing, and production issue mitigation.

  • Mindset: Relentless in pursuing impact through your work.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Solid experience with supply chain optimization systems.

  • Proficiency in FuzeRx's merged tech stack: Ruby on Rails, TypeScript/JavaScript, and PostgreSQL(Note: Python experience is also highly valued for our ML initiatives).

  • Experience building and integrating predictive ML models.

  • Experience designing and implementing service-oriented architectures.

  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment and maintain a growth mindset.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving that’s biased towards impact.

  • A strong sense of ownership over your work and a desire to uplevel your peers.

  • Passion for FuzeRx’s mission and our company values.

Physical requirements for this role include the ability to work at a computer terminal with monitor, keyboard and mouse for extended periods of time, stoop, bend, and reach for equipment and supplies, make frequent repetitive motions required to operate a computer that include the wrists, hands and fingers, and lift, carry, push, pull, and move light objects up to 20 pounds. title: Dock Tech Loader
description:
PRIMARY PURPOSE AND FUNCTION: A Dock Tech works under the direction of the Shipping Coordinator. Primary responsibility is to facilitate the loading of all outbound shipments onto trailers, and the final processing of all eComm orders. This position is responsible for accurate and efficient labeling and loading practices and will be expected to monitor more than one load/trailer at any given time. The Dock Tech will be cross trained in a number of shipping tasks and will be expected to perform these tasks as the workload dictates. This employee will provide clear and accurate communication to carriers to see that trailers are moved in and out of docks as needed. General requirements also include but are not limited to cycle counting, and the ability to lead and train others. This employee may be scheduled to work in other departments or other areas in shipping and may be required to report to other supervisors in other department when shipping work volume is low. Evening and weekend hours are required during the peak holiday shipping period (October/December). This employee must be able to work in other areas of the factory when the workload dictates.

SCHEDULING REQUIRMENTS: 1st Shift 8:30am—1:00pm

NOTE: (hours vary during season/OT required)

DOCUMENTATION (QUALIFICATIONS):

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

A Dock Tech must be able to work in a team environment as well as work independently and must be able to follow instructions given by the Shipping Coordinator.

  • Knowledge of Shipping.
  • Truck loading/ Dock experience helpful
  • Good communications skills/ Bilingual a plus.
  • Leadership experience a plus.

Education and/or Experience: High school degree or equivalent; Prior Shipping /Loading Experience.

Must have strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

Bi-lingual in Spanish preferred.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS:

Working Conditions: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will work in a warehouse/ assembly/production atmosphere near moving mechanical parts. While working on a machine may work near fumes or airborne particles.

The noise level environment is moderate noise with the sound of forklifts driving around.

The temperature in shipping may be cooler than in other departments due to having doors open for trailer trucks, and colder temperatures in trailer.

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will stand and walk most of the time, will use and reach with hands and arms more than 2/3’s of the time.

A Dock Tech will lift 10- 50 pounds, over or up to 2/3’s of the time.

Effectiveness is measured by being able to work within a groups pace in different shipping functions and meet the expected quantity and quality standards.

The specific information shown in each section of this description is not intended to be all-inclusive. This information represents typical elements and criteria necessary to successfully perform the job.

  • Follow appropriate SOPP’s, SSOP’s, GMP’s, and equipment specific procedures
  • Follow established sanitary production guidelines
  • CCP (Critical Control Point), QCP (Critical Quality Point), and scale checks as needed.

title: Kommunikationschef til SAGRO
description:
Kommunikationschef til SAGRO

Vil du sætte retning, skabe synlighed og give landbruget en stærk stemme?

Hos SAGRO tør vi mene noget og tage plads i offentligheden. Vi rådgiver landmænd og fødevareproducenter – og vi vil være tydelige, relevante og nærværende i vores kommunikation med kunder, medarbejdere og omverdenen.

Derfor søger vi en kommunikationschef, der både kan sætte den strategiske retning og selv tage del i produktionen.

Hvorfor skal du vælge SAGRO som din nye arbejdsplads?

Som kommunikationschef får du mulighed for at præge, hvordan SAGRO bliver oplevet – internt og eksternt. Du bliver leder for et kreativt og fagligt team, der skal arbejde med alt fra journalistik og grafisk design til marketing og sociale medier.

Her får du ikke blot ansvaret for kommunikationen. Du får også plads til at bruge din faglighed, din nysgerrighed og din evne til at få de gode historier frem i lyset.

Din rolle som kommunikationschef

Du får det overordnede ansvar for SAGROs kommunikation og markedsføring. Det betyder, at du både skal sætte den strategiske retning, skabe fremdrift i hverdagen og selv bidrage aktivt til indhold og kommunikation. Du bliver en del af chefgruppen og deltager i chefmøder. Samtidig får du en central rolle som sparringspartner for direktionen – og som SAGROs tydelige talerør i dialogen med medierne.

Dine vigtigste opgaver:

  • Ca. 50% af tiden bruger du på at producere indhold på tværs af kanaler – herunder artikler, pressemeddelelser, nyhedsbreve, sociale medier, kampagner og web, samt have redaktionelt ansvar for magasinet Grobund. Som afdeling skal I derfor være tæt på organisationen og løbende opsnappe historier, behov og muligheder på tværs af SAGROs afdelinger og datterselskaber.

  • Ca. 30% af tiden bruger du på at lede, udvikle og prioritere opgaverne i Kommunikationsafdelingen. Teamet består af tre medarbejdere med kompetencer inden for marketing/kampagner, grafisk design og sociale medier. De journalistiske kompetencer skal du i høj grad selv bidrage med. I skal udvikle og gennemføre kommunikations- og marketingstrategier, der understøtter SAGROs samlede strategi og rådgivningsydelser, samt styrke SAGROs employer branding og interne kommunikation.

  • Ca. 20% af tiden bruger du på at rådgive direktion og chefer om kommunikation, pressehåndtering, positionering og aktuelle sager. Du vil være SAGROs kontakt til medierne og sikre en proaktiv, troværdig og tydelig presseindsats.

Du vil have ansvar for budgettet på kommunikationsområdet, herunder blandt andet prioritering af annoncering, messer og merchandise.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Sandsynligvis har en baggrund som journalist eller en tilsvarende stærk kommunikationsfaglig profil. Du kan skrive skarpt, finde den gode vinkel og omsætte komplekse faglige emner til kommunikation, som modtageren forstår og har lyst til at læse.

Du har erfaring med strategisk kommunikation og marketing – og gerne erfaring fra landbruget, fødevareerhvervet eller en beslægtet branche med mange fagligheder, interesser og samfundsmæssige dagsordener.

Derudover er det vigtigt, at du:

  • Har erfaring med ledelse eller er klar til at tage et tydeligt ledelsesansvar - du kan skabe et velfungerende team, som står fagligt stærkt og motiveret for opgaven.
  • Har pondus og kan stå sikkert i rollen som rådgiver for direktion og chefgruppe.
  • Trives med pressehåndtering og kan repræsentere SAGRO professionelt og troværdigt i offentligheden.
  • Kan balancere strategi, planlægning og drift med selv at være en aktiv producerende del af teamet.
  • Arbejder proaktivt og har blik for de historier og muligheder, der opstår i organisationen.
  • Har god forståelse for digitale kanaler, sociale medier og datadrevet kommunikation.
  • Kan skabe engagement, retning og samarbejde – også når mange interesser og fagområder skal mødes.
  • Har kreativitet, humor og mod til at udfordre, når det styrker kommunikationen.

Hvem bliver dine nærmeste medarbejdere?

Du får personaleansvar for et engageret kommunikationsteam på tre medarbejdere. Teamet arbejder bredt med journalistik, grafisk design, marketing og sociale medier og servicerer SAGROs fem huse i Ringkøbing, Holstebro, Herning, Billund og Esbjerg.

Afdelingen er kendt for høj faglighed, kreative idéer og en praktisk tilgang til opgaverne. I arbejder tæt sammen med kolleger på tværs af hele organisationen og har en vigtig rolle i at gøre SAGROs viden, mennesker og rådgivning synlig.

Hvad får du mere?

Du får en central og indflydelsesrig rolle i en virksomhed, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling, og hvor kommunikation bliver taget alvorligt.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En fleksibel arbejdsplads med plads til faglig og personlig udvikling
  • Mulighed for relevant efteruddannelse og kompetenceudvikling
  • Et arbejdsmiljø med høj faglighed, samarbejde og arbejdsglæde
  • Kantineordning med morgenmad og frokost, pension, sundhedsforsikring og adgang til massage
  • Primær arbejdsplads i Herning eller Billund med mulighed for arbejdsdage i vores øvrige huse.

Hør hvad din kommende direktør Torben Jensen siger om jobbet og om SAGRO:

”Der er tale om en meget central position i vores virksomhed. Vores samlede udadvendte kommunikation er virkelig vigtigt i forhold til vores position i markedet for landbrugsrådgivning. Derfor skal du både besidde nysgerrighed, kreativitet og dygtighed, samt være i stand til at lede både hele det kommunikative område, samle op fra den øvrige organisation og være en god og energisk sparringspartner til alle os, der konstant kommunikerer på mange strenge".

Torben Jensen, adm. direktør, SAGRO

Læs mere om vores rekrutteringsproces her: Rekrutteringsproces (job-hos-sagro.dk)

Ansøgningsfrist: Løbende

SAGRO I/S

Kontaktoplysninger:

Britta Bendix

HR-chef

21306267

brb@sagro.dk

Torben Jensen

Administrerende direktør

76602113

tje@sagro.dk

Vil du vide mere om os?

SAGRO er bygget på værdier. Det betyder, at vi i dagligdagen leder på basis af fem grundlæggende værdier: handlekraft, ansvarlighed, engagement, tillid og hjerte. Til gengæld ønsker vi færrest mulige regler. Det forudsætter, at vores værdier udleves og efterleves af alle. At vi er og lever værdierne ud i det daglige - i samspil med kunder, ledelse og medarbejdere.

SAGRO har et unikt sammenhold blandt medarbejderne, og styrken er baseret på et stærkt samarbejde og høj faglighed for den enkelte. Vi er optaget af at præge den fremtid, som vores kunder ønsker at være en del af, og derfor er udvikling helt afgørende, både for den enkelte og for SAGRO som virksomhed.

Vi har fem huse, hvor vores dygtige medarbejdere har sin daglige gang, når de ikke er ude hos kunderne.
Husene er beliggende i Holstebro, Ringkøbing, Herning, Billund og Esbjerg. Vores rådgivere dækker en bred vifte af ydelser, og kan hjælpe indenfor regnskab, selskaber, generationsskifte, HR og løn, økologi, kvæg, grise, planter, miljø og natur, ESG, økonomi og strategi.

På www.job-hos-sagro.dk kan du læse mere om os.

title: Manager, Data Analytics - FuzeRx
description:
Job Summary

At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs.

Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.



Job Description

As a Manager, Data Analytics at Fuze Health, you will lead metrics strategy and work closely with the Product and Operations team to ensure high-quality, trusted, and timely data drives impactful business decisions, operations, and product launches.

In this role, you will manage, build, and lead a high-performing team responsible for designing and implementing meaningful metrics to evaluate product launches and support our Operations teams. This role is equal part business and technical leadership, organizational design, and cross-functional partnership, shaping how decision are made across a fast-growing, technology-driven healthcare organization.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Vision

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Product Analysts, fostering a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

  • Define and execute the long-term vision for FuzeRx's Product Analytics team, ensuring alignment with company strategy and product roadmaps.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, and Operations teams to prioritize and deliver high-impact data initiatives.

  • Establish clear career paths, performance standards, and hiring plans to scale the team thoughtfully and sustainably.

  • Build strong stakeholder trust by translating business needs into data insights and scalable data solutions.

Product Analytics

  • Provide close analytics support to evaluate the impact of new product features and enhancements

  • Drive best practices in experiment design and analysis.

  • Communicate insights and new opportunities revealed through data analysis to senior management.

Analytics Engineering

  • Own FuzeRx's data transformation logic by taking raw data inputs and converting them into scalable, reusable data assets that drive business decisions and insights.

  • Participate in evolving FuzeRx’s data platform, defining best practices that shape the long-term analytics ecosystem and establish durable design patterns that ensure long-term scalability and maintainability.

Business Intelligence

  • Surface durable, relevant, and reusable dashboards to monitor the health of various products and operations

  • Establish and enforce best practices for maintaining a navigable and impactful business intelligence platform

Required Experience & Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field; advanced degree preferred.

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, data science, or related data insights roles.

  • Strong expertise in analytics engineering and data modeling principles; specifically, experience with DBT (or similar data transformation framework) and Git (or similar version control system)

  • Strong expertise in metrics design and instrumentation

  • Strong expertise in experiment design and evaluation

  • Proven track record working cross-functionally to provide analytics insights to Product and Operations teams

  • Expertise creating assets in Looker or an equivalent business intelligence platform

  • Experience operating in high-growth, fast-paced technology organizations.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of experience leading high-performing technical teams.

  • Experience building and analyzing data assets in healthcare, pharmacy, fintech, or other regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare data privacy standards.



Additional Information

Additional Physical Job Requirements

Physical requirements for this role include the ability to work at a computer terminal with monitor, keyboard and mouse for extended periods of time, stoop, bend, and reach for equipment and supplies, make frequent repetitive motions required to operate a computer that include the wrists, hands and fingers, and lift, carry, push, pull, and move light objects up to 20 pounds. title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
This is a genuinely interesting opportunity for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join a team that is building out a modern, enterprise-strength data platform and establishing how data engineering is done across the wider organisation.

Snowflake is relatively new within the environment. A strong reference architecture has been established and the focus is now on building upon that foundation, migrating data into the new environment and developing scalable, well-structured data models that can be confidently used across the business.

Importantly, this isn't simply a pipeline-building role.

There is a significant data warehousing and modelling component. You'll work from business requirements through to ingestion, transformation and the creation of robust information layers that enable analysts and other teams to confidently consume and report on data.

You'll also have the seniority and influence to help establish engineering standards, improve ways of working and shape how the platform evolves

What You'll Be Doing

  • Designing and building scalable enterprise data solutions within Snowflake
  • Developing robust dimensional data models and data warehouse structures
  • Building and maintaining complex data ingestion and transformation pipelines
  • Translating business requirements into well-structured, reusable information layers
  • Helping establish data engineering standards, patterns and development practices
  • Working across Snowflake, Azure, SQL, GitHub, Power BI and associated data tooling
  • Supporting the rebuild of legacy data workloads into a modern architecture rather than simply carrying technical debt forward
  • Working closely with analysts, technical teams, stakeholders and external partners
  • Providing technical leadership and mentoring to less experienced team members
  • Contributing to proof-of-concepts, automation and the adoption of new technologies
  • Helping establish sustainable approaches to data quality, governance and platform reliability
  • Longer term, contributing to the evolution of ML and MLOps practices within the data environment

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an established Senior Data Engineer rather than someone taking their first step into a senior position.

Ideally, You'll Bring

  • Significant commercial experience delivering data solutions, ideally 10+ years across data/technology environments
  • Strong hands-on data engineering experience
  • Excellent SQL, ETL/ELT and data warehousing capability
  • Strong experience with schema design and dimensional data modelling
  • Experience designing and building complex, production-grade data pipelines
  • Commercial experience with Snowflake
  • Good understanding of cloud data architecture, ideally within an Azure environment
  • Experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions rather than isolated reporting or analytics projects
  • The ability to understand business problems and translate them into practical data solutions
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to provide technical guidance to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • A willingness to lead, influence engineering practices and help others within the team

Experience with Coalesce, Omnata, Power BI, GitHub or Kimball-style dimensional modelling would be useful, but isn't essential if your core data engineering and modelling experience is strong.

Why Consider This Role?

The attraction here is the opportunity to join at a particularly good stage in the platform's evolution.

The foundations are already in place, so you aren't walking into a blank sheet of paper, but there is still plenty to build, improve and influence. You'll be working with a modern Snowflake architecture, helping determine what "good" looks like as the environment matures.

It's a senior position where you'll remain technically close to the work while having genuine influence over architecture, engineering standards and how data is made available across the organisation.

You'll join a collaborative and relatively young data team, with flexible hybrid working from a central Christchurch office.

If you're an experienced Data Engineer who enjoys the modelling and architecture side of data engineering just as much as building pipelines, we'd be keen to hear from you.

You must have valid New Zealand working rights to be considered for this role

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Build the science that shapes the future of human health.
Application closing date: 14.10.2026

Join a place where ambitious science thrives
Human Technopole (Milan) is a rapidly expanding life science institute where international researchers and cutting-edge technologies converge to accelerate biomedical discovery. Our mission is to transform bold scientific ideas into advances that improve human health.

Within this mission, the ICT & Digitisation Department at HT is expanding and seeking professionals with specific expertise in DevOps related tasks.

We are seeking a technically gifted, innovative, and enthusiastic DevOps Engineer to support the activities of the Core Services Team in the Data Centre Facility.

Your mission
As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for the implementation and continuous improvement of centralized IT systems and cloud-native infrastructure. You will design and optimize CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks to enable efficient and reliable software development and deployment processes.

Working in a collaborative team environment, you will support enterprise-grade Kubernetes and cloud platform capabilities, including microservices, virtualization, and container technologies. You will ensure the scalability, security, and high availability of development, testing, and production environments.

The successful candidate will actively support the research community and collaborate closely with digital development, cybersecurity, and core services teams to enhance automation, efficiency, and service reliability.

You will report to the Core Services Manager.

You will enhance your professional skills by:

CI/CD & Automation

  • Designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to enable automated testing, integration, and deployment.
  • Optimizing build, release, and deployment processes to accelerate development cycles.
  • Ensuring seamless integration across development, staging, and production environments.
  • Integrating automated security scans, compliance checks, and DevSecOps best practices into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Developing and managing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation).
  • Automating provisioning, configuration management, scaling, and self-healing mechanisms.
  • Implementing and supporting multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud architectures.
  • Planning, deploying, configuring, and managing new and existing infrastructure systems.
  • Implementing, administering, and maintaining Kubernetes (on-premises and cloud), Docker, and containerized workloads.
  • Ensuring the health, scalability, performance, and reliability of Kubernetes, microservices, and related systems.
  • Monitoring and optimizing system performance, resource utilization, and latency.

Security, Reliability & Operations

  • Collaborating with the Cybersecurity team to enforcing RBAC, secret management, encryption, and security best practices.
  • Diagnosing and resolving infrastructure and CI/CD incidents, performing root cause analysis, and implementing preventive measures.
  • Ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and operational continuity, including performing emergency maintenance.

Documentation, Governance & Support

  • Maintaining up-to-date technical and operational documentation.
  • Enforcing DevOps standards, coding practices, and operational guidelines.
  • Providing technical guidance, contributing to projects, mentoring junior engineers, and supporting broader DevOps, Linux, and Data Centre operations as needed.

Human Technopole supports career development through training, mentoring and dedicated learning opportunities.

What you'll bring

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years in DevOps, cloud engineering, or infrastructure automation.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.
  • Deep knowledge of container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Strong scripting and automation skills in Bash, Python, or Go.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a focus on scalability, security, and efficiency.
  • Ability to collaborate in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment.
  • Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.

Preferred

  • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
  • ITIL certification

Organizational and social skills

  • Strong communication skills, given the multicultural nature of our team.
  • Excellent teamworking skills.
  • Proactive approach to continuous improvement.

Why Human Technopole

HT offers an international and dynamic workplace, competitive welfare provisions, flexible working policies and relocation support. Researchers moving to Italy may benefit from attractive tax benefits. We promote work–life balance and provide parental support initiatives.

We strongly encourage applications from candidates belonging to protected categories (L. 68/99).

title: Seasonal Safety & Security Officer - 3rd Shift
description:
Available Positions & Schedules

We are hiring two Seasonal Safety & Security Officers for our Westerville, OH location. Each position has a designated overnight schedule:

  • Position 1: Monday – Friday, 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM

  • Position 2: Tuesday – Saturday, 8:00 PM – 4:00 AM

Candidates will be considered for the position that aligns with their availability and will be assigned to the corresponding schedule. Additional hours may be required based on business needs.

Job Summary

1-800-FLOWERS.COM, Inc. is seeking dependable, detail-oriented Seasonal Safety & Security Officers to help maintain a safe and secure environment for employees, visitors, facilities, and company assets at our Westerville, OH location.

In this role, you will support overnight safety and security operations by monitoring surveillance and access control systems, conducting routine facility patrols, responding to incidents and emergencies, and maintaining accurate documentation. You will also work closely with internal departments, including Human Resources and Legal, to support company policies and promote a safe workplace throughout the seasonal assignment.

The ideal candidate is observant, professional, reliable, and comfortable working independently and making sound decisions during overnight hours.

Key Responsibilities

Major responsibilities of the position are listed below. To perform the job successfully, an individual must be able to execute each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. Additional duties, assignments, and special projects may be assigned at management's discretion.

  • Monitor CCTV, access control, and dispatch systems to identify and respond to potential safety and security concerns.

  • Conduct routine patrols of parking lots, building exteriors, and company property to identify potential hazards, monitor activity, and enforce safety and security policies.

  • Monitor employee, visitor, and vehicle traffic entering and exiting the facility, including during overnight operations.

  • Respond promptly and professionally to safety- and security-related calls and requests for assistance throughout the facility.

  • Investigate incidents involving employees, visitors, company property, or assets by gathering relevant information and documenting findings.

  • Prepare accurate and timely incident reports, summaries, and documentation using company computer systems.

  • Respond to burglary alarms, fire alarms, medical emergencies, and other emergency situations while coordinating with appropriate emergency responders.

  • Provide First Aid and CPR during medical emergencies when properly trained and assist emergency medical personnel as needed.

  • Identify and report potential workplace safety hazards, unsafe conditions, and security risks.

  • Help protect company employees, visitors, facilities, and assets through proactive observation, routine monitoring, and appropriate response.

  • Collaborate with Human Resources, Legal, and other internal departments to support and enforce company safety, security, and workplace policies.

  • Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when handling sensitive employee information, investigations, and security-related matters.

  • Follow established emergency response procedures and assist with maintaining a safe and orderly environment during overnight operations.

  • Perform additional duties and special assignments as directed by management.

title: [Expression of Interest] General Application
description:
Type: Full-time
Location: London · San Francisco

The Role

Titles are a lossy compression of what people are actually great at. The people who move us furthest tend to have jagged, cross-disciplinary skill profiles that no standard req captures. Here, you get to define your own role.

The roles we’ve posted cover our known, near-term gaps. This one is for the people who don’t fit a box but can clearly see where they’d plug in and accelerate us. Use this application to make your case: name the role, draw its edges, and show us exactly how your background compounds what we’re building.

You might be a fit if you

  • Have built, researched, or shipped at a genuinely high bar, whatever your domain.

  • Do your best work before the map exists, and would rather take a fuzzy problem, scope it down, and own it end to end.

  • Are pulled toward the seam where neuroscience, biology, and modern ML meet, whether your entry point is neural recording, signal processing, large-scale training, data infrastructure, or something we haven’t thought of.

  • Are comfortable with large, messy, real-world data and the rigor it takes to trust results from it.

  • Collaborate high-bandwidth and low-ego. We’re a small team of ML engineers, data engineers and researchers, and the strongest idea wins no matter whose it is.

  • Are driven to build technology that expands what people can do.

Good to know

  • We work in person in London and San Francisco. Tell us which office you’d join and whether you’re already able to work there.

Responsibilities

  • Identify new attack patterns and model vulnerabilities.

  • 3+ years of professional experience in cybersecurity, security research, red teaming, or a related security field.

  • Strong understanding of LLMs, prompt injection, and AI security.
  • Experience with red teaming, security research, or adversarial testing.
  • Strong Python and automation skills.
  • Creative problem-solving and ability to develop new attack techniques.
  • Ability to analyze results and communicate findings clearly.

Preferred Skills That Set You Apart

Alice is a trust, safety, and security company built for the AI era. We safeguard the communicative technologies people use to create, collaborate, and interact- whether with each other or with machines.

Alice is widely considered a global leader in online safety and AI security. We have some of the most forward-thinking and passionate minds in the world working to safeguard over 3 billion users across the largest AI and tech platforms.

If you're creative and driven to secure the future of AI, we want to hear from you!

title: Retail Customer Experience Associate, Lacantera - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Customer Experience Colleague, you will create exceptional, personalized shopping experiences for our customers. You’ll prioritize customer satisfaction by actively engaging with shoppers across all touchpoints - both in-store and online - and drive cross-category sales to support overall business goals. With a deep understanding of fashion, fit, and function, you will make tailored product recommendations and leverage digital tools to enhance the customer journey. You also will work across different departments daily, often transitioning between multiple areas throughout the day.

In this role, you’ll also play a key part in client relationship building through outreach tools like My Client and social media. Your collaborative approach with peers, store leaders, and brand partners will help identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and elevate the overall customer experience. In addition to service and selling, you’ll support operational excellence through floor readiness, event execution, merchandise setup, and opening/closing procedures.

A positive, can-do attitude, strong communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-caliber service will be key to your success in this role.

How Our Selling Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride, greet teammates with a warm hello, and help ensure the sales floor is clean, organized, and prepared for customers. Before getting started, they review their sales goals, learn about new arrivals and top-selling items, and stay up to date on current trends and promotions - so they’re fully informed and ready to engage, educate, and sell with confidence.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - offering a warm welcome, making eye contact, and creating friendly, personal conversations to create customer relationships to bring the customers back.
  • Throughout the day, they maintain a shoppable space by recovering the floor and fitting rooms, updating signs and pricing, and supporting any needed merchandise moves.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem
  • At least 2 years of selling or customer experience preferred

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to an inclusive work environment.

title: Programme Policy officer - VAM
description:
DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS

13 October 2026-23:59-GMT+02:00 Eastern European Standard Time (Cairo)

WFP celebrates and embraces diversity. It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability.


ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of extreme weather shocks.


At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.


WHY JOIN WFP?

  • WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.
  • WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.
  • WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.
  • A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.
  • We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).




Background:
Egypt is currently facing a strained economic environment driven by regional instability and global trade disruptions. The Middle East crisis that erupted in February 2026 has intensified pressures on the economy, raising oil prices and import costs and adding further stress to Egypt’s external position. As a net importer of strategic crops such as wheat, as well as oil and natural gas — the latter being a critical input for fertilizer production — Egypt remains highly exposed to global price volatility.
After notable improvements in 2025, when the Egyptian pound appreciated from EGP 50.4 in January to EGP 47.6 in December and inflation eased significantly — with overall inflation falling from 23.2 percent in January to 10.3 percent by December, and food inflation dropping from 20.2 percent to just 0.9 percent — the February 2026 crisis triggered a depreciation to EGP 53 in May 2026. This reversal reignited inflationary pressures across both food and non food items. Rising costs have strained household budgets and forced many families to adopt negative coping strategies, including reducing meal sizes, lowering dietary diversity, and shifting to cheaper, less nutritious foods. These behaviors have serious implications for food security and nutritional status, particularly among vulnerable groups such as pregnant and breastfeeding women, infants and young children, the elderly, and households already living in poverty.
In response, the government has sought to balance fiscal pressures with measures to protect household purchasing power and access to basic needs. Government actions have included increases in fuel, electricity, and railway ticket prices, alongside consideration of shifting food subsidies to cash transfers and selling bread at market prices. At the same time, the government has encouraged local wheat production to reduce import dependence and trade imbalances. Complementary measures have included raising the minimum wage and the rollout of a temporary expansion of Egypt’s social protection scheme. These interventions aim to cushion households against the irreversible consequences of poverty, food insecurity, and malnutrition.
Against this backdrop, the objective of the consultancy is to generate evidence on how recent economic shocks and policy measures affect household purchasing power, food security, and nutrition. The consultant will leverage the most recent Household Income and Expenditure Surveys (HIECS) and previous datasets to estimate the prevalence of food insecurity and nutrition deficiencies, analyze trends over time, and profile food insecure households by socioeconomic, geographic, and dwelling characteristics.
Building on this analysis, the consultant will develop a concise nutrition synthesis using HIECS data and relevant nutrition indicators to examine underlying drivers, correlations, disparities, and trends where possible. This will strengthen the interpretation of how economic shocks, food insecurity, poverty, and policy measures translate into dietary and nutrition risks for vulnerable groups, particularly women, children, and households enrolled in social protection programmes, specifically under the ‘ First 1000 days’ programme, and also food subsidy schemes in line with updated reference food basket for Egyptians. The findings will also inform the Cost of Diet and Cost of Food and Nutrition studies, supporting evidence-based programming and policy dialogue under the national food systems agenda.
The consultant will simulate different scenarios for government measures — including subsidy reforms and social assistance expansions — to assess their potential impact on household vulnerability, food insecurity, dietary patterns, and nutrition outcomes. Building on these models, the consultant will deliver strategic, programmatic, and policy insights grounded in evidence. This will enable proactive and timely interventions to mitigate the socio economic impacts on household food security and nutrition, particularly among the most vulnerable. Evidence generation will also focus on identifying the groups most at risk and their specific food security and nutrition needs, thereby informing recommendations for the Government of Egypt on the most appropriate interventions. This aligns with government priorities under the food systems approach, consistent with Egypt’s commitments to the Food Systems Summit resolutions of 2021 and national initiatives — including the National Operational Plan for Food and Nutrition Systems 2025–2030 and the Accelerated Anemia Action Plan.
Furthermore, the analysis will explore the degree to which food insecurity intersects with poverty and assesses the impact of single and multi layered social protection and subsidy interventions in addressing household vulnerabilities. It will also provide evidence on how existing government targeting and data systems can be integrated to address different vulnerability dimensions, including food insecurity, poverty, and nutrition.
The analysis will generate evidence to inform ongoing operational and programmatic collaboration between WFP and relevant ministries, including on economic empowerment, smallholder farmer resilience, school feeding programme, and the 1,000 Days top-up under the Takaful and Karama programme. This evidence will include analysis of the prevalence of food insecurity across activities and target groups, disaggregated by household characteristics, geography, poverty status, and participation in social protection and food assistance programmes. The analysis will draw on social assistance and support reported by surveyed households, as well as reported income sources and economic sectors.
In addition, the consultant will support the strengthening of national institutions’ capacity to analyze and monitor food security and nutrition indicators. This will enhance the ability of national institutions to generate timely, policy relevant evidence and inform government decision making on food security and nutrition.
The analysis will inform policy dialogue and programmatic evidence generation on food security and nutrition with the government and will be reflected in inter-agency collaboration. This includes contributions to the Country Analysis and UNSDCF, food security working groups, roundtable discussions, and engagement with partner agencies.
Collaboration will be maintained with the VAM Officer in Egypt CO and senior consultants in HQ to ensure robust evidence generation and policy relevance.

Key Responsibilities of the Programme Policy Officer

1. Data, Analysis and Simulation

  • Analyse Data: Utilize the latest Household Income, Expenditure, and Consumption Surveys (HIECS), ensuring comparability with earlier rounds. Manage and analyze data, incorporating additional relevant surveys and secondary sources as needed.
  • Conduct Simulation Models: Develop and run simulation models to assess the impact of recent and potential economic measures such as currency devaluation, inflation, and subsidy reforms and potential future changes, on food security and nutrition status.
  • Evaluate Impact: Analyse how economic changes affect purchasing power, food security and nutrition status of households based on latest WFP approach and guidelines.
  • Assess overlap: Examine the degree to which food insecurity intersects with poverty, and evaluate the impact of single and multi‑layered social protection and subsidy interventions in addressing household vulnerabilities.

2. Technical Guidance and Capacity Strengthening

  • Contribute to the capacity strengthening of national institutions in the analysis and monitoring of food security and nutrition related indicators, to mainstream food security and nutrition component, in alignment with government priority interventions under the food system agenda.
  • Provide Technical Guidance: Offer expert advice on the surveys, context, simulation modelling techniques and methodologies.
  • Formulate Strategic and Operational Advice: Deliver strategic and operational recommendations based on analytical findings.
  • Support the introduction and implementation of nutrition analyses and data tools including the Cost of Diet and Cost of Food and Nutrition.

3. Report Preparation including:

  • Methodology: Document methodologies used, including simulation models and data sources.
  • Analysis: Present detailed findings from simulations, including poverty–food insecurity overlaps and implications for nutrition outcomes.
  • Findings: Provide a comprehensive summary of results, including any potential scenarios and their impacts.
  • Recommendations: Offer actionable recommendations for policymakers or relevant stakeholders based on the analysis.

Components

Three main components are required, including as applicable, raw and processed datasets, syntax files, output tables, and summary report or presentation and/or policy papers covering methodology, analysis, key findings, and recommendations, to communicate the implications of the analysis and recommend actions.

The components are:

  • Analysis of Food Security and Nutrition risks and vulnerabilities of vulnerable Egyptians and Impact of economic crisis and government measures:
    • Presenting Food Security and Nutrition analysis of vulnerable Egyptians and Impact of inflation, currency devaluation, social assistance and subsidy cuts on household purchasing power, food security, nutrition status, consumption patterns, and dietary diversity.
    • The analysis will focus on the combined impact of the different economic and government measures as well as the sole impact of each measure. The analysis will follow the latest WFP corporate guidance on food security and nutrition analysis will include the consumption of macro and micronutrients (such as iron, folic acid, vitamin A) and dietary diversity across different age groups and among women of reproductive age, and pregnant lactating women.
    • The food security and nutrition analysis will be broken down by household characteristics (such as household size, the presence of children, households who have pregnant and lactating women or children under two), regional and sub-regional differences, enrollment in social assistance programmes (such as Takaful and Karama and 1000 days programme, and food subsidy schemes in line with the reference food basket for Egyptian HHs), and poverty levels to inform the vulnerability and impact of investment. It will explore the contribution of nutrition-specific interventions, such as the national flour fortification program, in enhancing dietary diversity and nutrient intake.
    • undefined
    • Cost of Diet analysis
    • undefined
    • In line with WFP programme priorities and strategic alignment with the government on the resilience portfolio, economic empowerment, and school; feeding programmes, the analysis will capture the food security status of small holder farmers and economic empowerment beneficiaries disaggregated by household characteristics, geography, social protection and food assistance programmes, and poverty.
    • Additionally, the analysis will explore the overlap between poverty and food insecurity, and assess the impact of single and multi‑layered social protection and subsidy interventions in addressing household vulnerabilities.
  • Generate a short synthesis encompassing above data from HIECS, linking to nutrition indicators, showing trends, disparities, focusing on specific target groups, PBWs and children under two, including those enrolled into the national SP system and comparing to non-beneficiaries.
  • undefined
  • Capacity Strengthening for National Institutions to mainstream food security and nutrition component, in alignment with government priority interventions under the food system agenda.
    • Delivery of training and preparation of training materials to strengthen national institutions capacity on food security and nutrition analysis.
    • Contribute to the training on the COD tool Support data analysis and synthesis of findings aligning with the tool design and methodology Support the implementation of cascade training of the tool to relevant government counterparts
  • COFAN:
  • In line with the Government of Egypt’s engagement in regional food systems and nutrition investment agendas, the assignment will contribute to the methodology development and facilitation of implementation of the Cost of Food and Nutrition in Africa (COFAN) study as a deliverable under the national food systems portfolio. COFAN builds on the updated Cost of Hunger in Africa approach and broadens the analysis to estimate the social and economic impacts of multiple forms of malnutrition, including undernutrition, overweight and obesity, micronutrient deficiencies . Support will include essentially technical inputs to the study design, data analysis plan, synthesis of findings, and investment case scenarios, ensuring alignment with national priorities on nutrition, food subsidy reform, social protection, nutrition-sensitive programming, and human capital development. This study will generate higher-level policy and investment evidence to inform government dialogue, programme prioritization, and financing decisions for nutrition programmes under the national food and nutrition systems operational plan.

Project timeline and payment plan

Analysis of Food Security and Nutrition of vulnerable Egyptians and Impact of economic crisis and government measures

Output 1: Estimate current and historical prevalence and trends of food security, nutrition consumption (and indicators where applicable), and dietary diversity, disaggregated by household characteristics, poverty levels, regional differences, and WFP programme interventions. Syntax files and an excel file including all results to be submitted upon finalization of output 1.

Output 2: Assess nutrition consumption patterns including those of macro‑ and micronutrients (iron, folic acid, vitamin A, zinc) and dietary diversity, Minimum acceptable diet across different age groups, with emphasis on women of reproductive age, pregnant and lactating women, and children under two, and school age/adolescents. Emphasize trends, links with underlying drivers, and highlight geographic, age group and other relevant disparities. Explore the contribution of nutrition interventions, such as the first 1000 days programme within Takaful and Karama in contributing to reducing the impact of socioeconomic shocks and related consequences on vulnerable groups, through enhancing dietary diversity and nutrient intake, and cushioning them from falling into further poverty and food insecurity. Syntax files and an excel file including all results to be submitted upon finalization of output 2.

Output 3: Explore the degree to which food insecurity intersects with poverty and evaluate the impact of single and multi‑layered social protection and subsidy interventions in addressing household vulnerabilities. Provide evidence on how government targeting and data systems can be integrated to address multidimensional vulnerabilities (poverty, food insecurity, nutrition). Syntax files and an excel file including all results to be submitted upon finalization of output 3.

Output 4: Review and update shock impact simulation models by incorporating different government measures and their magnitudes, and assess their impact on different poverty levels (extremely poor, poor, near poor, and non poor), food security (severely food insecure, moderately food insecure, marginally food secure, and food secure) , nutrition, dietary diversity, and access to services (nutrition and health). This includes analyzing how the impact varies across different household characteristics, such as age, education, sex, and marital status of the household head; presence of children in different age groups; presence of pregnant or breastfeeding women; enrollment in one or more social assistance programs; geographical location. Include analysis of return on investment and cost of inaction. Syntax files and an excel file including all results to be submitted upon finalization of output 4.

Output 5: Cost of Diet Analysis Support the design, analysis, and roll-out of the Cost of Diet study with key deliverables including; 1. Inputs to the Cost of Diet study design and analytical framework provided, ensuring alignment with HIECS data, the Cost of Diet tool methodology, and Government priorities under the food systems, food subsidy, and social protection agendas. 2. Inputs to data analysis, synthesis of findings, and final report provided, including interpretation of dietary affordability, nutrient gaps, and implications for vulnerable groups and priority government programmes. 3. Cost of Diet tool training delivered, including preparation of relevant training materials and support to a four-day training for national counterparts; 4. Support provided to the cascade training and roll-out of the Cost of Diet tool with relevant government institutions, to strengthen national capacity to use nutrition-specific evidence in programme design, targeting, and policy dialogue. Syntax files and an excel file including all results to be submitted upon finalization of output 5.

Output 6: A consolidated summary report with methodology note and key findings, and a full-fledged PowerPoint presentation with detailed findings.

Capacity Strengthening for National Institutions to mainstream food security and nutrition analysis at national level in line with Government priorities and interventions

Output 1: Delivery of capacity strengthening workshop on food security and nutrition analysis with government counterparts, including line ministries.

Output 2: Contribute to data preparations, data analysis, and the roll out of the cost of diet training.

Output 3: Delivery of advanced technical training to Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics and National Nutrition Institute. This includes the preparation of training materials.

Cost Of Food and Nutrition (COFAN)

Output 1: Provide technical inputs to the COFAN study design, including the analytical framework, scope, priority policy questions, and alignment with Egypt’s national food systems, nutrition, social protection, and food subsidy reform priorities.

Output 2: Contribute to the COFAN data analysis plan and synthesis of findings, ensuring that food security, nutrition, dietary affordability, social protection, food subsidy, and vulnerability dimensions are reflected coherently in the analysis.

Output 3: Provide technical inputs to the development of investment case scenarios and policy recommendations, including contributions to programme prioritization, financing dialogue, and review of the final COFAN report.

Output 4: Review the final COFAN report and provide technical feedback to ensure coherence with the study design, analytical framework, and national policy priorities.


Skills and Expertise Required

  • Expertise in Econometrics: Proficiency in econometrics and simulation modelling.
  • Knowledge of Food Security: Understanding of food security and nutrition indicators and their measurement.
  • Data Analysis: Experience with household income and expenditure survey data.
  • Collaboration Skills: Ability to work effectively with other experts and stakeholders.
  • Report Writing: Strong skills in technical writing and report preparation.

LANGUAGES

Working knowledge (proficiency/Level C) of English is required.

There are no bystanders here. We proactively identify problems and take full responsibility over getting a strong result. We are self-driven, own our mistakes, and feel deep responsibility over what were building.

Action today

We have a small amount of time to do something incredibly hard and meaningful. The pace and intensity of the organization is high. If we can take action today or tomorrow, we will choose to do it today.

This role offers market competitive salary, equity, and competitive benefits.

- Provide direct leadership and oversight of the daily shipping operation.

Handheld Computer & Systems Support
- Assist associates with handheld computers/RF devices and warehouse systems.
- Help troubleshoot common system, scanning, picking, and loading issues.
- Ensure associates are properly using technology and following required system processes.
- Identify system or equipment issues that may impact productivity or shipping accuracy.
Process & Best Practices
- Ensure associates follow established standard operating procedures (SOPs) and best practices.
- Maintain strong adherence to customer and company operational standards.
- Identify opportunities to improve workflow, productivity, quality, and safety.
- Help implement process improvements and reinforce changes with the team.
- Ensure processes are followed consistently rather than allowing shortcuts that create safety or quality risks.
Safety & Quality
- Maintain a strong safety-first culture throughout the warehouse.
- Immediately address unsafe behaviors, conditions, and practices.
- Ensure associates are following proper lifting, material handling, loading, and equipment procedures.
- Support warehouse safety inspections and corrective actions.
- Maintain high standards for product handling, cleanliness, housekeeping, and food safety.
- Take ownership of keeping the work environment safe, clean, and organized.
What We're Looking For
The ideal candidate is:
- A hands-on warehouse leader who enjoys being on the floor.
- Comfortable directing employees and holding people accountable.
- Strong at organizing people, processes, and workflow.
- Able to make decisions quickly in a fast-paced environment.
- Comfortable working with handheld/RF warehouse technology.
- Process-oriented and committed to following established best practices.
- Safety-minded with the ability to recognize and correct hazards.
- A strong communicator who can work effectively with associates, supervisors, management, and customers.
- Willing to jump in and help when the operation needs additional support.
- Able to balance productivity, safety, quality, and customer service.
Preferred Qualifications
- Previous warehouse, distribution, shipping, or logistics experience.
- Previous lead, supervisor, or team leadership experience.
- Experience with RF scanners/handheld warehouse computers.
- Experience with picking, loading, staging, or shipping operations.
- Experience in a food, beverage, grocery, or distribution environment preferred.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced warehouse environment.
- Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift, and work on the warehouse floor for extended periods.
Schedule
Regular Days Off: Saturday & Wednesday
The Shipping Lead must be available to work the remaining scheduled days and be flexible based on operational needs, shipping volume, and customer requirements.
Why Join Capstone Logistics?
This is an opportunity to take a leadership role in a high-volume distribution operation where your leadership directly impacts safety, productivity, employee performance, and customer service.
We are looking for someone who doesn't just tell people what to do — but gets on the floor, understands the operation, solves problems, and leads by example.
If you are a hands-on warehouse leader who takes ownership of the operation and enjoys building a safe, productive, and accountable team, we want to hear from you.

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
Technical Business Analyst defines, manages, and delivers digital product requirements that support business objectives and operational excellence in Financial Industry. The role ensures a clear, prioritized backlog and strong alignment between business stakeholders, technical teams, and end users.

Operating at the intersection of product ownership, business analysis, and process optimization, as well as system integration, The Business Analyst guides solutions from discovery through delivery and continuous improvement. The role requires a solid understanding of APIs and system-to-system integrations, as the Business Analyst will work closely with technical teams to define integration requirements, data flows, and expected system behavior.

Our client is a technology-driven insurance platform that enables businesses to embed protection products directly into their customer journeys. Our project will support the client in enhancing its digital insurance capabilities and delivering a seamless, efficient experience for partners and customers.

Responsibilities

Drive Impact: Your expertise will play a pivotal role in identifying, analyzing, and shaping business needs, ensuring that solutions deliver measurable value and improve end-to-end processes across domains.

Own the Product Direction: You will manage and prioritize the product backlog and roadmap, balancing business value, risks, dependencies, and operational constraints to drive informed decision-making.

Shape Solutions from Discovery to Delivery: You will lead discovery workshops, analyze AS-IS processes, and define optimized TO-BE solutions, translating complex needs into clear process flows, user journeys, data flows, API requirements and system interactions.

Bridge Business and IT: You will act as the connector between stakeholders and technical teams, facilitating collaboration, clarifying business, functional, and integration requirements, and ensuring shared understanding within cross-functional teams.

Define API and Integration Requirements: You will analyze system interactions and integration needs, document API-related requirements, define data mappings and expected request-response flows, and collaborate with developers and architects to ensure that integrations support the intended business processes.

Translate Needs into Actionable Work: You will convert requirements into structured user stories, acceptance criteria, API-related use cases, and test scenarios, ensuring alignment with the broader ecosystem and operational processes.

Enable Successful Delivery with Partners: You will collaborate with internal teams and external providers, preparing detailed requirement packages and validating delivered solutions against expectations, including API and integration requirements.

Validate Integrated Solutions: You will support the validation of APIs and system integrations by reviewing specifications, coordinating integration testing, analyzing API responses and errors, and confirming that delivered solutions meet business expectations.

Drive Adoption and Change: You will support stakeholders through UAT cycles, training, and communication, ensuring smooth adoption of new capabilities and embedding them into daily operations.

Ensure Continuous Improvement: You will provide ongoing application support, analyze recurring issues, and transform insights into enhancements that optimize processes and ensure long-term sustainability.

  • 3+ years of experience in Business Analysis and/or Product Ownership, with a proven record of delivering enterprise solutions and experience in context switching roles.
  • Hands-on experience working with APIs and system integrations, including the ability to understand API documentation, endpoints, request and response structures, authentication methods, error handling, and data mappings.
  • Experience translating business needs into functional and integration requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and system interaction diagrams.
  • Familiarity with tools used to explore, document, or test APIs, such as Postman, Swagger, or OpenAPI.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand business context and translate it into actionable outcomes, with hands-on experience leading discovery activities, defining business processes, and navigating complex stakeholder landscapes.
  • Strong background in evaluating solution alternatives (existing tools vs. custom development), third-party integrations and making informed recommendations based on value, feasibility and cost.
  • Proven ability to autonomously transform complex business and process requirements and integration requirements into well-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery milestones.
  • Experience managing UAT cycles, coordinating stakeholders, and driving adoption across diverse user groups.
  • Strong operational mindset, including post-deployment support, user interaction management, and continuous improvement of applications and processes.
  • Excellent communication skills in English
  • Regular use of AI tools to improve productivity, automate or reduce repetitive work, support decision-making, and deliver higher-quality outcomes

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Klaar om als Senior Data Engineer/Platform Engineer impact te maken bij toonaangevende organisaties? Bij Team EIFFEL werk je projectmatig aan uitdagende datavraagstukken, van corporates tot overheid. Je bouwt aan slimme data-oplossingen én begeleidt collega's in hun groei. Jij kiest je richting: verdiepen of verbreden. Zo blijf je jezelf voor.

Dit ga je doen

  • Je verzamelt en integreert data uit verschillende bronnen zoals databases en API's
