Je bent fit for the job als je...

  • minimaal 5 jaar ervaring hebt als Data Engineer of vergelijkbaar (binnen een Microsoft omgeving)
  • een hbo- of wo-diploma hebt in Informatica, Data Science of Business IT & Management
  • ervaring hebt met SQL, Python en ETL/ELT tools zoals Data Factory, dbt of Airflow en kennis van AVG richtlijnen en hoe data daarop aansluit
  • ervaring hebt met CI/CD, Git en data-integraties (API's)
  • Nederlands spreekt en schrijft op minimaal C1-niveau
  • bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B

Dit krijg je van ons

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen 5.500 en 8.500 euro bruto per maand op basis van een 40 urige werkweek, passend bij jouw ervaring en expertise.

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied

Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is, of het nu gaat om een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis. Dat doen we door slimmer te werken, ideeën van papier naar praktijk te brengen en de juiste mensen op de juiste plek te zetten. Voor grote transformaties én snelle oplossingen. Van multinational tot start up: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Je sluit je aan bij Team Analytics, een groeiend team van gedreven data professionals. Samen help je organisaties door heel Nederland om datagedreven werken naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je werkt aan projecten waar je écht impact maakt en je krijgt de ruimte om jouw expertise te verdiepen en te verbreden.

Op vrijdag werken we samen in ons clubhuis in Arnhem. Deze dag staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega's en het versterken van de verbinding met Team EIFFEL. Verwacht je opdrachtgever je die dag op locatie? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.

EIFFEL is onderdeel van Team EIFFEL: een community van ruim 3.000 experts binnen interim, consultancy en projectmanagement. Met opdrachten in 24 kennisdomeinen, bij meer dan 600 opdrachtgevers, en een trainingsaanbod waar je eindeloos uit kunt kiezen, helpen onze Performance Managers jou een loopbaan te bouwen die past bij jouw ambitie en levensfase.

title: Senior Gameplay Programmer
description:
Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

**Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

  • Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.
  • Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.
  • Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.
  • Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.
  • Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.
  • Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

**You’re a great match if

**

  • You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team
  • You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off
  • You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them
  • You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team
  • You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

**Nice to have

**

  • Experience working on live games

**Requirements For Any Job At Triband

**

  • You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward
  • You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture
  • You value a positive work environment
  • You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

**Practicalities

**

  • Primarily work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen
  • Only open to candidates who are already eligible to work in Denmark as we don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role
  • 37-hour work week, with flexible work hours
  • No crunch, we put people before deadlines
  • Our working language is English

**We offer

**

  • Silly but ambitious projects
  • The chance to contribute to great games that reach millions of players
  • A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged
  • Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games
  • A professional development budget to invest in your growth
  • Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights and team events
  • Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).
  • Six weeks of paid vacation
  • Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement
  • Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked
  • Pension plan and private health insurance
  • Endless amounts of coffee

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

title: SENIOR PRODUCT OWNER / BA – FX STRUCTURED PRODUCTS
description:
An established, well-capitalized financial technology firm operating at the intersection of institutional banking and digital connectivity. We power seamless access between global financial institutions and premier product providers.

We are currently expanding our derivatives vertical and looking for a specialist to lead a high-impact greenfield initiative.

The Role:

We are building a new FX Structured Products execution and pricing module from scratch. This includes complex instruments such as DCN Options, TARFs, and Pivots.

We need someone who can:

  • Bridge the gap between structured product engineering and elegant trading technology.
  • Lead product strategy while staying deeply hands-on with requirements, workflows, and technical execution.
  • Own the full lifecycle—from pre-trade RFQ design to post-trade event processing.

What You'll Actually Do:

  • Define & Prioritize: Shape the product roadmap and feature backlog. Decide what gets built and when.
  • Design User Journeys: Create intuitive UI mockups and workflow diagrams for price requests, order execution, and real-time position management.
  • Map the Entire Lifecycle: Engineer end-to-end trade flows—covering pricing, execution, allocations, confirmations, and corporate actions.
  • Write Crystal-Clear Specs: Break down complex logic into detailed user stories in Jira. Lead Agile ceremonies and keep delivery on track.
  • Lead the Tech Conversation: Partner closely with developers and DevOps. Guide architectural decisions and challenge technical trade-offs to ensure a high-performance, scalable solution.

Who You Are (The Must-Haves):

  • FX Derivative Native: 7–8+ years working directly with FX Options, TARFs, Pivots, or similar structured products. You know the mechanics, the pricing nuances, and the institutional workflows inside out.
  • Tech-Savvy Product Leader: Proven experience as a Product Owner, Lead BA, or Product Manager inside an Agile engineering environment. You don't just write tickets—you understand the underlying system logic.
  • UX-Driven Thinker: You have designed or significantly influenced the UI/UX of a B2B financial trading platform (single-dealer, multi-dealer, or institutional investment tools). You instinctively know what makes a workflow smooth or clunky.
  • Tooling: Jira is your second home.
  • Leadership Presence: You can drive a cross-functional team from vague requirements to polished implementation. You push back when necessary and align stakeholders effectively.
  • Problem-Solving DNA: Highly analytical, deeply curious, and not afraid to get your hands dirty in the details.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with the FIX protocol is a distinct advantage.
  • Academic Background: We tend to see exceptional analytical discipline from graduates of top-tier institutions like HKUST—but talent trumps pedigree.

Why You Should Consider This:

  • Greenfield Build: This is not maintenance work. You are shaping a brand-new product from day one.
  • Institutional Scale: Your work will directly impact how major financial institutions trade complex derivatives globally.
  • Agile & Flat: No excessive bureaucracy. Decisions happen fast. Your voice carries weight.
  • Competitive Package: Base salary + performance incentives aligned with your seniority and impact.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
AppsFlyer is known for its massive backend production. At any given moment thousands of servers are consuming 200+ billion mobile app events daily, crunching our users' data, serving requests, and communicating on a massive scale. To achieve such scale, our data & microservice architecture is built with the best and latest cutting-edge technologies such as Node.js, Go, Kafka, GraphQL, Neo4j, Redis, BigQuery, AWS, and many more…

The SaaSLab group is part of the AFOS (AppsFlyer Operating System) unit which owns the SaaS platform and control plane of AppsFlyer — the foundational layer that manages users, accounts, billing, API gateway, authentication, permissions, and business integrations. SaaSLab's systems serve as the backbone for every product and feature at AppsFlyer, handling millions of API calls daily and supporting thousands of enterprise customers worldwide.

We are looking for an exceptional Software Engineer to join the Domain Team within SaaSLab. The Domain Team owns AppsFlyer's core entities — accounts, apps, and users — as well as the onboarding experience. This is a foundational domain that every other product and team at AppsFlyer depends on. You will design, build, and operate the backend systems that power these entities while contributing to the team's ongoing architectural evolution.

The position requires strong backend engineering skills, a solid understanding of distributed systems, and the ability to take ownership of complex technical problems from design through production.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems and data flows for AppsFlyer's core entities (accounts, apps, users) and onboarding flows
  • Take part in decoupling from legacy data stores, building a resilient domain model, and adopting modern patterns like GraphQL Federation
  • Write high-quality, well-tested, production-grade code and take ownership of your features from design through deployment and operation
  • Participate in architecture discussions, design reviews, and code reviews, contributing ideas and raising the bar for the team
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, team leads, and engineers across SaaSLab and AFOS to define and deliver on the team roadmap
  • Help ensure high availability, security, and operational excellence for systems that underpin every AppsFlyer product
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues, contributing to on-call rotations as needed
  • Stay curious about new tools, technologies, and approaches, and help the team adopt AI-powered tools and modern SDLC practices
  • Contribute to a strong engineering culture of ownership, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement

What You Have

  • 5+ years of software development experience, with strong backend engineering skills
  • Experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems
  • Strong understanding of software design, system architecture, and development best practices

We’re looking for a senior engineer who can build AI native products on top of reliable, secure, high quality data systems. Someone who has experience shipping production level software for high trust workflows, understands data pipelines and data quality deeply, can deploy safe agentic systems, and knows how to design robust architecture that scales.

This role is for someone who has shipped production software at scale, understands data pipelines and data quality deeply, and knows how to deploy AI systems that are useful, observable, and safe.

You’ll work across the full stack: data ingestion, transformation, storage, APIs, product surfaces, AI workflows, agentic systems, and observability.

What makes you a great fit

You have strong production engineering judgment and can move quickly without compromising reliability, data integrity, and security:

● 8+ years building production software

● Strong experience with TypeScript, React, SQL

● Deep backend architecture, API, data modeling, and production debugging skills

● Significant experience with data pipelines, integrations, or data-heavy systems

● You have built sturdy data pipelines customer facing products rely on

● You think naturally in failure modes: stale data, duplicate events, schema drift, partial writes, bad joins, expired tokens, provider outages, and malformed model outputs

● You have experience with Supabase, Postgres RLS, Deno, Modal, embeddings, vector search, transcription, GPU workloads, or similar infrastructure

● You have worked with data validation, reconciliation, lineage, observability, or audit systems

● You have experience with AI evals, AI observability, agent testing, or red-teaming AI systems

Your day-to-day in this position

You will design and ship production-grade systems that combine software engineering, data infrastructure, and AI, including:

● Building secure, scalable full-stack product features

● Designing data models, APIs, integrations, and backend architecture

● Creating reliable data pipelines with strong validation and observability

● Shipping high value high trust AI/LLM-powered features

● Building safe agentic workflows with scoped tools, permissions, logging, evals, and failure handling

● Debugging issues across ingestion, transformation, database, API, UI, and AI context

● Designing systems with security, privacy, auditability, and observability

  • Strengthen design-system adoption and help teams use shared patterns across surfaces, devices and locales

  • Collaborate effectively across US and India time zones in a 100% remote environment

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of relevant product design experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, platform, CRM, workflow-heavy or similarly complex digital product environments

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates product judgment, systems thinking, customer empathy, high-quality execution and measurable product impact

  • Proven experience across the design lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content design and usability testing

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality

  • Working knowledge of design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners and other designers

  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions, incorporate feedback and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft

  • Understanding of front-end implementation constraints and the ability to bridge practical gaps between design and code

  • Curiosity about users, data, systems, new tools, emerging technologies and better ways for teams to work

How You Work

  • You hold yourself to an unusually high bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality

  • You move comfortably from customer insight and product strategy to detailed design execution

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

title: Clinical Research Monitor
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The ​Clinical Research Monitor​ensures compliance of the clinical research with the currently approved protocol/amendment(s), with all applicable regulatory policies and guidelines, including Good Clinical Practice (GCP), as well as with Sidra’s policies and procedures. S/he assists in the design, development, implementation, and conduct of an effective monitoring program in accordance with GCP, institutional policies and procedures, and research protocols.

As such, the clinical research monitor performs a quality control measure to ensure the integrity of research data and protection of the rights and well-being of study participants.

The ​Clinical Research Monitor​ should monitor all study related procedures and documentation such as Informed Consent Form, Source Documentation and CRF review, Adverse Events, Serious Adverse Events and Unanticipated Problems, Investigational Product (IP) (if applicable), Laboratory and Specimen Management, Protocol Deviations/Violations, Investigator Site File (ISF) / Study binder, Roles and Responsibilities of site staff, Facilities appropriate to study execution and Enrollment target, recruitment strategies

The ​Clinical Research Monitor​ ensures that, for those clinical research studies assigned for monitoring, the appropriate and required monitoring tasks and related activities occur as outlined in the monitoring plan or as per the procedure “Monitoring for clinical research and clinical trials” and in compliance with all related regulatory standards. S/he monitors if the reported study data is accurate, complete, and verifiable from source documents, and captures all inconsistencies observed during the clinical research studies in order to prevent recurrence on non-compliance with established regulatory standards.

The ​Clinical Research Monitor​ is responsible for multiple projects at a time, and must have strong time management skills in addition to working both independently and in a team environment.

KEY ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Ensures that the Investigator and study team follow the approved protocol and all approved amendment(s), if any, and adhere to current regulations, applicable ICH/GCP guidelines, local policies and standard operating procedures, including Monitoring standards and guidelines.

  • Ensures that the investigator and the investigator's study team are performing the specified study functions, in accordance with any other written agreement between the sponsor and the investigator, and have not delegated these functions to unauthorized individuals.

  • Adheres to the protocols’ Monitoring Plans; e.g. monitoring visit type, frequency, and required critical monitoring activities by utilizing monitoring tracking forms and other monitoring related tools and templates.

  • Performs study conduct trainings to research teams such as Site Initiation Visits for Clinical Trials and Initial Site Trainings for Clinical Research

  • Develops and updates Study conduct training materials as requested for researchers and study conduct templates as needed.

  • Assists in the development and writing of clinical research monitoring plans.

  • Conducts the monitoring visits, writes the monitoring report in details by summing up the findings of the monitoring process and put the corrective/prevention action plan for these findings. The CRM then reports to the next in line authority for approval. Issues the letter to the principal investigator and follows up with the PI to close the findings.

  • Verifies that the investigator has filed the current Investigator’s Brochure, all documents, and all study supplies needed to conduct the study properly in their study investigator sites files and comply with the applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Verifies that the investigator has adequate qualifications and resources documented in their study investigator sites files and remains adequate throughout the study period.

  • Validates that the investigator and the investigator’s study team are adequately informed about the study through their training records.

  • Verifies that the investigator is enrolling only eligible subjects and reports subject recruitment rate.

  • Verifies that written informed consent was obtained from each subject before participation in the study.

  • Verifies subjects are provided with necessary instruction on properly using, handling, storing, and returning the investigational product(s).

  • Checks that data required by the protocol are reported accurately on the Case Report Forms (CRF)/study data collection sheets and are consistent with the source documents, verifies that study data entered on the CRFs is consistent with patient clinical notes and other source documentation (source data verification), and Informs the investigator of any CRF entry error, omission, or illegibility. Ensures as well that proper corrective plan is taken as per ICH-GCP standards.

  • Verifies that all withdrawals and dropouts of enrolled subjects from the study are reported and explained on the CRFs.

  • Checks whether all adverse events (AEs) and unanticipated problems (UP) are appropriately reported within the time periods required by GCP, the protocol, the IRB/IEC, the sponsor, and the applicable regulatory requirement(s). In case of any unreported AEs / Ups, the CRM has to report this on the monitoring report and ask the PI to report it to the IRB

  • Verifies that the investigator provides all the required reports, notifications, applications, and submissions and that these documents are accurate, complete, timely, and legible, dated, and identify the study.

  • Determines whether the investigator is maintaining the essential documents in their regulatory study binders.

  • Meets expected timelines for completion of monitoring activities and submission of written monitoring reports.

  • Track and report all issues identified through the monitoring visits on the monitoring tracking tools

  • Communicates deviations from the protocol, SOPs, GCP, and the applicable regulatory requirements to the investigator and ensures appropriate action is designed to prevent recurrence of the detected deviations. Communicate to HRPP Director and IRB Office any critical or major deviation/violation that would require intervention from these offices promptly.

  • Adheres to Sidra’s standards as they appear in the Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest policies

  • Adheres to and promotes Sidra’s Values

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS – SELECTION CRITERIA

ESSENTIAL

PREFERRED

Education

Bachelor’s degree in biology, health/ biomedical sciences or equivalent

Master's degree in biology, health/ biomedical sciences or equivalent

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a related field - in an international EMA/FDA regulated environment - as a clinical research monitor/associate or research quality assurance in a pharmaceutical company or CRO (contract research organization).

Certification and Licensure

Association of Clinical Research Professionals – Certified Clinical Research Associate (ACRP-CCRA) or willingness to obtain within the 1st 2 years of recruitment

Certified Clinical Research Professionals (SOCRA) or willingness to obtain within the 1st 2 years of recruitment

title: Senior Market Data Platform Engineer – HFT / Quant Trading
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Market Data Platform Engineer to design, build, and optimize high-performance data infrastructure supporting quantitative research, trading, and execution.

This role requires strong hands-on experience in building data platforms from the ground up, with expertise in real-time data processing, database architecture, data integration, and large-scale data management.

You will work closely with Quant Researchers, Traders, and Engineering teams to develop scalable, reliable, and efficient data solutions that support both real‑time trading activities and historical quantitative research.

We are particularly interested in candidates from buy-side quantitative trading, proprietary trading, HFT, systematic investment firms, or other high‑performance data engineering environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable market data platforms and real‑time data infrastructure supporting quantitative research, trading, and execution.
  • Develop and maintain high‑throughput data pipelines for real‑time market data, including Tick Data, Order Book, Trade Data, Reference Data, and other trading‑related datasets.
  • Own end‑to‑end data ingestion, cleansing, normalization, validation, storage, and distribution to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Design and optimize database architecture, data models, and storage solutions to support large‑scale real‑time and historical datasets, ensuring efficient data retrieval and query performance.
  • Build and enhance data processing frameworks, monitoring mechanisms, and data quality controls to improve platform performance and operational efficiency.
  • Work closely with Quant Researchers, Traders, and Execution teams to understand data requirements and develop solutions that improve data accessibility, usability, and processing efficiency.
  • Identify and resolve data processing bottlenecks, optimize system latency and throughput, and ensure platform scalability and stability.
  • Contribute to the overall architecture and continuous development of the firm’s quantitative trading data platform.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline, with at least 5 years of relevant experience in Data Platform Engineering, Market Data Engineering, Quant Data Infrastructure, or Real‑Time Data Systems.
  • Proven hands‑on experience designing and building data platforms from scratch (0-to-1), including real‑time data pipelines, distributed processing systems, and large‑scale data infrastructure.
  • Strong expertise in data ingestion, cleansing, normalization, data modeling, and data quality management, with experience handling complex, high‑volume datasets.
  • Solid knowledge of database architecture and optimization, with hands‑on experience in technologies such as ClickHouse, StarRocks, Iceberg, HBase, or other high‑performance databases.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Scala, or similar languages, with practical experience in real‑time data processing frameworks such as Flink, Spark, Kafka, or equivalent technologies.
  • Good understanding of quantitative trading workflows and how market data supports research, strategy development, and execution. Experience in buy‑side quantitative trading, proprietary trading, HFT, or systematic investment firms is highly preferred.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with proficiency in both English and Chinese to effectively engage regional Chinese‑speaking stakeholders.

title: Credit Control & Collections Analyst || Remote || Up to 45k
description:
Role Overview:

The Credit Control & Collections Analyst plays a critical role in maintaining organisational cash flow through proactive management of customer accounts, and by providing detailed financial reporting, analysis and business insights to support financial decision making.

The role combines accounts receivable responsibilities with data analysis, requiring the ability to identify trends, investigate anomalies and provide meaningful financial information to support the Finance team and broader business.

Key Responsibilities:

The main responsibilities of the role include:

Reporting and Financial Analysis

· Prepare regular accounts receivable, debtor performance and management reports.

· Monitor, analyse and report on debtor activity, Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), customer payment trends and collections performance.

· Prepare cashflow forecast schedules and supporting information based on customer payment activity, expected receipts and collection activity.

· Extract and compile financial and operational datasets from SAP, Vend and other business systems for reporting purposes.

· Review customer account data to identify trends, anomalies and potential credit or collection risks, escalating significant findings to the reporting manager.

· Prepare other routine reports and analysis as required.

· Ensure the accuracy, completeness and integrity of financial reporting data.

Accounts Receivable and Credit Control

· Manage an allocated portfolio of customer accounts and proactively pursue outstanding debt.

· Contact customers via email and phone to follow up overdue accounts and facilitate prompt payments.

· Process customer payments and accurately allocate receipts within financial systems.

· Prepare and distribute customer statements and account correspondence.

· Reconcile customer accounts and investigate discrepancies.

· Investigate and resolve pricing, billing and account queries in collaboration with internal departments.

· Raise credit notes and adjustments in accordance with approved procedures.

· Escalate significant, aged or disputed debts promptly in accordance with procedures, and undertake recovery actions as directed.

· Process recharge invoices and other customer invoicing requirements.

· Maintain accurate records of collection activities and customer communications.

· Develop and maintain positive customer relationships whilst ensuring collection targets are achieved.

· Create and maintain customer accounts and master data in SAP, ensuring new accounts are set up accurately and promptly and customer information remains current.

· Complete customer credit reviews, including assessment of payment history and credit information, and monitor credit limits and account performance, escalating significant credit-risk concerns as required.

General Finance Support

· Perform account reconciliations and other finance activities as required.

· Provide coverage for other finance team members when on leave

· Participate in finance projects, data cleansing and system improvement activities as required.

· Undertake other duties as reasonably required.

Key Requirements:

Skills and Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of accounts receivable, credit control, debt collection and customer account management processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with financial and operational data, identify trends and exceptions, and prepare accurate reports.
  • Good understanding of customer credit information, credit limits, payment history and credit-risk indicators.
  • Strong investigatory and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate and resolve account discrepancies.
  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, reporting and reconciliation activities.
  • Strong systems capability with experience using financial software or ERP systems, ideally SAP.
  • Ability to interpret financial and customer account information and identify matters requiring further investigation or escalation.
  • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail, particularly when maintaining financial and customer master data.
  • Professional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.

Experience

  • Minimum 3-5 years’ experience in an Accounts Receivable, Assistant Accountant, Credit Control or similar role
  • Demonstrated experience in accounts receivable, customer account management, reconciliations, collections and financial reporting.
  • Experience working with financial systems or ERP platforms, ideally SAP, is preferred.
  • Experience working within high-volume commercial, retail, wholesale or FMCG environment is highly regarded.
  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills are required.

Education

  • Degree qualifications in Accounting, Finance, Data Analysis or related disciplines, or equivalent experience

Personal Attributes & Characteristics:

· Professional, confident and resilient with a strong customer service mindset

· Able to communicate (verbal and written) in English to a professional level

· Highly organised with strong time management skills, able to manage competing priorities and consistently achieve deadlines

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

· Proactive, resourceful and solutions-focused, with the ability to identify patterns in data and confidently escalate concerns or issues.

title: Vi søger en sekretærkollega til et barselsvikariat i Afdeling for Kræftbehandling, SUH Køge
description:
Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel for patienter – og udvikle dine sundhedsadministrative kompetencer?

Vi søger en kollega til et barselsvikariat i Afdeling for Kræftbehandling, SUH Køge

Har du lyst til at blive en del af en sekretærgruppe, hvor samarbejde, faglighed og ordentlighed er vigtige for, at hverdagen fungerer?

En af vores dygtige sekretærer går på barsel i november, og derfor søger vi en kollega til et barselsvikariat på 37 timer om ugen i Afdeling for Kræftbehandling på SUH Køge.

Har du lyst til at arbejde med patientkontakt, koordinering og sundhedsadministrative opgaver – og samtidig udvikle dine kompetencer i et spændende speciale? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

En vigtig funktion i patienternes forløb

I Afdeling for Kræftbehandling arbejder vi med patientforløb inden for blandt andet prostata-, blære-, lunge-, tarm-, bryst-, bugspytkirtel- og livmoderkræft.

Som en del af vores sekretærgruppe får du en vigtig rolle i at få hverdagen og patientforløbene til at hænge sammen. Vores arbejde kræver overblik, struktur og et godt samarbejde med både patienter, pårørende, kolleger og klinikere.

En central del af din funktion bliver call-center funktionen. Her håndterer du patienternes henvendelser og hjælper med at sikre, at de får den rette hjælp, og at relevante spørgsmål og opgaver bliver fulgt op. Det kræver, at du kan kommunikere imødekommende, bevare overblikket og vurdere, hvornår en henvendelse skal gives videre til andre fagpersoner.

Derudover vil du varetage en række sundhedsadministrative opgaver inden for blandt andet booking, planlægning, koordinering og registrering.


En god mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer

Barselsvikariatet byder på en varieret hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver. Du får mulighed for at lære vores arbejdsgange, systemer og patientforløb at kende og gradvist blive mere sikker i de funktioner, du skal varetage.

Vi tilpasser introduktionen til dine erfaringer og kompetencer. Du behøver derfor ikke at kende vores speciale på forhånd, men du skal have lyst til at lære og udvikle dig i jobbet.

Stillingen kan være en god mulighed for dig, der er nyuddannet sundhedsadministrativ koordinator og gerne vil opbygge erfaring i praksis. Den kan også være relevant for dig med en anden sundhedsfaglig uddannelse, som har erfaring med sundhedsadministrative opgaver og ønsker at bringe dine kompetencer i spil i en ny sammenhæng.

Du vil ikke skulle varetage alle de mest komplekse sundhedsadministrative funktioner. Opgaverne tilpasses din uddannelse og erfaring, så du kan bidrage med det, du allerede kan, og udvikle dig inden for de funktioner, der hører til stillingen.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger først og fremmest dig, der er uddannet lægesekretær eller sundhedsadministrativ koordinator.

Har du en anden sundhedsfaglig uddannelse, kan du også komme i betragtning, hvis du har relevant erfaring med sundhedsadministrative opgaver og det rette mindset til at indgå i vores sekretærgruppe.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • arbejder struktureret og har blik for detaljerne
  • kan prioritere opgaver og bevare overblikket i en hverdag med forskellige henvendelser
  • kommunikerer imødekommende og professionelt med patienter, pårørende og kolleger
  • tager ansvar for dine opgaver og følger op på det, du sætter i gang
  • har lyst til at lære nye arbejdsgange og systemer at kende
  • bidrager positivt til samarbejdet og deler viden med dine kolleger.


En arbejdsplads med ro, retning og ordentlighed

Vi er en sekretærgruppe, hvor vi arbejder med at skabe tydelige arbejdsgange, dele viden og hjælpe hinanden i hverdagen.

Som leder lægger jeg vægt på, at du ved, hvad der forventes af dig, og at du får mulighed for at udvikle din faglighed. Jeg tror på, at vi lykkes bedst, når vi har tillid til hinanden, kommunikerer ordentligt og tager fælles ansvar for opgaverne og den arbejdsplads, vi er en del af.

Vi skal kunne spørge hinanden om hjælp, være nysgerrige og finde løsninger sammen. Vi behøver ikke at være ens, men vi skal kunne samarbejde om et fælles mål: at skabe gode og sammenhængende patientforløb.

Vi arbejder med alvorlige sygdomsforløb, men der skal også være plads til et smil og lidt lethed i hverdagen.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos os får du:

  • en varieret sundhedsadministrativ stilling med en central rolle i call-center funktionen
  • mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer og få erfaring fra et specialiseret område
  • en introduktion, der tager udgangspunkt i din uddannelse og erfaring
  • kolleger, som du kan sparre med og lære af
  • en arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og ordentlighed er vigtige værdier.


Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingsbetegnelse: Barselsvikariat i Afdeling for Kræftbehandling

Arbejdssted: SUH Køge

Arbejdstid: 37 timer om ugen

Tiltrædelse: snarest muligt

Vikariatets varighed: cirka 1 år

Ansøgningsfrist: 27. oktober 2026

Samtaler: forventes afholdt i uge 45


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og til at møde en kollega, der har lyst til at bidrage til vores fællesskab og være med til at få hverdagen til at fungere – til gavn for både patienter og kolleger.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.

title: Medication Management Coordinator-Remote
description:
Join the Trusted Results Therapy Group Team

At Trusted Results Therapy Group (TRTG), we believe great care starts with great people. We are a growing, clinician-led behavioral health organization committed to making high-quality mental health services accessible to individuals and families across South Carolina.

What makes TRTG different is our people and our purpose. We have built a collaborative, supportive environment where team members are encouraged to grow professionally, bring new ideas forward, and make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve.

As a CARF-accredited organization, we are committed to high standards of care while continuing to expand the services and resources available to our clients. Our team includes professionals across therapy, psychiatry, psychological testing, rehabilitative behavioral health services, school-based services, nursing, administration, operations, and leadership — all working together toward one mission: helping people achieve trusted results.

About the Role

We're hiring a Medication Management Coordinator to support our growing Psychiatry / Medication Management Program. This is afully remote position for someone organized and caring who likes keeping things moving: prior authorizations, refill requests, patient communication, and the administrative work behind them.

If you have a medical assistant, medical office, or prior authorization background and want meaningful work from home, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Prior Authorizations

  • Complete and manage prior authorizations for medications, treatments, and services, and see each one through to a decision.
  • Work with insurance companies and prescribers to get timely approvals, and re-authorize before coverage lapses.
  • Keep patients, pharmacies, and providers updated on approvals and denials, and help with appeals.

Patient Communication

  • Monitor the medication management inbox, phone line, and patient portal for refill requests and symptom calls.
  • Check refill requests against the chart, route them to the prescriber, and follow up with patients.
  • Document symptom calls, route them by urgency, and escalate safety concerns right away.

Clinical Paperwork & Forms

  • Coordinate the completion of specificforms with providers, clients, and our Medical Records Manager.
  • Send invoices for prescription refills and paperwork completion.
  • Confirm releases of information are in place, and upload completed paperwork to our EHR.

Administrative Support

  • Provide remote administrative support as needed, including scheduling support, EHR data entry, and other administrative tasks for the Medication Management Program and TRTG as a whole.

What You Need

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Must live in South Carolina.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a private, quiet workspace.
  • Strong organization, follow-through, and communication skills.
  • Commitment to HIPAA and patient confidentiality.

Nice to Have (Not Required)

  • Medical Assistant certification (CMA, RMA, or CCMA).
  • Medical assistant, medical office, or prior authorization experience.
  • Familiarity with mental health conditions and psychiatric medications

Pay: $16–$18 per hour

Schedule: Monday–Friday, with possible Saturday availability.

**Exact hours will be discussed during the interview.

Why Join TRTG?

When you join TRTG, you become part of an organization that values:

  • Meaningful work that directly impacts individuals, families, and communities
  • A collaborative, team-centered culture
  • Professional growth, training, and leadership development
  • Opportunities to grow as the organization continues to expand
  • Innovation and new ideas from every level of the organization
  • A commitment to accessibility and reducing barriers to mental healthcare
  • High standards for quality, ethics, and client care
  • A workplace built around our core values of Trust, Results, Accessibility, and Community
  • 100% remote work with no commute
  • [Benefits: PTO, paid holidays, health insurance, 401(k), etc.]

We are looking for people who want more than just a job. We want team members who care about the work, care about the people around them, and want to be part of an organization making a lasting difference in mental healthcare across South Carolina. If that sounds like you, we would love to learn more about you.

Ready to apply? Submit your resume. A short note on why this role interests you is a bonus.

Trusted Results Therapy Group is an equal opportunity employer.

Salary: $16-$18 per hour

title: Senior Data/AI/ML Engineer at Woolworths Group Limited
description:
What you’ll do:

The wiqNZ team unlocks the power of data to reimagine retail and make Kiwis’ lives better every day. As a Senior Data, AI, and ML Engineer, you will architect and deploy advanced models using agentic workflows, autonomous coding agents, and robust AI governance frameworks to scale our data capabilities. Beyond model deployment, you will design clean, semantic data architectures and cloud warehousing environments that enable AI agents to build, test, and govern pipelines autonomously. Working closely with cross functional teams, you will turn business challenges into trusted data solutions, establish core engineering patterns, and mentor junior team members.

  • Design, deploy, and manage multi-agent ecosystems, autonomous coding agents, and generative AI capabilities like retrieval-augmented generation and vector embeddings.
  • Build clean, structured data architectures using dimensional modeling and cloud warehousing to ensure schemas are easily interpretable by LLMs and AI agents.
  • Deploy automated agentic testing frameworks to manage non-deterministic model outputs, validate data quality, and enforce enterprise performance standards.
  • Establish comprehensive AI governance and observability structures to monitor for data drift, concept drift, algorithmic bias, and hallucinations.
  • Implement strict security guardrails and responsible AI practices to mitigate risks such as prompt injection and data exfiltration, ensuring protection of PII and full auditability for all AI-assisted workflows.
  • Track and optimize cloud compute expenditures across model token usage, efficient BigQuery processing, and cost-effective Vertex AI endpoint scaling.
  • Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions through direct collaboration with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Promote modern engineering standards, mentor junior team members, and conduct regular peer reviews to elevate technical capabilities across the team.

What you’ll bring:

description:
About Our Company

We’re a physician-led, patient-centric network committed to simplifying health care and bringing a more connected kind of care.

Our primary, multispecialty, and urgent care providers serve millions of patients in traditional practices, patients' homes and virtually through VillageMD and our operating companies Village Medical, Village Medical at Home, Summit Health, CityMD, and Starling Physicians.

Job Description


Job Description

The Revenue Cycle Specialist is responsible for researching and resolving payment and account discrepancies to ensure the accuracy and integrity of patient accounts. Working primarily within Athenahealth, this role performs detailed account analysis, payment research, worklist resolution, refund processing, and payment reconciliation activities. The Specialist collaborates with internal teams, vendors, and payers to resolve complex account issues while maintaining established quality,

productivity, and compliance standards.

This position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to navigate multiple systems while supporting the overall goals of the Revenue Cycle department.


Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Research and resolve payment discrepancies and account variances to ensure accurate account balances and payment application.
  • Work assigned Athenahealth worklists, reviewing patient accounts and determining appropriate resolution based on payment, adjustment, and account activity.
  • Investigate unapplied, misapplied, unidentified, and unallocated payments and take corrective action when appropriate.
  • Review and process patient and insurance refunds in accordance with departmental policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Verify deposits and reconcile payment activity utilizing bank portals, payer portals, internal reporting, and supporting systems.
  • Retrieve remittance information and supporting documentation necessary to complete payment research and account resolution.
  • Utilize Athenahealth as the primary workflow platform while leveraging additional systems and reporting tools, including Tableau and LK Oasis, to support account analysis and research.
  • Monitor and respond to departmental communications, including shared mailboxes within established service level expectations.
  • Identify recurring payment or account issues and communicate trends, workflow barriers, and improvement opportunities to leadership.
  • Collaborate with internal Revenue Cycle departments, vendors, payers, and other stakeholders to resolve account-related issues.
  • Support audits, special projects, process improvement initiatives, and cross-functional departmental activities as assigned.
  • Maintain established productivity, quality, and accuracy standards.
  • Adhere to HIPAA regulations, company policies, and confidentiality requirements while safeguarding Protected Health Information (PHI).

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent required.
  • Minimum one (1) year of experience in healthcare revenue cycle, medical billing, payment posting, payment reconciliation, refunds, banking, accounting, collections, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to interpret payment activity, identify discrepancies, and determine appropriate resolution.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Outlook.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize workload, manage multiple assignments, and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
  • Demonstrated commitment to quality, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within Athenahealth.
  • Experience managing payment-related worklists and account resolution activities.
  • Knowledge of patient and insurance refund processes.
  • Banking, cash application, reconciliation, or payment research experience.
  • Familiarity with payer portals, remittance processing, and healthcare reimbursement workflows.

Core Competencies Technical Competencies

  • Patient Account Resolution
  • Payment Research & Reconciliation
  • Refund Processing
  • Worklist Management
  • Revenue Cycle Operations
  • Data Analysis
  • Athenahealth
  • Microsoft Excel

Professional Competencies

  • Attention to Detail
  • Accountability
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Problem Solving
  • Communication
  • Collaboration
  • Adaptability
  • Time Management
  • Quality Focus

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use.
  • Frequent keyboarding and data entry.
  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks throughout the workday.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in a virtual environment.

This is a non-exempt position with a salary range of $18.99 - $23.37/hr based on experience.

title: IT Infrastructure & Operations Manager
description:
Endeavour has an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about sustainability and eager to be part of an innovative company that’s on a journey to transform the world’s infrastructure. The right person is trustworthy with confidential information, highly organized, self-motivated, has excellent communication skills, can think strategically, and works equally as well independently as with a team.

Endeavour offers flexibility and endless growth opportunities to those who can harness their skills and talents and identify how and where to use them to add value. Our support team is the heart of the ecosystem. We’re a diverse group of bright, passionate, dedicated people, working together to make a real difference. Are you ready to join the journey?

Key Responsibilities

Include but are not limited to:

  • Manage the day-to-day operation, availability, and performance of the organization's IT infrastructure and operational services.
  • Lead and develop the IT Operations team, fostering a culture of accountability, customer service, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Administer and maintain enterprise infrastructure, including networking, servers, storage, cloud services, endpoint management, identity platforms, and collaboration technologies.
  • Oversee the administration, lifecycle management, and operational support of core SaaS platforms and IT systems, ensuring they remain secure, reliable, and aligned with business needs.
  • Plan and execute infrastructure upgrades, technology refreshes, and operational improvement initiatives to maintain a modern and resilient IT environment.
  • Manage enterprise backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities to minimize operational risk and downtime.
  • Partner with the Information Security team to implement security best practices, vulnerability remediation, endpoint protection, and compliance requirements.
  • Oversee IT operations, ensuring incidents, service requests, and changes are managed effectively while meeting established service levels.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure documentation, operational procedures, system inventories, and technical standards.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with technology vendors, managed service providers, and implementation partners, coordinating on-site engagements and ensuring successful delivery of infrastructure and technology initiatives.
  • Serve as the primary IT owner for infrastructure-related vendor implementations, coordinating resources, validating deliverables, and ensuring smooth transition into ongoing operations.
  • Collaborate closely with Enterprise Applications, Business Relationship Management, Cybersecurity, and business stakeholders to support enterprise technology projects and organizational priorities.
  • Manage infrastructure-related budgets, technology licensing, maintenance agreements, and hardware lifecycle planning.
  • Monitor infrastructure health, operational metrics, and system performance, identifying opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, and user experience.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical solutions that improve operational effectiveness, scalability, and service delivery.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Skills & Requirements

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field required; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will also be considered.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as Microsoft, Cisco, CompTIA, ITIL, VMware, Azure, or AWS are preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in Operations, Cybersecurity Engineering, DevOps, or related roles.
  • 3+ years of experience leading or supervising an IT operations, infrastructure, or service delivery team.
  • Experience with IT service management (ITSM) processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management; familiarity with ITIL principles is preferred.
  • Experience with automation or scripting using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages, with familiarity securing or governing AI tools and platforms preferred.

Specific Skills / Abilities

  • Critical Thinker
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Solve complex problems
  • Strategies and scale ideas and solutions
  • Trustworthy and reliable
  • Self-Starter and ability to work independently
  • Ability to work with technical and non-technical staff
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Great Place to Work

Enjoy…

A fast-paced, entrepreneurial culture focused on innovation.

A flexible, autonomous work environment.

A culture of respect, learning, and excellence.
Experienced, highly talented experts as team peers.
Growth and travel opportunities.
A team of change-makers having a significant impact on people and the planet.

About Endeavour

Endeavour is the main hub—a self-sustaining incubation platform for innovation—within a larger ecosystem focused on sustainable infrastructure. It provides the space, time, and resources necessary to take advanced technologies from ideation through development to launch. Our teams are working hard to decentralize infrastructure and deploy innovative energy, water, and waste treatment solutions that are more sustainable and more profitable than those currently in existence. Our aim is to guarantee clean water and renewable energy to everyone, everywhere. We’re passionate change-makers who want to leave the world better than the way we found it. There is a strong sense of camaraderie between good-natured people who bring their A-game to work, every day, to make a difference. To work at Endeavour is to know that you are part of something special—something bigger than yourself.

Today, we’re deploying solutions that are immediately scalable and profitable, including EV charging, data center cooling, and waste to fuel systems. As we look to the future, Endeavour intends to remain at the forefront of innovation, taking on grander challenges based on the needs of our clients and of local economies. We hope that our Sustainable Habitat for Innovation towards a Purpose (SHIP) will be a model that inspires people and businesses to join the journey so that together we can combine the best of what technology and the natural world can offer to ensure a regenerative/sustainable world for generations to come. Are you ready to #JoinTheJourney?

title: Plejecenter Hyrdevænget søger social- og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent til dagvagt
description:
Vi leder efter dig som er uddannet social og sundhedshjælper- eller assistent, og som ønsker at arbejde på en fantastisk arbejdsplads som vægter trivsel hos både beboere og personale højt!

Om os

Plejecenter Hyrdevænget er et demensvenligt hus i tre etager, to etager med specialiserede demensboliger og en etage med almene plejeboliger - det er her vi mangler én kollega.

Hyrdevænget har aktuelt 62 boliger i brug, og ibrugtagning af de sidste boliger sker løbende gennem de næste år.

På Hyrdevænget betyder beboernes kognitive svigt at konflikter, konstante kompromiser og nye udfordringer er et dagligt vilkår. Det er utrolig vigtigt for os at beboerne er trygge og glade for at bo her, og at vi har et godt samarbejde med pårørende.

Vi har altid fokus på fagligheden og vil altid gerne videreudvikle os, både som gruppe og individuelt. Det er en forventning, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, og trives med mange opgaver. Vi er et tværfagligt team hvor kompetenceudvikling og delegering af opgaver er en naturlig del af samarbejdet.

Det vægter vi højt

  • Altid fokus på det hele menneske med en helhedsorienteret og empatisk tilgang
  • En høj grad af faglig sparring og refleksioner i det daglige arbejde
  • Personcentreret omsorg og Low arousal er udgangspunkt for al pleje og omsorg, udfra det overordnede mål at beboerne oplever selvbestemmelse og velbefindende i dagligdagen
  • Indbyrdes tillid, respekt og ærlig kommunikation fordi vi tror på, at det er grundlaget for trivsel og godt samarbejde
  • En ”vi løfter i flok” tilgang til hverdagen, og det forventes at alle hjælper alle

Det kan vi tilbyde

  • Fælles introduktionsforløb for alle nyansatte i Sundhed og Omsorg
  • Lokal introduktionsforløb på Hyrdevænget
  • En personlig kontaktperson som vil hjælpe dig med at falde godt til i huset
  • Undervisning i demens, dokumentation og medicin
  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling i form af uddannelse, kurser og temadage
  • En nærværende og lyttende leder med fokus på din trivsel
  • Personalegoder og rabataftaler med mange butikker
  • Supervision i personalegruppen

Yderligere oplysninger

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer ugentligt, men aftales individuelt. Dagvagter arbejder som udgangspunkt hver 3. weekend.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst og jf. principperne for Ny Løn.

Har du spørgsmål eller vil du komme forbi inden du søger, så er du velkommen til at kontakte Leder på Hyrdevænget Shannet Jakobsen på mail shannet.jakobsen@egekom.dk eller telefon 7259 7512.

Ansøgningsfrist: 29. oktober 2026 - samtaler forventes afholdt løbende.
Tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Uddannelsespapirer vedhæftes ansøgning.

Ved ansættelse i denne stilling forudsætter Egedal kommune, at du skal give samtykke til at der indhentes elektronisk straffeattest hvis det bliver dig, som får tilbudt stillingen.

Ønsker du mere information om Egedal Kommune kan du søge denne på kommunens hjemmeside .

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Based in Auckland, the Senior Software Engineer - Web Services will design, build and deploy full-stack web applications and machine-to-machine services used across the business. You'll work directly with stakeholders in Engineering, Manufacturing and Corporate functions to understand their needs and turn them into reliable, well-architected software that people rely on every day.

This is a senior role with real influence. You'll approve code reviews and architecture designs, help set the technical standards for the team, facilitate scrum activities, and coach and mentor more junior engineers. You'll also be trusted to step in as deputy for the team lead when needed.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

  • Design and develop web applications end to end, including database schemas, back-end services, front-end applications and web-based user interfaces.
  • Build machine-to-machine services and REST APIs that integrate with systems across Rocket Lab.
  • Develop software and unit tests for bug fixes and feature requests, and document how to operate the software products you build.
  • Review source code merge requests, approve merge requests for Software Assurance Levels B and below, and help set the team's code review standards.
  • Facilitate software architecture meetings and approve software architecture designs.
  • Approve software requirements and manage trade studies to support technical decisions.
  • Refine product backlog items, approve the definition of ready, and help prioritise the backlog.
  • Facilitate scrum activities, such as stand-ups, retrospectives and sprint planning, and manage scrum information like velocity and retro minutes.
  • Facilitate stakeholder meetings to understand requirements and keep projects aligned with business needs.
  • Deploy operational software, support users of deployed software, and deliver training on how to use it.
  • Coach and mentor more junior engineers, and help define best practice across the team.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • A tertiary qualification in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a similar field.
  • 5+ years' professional experience in a relevant discipline.
  • Strong experience designing and building REST APIs.
  • Experience with Node.js.
  • Experience with Angular or another front-end framework, such as React or Vue.
  • Proficiency in Git.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the judgement to find the right solution, not just a working one.
  • A team player with a positive, "How can I help?" attitude. No task is beneath you.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike.
  • The ability to plan and prioritise your own work, deliver on time, and get things right the first time.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes.
  • Experience with network programming, such as sockets and WebSockets.
  • Experience with Node.js/npm build systems and tooling.
  • Experience with Elasticsearch.
  • Experience designing relational database schemas and working with service-oriented architectures.
  • Experience facilitating agile or scrum ceremonies, or working as a technical lead.
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other engineers.
  • An interest in aerospace, manufacturing or similarly complex engineering environments.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Domestic and international travel may be required.

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com. This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality.

title: At Your Service Center Associate, Mission Viejo - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an At Your Service Center Colleague, you are at the heart of delivering a seamless and personalized shopping experience. You’ll support all At Your Service activities, including Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS), merchandise returns, order pickups, and other assigned tasks - all while upholding Macy’s service standards.

This role requires strong multitasking abilities, problem-solving, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment where flexibility is key, including working a variety of shifts such as nights, weekends, and holidays.

This role goes far beyond just being a cashier. Here, the customer is at the heart of everything we do - every day, all day. If you're passionate about selling, reaching goals, working as a team, and creating amazing experiences through genuine hospitality, this could be the perfect fit for you! You’ll also help keep the shopping space clean, organized, and inviting so every customer feels welcome the moment they walk in.

How Our At Your Service Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Every day starts with a positive example. As an At Your Service Colleagues (AYS), you come in energized and ready to make an impact - wearing your name badge with pride, greeting teammates with warmth, and helping ensure the At Your Service areas is clean, organized, and ready for customers. You help set the pace by reviewing sales goals, learning about new arrivals and top-selling items, and staying up to date on trends and promotions - so you’re prepared to support the team and engage customers confidently.
  • In the At Your Service area, you lead through action - welcoming customers with genuine hospitality, making eye contact, and starting friendly, personal conversations that build lasting relationships. Assist customers in all aspects of total store fulfillment, including By Online and Pick Up in Store, be proficient in all systems needed to complete transactions, and ensure the collection area is organized so the customer pick-up experience is friction-free
  • You help maintain a shoppable space by recovering merchandise and keeping the pickup and return areas clean while ensuring timely completion and curbside delivery of Buy Online Pickup In Store (BOPS) orders.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Makes prompt, sound decisions in real time to effectively address customer needs and resolve issues
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands.
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs. stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment.
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

description:
