title: Product Engineer - Tissue
description:
Build the Future of Tissue Fabrics with Albany International

Bring your education, curiosity, and problem-solving mindset to a global leader in Paper Machine Clothing and Engineered Fabrics. Join our Kaukauna R&D Product Engineering team and help develop high-performance products that make tissue and paper manufacturing more efficient, sustainable, and productive.

Who We Are

Albany International is the world’s leading supplier of custom-designed consumable fabrics, belts, and felts for papermaking and tissue manufacturing. We also create engineered fabrics for the nonwoven, corrugator, building products, tannery, and textile industries. With operations in 10 countries and customers around the globe, we offer the reach of an international organization and a long-standing culture of innovation in engineered textiles and materials science.

Your Opportunity in Kaukauna

At our Kaukauna location, you will play a key role in developing and manufacturing high-performance fabrics used on conventional, TAD, and other tissue machines around the world. In this hands-on engineering role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve real-world challenges, support product development and manufacturing, and drive improvements in performance, quality, and sustainability. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you will help deliver innovative solutions for some of the world’s largest tissue producers.

What You’ll Do

  • Support development of custom-engineered fabrics that improve paper machine efficiency, sheet quality, dryness, energy performance, softness, bulk, and absorbency.
  • Design and evaluate new weave patterns through laboratory testing, modeling, pilot loom trials, and manufacturing-scale validation.
  • Analyze performance data, troubleshoot issues, and document manufacturing centerlines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive innovation, solve complex challenges, and deliver high-impact solutions for customers.

Why Your Work Matters

A tissue machine can produce hundreds of tons each day, and unplanned downtime can cost a customer hundreds of thousands of dollars daily. The products you help create are essential to reliable machine operation and the production of high-quality tissue. Your ideas and engineering decisions can have a direct, measurable impact for customers around the world.

Ready to engineer tomorrow’s solutions?

Join Albany International in Kaukauna and turn technical insight into products that keep critical manufacturing processes moving.

title: Composite Technician

description:
Albany Engineered Composites (AEC) is an aerospace company with a history of manufacturing the most advanced composite parts for commercial and military aircraft. Composite Technicians perform lay-up, braiding and filament winding of composite materials in accordance with customer and company specifications and requirements while following company policies and using proper personal protective equipment. Other duties include:

  • Verifies quality of finished product.

title: Campus Administrator and Financial Aid Officer
description:

title: Program Owner, EMEA Field & Cross-Persona Enablement
description:
Summary

As Program Owner for Regional Enablement in EMEA, you turn business needs into learning that helps teams win across two focus areas: owning a portfolio of programs (onboarding, methodology, competency development) for EMEA Sales, PS, and CS, and serving as the EMEA execution partner for global enablement programs (GGS, TAM, AE, SE, CS) by adapting and localizing centrally-designed content with global Persona Program Managers.

You align with other Program Owners, the relevant Persona Program Managers, and the EMEA Sales/Adoption Business Partner to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery across the region.

Job Description

The Guidewire Enterprise Readiness Team aligns information, learning, and communication experiences to support readiness and adoption goals across all Guidewire personas — Customer, Partner, and internal teams. Our goal is to build an enterprise training and enablement strategy that becomes a competitive differentiator, ensuring employees, customers, and partners maximize their impact with Guidewire Cloud.

Key Responsibilities


A. Owned Programs (EMEA Field: Sales, PS, CS)

You are accountable for design, delivery, and continuous improvement of these programs.

  • Own coordination of the functional onboarding program for the EMEA Field organization, including activity assignment and EMEA-specific adaptation. Success is measured by role readiness at the 6-month mark.
  • Ensure new hires are registered for Field Onboarding or technical certification courses as assigned; gather ongoing feedback to improve programs.
  • Deliver key methodology training and Field Onboarding sessions for the EMEA region; support all-hands and regional sessions as guided by the EMEA Sales/Adoption Business Partner.
  • Develop ad-hoc role/functional training to elevate skill development across the EMEA region, aligning delivery with in-person learning events.
  • Apply readiness methodology across all owned programs: validate and consult on needs assessment, readiness plans, content curation/development, and partner sign-off on plan, content, and outcome measurement.
  • Partner with the EMEA Readiness Business Partner on training tied to new hire programs and field events (Regional Kick-Offs, Sales Reviews, Quarterly Field Updates, etc.).
  • Support the broader readiness transformation strategy — shifting from a push to a pull model using AI capabilities to deliver content in context.
  • Own the operational execution of recurring EMEA regional enablement mechanisms, including planning, stakeholder coordination, participant readiness, communications, action tracking, follow-through and continuous improvement, in partnership with the EMEA Sales/Adoption Business Partner.

B. Cross-Persona Execution Support (GGS, TAM, AE, SE, CS — EMEA)

Each of these personas has a distinct global Persona Program Manager who owns overall program design. You are accountable for reviewing, adapting, and localizing that content for EMEA delivery, and for regional execution quality — not for originating the program.

  • Partner with global GTM Program Owners to ensure programs are regularly enhanced, communicated, and measured against business expectations; ensure programs are loaded into the appropriate LMS and changes are communicated to EMEA leadership.
  • Serve as the EMEA counterpart to each persona's global Persona Program Manager (GGS, TAM, AE, SE, CS); review centrally-designed content — virtual sessions, eLearning, and in-person events — and adapt/localize it for EMEA relevance (language, regional examples, market context).
  • Schedule and, where appropriate, co-facilitate delivery of these localized programs for EMEA audiences.
  • Register and track EMEA participants, monitor regional completion, and feed regional performance and content feedback back to each Persona Program Manager for continuous improvement.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

For Owned Programs (Section A):

  • Stakeholder Satisfaction: internal/external satisfaction with strategic partnership and execution
  • Business Performance: correlation of readiness programs to measurable performance improvement, including new hire readiness and skill attainment
  • Program Usefulness Score: average post-learning usefulness score
  • Program Completion Rate: 80% of target audience completing programs within the designated timeframe
  • New Hire Readiness: 80-90% of Field managers rating employees functionally prepared after 6 months
  • Program Management: adherence to program methodology, task tracking via tools such as
  • Mechanism Sustainability / Execution Reliability: recurring regional mechanisms operate on schedule, with clear ownership, dependencies and follow-through, and with decreasing reliance on individual contributors for day-to-day coordination.

For Cross-Persona Execution Support (Section B):

  • Regional Completion Rate: 80% of EMEA target audience completing each localized program
  • Delivery Adherence: on-time, on-scope regional rollout against the Persona Program Manager's plan
  • Localized Content Quality: EMEA-specific usefulness/feedback score on the adapted content, tracked separately from the global program's overall usefulness score (which stays with the Persona Program Manager)

Required Skills / Experience

  • 4–6 years in enablement, learning & development, onboarding, or related fields within enterprise software; 1–2 years facilitating live or virtual training. P&C insurance or enterprise SaaS experience preferred but not required.
  • Instructional design and facilitation: advanced curriculum design, learning activities, dynamic presentation/facilitation. AI- fluency to create content and explore modalities.
  • Business acumen and P&C industry knowledge to ensure strategic relevance and practical adoption.
  • Complex project management: plan and execute multi-workstream programs; maintain accurate weekly status in the project tracking system.
  • Communication and adaptability: excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills; able to multitask and adapt to a changing environment.
  • Strategic stakeholder collaboration: influence alignment with EBPs, global program owners, and cross-functional leaders; translate needs into effective enablement solutions.
  • Integrity, Rationality, & Collegiality: operate within Guidewire values — truthful relationships, evidence-based decisions, professional collegiality.
  • Tools proficiency: Google Workspace; LMS and survey/analytics tools; authoring platforms; virtual delivery tools; AI tools; project tracking (e.g., ).
  • Language Proficiency in English and at least one other European language. (Preference for French, Spanish, German, Italian)
  • AI- fluency in content creation, program execution, and workflow automation. We are an AI-forward company and want to leverage the tools we have to optimize our targeted deliverables and process flows.

About Guidewire


Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.


As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Customer Experience Colleague, you will create exceptional, personalized shopping experiences for our customers. You’ll prioritize customer satisfaction by actively engaging with shoppers across all touchpoints - both in-store and online - and drive cross-category sales to support overall business goals. With a deep understanding of fashion, fit, and function, you will make tailored product recommendations and leverage digital tools to enhance the customer journey. You also will work across different departments daily, often transitioning between multiple areas throughout the day.

In this role, you’ll also play a key part in client relationship building through outreach tools like My Client and social media. Your collaborative approach with peers, store leaders, and brand partners will help identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and elevate the overall customer experience. In addition to service and selling, you’ll support operational excellence through floor readiness, event execution, merchandise setup, and opening/closing procedures.

A positive, can-do attitude, strong communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-caliber service will be key to your success in this role.

How Our Selling Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride, greet teammates with a warm hello, and help ensure the sales floor is clean, organized, and prepared for customers. Before getting started, they review their sales goals, learn about new arrivals and top-selling items, and stay up to date on current trends and promotions - so they’re fully informed and ready to engage, educate, and sell with confidence.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - offering a warm welcome, making eye contact, and creating friendly, personal conversations to create customer relationships to bring the customers back.
  • Throughout the day, they maintain a shoppable space by recovering the floor and fitting rooms, updating signs and pricing, and supporting any needed merchandise moves.
  • They always Finish Strong - sharing our Loyalty program benefits, making sure customers have all they need, and ending with a sincere thank-you, often walking the package around and using the customer’s name.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

Who You Are

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality
  • Must be able to:
    • Understand and communicate effectively with customers, co-workers, and supervisors
    • Read and understand employment policies and safety rules/procedures in English
  • Be comfortable communicating and collaborating with customers and colleagues
  • Responsible for acquiring new customers by opening credit accounts and sharing loyalty benefits
  • Meeting daily sales goal challenges
  • Enjoy meeting people, learning about them, and sharing information
  • Resourceful and eager to start a new venture and can adapt to changing priorities; you can work on your own but are great with team dynamics
  • You can handle electronic devices with no problem
  • At least 2 years of selling or customer experience preferred

Essential Physical Requirements You Will Perform

  • This position requires talking, lifting, constant moving, standing, and reaching with arms and hands
  • Standing for at least two consecutive hours, lifting at least 25lbs., stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing ladders, reaching, including above eye level
  • Requires close vision, color vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
  • Frequent use of computers and other technology, necessary to perform job functions, including handheld equipment, cash register and ability to process register transactions

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

title: Kom og bliv en del af et fantastisk team! Vi søger VSP-kollega til Esbjerg Dyrehospital
description:
Vi søger en VSP som er interesseret i anæstesi, som trives med et højt flow, ansvar, variation og som ønsker at være en del af et fantastisk team af dyrlæger, veterinærsygeplejersker og elever.

Er det mon noget for dig? Så er Esbjerg Dyrehospital måske din nye arbejdsplads.

Vi søger en der finder ro i at have styr på detaljerne. Som ved, at tryghed for patienten starter med overblik og faglighed. Som har lyst til at være en del af et team, hvor vi både hjælper hinanden, udvikler os sammen og har det sjovt.

Hvem er vi?

Esbjerg Dyrehospital er en arbejdsplads med høj faglighed, højt tempo og høje standarder. Vi tager vores arbejde seriøst, men samtidig prioriterer vi en hverdag med god stemning og teamwork.

Vi er et moderne dyrehospital med gode faciliteter og et engageret team. Med ny ledelse er der fokus på tydelige rammer, godt samarbejde og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Vi er en del af VetGruppen A/S og dermed et større dansk fællesskab med mere end 50 smådyrsklinikker og dyrehospitaler landet over.

Gennem VetGruppen har vi adgang til stærk faglig sparring, henvisningsmuligheder og specialiserede behandlinger. Derudover har koncernen sin egen kursusvirksomhed, VLEARN, som giver gode muligheder for målrettet efteruddannelse, også inden for odontologi.

Din rolle

Du vil blive en del af vores operationsteam, hvor du sammen med dyrlæger og veterinærsygeplejersker kommer bl.a. til at:

  • Styre og overvåge anæstesi med ro, overblik og faglig stolthed
  • Sikre trygge patientforløb fra indlæggelse til opvågning
  • Være med til at løfte og udvikle vores niveau inden for anæstesi
  • Tage del i klinikkens hverdag, også når den er lidt uforudsigelig.

Vi leder efter dig, som:

  • Er autoriseret veterinærsygeplejerske
  • Har interesse for anæstesi, og lyst til at blive endnu bedre
  • Har blik for detaljen og ikke er bange for at tage ansvar
  • Er en holdspiller, for hos os er teamwork vigtigt.

Hvad får du?

  • En hverdag, hvor der er mulighed for faglig udvikling
  • Indflydelse på dit arbejde og mulighed for at præge udviklingen
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor der både er plads til høj faglighed og ægte grin
  • Vestjyllands bedste kolleger😉

Praktisk

Stillingen er på 37 timer, men deltid er også en mulighed. Opstart hurtigst muligt.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så hører vi meget gerne fra dig. Send din CV og ansøgning via siden her.

Kontakt gerne klinikleder Kate Lyngbak Kristensen på telefon 20831612 ved spørgsmål.

title: Data Platform DevOps Analyst
description:
Because we strive to put people first.
Culture, our way.

Technology at Primark

What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

Our technology team is actively seeking for Data Ops Analyst to join its Data Platform & Engineering team, supporting the reliability and performance of its Databricks-based enterprise data platform. The role focuses on monitoring data pipelines, managing incidents, coordinating releases and production handovers, and ensuring data products are well-governed, scalable, and operationally ready. Working closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams, you'll play a key role in delivering trusted data solutions while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Get

This role is a hybrid opportunity, offering 2-3 days Working from office.

People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best.

Let’s talk lifestyle: Healthcare, pension and potential bonus. 27 days of leave, plus bank holidays and if you want, you can buy 5 more. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria.

Job Description

What You’ll Do as Data Ops Analyst

In your role, you’ll collaborate with different people across a range of skillsets. Here’s a flavour of your day-to-day:

  • Support the operation and reliability of Primark’s modern data platform helping manage Databricks, dbt Cloud and Azure data services while ensuring data products are production-ready, supportable and aligned with engineering standards.
  • Monitor and maintain critical data pipelines and platform services proactively identifying failures, delays, data quality issues and operational risks while coordinating incident triage, escalation and resolution to minimise business impact.
  • Coordinate releases, deployments and production handovers managing environment readiness, promotion activities, change governance, operational checklists, release schedules and service readiness documentation to ensure smooth delivery.
  • Drive operational excellence through governance and documentation maintaining runbooks, support guides, monitoring dashboards, service catalogues and reporting on platform health, SLA performance, deployment activity and support trends.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering, Platform, Cloud, Security, BAU and SIAM teams supporting access management, environment support, platform issue resolution, service reviews and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance reliability and supportability.
  • Contribute to Primark’s data platform modernisation journey supporting the migration from Teradata to Databricks, validating production readiness, improving monitoring and automation capabilities and helping embed modern DataOps practices across deployment, observability and support processes.

Qualifications

What You’ll Bring

Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:

  • 2-4 years’ experience in Data Operations, Application Support, Platform Support, Data Engineering Support or a similar operational role supporting business-critical systems and data platforms in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of modern data platforms and DataOps practices with exposure to Azure DevOps, Databricks, dbt Cloud, Azure data services, SQL, Python, ETL/ELT processes, job scheduling, monitoring, observability and deployment automation.
  • Experience supporting production environments and service operations including monitoring, alerting, incident management, ticketing systems, release management, environment management, change governance and enterprise support processes.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate incidents methodically, identify root causes, assess business impact and drive issues through to resolution while maintaining high operational standards.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Security, Governance, SIAM, Analytics and business teams while clearly communicating technical issues and recommended actions.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented and continuous improvement focused with experience maintaining operational documentation, runbooks, handover materials and support processes while identifying opportunities to improve reliability, reduce recurring issues, increase automation and enhance overall platform supportability.

Additional Information

Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 480 stores in 18 countries today and growing.

So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day.

You’re our driving force. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way.

title: Category Leadership Director - Kroger/Target/Meijer

Job Description:

Category Leadership Director – Kroger/Target/Meijer

Franklin, TN or Cincinnati, OH

This role can be based in Franklin, TN or Cincinnati, OH with regular in-office collaboration expected. Flexibility is a key enabler, empowering associates to make choices that support both business outcomes and personal needs, including occasional remote work.

This position is responsible for leading Category Strategy and delivering category growth plans across Kroger, Target, and Meijer for Mars Pet Nutrition. The Category Director will lead a high-performing team responsible for providing industry-leading category thought leadership, shopper insights, and strategic recommendations that drive mutual growth for both Mars and our retail partners.


This leader will develop and strengthen executive-level relationships across the retailers, positioning Mars Pet Nutrition as the trusted partner of choice in category growth, shopper understanding, and future-focused retail solutions. The role will serve as a critical connector between customer needs and Mars capabilities, ensuring the voice of the customer is embedded throughout category strategy, storytelling, activation, and innovation initiatives.

The Category Director will partner closely with Customer Development, Insights, Demand, Digital Commerce, Revenue Growth Management, and Marketing teams to identify emerging category trends, unlock growth opportunities, and deliver superior business results while maintaining appropriate separation between Category Leadership and Sales responsibilities.

What are we looking for?


  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 10+ years of experience in Category Management, Account Management, Insights, or Sales Strategy/Trade Marketing roles – prior leadership experience preferred
  • Experience developing category growth strategies with large national or regional retailers.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally.
  • Strong leadership experience with a track record of recruiting, coaching, and developing talent.
  • Deep understanding of category management principles, shopper behavior, retail analytics, and consumer insights.
  • Strong strategic thinking, communication, and storytelling capabilities.
  • Experience leveraging advanced data sources to drive business decisions and retailer recommendations.
  • Ability to navigate complexity and lead change within a matrixed organization.

What would be your key responsibilities?


  • Deliver category and business objectives across Kroger, Target, and Meijer, including growth in Net Sales Value (NSV), market share, profitability, and retailer influence.
  • Lead and develop a team of Category Managers and Category Analysts, creating a culture of accountability, capability building, and continuous learning.
  • Serve as the primary category leadership contact for key retailer merchandising, strategy, and insights organizations.
  • Build and execute customer-specific category growth strategies grounded in shopper, consumer, retailer, and marketplace insights.
  • Identify emerging shifts in the pet category and retail landscape, translating insights into actionable customer opportunities.
  • Drive category captaincy, advisory roles, and strategic influence across priority pet categories.
  • Lead development of compelling customer-facing storytelling and recommendations that support retailer growth strategies.
  • Ensure integration of advanced analytics, shopper insights, digital commerce data, loyalty data, and emerging data sources into business recommendations.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to develop innovative solutions that enhance customer outcomes and strengthen Mars' competitive advantage.
  • Champion customer-back thinking and ensure retailer perspectives are incorporated into category strategies, activation plans, and organizational priorities.
  • Develop retailer-specific learning agendas that deepen Mars' understanding of Kroger, Target, and Meijer shoppers and business drivers.
  • Maintain deep expertise in assortment, shelving, pricing, promotion, merchandising, omnichannel retailing, and category management best practices.

What can you expect from Mars?


  • Work with over 150,000 diverse and talented Associates, all guided by The Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose driven company, where we are striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

title: Applied Scientist
description:
About the team

Join our dynamic team, leveraging a comprehensive database of over 100 million homes, transactions, and users to predict and analyze housing market trends. As an Applied Scientist specializing in traditional econometrics and machine learning with a focus on time series and hierarchical forecasting, you will play a critical role in shaping our understanding and forecasting of the housing market.

About the role

As an Applied Scientist you will actively participate in Collaborative Forecast Development: Work alongside other applied scientists, data scientists and economists to develop hierarchical forecasts for the housing market at various regional levels:


  • Feature Extraction: Identify economic and demographic driving forces of housing market growth across regions and extract features that predict housing market trends 1 to 2 years in the future.
  • Model Deployment: Collaborate closely with the engineering team to deploy models into production environments.
  • Forecast Production: Contribute to monthly forecast production, communicating forecast performance and the housing market outlook to business partners and senior leadership team.
  • Scenario Modeling: Develop scenario models that capture a wide range of housing market outcomes and contribute to a company-wide stress-testing framework.
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $139,400.00 - $222,600.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $132,400.00 - $211,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • Keen Housing Market Observer: Strong interest and understanding of the housing market and the economic factors that influence it.
  • Innovative Problem Solver: Passionate about working on innovative solutions to time series, panel data, and hierarchical forecasting problems, conducting independent research, and applying research methods to real-world problems.

  • Technical Proficiencies:

    • Strong foundation in traditional econometric methods and modern machine learning techniques.
    • Proficient in data cleaning, preprocessing, and feature engineering for time series data. Experience with large-scale datasets and familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark.
    • Ability to design and implement robust model evaluation and validation strategies, including cross-validation and backtesting. Experience with metrics for time series forecasting accuracy and performance assessment.
    • Proficient in cloud-based platforms and tools for deploying and monitoring machine learning models.
    • Proficient in building AI agent to automate manual work

  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of conveying complex concepts to a broad audience.
  • Experience: 2+ years of proven experience working in time series/spatial forecasting space.
  • Educational Background: Master’s or PhD degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Physics, Earth Sciences, or a related scientific field

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities!

What do we do?💥

We empower governments to deliver exceptional citizen experiences.

Check out our ‘About Us’page for a deep dive into our product and what makes us exceptional.

About Clariti

Clariti builds community development software for cities and counties: permitting, licensing, plan review, and the workflows that let local governments serve their residents. We are in the middle of an AI-native transformation: AI is becoming part of our products and part of how our engineering pods build them.

About the role

Clariti's products run the permitting and community development operations of cities across North America. We are rethinking how that software should work when AI is part of the product and part of how the product gets built, and the engineering pod you would join is at the center of that work.

You will join a product engineering pod as a developer. The pod is small and senior, and works inside our Agentic SDLC framework: agent specs, orchestration workflows, reusable prompts, and eval harnesses that let a handful of engineers deliver at multiples of traditional velocity. You will not be typing every line yourself. You will be directing, reviewing, and shaping the work of coding agents, then owning the result as if you had written it, because you are accountable for it either way.

This is a product engineering role. Your job is to ship products: features cities will use to issue permits, run inspections, and serve residents, delivered to the quality bar government software demands.

What you will do

  • Ship product. Take features from spec through delivery in production, working within the pod's agentic workflow. Own the outcome end to end: correctness, performance, security, and the experience of the person at the counter who has to use it.
  • Work agent-first. Write clear specs and acceptance criteria, direct coding agents to implement them, review the output critically, and iterate. Your leverage is judgment, not keystrokes.
  • Hold the quality bar. Government software is scrutinized differently than consumer software. You test what agents produce, you understand what you ship, and you do not merge what you cannot explain.
  • Improve how the pod works. Feed what you learn about the framework, the workflows, and the agents back to the pod and to the Applied AI team that owns the framework. Velocity is a shared asset; you help keep it high.
  • Learn the domain. Permitting, licensing, plan review, inspections, and the rules cities live under. The best engineers here understand why a workflow exists before they change it.

What you bring

  • 7+ years as a software developer shipping production web applications, with deep fundamentals in API design, data modeling, testing, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Real experience building with coding agents and AI-assisted development tools, and a clear-eyed view of what they are good at and where they fail. You have shipped production code this way, not just experimented.
  • Strong written communication. In an agent-first pod, the quality of your specs determines the quality of the code.
  • The habit of reading and understanding what you ship, including code you did not type. You verify; you do not assume.
  • Comfort with pace and ambiguity. The roadmap is ambitious and the pod moves quickly.

Nice to have

  • Experience in government, civic, or other regulated software, where auditability and accessibility are requirements rather than preferences.
  • Experience with permitting, land management, or community development systems, or with the operations of a municipal government.
  • Experience with eval-driven development or building evaluation harnesses for AI-generated code.

How success is measured

  • 90 days: you understand the codebase, the pod's agentic workflow, and the permitting domain well enough to take features from spec to production without close supervision, at the pod's quality bar and without slowing the team down. You are shipping at the pod's average throughput: not a first feature or two, but a steady stream of production features every week, at the same pace and quality as the developers who were here before you.
  • 12 months: you are a dependable owner of meaningful parts of the product, trusted to take ambiguous problems from a customer conversation through to a shipped, well-tested feature. Your specs and reviews raise the quality of the pod's output, and you have made at least one lasting improvement to how the pod works, not just what it ships.

What’s in it for you?🫵

We invest in and empower our team members with competitive compensation packages, well deserved time off and benefits to keep you and your family healthy! *

💰 The base salary range for this role is expected to be between $103,000- $160,000 based on the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications while considering internal pay equity and our broader pay philosophy. 💰

If you have questions about compensation as we move through the process, we’re happy to discuss further.

*Benefits depend on employment type (full-time, part-time, contract, etc).

Things to Note 📝

Background checks - Because our customers trust us with sensitive information, we require all successful candidates to undergo comprehensive background checks before joining our team. We focus strictly on global sanctions and criminal offences that are directly relevant to employment at Clariti, and follow all applicable privacy and human rights legislation.

Travel- Although we operate as a remote company, all roles are expected to participate in occasional travel for in-person company-wide or departmental meetings, typically 1-2 times per year. Additional travel requirements specific to the role, if any, will be outlined in the job description.

We're committed to building an inclusive culture where our team members take ownership over projects, tasks, and outcomes; bring a growth mindset to drive continuous learning and self-development; have the ability to communicate courageously in a direct but respectful way; and are customer-focused by keeping the customer at the heart of decision-making. It’s the diversity of our team that helps us make better decisions, by leveraging the diversity in thought & experience across to create impactful solutions as we explore new paths & challenges as we grow. We’re working to create a workplace and team that is as diverse as the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

Questions? We are here to help

If you require accommodations in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in our hiring process for any reason, please direct your questions to and we’ll be happy to support you.

title: Creative Strategist (Paid Social + Performance Design)
description:
Full-time or part-time. Fully remote.

You write the briefs and make the finished ads for Meta and TikTok. This role combines design, creative strategy and production in one person. On each account you partner with a Growth Strategist, who runs media and the client relationship, while you run the creative side.

We're hiring at the Mid level of our Creative Strategist career path (Junior, Mid, Senior, then Lead or Director). We'll also talk to strong Junior and Senior candidates and level you against the same grid we use for the team.

What you'll do

  • Write your own briefs, covering angle, persona, awareness stage, hook and format.
  • Take a concept from brief to finished asset without hand-offs: statics, video cuts, UGC edits and landing page modules.
  • Pull customer language from reviews and ad comments, then build personas and message maps before you open a design file.
  • Run content gap analysis on competitors in the Meta Ad Library and on the account's own ads.
  • Explain why an ad works using hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA and creative tags.
  • Design tests with a hypothesis, one variable and a success metric, and log every result in our platform.
  • Know how attribution windows change creative results, and flag a "winner" propped up by view-through conversions.
  • Design landing page and product page sections, and watch Clarity recordings to see what visitors skip.
  • Present creative on client calls and turn the feedback into the next round.
  • Plan monthly output against the media plan and keep your hours inside each account's scope.
  • Turn a repeatable production task into an AI workflow your teammates reuse.
  • Write up creative gaps on your accounts with the extra scope and cost they would need.

How we measure the role

  • On-time delivery against agreed dates
  • Revision rounds caused by a missed brief or brand rule
  • QA escapes (off-brief or off-brand assets reaching a client or going live)
  • Share of your tests with a written hypothesis, clean setup and logged analysis
  • Hours logged against creative scope
  • 2 to 5 years making paid social creative for DTC brands, with a portfolio of statics, video and UGC edits and the results behind them.
  • Strong in Figma or Adobe CC, plus a video editing tool.
  • Comfortable in Meta Ads Manager and a creative analytics tool like Motion.
  • You already use AI image, video and copy tools in production, and you check every output before it ships.
  • Clear written English. We review your briefs and test write-ups as closely as your ads.
  • Bonus: Klaviyo email design, landing page builds, UGC creator sourcing.

How you grow here

Every level on the career path is written down: what you do, how it's measured and what evidence moves you up. Promotion comes after two quarters of next-level work, reviewed by a panel of three leaders. Your manager reviews your pay step every quarter, so you never have to negotiate a raise. After Senior, you choose between Lead (senior individual contributor) and Director (people leader).

Moving from Mid to Senior usually looks like setting creative strategy across several accounts, mentoring one to three teammates, running a creative automation you monitor and writing creative expansion proposals with a business case.

jetfuel.agency is a performance marketing agency for DTC and e-commerce brands, mostly in the $5M to $50M revenue range. We're a small, fully remote team. Creative strategy is part of every role here, and every role uses AI daily: we build reusable skills and automations inside our own agency platform, then check every output by hand before it reaches a client.

title: Lead Data Solution Engineer
description:

Overview

You’ll design and deliver data integration solutions that support BI and AI work across Azure and on-prem environments. Your work will help turn complex data into reliable pipelines, useful reports, and data that can be used for machine learning and AI initiatives.

This role gives you the chance to work on several technically complex, business-critical projects at once. You’ll be part of a team that values doing the right thing, building trusted relationships, and growing together.

You’ll also join a fun and flexible environment with development support, hands-on learning, and work that has clear impact for the business and the people it serves.

How you'll make an impact

You’ll lead the design and delivery of scalable data pipelines that help bring BI and AI work to life across Azure and on-prem environments. You’ll build reliable solutions that move data from source systems into clean, trusted structures that teams can use for reporting, analytics, and machine learning.

You’ll also work hands-on with data ingestion, transformation, validation, and loading. That means pulling data from APIs, databases, Azure Blob Storage, ADLS Gen2, third-party systems, and on-prem SQL Server, then making sure it is accurate, available, and ready for use.

  • Design and maintain ETL and ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, and Azure SQL.
  • Support on-prem SQL Server integration, including data extraction, synchronization, replication, and performance tuning.
  • Write and optimize T-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and functions to support processing, reporting, and analytics.
  • Help maintain data quality, consistency, lineage, and governance through validation, reconciliation, and exception handling.
  • Troubleshoot ETL failures, data latency issues, and production incidents across Azure and on-prem environments.
  • Support data models, data marts, and feature stores for analytics and machine learning use cases.
  • Develop, train, fine-tune, deploy, and monitor AI and ML models using structured and unstructured data.
  • Apply Azure security practices, including RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Key Vault, and private networking.
  • Help improve ETL, ELT, and AI engineering processes through automation and modern Azure patterns.

About you

  • You have 10+ years of experience in data solutions engineering, including 7+ years on the Microsoft platform.
  • You have an Advanced English Level.
  • You have 7+ years of experience designing and building large applications with SQL Server.
  • You have worked with Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Azure Functions, SQL Server, T-SQL, and SSIS.
  • You have built or supported CI/CD pipelines and used DevOps tools to move code, database changes, and data through the release cycle.
  • You have used Python and data libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, and PyArrow.
  • You have built or supported AI and machine learning solutions in cloud environments, including work with vector databases.
  • You can explain technical ideas clearly to managers, developers, vendors, and systems teams.
  • You can lead a project team, shape a technology vision, and create detailed estimates for planned work.
  • You have a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Your Team & Role

As a Senior Data Engineer you will analyze, design, develop, test, and perform ongoing maintenance to build high quality data pipelines that drive platform delivery. You will implement capabilities to solve sophisticated business problems, deploy innovative products, services and experiences to delight our customers! In addition to applied experience, you will bring excellent problem solving, communication and teamwork skills, along with agile ways of working, strong business insight, an inclusive leadership attitude and a continuous learning focus to all that you do.

  • Develop high quality, well documented and efficient code adhering to all applicable Prudential standards
  • Conduct complex data analysis and report on results, prepare data for prescriptive and predictive modeling, combine raw information from different sources
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and architects on data projects to enhance data acquisition, transformation, organization processes, data reliability, efficiency, and quality

  • Bring an applied understanding of relevant and emerging technologies, begin to identify opportunities to provide input to the team and coach others, and embed learning and innovation in the day-to-day
  • Work on complex problems in which analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors
  • Use programming languages including but not limited to Python, SQL, Scala, Pyspark/Apache Spark, Shell scripting

The Skills & Expertise You Bring

  • Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering or experience in related fields
  • Experience in working with DevOps automation tools & practices ; Knowledge of full software development life cycle (SDLC)
  • Leverage diverse ideas, experiences, thoughts and perspectives to the benefit of the organization
  • Knowledge of business concepts tools and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business
  • Ability to learn new skills and knowledge on an on-going basis through self-initiative and tackling challenges
  • Excellent problem solving, communication and collaboration skills; enjoy learning new skills!
  • Applied experience with several of the following:
    • Programming Language: Python, SQL, Scala, Pyspark/Apache Spark, Shell scripting
    • Microsoft Fabric - proven experience building and optimizing data pipelines in MS Fabric
    • Data Ingestion, Integration & Transformation: Moving data from multiple sources, formats, and volumes to analytics platforms through various tools. Preparing data for further analysis; transforming and mapping raw data to generate insights and wrangling data through tools.
    • Database Management System: Storing, organizing, managing, and delivering data using relational DBs, NoSQL DBs, Graph DBs, and data warehouse technologies.
    • Database tools: Data architecture to store, organize, and manage data. Experience with SQL and NoSQL based databases for storage and processing of structured, semi-structured & unstructured data.
    • Real-Time Analytics: Spark, Kinesis Data Streams
    • Data Buffering: Kinesis, Kafka
    • Workflow Orchestration: Airflow, AppFlow, Austosys, Cloudwatch, Splunk
    • Data Visualization: Tableau, Power BI, MS Excel
    • Data Lakes & Warehousing: Building Data Models, Data Lakes and Data Warehousing
    • Data Protection and Security: Knowledge of data protection, security principles and services; data loss prevention, role based access controls, data encryption, data access capture and core security services
    • Common Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Frameworks: Ansible, CloudFormation
    • Cloud Computing: Knowledge of fundamentals of AWS architectural principles and services; Strong ability on cloud formation and to write code; Knowledge of AWS core services
    • Testing/Quality: Unit, interface and end user testing concepts and tooling inclusive of non-functional requirements (performance, usability, reliability, security/vulnerability scanning, etc.) including how testing integrated into Dev Ops; accessibility awareness

Preferred qualifications:

  • Serverless data pipeline development using AWS Glue, Lambda and Step functions
  • Other Certifications?

You’ll Love Working Here Because You Can

Join a team and culture where your voice matters; where every day, your work transforms our experiences to make lives better. As you put your skills to use, we’ll help you make an even bigger impact with learning experiences that can grow your technical AND leadership capabilities. You’ll be surprised by what this rock-solid organization has in store for you.

description:

Certified Ophthalmic Assistant




Come work where we specialize in you! We have nearly 2,000 reasons for you to consider a career with Prevea Health—they're our employees. We're an organization that values kindness, responsibility, inclusivity, wellness and inspiration. At Prevea, we provide continuous education, training and support so every member of the team contributes to our success. Together we are the best place to get care and the best place to give care.

Job Summary
At Prevea Health the Certified Ophthalmic Assistant (COA) is responsible for assisting optometrists and ophthalmologists in providing high-quality patient care by conducting preliminary eye exams, gathering medical histories, and performing diagnostic tests. Ensure accurate documentation, maintain clinical equipment, and support a smooth and efficient workflow in the ophthalmic clinic.

What you will do

  • Perform essential rooming tasks, including patient medical history, background documentation, and administering eye drops. Conduct and interpret various eye care diagnostic tests and exams, such as Visual Field, OCT, Topography, and Fundus Photography. Assess ocular motility, pupil reactions, and confrontational fields. Additionally, perform retinoscopy or obtain a manifest refraction as needed.
  • Clean and maintain exams rooms, instruments and equipment, making sure they are within infection control standards. Ensure appropriate levels of medical supplies for each patient's room. Order supplies when needed.
  • Escribe prescription refills as directed for medications related to eye conditions, including drops, steroids, and antibiotics for eye issues, while following established treatment protocols for consistency. Manage patient phone calls within the scope of practice, such as processing contact lens orders, and communicate relevant patient inquiries to providers as needed. Triage patient concerns regarding eye changes in condition and ability to schedule appropriately (example: floaters) including patient education for procedures and surgery
  • Coordinate provider schedules/appointments and prepare patient charts.
  • Prepare patients for their visit with the optometrist and/or ophthalmologist, including minor in-office surgeries and laser procedures. Assist physicians with interoffice surgical procedures and laser treatments. Additionally, set up lasers for physician use.
  • Ordering imaging tests, including carotid ultrasound, CT, or MRI, as well as laboratory tests.
  • Perform A-scan measurements and IOL calculations.

  • Graduation from an accredited program for ophthalmic assistant Preferred

title: Retail Customer Experience Associate, Wolfchase - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As a Customer Experience Colleague, you will create exceptional, personalized shopping experiences for our customers. You’ll prioritize customer satisfaction by actively engaging with shoppers across all touchpoints - both in-store and online - and drive cross-category sales to support overall business goals. With a deep understanding of fashion, fit, and function, you will make tailored product recommendations and leverage digital tools to enhance the customer journey. You also will work across different departments daily, often transitioning between multiple areas throughout the day.

In this role, you’ll also play a key part in client relationship building through outreach tools like My Client and social media. Your collaborative approach with peers, store leaders, and brand partners will help identify opportunities, resolve challenges, and elevate the overall customer experience. In addition to service and selling, you’ll support operational excellence through floor readiness, event execution, merchandise setup, and opening/closing procedures.

A positive, can-do attitude, strong communication skills, and a passion for delivering high-caliber service will be key to your success in this role.

How Our Selling Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They wear their name badge with pride, greet teammates with a warm hello, and help ensure the sales floor is clean, organized, and prepared for customers. You'll own the pipelines behind decision-making for a large-scale consumer platform — with direct influence over the technology choices, architecture, and data quality bar the business relies on.

title: AWS DevOps & Platform Engineering Lead
description:
This is not a DevOps role where you sit on the sidelines reviewing architecture diagrams.

You’ll be leading the AWS DevOps and platform engineering capability while staying firmly hands-on.

Around half your time will be spent in engineering delivery across AWS environments, migrations, modernisation projects and managed services. The other half will focus on leading and developing the DevOps team, owning delivery standards, supporting customers and making sure the work gets done properly.

You’ll be responsible for the technical direction of the team, but you’ll still be expected to design solutions, review code, solve complex production issues and step into high‑pressure incidents when needed.

The environment suits someone who enjoys both the technical and leadership sides of the job and does not want to choose between the two.

Core tech: AWS, Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, EKS, Docker, Helm, GitHub Actions, GitLab, Linux, Python/Bash, CloudWatch and CloudTrail.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the DevOps engineering team, including hiring, onboarding, performance management and day‑to‑day work allocation.
  • Mentor engineers through technical reviews, code reviews, pairing and structured development plans.
  • Build capability within the team and create clear AWS certification and career development pathways.
  • Own the technical delivery of DevOps workstreams across customer projects.
  • Produce realistic technical estimates and ensure delivery remains within agreed scope and effort.
  • Lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable AWS architectures.
  • Define DevOps, Infrastructure‑as‑Code and CI/CD standards across projects.
  • Design AWS landing zones and multi‑account environments using AWS Organizations and Control Tower.
  • Design and manage container platforms using Kubernetes, Amazon EKS and ECS.
  • Build and maintain containerised workloads using Docker and Helm.
  • Design CI/CD and GitOps pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions and GitLab.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting and observability across production environments.
  • Design backup and disaster recovery solutions, including RTO, RPO and DR testing.
  • Support AWS migrations and application modernisation projects.
  • Ensure AWS environments align with Well‑Architected principles.
  • Implement and maintain AWS security controls across IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, GuardDuty, Security Hub and related services.
  • Embed security into CI/CD pipelines through policy‑as‑code, infrastructure scanning and secrets scanning.
  • Support environments operating under compliance requirements such as POPIA, GDPR, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST and HIPAA.
  • Act as the escalation point for complex AWS production issues.
  • Lead P1 and P2 incident response, root cause analysis and post‑incident reviews.
  • Establish and manage on‑call and support rotations to ensure SLA commitments are met.
  • Advise customers on AWS optimisation, resilience, reliability and cost reduction.
  • Participate in architecture workshops and technical discovery sessions with customers.
  • Produce technical designs, estimates, proposals and input into Statements of Work.
  • Communicate technical risks, decisions and delivery status clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Work closely with Delivery, Presales, Managed Services, Security and FinOps teams.
  • Build reusable delivery assets including Terraform modules, pipeline templates, SOPs and runbooks.
  • Track and improve engineering delivery metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate and mean time to recovery.

Requirements

You’ll need strong technical depth, but this role also requires proven experience leading people and owning delivery.

  • 7+ years’ experience across infrastructure, cloud or DevOps.
  • At least 4+ years of substantial hands‑on AWS experience.
  • At least 2+ years’ experience leading or managing engineers.
  • Proven experience with hiring, performance management, mentoring and work allocation.
  • Strong hands‑on AWS experience across:
  • IAM
  • VPC and networking
  • EC2
  • S3
  • RDS / Aurora
  • AWS Organizations
  • AWS security principles
  • Strong Infrastructure‑as‑Code experience using Terraform and AWS CloudFormation.
  • Solid experience with Terraform module design and state management.
  • Strong Docker and Kubernetes experience.
  • Production experience with Amazon EKS.
  • Good understanding of Kubernetes pods, deployments, services and Helm.
  • Strong CI/CD and Git‑based workflow experience.
  • Experience with CloudWatch and CloudTrail.
  • Scripting experience using Python and/or Bash.Proven customer‑facing technical delivery experience within a consulting, AWS partner or managed services environment.
  • Experience managing production incidents and on‑call support against contracted SLAs.
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, or the ability to achieve one within six months of joining.

Advantageous

  • Amazon ECS experience.
  • AWS Control Tower and landing zone experience.
  • AWS Security – Specialty or Advanced Networking – Specialty certification.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate, CKA or CKAD certification.
  • Experience with policy‑as‑code and IaC security scanning tools such as Checkov, tfsec or OPA.
  • Backup and disaster recovery design experience.
  • FinOps and AWS cost optimisation experience.
  • Exposure to AI/ML workloads such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker or MLOps environments.
  • Experience working in regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, higher education or public sector.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation.
  • BSc in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

The Person

You’ll suit this role if you are comfortable switching between technical delivery, team leadership and customer conversations without losing momentum.

You lead from the front, remain calm when production is under pressure and take ownership when things go wrong.

You care about engineering quality, security and documentation, but you also understand that delivery needs to make commercial sense.

Most importantly, you’re still technically curious and hands‑on.

Interested?

If you’re an experienced AWS DevOps leader who still enjoys building, solving and getting into the technical detail, this is worth a conversation.

description:

Experience:5+ Years

About Quantum Strides LLC

Quantum Strides LLC is a premier enterprise software solution provider and an IBM Business Partner specializing in IBM Maximo Application Suite (IBM MAS) including IBM Maximo Real Estate and Facilities (IBM MREF). Headquartered in the United States, with a global presence across India, and the Philippines, we deliver innovative enterprise solutions by leveraging emerging technologies, including AI-driven automation, cloud, and digital transformation strategies.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced AutoCAD Engineer with strong technical expertise and the ability to translate business and technical requirements into high-quality drawings and documentation. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience working on complex AutoCAD projects and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Drawings

  • Drawing Preparation: Clean, audit, and standardize AutoCAD files (removing Xrefs, hatching, and unnecessary blocks) to prepare them for TRIRIGA publishing.
  • Polylining: Execute precise polylining of gross areas, assignable areas, and sub-areas (rooms, workstations, closets) according to BOMA or IFMA standards.
  • Publishing & Synchronization: Use the TRIRIGA CAD Integrator/Publisher tool to link CAD drawing objects to TRIRIGA records and publish them to the environment.
  • Label Configuration: Configure and maintain CAD label styles to ensure space IDs, employee names, or occupancy status display correctly within the system.

Data Integrity & Maintenance

  • Spatial Validation: Ensure that square footage calculated in CAD matches the data reflected in the TRIRIGA Space Manager.
  • As-Built Management: Incorporate "As-Built" drawings from construction or renovation projects into the master CAD library.
  • Troubleshooting: Resolve synchronization errors between the CAD plugin and the TRIRIGA server, such as "unattached" records or broken links.

Space Management Support

  • Occupancy Mapping: Assist the Space Planning team by updating drawing layers to reflect personnel moves, adds, and changes (MAC).
  • Standardization: Maintain a consistent CAD layer naming convention (Standard Operating Procedures) across all regional or global portfolios.
  • Reporting: Generate spatial reports directly from CAD data to assist leadership in real estate optimization.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience working with AutoCAD and CAD integrator for TRIRIGA/MREF
  • Strong understanding of drafting standards, layers, blocks, and annotations.
  • TRIRIGA CAD Integrator/Publisher Plugin: Direct experience using the plugin to "attach" objects (rooms, people, assets) to the TRIRIGA database.
  • Standardization: Ability to enforce and follow strict CAD standards (e.g., layer naming conventions like A-AREA-IDEN
  • BOMA/IFMA/OSCRE: Knowledge of global standards for measuring floor area (e.g., knowing the difference between "Rentable," "Usable," and "Gross" area).

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Exposure to Business Analyst or coordination activities such as requirements discussions and documentation.
  • Experience working on short-term or project-based engagements.
  • Familiarity with industry best practices and quality standards.
  • Experience working with distributed or remote teams.

Why Join Quantum Strides?

  • Flexible engagement models (full-time / part-time).
  • Opportunity to work on impactful and challenging projects.
  • Collaborative and growth-oriented work culture.
  • Competitive compensation aligned with market standards.

title: Data and AI Engineer
description:
ESGpedia is Asia’s leading in ESG data and technology company, headquartered in Singapore. We offer a comprehensive suite of digital solutions on our one-stop platform to empower corporates, SMEs, and the financial sector to achieve ESG excellence.

The ESGpedia platform powers key initiatives across the Asia Pacific region, including the ESCAP Sustainable Business Network (ESBN) Asia-Pacific Green Deal digital platform and the Asia-Pacific Single Accesspoint for ESG Data (SAFE) initiative. ESGpedia is GRI-licensed.

At ESGpedia, we believe people are our greatest asset. Unified by a common purpose of accelerating the world’s transition towards a net zero economy, our team is built on mutual trust, respect, and support. We believe in hands-on learning and taking ownership of one’s work – which means creating a spirited environment for all team members to take on exciting challenges, create meaningful impact for our planet, and grow both personally and professionally.

For more information about ESGpedia, please visit: www.esgpedia.io

Job Summary

As a Data and AI Engineer at ESGpedia, you will bring data engineering, customer analytics and applied AI development into one role. You will own assigned solutions from understanding the business question and collecting data through pipelines, dashboards and AI features, including ongoing support. Your work will help customers use accurate sustainability data and help ESGpedia develop reusable products.

Job Responsibilities

  • Build reliable, robust and scalable real-time data pipelines. Work with backend engineers to understand data structures, agree on source data contracts and manage schema changes. Build streaming and event-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines, with batch processing where appropriate. Implement validation, monitoring, retries and backfills to keep data accurate and available.
  • Deliver Customer Analytics with various Stakeholders. Work with customers, Sales, Product and other stakeholders to clarify needs and define metrics. Analyse data, investigate discrepancies and explain findings. Build and maintain bespoke and common Business Intelligence Dashboards, validating the complete path from source data to displayed results.
  • Lead the development of AI Products. Identify opportunities and own delivery from feasibility and prototypes to customer demonstrations and production features. Develop extraction, search, analysis and automation solutions using Databricks and AI services. Evaluate accuracy, cost and latency, and work with application engineers on integration, deployment and monitoring.
  • Collect and prepare trusted data. Maintain data collection from databases, APIs, files and public sources, including scraping pipelines. Clean, standardise and reconcile data; resolve duplicates and inconsistent formats; and retain source references. Validate units, reporting periods and missing or revised values with the relevant business owners.
  • Build reusable data models and self service analytics. Design analytical datasets and shared metric definitions for dashboards and AI applications. Optimise storage, transformations and queries for performance. Turn repeated customer requirements into reusable models and templates, and evaluate Genie or equivalent tools for customer self-service using governed data and tested answers.
  • Maintain service quality and client continuity. Continue supporting existing clients and their Business Intelligence Dashboards while introducing new capabilities. Resolve pipeline and dashboard incidents, preserve the last valid dataset when refreshes fail, and improve freshness and loading performance. Apply testing, code review, version control, CI/CD and customer access controls.
  • Own delivery and share knowledge. Estimate work, agree priorities with stakeholders and communicate progress, dependencies and risks. Document calculations, data models, pipelines and support procedures. Provide customer demonstrations and maintain backup coverage so the team can support solutions across data, analytics and AI.

Requirement

We welcome candidates from data engineering, data analytics, BI development and related software or AI roles. Bring strong foundations and a willingness to grow across the role; we can train targeted gaps in platforms and adjacent skills.

  • Typically three or more years of relevant experience delivering and supporting data pipelines, analytical solutions or data-driven applications.
  • A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with the ability to read, improve and troubleshoot existing code.
  • Practical understanding of data cleaning, validation, modeling and relational or NoSQL databases, with experience in systems such as MongoDB, MariaDB, MySQL or Redis.
  • Ability to translate business questions into analysis, validate calculations and explain results clearly, with experience creating Business Intelligence Dashboards.
  • Experience delivering and supporting a production pipeline, dashboard or application, together with working knowledge of testing, Git and structured deployment practices.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving and ownership, including stakeholder collaboration and managing changing priorities in a startup.
  • Experience with streaming, event-driven systems and schema change management is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with Databricks, PySpark, AWS, AI development and evaluation, or self-service analytics tools is a plus.

What We Look For

  • Self-Starters: You don’t wait for instruction—you spot what needs doing and take initiative. We love that.
  • Curious Builders: You ask the right questions, dig deep, and thrive in ambiguity. You turn complex problems into elegant, real-world solutions.
  • Communicators Who Connect: Whether you’re writing a report or leading a meeting, you convey your ideas with clarity, empathy, and purpose.
  • Accountable High Performers: You take ownership, deliver under pressure, and hold yourself to a high standard—even when no one’s watching.
  • Passion for Impact: You’re not just looking for a job—you want to do work that matters. Whether it’s advancing sustainability, transforming client outcomes, or innovating with tech, you’re fueled by purpose and driven to make a difference!

ESGpedia is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace for all. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, or other employment practices. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating and fostering an inclusive environment for all employees.

You may refer and access our website(www.esgpedia.io) for more information.

title: Data-quality specialist
description:
We're seeking someone to keep the service's data trustworthy. To steward the data, find and fix quality problems, and reconcile between the contingent workforce platform and the HR and finance systems, so that reports and controls rest on accurate records.

The role suits a data analyst or steward who enjoys tracing a break back to its source.

About the Service

A leading South African financial institution is mobilising a managed service to run its contingent workforce process end to end. The service covers the full contractor lifecycle: requisitions, supplier routing, onboarding, contractor care, renewals, timesheets and deliverables, billing control and exits. It operates for a large population of contractors and consultants placed by a panel of more than 200 recruitment suppliers.

The service is delivered by a neutral managed service provider, on the client's systems and under the client's policies. The client keeps every decision that matters: policy, budget, rates, selection, payment and settlement. The provider administers, controls, reports and improves, and treats every supplier equally.

Key Responsibilities Data Stewardship Monitor completeness, accuracy and consistency of the workforce, supplier and financial data. Maintain data definitions and quality rules. Reconciliation Reconcile between the vendor management platform and HR and finance systems, and resolve breaks. Track data exceptions to closure with the owner of the source. Reporting Report data quality metrics and root causes, and recommend fixes to the reporting lead. What success looks like Data quality measured and improving against defined rules. Reconciliation breaks between systems resolved with source owners. Root causes of recurring data errors identified and fixed. Boundaries of the role

Independence is central to this service. This role does not:

change source records without the owner's approval, or use data access to influence supplier or candidate outcomes. override, or act in place of, a client decision on policy, budget, rates, selection, payment, settlement or risk acceptance. favour or disadvantage any supplier or candidate. influence supplier allocation, candidate screening or progression, rate outcomes, commercial disputes or supplier standing. This role sits in a ring-fenced specialist team.

You must declare any current or recent relationship with the client institution or with any supplier on its panel.

Qualifications Degree or diploma in information systems, statistics, business or a related field. Experience At least 7 years in data quality, data stewardship or data analyst roles. Experience with SQL and data reconciliation across systems. Skills and knowledge Data quality management. SQL and reconciliation. Root-cause analysis. Attention to detail and communication. Systems and tools SQL, Excel, business intelligence tools, and familiarity with HR and finance systems. Advantageous Experience with HR or workforce data. Personal attributes Persistent in tracing breaks to source. Diplomatic when a source owner must change a record. Documents rules and findings. Working relationships The MI/BI and Service Performance Lead. Reporting and Analytics Analysts. Owners of HR, finance and platform data at the client.

Please Note: As all iqbusiness roles require honesty in the handling of or access to cash, finances, financial systems, or confidential information; our recruitment process requires that the following background checks be completed: credit, criminal, ID, and qualification verification.
