title: [Loonshot Games] 3D Effect Artist - Project Camp(3년 이상)
description:
우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

저희는 누적매출 5,000억 이상 달성한 모바일 게임을 운영해 온 숙련된 팀입니다.

지금은 크래프톤의 룬샷게임즈에서 새로운 게임을 만들기 위해 소중한 동료를 찾고 있습니다.

  • 아름다운 판타지 세계와 매력적인 캐릭터 서사를 중심으로 한 모바일 RPG
  • 도트 기반 캐릭터와 입체적인 배경 연출을 결합한 개성 있는 2.5D 비주얼의 게임
  • 동료를 만나고 공간을 성장시키며, 자신만의 모험을 확장해 나가는 수집·성장형 게임
  • 쉬운 진입성과 전략적 전투, 감성적인 내러티브를 함께 갖춘 게임

※ 본 포지션의 채용이 진행되는 Loonshot Games는 2/23자로 크래프톤의 자회사로 분사 완료되었습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

프로젝트 초기 단계에서 HD 2D JRPG의 전투와 세계관에 어울리는 이펙트 스타일을 정립하고, 지속 가능한 VFX 제작 기반을 구축합니다.

  • 픽셀 아트, 3D 배경, 조명, 포스트 프로세싱이 조화되는 HD 2D 이펙트 스타일 개발
  • 스퀘어 에닉스풍 JRPG의 클래식한 감성과 현대적인 연출을 결합한 전투 VFX 제작
  • 일반 스킬, 필살기, 속성 공격, 버프·디버프, 피격·사망 등 핵심 전투 이펙트의 기준 수립
  • 쿼터뷰 또는 탑뷰 전투에서 공격 방향, 범위, 타격 지점이 명확하게 보이는 연출 설계
  • 카메라 연출, 캐릭터 애니메이션, 사운드와 연계되는 타격감 및 전투 피드백 구축
  • 다양한 캐릭터와 스킬에 확장 적용할 수 있는 이펙트 제작 파이프라인 및 공통 리소스 정립
  • 프로젝트의 성능 목표와 플랫폼 환경을 고려한 최적화 기준 수립
  • 초기 프로토타입 단계에서 VFX 관련 기술적 리스크를 확인하고 해결 방안 제시

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 게임 VFX 제작 경력 3년 이상 또는 이에 준하는 실무 역량
  • Unity 기반의 실시간 이펙트 제작 경험
  • Shuriken Particle System, VFX Graph 또는 이에 준하는 툴 활용 능력
  • 전투 스킬, 타격, 피격, 버프·디버프 등 게임 이펙트 제작 경험
  • 이펙트의 형태, 타이밍, 색상, 밝기, 움직임을 통해 의도를 전달할 수 있는 능력
  • 카메라 거리와 게임 화면에서의 가독성을 고려한 이펙트 설계 능력
  • 텍스처, 파티클, 메쉬, 셰이더를 조합하여 다양한 표현을 구현할 수 있는 역량
  • 캐릭터 애니메이션 및 기획 의도를 이해하고 유관 부서와 협업할 수 있는 커뮤니케이션 능력
  • 이펙트의 제작 의도와 작업 방향을 설명하고, 피드백을 바탕으로 개선할 수 있는 능력
  • 모바일 또는 실시간 게임 환경에서의 최적화 경험

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • HD 2D, 2.5D, 픽셀 아트 기반 게임의 VFX 제작 경험
  • 옥토패스 트래블러, 브레이블리 디폴트 등 클래식 JRPG 스타일의 연출에 대한 이해
  • 픽셀 아트 또는 픽셀 기반 이펙트 제작 경험
  • 2D 스프라이트와 3D 파티클·메쉬를 결합한 이펙트 제작 경험
  • Unity Shader Graph 또는 커스텀 셰이더 제작 경험
  • Timeline, Cinemachine, Animation Event 등을 활용한 연출 구현 경험
  • 필살기, 컷인, 카메라 줌·쉐이크 등 시네마틱 전투 연출 경험
  • 전투 이펙트 스타일 가이드 및 공통 이펙트 라이브러리 구축 경험
  • Houdini, Blender, Maya, After Effects, Photoshop 등 관련 툴 활용 능력
  • 이펙트 제작을 위한 텍스처·메쉬 생성 프로세스를 개선하거나 자동화한 경험
  • 이펙트 리소스의 드로우콜, 오버드로우, 파티클 수 등을 분석하고 최적화한 경험
  • 초기 프로젝트에서 아트 방향성과 제작 기준을 수립해 본 경험
  • JRPG, 전략 RPG, 턴제 RPG 장르에 대한 높은 관심과 이해

룬샷게임즈의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • 서류 전형 > 사전 인터뷰 (Phone Interview) > *직무 테스트 (Pre-Test) > 직무 면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 종합 면접 (Culture Fit Interview) > 학/경력, 평판조회 > 처우협의 > 최종 합격 및 입사
    *해당 전형은 포지션에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.

  • 필요 시 직무 테스트 또는 면접 전형이 추가될 수 있으며, 이에 대한 상세 내용은 개별 안내드립니다.
  • 전형 결과는 지원서에 기재된 이메일로 2주 이내 발송되며, 내부 일정에 따라 다소 지연될 경우 별도 안내드립니다.

필요 서류를 확인해주세요!

  • 입사지원서 (자유 양식), 자기소개서, 경력기술서, 포트폴리오(필수)
  • 포트폴리오 첨부 시, 하단 안내 사항을 확인해 주시기 바랍니다.

title: Data Engineer (Projects)
description:
Is this your next role?

Do you enjoy building modern data platforms, solving complex data challenges, and delivering solutions that have a real impact on business outcomes?

Is this your next role?

Do you enjoy building modern data platforms, solving complex data challenges, and delivering solutions that have a real impact on business outcomes?

At Heartland, we're looking for a Data Engineer - Projects to help shape and deliver strategic data initiatives across both New Zealand and Australia. You'll work with modern cloud technologies including Snowflake, dbt, Azure Data Factory, Data Vault 2.0, and AtScale, building scalable data products that support everything from regulatory reporting and finance analytics to platform migrations and business transformation programmes.

This is an opportunity to work on meaningful projects within a growing financial services organisation that is investing heavily in its data and digital capabilities. You'll have the chance to influence solution design, work closely with stakeholders across the business, and help establish best-practice data engineering standards.

Why this role is exciting

  • Work with a modern cloud data stack: Snowflake, dbt, Azure Data Factory, DV2 and AtScale.
  • Deliver high-impact projects that directly support strategic business initiatives.
  • Join a collaborative team where your technical expertise and ideas are valued.
  • Help shape the future of data at a digital-first financial services organisation.
  • Gain exposure to both New Zealand and Australian banking environments.
  • Enjoy a balance of hands-on engineering, solution design, stakeholder engagement and innovation.

Does this sound like you?

You're passionate about data engineering and enjoy turning complex business requirements into scalable, reliable data solutions. You thrive in project environments, enjoy solving challenging problems, and take pride in delivering high-quality outcomes.

You’ll Bring Proven Experience In

  • Delivering data engineering solutions in production environments, including project delivery, controlled releases and stakeholder engagement.
  • Strong hands-on engineering using Snowflake and SQL, including performance optimisation and cost-conscious design.
  • Developing and supporting dbt in production, including models, testing, documentation, lineage and deployment practices.
  • Building and operating ingestion and orchestration solutions, ideally using Azure Data Factory.
  • Applying dimensional modelling and/or Data Vault 2.0 concepts to meet business requirements.
  • Delivering governed semantic layer solutions, ideally with AtScale or similar technologies.
  • Working within regulated industries where data accuracy, governance and traceability are critical.

Your Strengths Include

  • Advanced SQL and data transformation skills.
  • Designing solutions that are maintainable, performant and operationally supportable.
  • Navigating ambiguity and translating business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability.
  • Communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Following disciplined engineering practices including Git/GitHub, code reviews, testing and documentation.
  • Managing competing priorities while maintaining delivery quality and transparency

A Bit About Us And What We Do

Heartland is an NZX/ASX-listed financial services group with big growth plans. Heartland owns both Heartland Bank in New Zealand and Heartland Bank in Australia. We provide award-winning savings and finance products to a diverse range of customers including business owners, farmers and retirees. Heartland's strategy is to digitalise everything we do, enabling us to provide customers with what they need in a scalable way. We can then pass those benefits onto the customer through faster service and better rates.

Can you see yourself here?

We're innovative and always evolving. We work together as one team and have big ambition. We're committed to creating a culture of inclusivity that celebrates our diverse backgrounds and supports the wellbeing of our people. We offer real opportunities for learning and career development. You can also drive change through our internal groups (including Manawa Whenua - our Māori group, the Rainbow Committee, Diversity & Inclusion Committee and our Green Team).

Diversity & Inclusion

At Heartland, we're proud to celebrate the many characteristics that make each of us different. We are committed to improving the inclusiveness of our workplace, enabling our people to be authentic and helping us better understand and respond to our customers. We're a Living Wage Employer, a Hearing Accredited Workplace, and have the Rainbow Tick.

Heartland is an equal opportunity employer. We strongly encourage everyone to apply and we welcome everyone to the team. Please let us know if you need any adjustments throughout the application or interview process including a sign language interpreter or speech-to-text reporter. In your application, feel free to let us know what your pronouns are (for example, she/her, he/him, they/them etc).

Keen to learn more?

For an insight into life at Heartland, check out our Instagram @heartlandbanknz or follow us on LinkedIn www.linkedin.com/company/heartland-bank-nz.

Please note you must be eligible to work in New Zealand.

title: Asset Protection Officer, Queens Center - Full Time
description:
Be Part of an Amazing Story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

As an Asset Protection Officer, you are a visible and welcoming presence who helps create a safe, secure, and service-focused shopping environment. Stationed at key entrances and high-shortage areas, you help deter theft, identify potential risk, support customer and colleague safety, and partner with store teams to deliver a positive experience for everyone who enters the store.

Why This Role Matters

This entry-level role is more than traditional security — it is presence with purpose. Whether greeting customers, helping deter theft, supporting team safety, or responding calmly during incidents, Asset Protection Officers help customers and colleagues feel comfortable, confident, and cared for while protecting the business.

How Our Asset Protection Colleagues Spend Their Day…

  • Our colleagues begin each day energized and ready to make an impact. They greet teammates with a warm hello. Before they get started, they review updates and department information so they're fully informed and ready to engage with confidence.
  • On the floor, they focus on the customer - offering a warm welcome, making eye contact, and creating friendly customer experience.
  • We believe service starts with each other - supporting one another with honesty, care, and collaboration so we can better serve our customers and communities.
  • And we know that excellence is a journey - we strive to improve every day, take pride in our work, achieve sales goals and learn from each other to deliver individual and store results.

What To Expect

  • Serve as a visible and reassuring presence at store entrances, high-traffic areas, and high-shortage locations.
  • Help deter theft and identify suspicious activity while maintaining a welcoming, customer-first approach.
  • Partner with store teams and Asset Protection leaders to support safety, service, and shortage reduction.
  • Respond calmly and professionally to incidents, medical situations, and other store needs.
  • Use technology and two-way communication devices to stay connected and support timely response.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Create a safe and welcoming first impression by greeting customers and maintaining a visible presence in key areas of the store.
  • Help protect company assets by deterring theft, identifying suspicious behavior, and supporting shortage reduction efforts.
  • Assist with apprehensions under the direction of Asset Protection Leaders, Captains, or Detectives.
  • Document theft, accidents, audits, and other incidents through accurate and timely reporting.
  • Conduct operational audits and complete assigned Asset Protection tasks as directed.
  • Support a culture of safety and service by partnering with store teams and responding appropriately to customer and colleague needs.
  • Follow company policies and legal standards related to apprehensions, searches, evidence handling, and confidential information.
  • Respond to medical situations and help facilitate basic first aid for customers and colleagues.
  • Provide testimony in criminal or civil legal proceedings, as needed.

Skills That Matter

Must Have

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings, weekends, and holidays, with regular, dependable attendance and punctuality.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with customers, colleagues, and supervisors.

  • Ability to read and understand employment policies, safety rules, and procedures in English.

  • Strong situational awareness and the ability to remain calm, professional, and service-focused during incidents.

  • Ability to handle proprietary, sensitive, and confidential information with discretion and integrity.

  • For jobs in New York, a current New York State Security Guard License is required.

  • Comfort using technology and two-way communication devices.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in retail, customer service, security, safety, or asset protection.

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with colleagues across levels and departments.

  • Prior experience supporting audits, incident documentation, or shortage reduction efforts.

Physical Activities You Will Perform

  • This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.
  • Position requires prolonged periods of standing/walking around store or department.
  • May occasionally involve reaching above eye level, stooping, kneeling, or crouching.
  • Must be able to apprehend shoplifters.
  • Ability to sustain long periods of time enclosed in surveillance areas.
  • Frequently lift/move up to 30lbs.
  • Requires close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some additional benefits we offer include:

  • Merchandise discounts
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Annual merit review
  • Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice
  • Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

Full-time colleagues are typically scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week, while part-time colleagues are typically scheduled 12-24 hours per week. All schedules contain weekend shifts as part of the requirements. Hours are dependent on business needs and colleague availability. Information regarding hours per week needed for benefit eligibility purposes can be found here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - Apply Today!

This job description is not all-inclusive and may not apply to colleagues covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Macy's Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

title: Digital Media Performance Analyst
description:
Job Title

Digital Media Performance Analyst

✨ About the Role


At Amadeus, the Digital Marketing Performance Analyst plays an important role in managing and optimizing digital media campaigns, with a focus on the hospitality sector. You’ll engage in regular client communication and support the implementation of strategy for multiple hotel clients across the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region.


You’ll work closely with a team of Digital Media Performance Strategists and Ad Operations professionals to deliver impactful client initiatives and continuously improve campaign outcomes.


🔍 Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement media plans by researching target audiences and recommending appropriate channels and budget allocations.
  • Recommend new products and identify opportunities to expand budgets with existing clients.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitors, and client landscapes to assess potential impacts.
  • Collaborate with Strategists to create engaging ad copy and keyword lists for client approval.
  • Coordinate campaign setup, tracking workflows, and timely launch of new and renewal campaigns.

title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
description:
Job Summary

At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs.

Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.


Job Description
At Alto, we are transforming the pharmacy experience through intelligent, scalable technology. Data is foundational to how we serve patients, empower operators, and enable smarter decision-making across the business. As the Senior Manager, Data Engineering, you will lead the strategy, architecture, and execution of Alto’s data platform — ensuring that high-quality, trusted, and timely data fuels everything from analytics and operations to product innovation and machine learning.
You will manage, build and lead a high-performing team responsible for designing resilient data pipelines, evolving our modern data stack, and establishing data engineering best practices. This role is equal parts technical leadership, organizational design, and cross-functional partnership — shaping how data is produced, governed, and consumed across a fast-growing, technology-driven healthcare organization.



Job Description

Key Responsibilities (see above)

Leadership & Vision

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Data Engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

  • Define and execute the long-term vision for Alto’s data platform, ensuring alignment with company strategy and product roadmaps.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Finance, and Enterprise teams to prioritize and deliver high-impact data initiatives.

  • Establish clear career paths, performance standards, and hiring plans to scale the team thoughtfully and sustainably.

  • Build strong stakeholder trust by translating business needs into scalable data solutions.

Data Platform & Architecture

  • Own the design and evolution of Alto’s data architecture, including ingestion, transformation, orchestration, storage, and serving layers.

  • Administer and maintain core platform tooling — including Fivetran, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, and Looker — ensuring these systems operate as reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure.

  • Provide a robust, well-governed platform foundation that enables Analytics to build and manage transformation logic within dbt, while enforcing standards for performance, testing, deployment workflows, access controls, and warehouse efficiency.

  • Ensure the underlying data platform reliably powers analytics, operational workflows, experimentation, and machine learning use cases — delivering trusted, well-documented, and production-grade data assets to both internal stakeholders and downstream systems.

  • Ensure the reliability, performance, and freshness of data pipelines through strong observability, lineage tracking, testing frameworks, and operational rigor.

  • Scale the platform to support increasing data volume, near-real-time use cases, and expanding business and regulatory complexity.

Data Governance, Quality & Operational Excellence

  • Evolve and strengthen existing standards for data governance, access control, privacy, and compliance within a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Refine and operationalize SLAs and performance metrics for data pipelines and platform reliability, ensuring clear accountability and transparency.

  • Enhance and scale current data quality monitoring and incident management practices to improve resilience, observability, and response times.

  • Continuously optimize infrastructure performance and cost efficiency through thoughtful architectural improvements and warehouse tuning.

Innovation & Cross-Functional Impact

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and evolve Alto’s data stack to support streaming, near-real-time analytics, and scalable AI workflows.

  • Enable robust experimentation and measurement by providing reliable, well-instrumented, and production-grade data pipelines that Analytics, Data Science, and Product teams can confidently build upon.

  • Collaborate closely with Data Science and Machine Learning teams to ensure the platform scales alongside growing model and feature complexity, providing the infrastructure, environment consistency, and operational guardrails necessary for reliable training and production inference.

  • Drive adoption of best-in-class tooling and practices that improve developer velocity and reduce operational toil.

  • Cultivate a culture where data is treated as a product — with clear ownership, discoverability, and accountability.

Required Experience & Qualifications (see above)

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field; advanced degree preferred.

  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or related data infrastructure roles.

  • 5+ years of experience leading and scaling high-performing technical teams.

  • Proven experience architecting, operating, and scaling modern cloud-based data platforms, including data ingestion, orchestration, cloud data warehouses, transformation frameworks, and semantic serving layers.

  • Strong expertise in data modeling principles, ELT architectures, and production-grade pipeline orchestration.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Proven track record owning platform reliability, including defining SLAs, implementing observability and data quality frameworks, and leading incident response and postmortems for production data systems.

  • Experience operating in high-growth, fast-paced technology organizations.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building data platforms in healthcare, pharmacy, fintech, or other regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with HIPAA and healthcare data privacy standards.

  • Experience supporting machine learning pipelines, feature engineering workflows, or feature stores.

  • Experience with streaming architectures (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub) and real-time analytics use cases.

  • Exposure to experimentation platforms and product analytics ecosystems.

  • Strong SQL and programming proficiency (e.g., Python, Scala, or similar).

  • Experience implementing data contracts and data product frameworks across domain teams.



Additional Information

Additional Physical Job Requirements

Physical requirements for this role include the ability to work at a computer terminal with monitor, keyboard and mouse for extended periods of time, stoop, bend, and reach for equipment and supplies, make frequent repetitive motions required to operate a computer that include the wrists, hands and fingers, and lift, carry, push, pull, and move light objects up to 20 pounds. The role also requires the ability to effectively communicate through verbal interactions, discern auditory information, and visually perceive details to perform essential job functions.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and similar applicable state laws, it is Fuze Health’s policy to provide reasonable accommodation to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in IT Support, Helpdesk, Desktop Support, or Technical Customer Service, with experience acting as a team lead, senior support engineer, or manager.
  • Experience supporting users in a hybrid environment (office staff + manufacturing, warehousing, or operational plant floor personnel).
  • Exceptional communication, patience, and customer-service mindset with strong problem-solving skills under time constraints.

title: [C3I] Data Architect

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Delta Labs uses AI to simulate and predict consumer behaviour at scale. We build Elaiia, a simulation engine that generates AI Twins — intelligent synthetic agents that mirror real consumer populations. Our clients use Elaiia to simulate customer decisions before committing to them: pricing strategies, product launches, campaign messaging, channel allocation. We replace surveys, focus groups, and intuition with simulation-based evidence.

We're a small, ambitious team building something we believe can fundamentally change how companies make decisions. We give people real ownership, trust, and the autonomy to do their best work. We move fast, hold ourselves to exceptionally high standards, and look for people who share our drive to build something extraordinary. If you're ambitious, intellectually curious, and thrive in an environment where your contributions directly shape the company's success, you'll feel at home here.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Full Stack Developer at Delta Labs, you will design and build the systems that power Elaiia's simulation platform. The Engineering team owns the full stack, from database schema to production UI, and is responsible for making Elaiia fast, reliable, and scalable.

THE STACK

A modern TypeScript frontend stack built on Next.js and React, backed by PostgreSQL and a set of Python microservices. Long-running study workflows are orchestrated as durable background jobs. OpenAI, Anthropic and Google Gemini are deeply integrated into the product layer, with LangGraph agents and full LLM tracing and evals. Deployed on Vercel and Microsoft Azure.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and build production features across the full stack, from data model to UI
  • Integrate LLM APIs into production workflows: prompt pipelines, structured outputs, token optimization, and reliability at scale
  • Build and operate long-running, multi-step simulation workflows — durable jobs that run for minutes or hours and cannot silently fail
  • Treat LLM quality as measurable: tracing, evals, and regression checks on the AI paths you own
  • Own entire features end-to-end and take responsibility for their performance, quality, and correctness
  • Collaborate with the research team to transition experimental AI capabilities — statistical persona models, agent architectures — into production-grade systems
  • Improve and extend the platform architecture as simulation workloads grow in complexity and volume
  • Ship continuously to maintain the pace the company needs

YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

  • You have 4+ years of experience shipping production web applications in TypeScript
  • You are strong in the modern React/Next.js ecosystem, and care about code quality, performance, and maintainability
  • You are comfortable reading and writing Python, or ready to — a meaningful part of our backend is Python services
  • You have designed relational database schemas that hold up under real-world scale and complexity
  • You have worked with or are deeply curious about LLM integration — prompt engineering, structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, agent architectures
  • You use AI tools as a core part of your development workflow and consider AI-assisted engineering the standard, not optional
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, stay focused under tight deadlines, and take ownership when things get challenging.
  • You are highly ambitious, self-driven, and excited by the opportunity to build something with significant potential.

STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO

  • Have built AI-powered features used by real customers in production
  • Have shipped LLM features with real evaluation and observability behind them, not just prompts that looked good in review
  • Have built asynchronous, long-running job pipelines and know how they fail
  • Have worked on multi-tenant including enterprise SSO
  • Have worked across both Vercel and cloud infrastructure like Azure
  • Have worked in a high-velocity early-stage environment

LOCATION

This role is based in Switzerland. We work from Zürich and meet regularly in person. Candidates should be based in Switzerland or open to relocation.

BENEFITS

  • We offer a competitive salary, potential equity participation, and the opportunity to build a company from its earliest stages. Delta Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds

description:

The Flexographic Press Operator’s primary function is to set up and operate flexo presses to produce items consistent with customer specifications.

Verbal and written professional communication skills.

Organization skills.

Detail oriented.

Initiative.

Problem Solving.

Time Management.

Perform basic mathematical skills, adding, subtracting, multiplication and division.

High school diploma and/or equivalent.

  • Solid understanding of networking, load balancers, VPCs, and SSL certs.
  • Strong grasp of application security, IAM, and compliance standards.
  • Experience with observability stacks like Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  • Clear English communication skills and a proactive, ownership-driven attitude.

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% remote – work from anywhere in LATAM.
  • Competitive USD-based compensation.
  • Join a truly global company with a diverse and inclusive team.
  • 10 days of PTO per year
  • Opportunities to shape infrastructure and engineering practices at scale.
  • A mission-driven culture focused on global growth, sustainability, and social impact.

title: 2nd Shift Production Line Lead
description:
About the Opportunity

We are growing and ramping up production at our Plymouth manufacturing facility and are looking for highly energized, positive, hands-on Production Line Leads who can help build strong, accountable production teams.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-moving manufacturing environment, leading from the floor, developing employees, and using metrics and measurable results to improve daily performance.

Our second shift is especially new and growing, making this a great opportunity for someone who enjoys helping establish routines, expectations, and a strong team culture from the ground up.

The ideal Line Lead is upbeat, organized, solutions-focused, comfortable with change, and able to balance people leadership with production execution.

What You'll Do

As a Production Line Lead, you will help coordinate the people, processes, training, and daily performance of an assigned production line.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead and coordinate daily production activities for an assigned line or work area
  • Help ensure production goals are achieved safely, efficiently, and consistently
  • Track and communicate key production metrics and performance measurements, including:
    • Output and production attainment
    • Labor utilization
    • Efficiency and productivity
    • Downtime
    • Waste and rework
    • Quality results
    • Attendance and staffing
    • Training progress
  • Effectively manage and adjust daily employee rosters and line assignments based on production needs, employee skills, attendance, and workflow
  • Ensure the right employees are positioned in the right jobs to support production goals
  • Conduct strong shift starts, communicate priorities, and maintain focus throughout the shift
  • Identify production obstacles and escalate or resolve issues quickly
  • Coach employees on performance expectations and reinforce accountability
  • Maintain a positive, respectful, and highly engaged work environment
  • Support onboarding and training of new and existing employees
  • Use Training Within Industry (TWI), Job Instruction, standardized work, or similar structured training methodologies to help employees learn jobs safely and consistently
  • Verify that employees can demonstrate required job skills before working independently
  • Help maintain and improve training matrices and employee skill records
  • Work closely with production leadership, quality, maintenance, safety, HR, and other departments
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflow, labor utilization, quality, training, and efficiency
  • Reinforce food safety, quality, sanitation, and workplace safety standards
  • Help create a culture where employees understand both what is expected and how their individual performance impacts the larger operation

What We're Looking For

We are looking for individuals who bring energy and leadership to the production floor.

Strong candidates will have:

  • Manufacturing, production, food manufacturing, warehouse, or similar operational experience

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Ninety One is South Africa’s largest investment manager and the only one with a global presence. The firm has 22 offices across 15 countries on five continents and manages R4.0 trillion of assets on behalf of clients (as at 30 June 2026).

Established in Cape Town in 1991 as part of the Investec Group, Ninety One demerged and rebranded in 2020, becoming an independent firm dual-listed in London and Johannesburg.

Always an active manager, Ninety One today offers strategies across equities, fixed income, multi-asset and private markets to institutions, advisors and individual investors around the world.

About the team:

At Ninety One, the vision for data is for trustworthy, discoverable and timely information to be at everybody’s fingertips. Data is our number one technology priority and foundational in our journey to become an AI-centred organisation.

The Data Technology team are custodians of Ninety One’s enterprise data platform and the core data domains that drive the firm’s investments and analytics engines. The team comprises several cross-functional, high-performing delivery squads, resourced through a mix of business and technology stakeholders. Their mandate is to deliver high quality, business value solutions, while assuring the highest standards of speed, accuracy, stability and security.

We treat data as a product and subscribe to a modern, customer-centred product development philosophy and as a team our key objectives are:

  • Better data - by improving the quality, trustworthiness, traceability and ownership of data
  • Faster data - by continuously reducing the time between data sourcing and information delivery
  • More data - by expanding the contextual, historical and domain content available and making it discoverable

We believe in the power of technology to enable our vision and are looking for passionate, committed individuals to join us on our journey.

In this role you will have a unique opportunity to work in a blended role requiring Data Engineering, Azure Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps practices to keep Ninety One's Databricks environment reliable, secure and well governed while building automation, common tooling and self-service for platform users.

In this role you will:

  • Work across both the data engineering and infrastructure/platform spaces to design, build and maintain solutions at the platform layer:Python solutions for platform and automation.Common shared libraries/modules used by data engineers and analysts across the platform.
  • Pipelines/processes that support overall platform management (e.g. for purposes such as cost tracking, governance, provisioning, monitoring).
  • CI/CD pipelines (DevOps/GitHub Actions) for platform and application deployments
  • Terraform IaC for Azure services and Azure Databricks (e.g. Unity Catalog, workspaces, networking, compute policies)
  • Collaborate with a wide ranging scope of teams including data engineers, analysts, security and infrastructure teams to translate requirements into capabilities.
  • Provide platform support to engineering teams and platform users including assisting with issues, ranging from code, platform and infrastructure.
  • Contribute to platform documentation, patterns and best-practice standards

You should consider applying if you have:

  • BSc Computer Science or equivalent
  • Minimum 7 years technology experience, with at least 3 years’ experience in the cloud platform/data platform roles
  • Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Azure infrastructure
  • Proficiency in Python and/or SQL; .NET is a plus
  • Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions
  • Terraform (IaC) experience, ideally in a multi-environment setup
  • Understanding of Platform Governance, Security
  • Experience in Data Modelling, Data Contracts and exposure to FinOps/cost attribution practices

Some of the attributes we look for in a person:

  • The ability to build and maintain meaningful relationships
  • The ability to ‘approach and own’ and continuously look for opportunities to develop
  • A client focused and collaborative approach
  • High conviction and be comfortable sharing opinions
  • A curiosity about technology and its potential to drive innovation

The UHealth-University of Miami Health System Information Technology & Systems Department has an opportunity for a full-time Systems Architect 2, MLOps Engineer.


The Systems Architect 2, MLOps Engineer is responsible for the independent design, development, and deployment of clinical applications and technologies. The architect defines system solutions based on user/client needs, cost, and required integration with existing applications, systems, or platforms. This employee also researches, identifies, selects, and tests technology products required for solution delivery. Establishes, implements, and documents technology integration or migration strategies. The employee must have the ability to proactively identify needs within the organization and, using expert technical and industry knowledge, design and build new solutions in support of organizational goals.


Core Responsibilities:

  • Engineers new workflows or optimize existing business processes that supersede existing standards set in place internally or by vendors utilizing expert knowledge crossing multiple clinical applications and operational areas.
  • Leads projects associated with application implementation and execution of high complexity and larger impact. Applies project management methodology and utilizes standard project management for software in development and maintenance of project plans.
  • Functions as an independent project lead or provides oversight for project manager and/or business analyst on assigned projects and recognize/ minimize business value lost during project/program execution.
  • Performs proactive analysis on current systems and technology in order to recommend potential changes or enhancements that will assist in adhering to organization's strategic vision and improve operational workflows as well as patient and end user experience.
  • Identifies product and customization requirements to effectively address necessary product configuration, while working within project scope and time line.
  • Serves as mentor to senior analysts and is proficient and/or certified in numerous applications.
  • Holds a comprehensive working knowledge and understands healthcare operational processes and job functions pertaining to assigned UHealth IT clinical applications and solutions.
  • Possesses expert knowledge of third party partnerships, experience with managing vendor relationships, and contract negotiations.
  • Provides support to the team in analyzing, resolving, and escalating complex integration problems encountered by the team during system implementations and upgrades.
  • Implement projects that are ahead of industry/peer trends. Thinks out of the box and follows the marking curve to stay on the forefront of Healthcare technology. Designs new solutions.
  • Participates in new hire orientation by providing the clinical application support in the work area required for the job role.
  • Collaborates with clinic leadership to develop or improve operational processes, polices, and procedures.
  • Participates in all clinical operations meetings to assess user feedback, gather future requirements for modifications, and provide a status on competency, adoption, and utilization rates.
  • Facilitates knowledge transfer of the technology-enabled user workflows and best practice use of applications.
  • Adheres to University and unit-level policies and procedures and safeguards University assets.

Department Specific Functions:

  • Architect and implement infrastructure to support machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) workloads across research, clinical, and operational domains
  • Apply strong proficiency in Python and machine learning frameworks to build a platform that ensures reproducibility and scalability of advanced ML/AI solutions
  • Utilize deep experience with containerization, orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code to enable scalable and reproducible deployments of ML/AI workloads
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using industry-standard tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps) for automated ML model deployment, monitoring, and retraining
  • Design and manage hybrid cloud/on-premises environments to support high-performance computing, data privacy, and compliance requirements (e.g., HIPAA, IRB)
  • Collaborate with data scientists, IT teams, and clinical stakeholders to translate ML/AI models into production-ready services integrated with clinical, research, and administrative systems
  • Implement frameworks for model governance, versioning, and auditability to ensure responsible and transparent AI practices, and integrate tools to streamline MLOps workflows
  • Design and implement robust APIs (e.g., RESTful, gRPC) to serve and integrate ML models with internal and external applications
  • Monitor system performance, model drift, and data integrity in real-time to maintain reliability and accuracy of deployed models
  • Apply a strong knowledge of clinical data standards (e.g., FHIR, OMOP, DICOM) to solution design and implementation

This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities as necessary.

  • Bachelor's Degree in relevant field
  • Epic or Healthcare EMR – Certification preferred
  • Minimum 8 years' experience in systems architecture, DevOps, or MLOps
  • Experience with hybrid cloud/on-prem environments, Azure preferred
  • Experience deploying and maintaining production workloads
  • Major systems development and implementation experience
  • Experience in healthcare or academic settings preferred
  • Experience mentoring and leading data teams, system engineering teams, or software engineering teams preferred
  • Experience with high-performance computing (HPC) or GPU-based workloads preferred
  • Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Strong proficiency with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, ARM templates)
  • Proficiency with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps)
  • Familiarity with ML lifecycle tools (e.g., MLflow, DVC, Airflow)
  • Familiarity with data integration standards and protocols, particularly those used in healthcare, such as APIs, FHIR, HL7, and DICOM
  • Understanding of responsible AI practices and model governance frameworks
  • Understanding of data privacy, security, and compliance in regulated environments
  • Demonstrated knowledge of change control and project management
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to communicate ideas and problem solutions
  • Works well independently and as part of a team
  • Knowledge of research compliance preferred

Any appropriate combination of relevant education, experience and/or certifications may be considered.

title: Kundservicemedarbetare till Ragn-Sells i Luleå!
description:
Nu finns chansen att arbeta hos ett av Sveriges främsta företag inom återvinning och miljö. Om ditt hjärta klappar lite extra för miljö och service kan detta vara helt rätt för dig! Ansök redan idag då vi arbetar med löpande urval!

Om tjänsten

Som kundservicemedarbetare kommer du bli en del av ett sammansvetsat team på Ragn-Sells Recycling AB i Luleå. Du välkomnas in i ett stort företag med familjär stämning och hjälpsamma kollegor.

Till en start kommer du erbjudas utbildningar för att lära dig grunderna i arbetet och vad företaget erbjuder sina kunder. Du kommer också gå bredvid andra mer erfarna kollegor, för att sedan successivt ta dig an egna ärenden som ökar i svårighetsgrad. Förutom andra kundservicemedarbetare arbetar du nära transportplanerarna, produktionsadminstratörer, säljare och affärsadministratörer.

Till en början kommer anställningen gå via oss på Academic Work och därefter finns det goda möjligheter att anställningen övergår till Ragn-Sells.

Arbetsuppgifter

I denna tjänst kommer du huvudsakligen arbeta med att hantera ärenden från företagskunder, stötta ordinarie kollegor i processer samt ha en del kontakt med privatpersoner. Kundservicen får in ärenden från hela norrlandskusten och för att trivas i denna roll ser vi att du trivs med att ha många kontaktytor och tycker om att arbeta strukturerat och noggrant. I tjänsten kommer du använda Ragn-Sells ärendehanteringsystem samt telefon.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har arbetslivserfarenhet av kundservice eller annan roll vi bedömer som likvärdig
  • Har mycket god telefon -och systemvana då du behöver hantera flertalet system
  • Uttrycker dig obehindrat på både svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift, och är trygg i att kommunicera med olika intressenter

Det är meriterande om du har

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta med uppsökande försäljning eller komplex ärendehantering över telefon
  • Intresse av miljöfrågor
  • Anknytning eller är bosatt i Luleå.

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:

  • Hjälpsam
  • Social
  • Ansvarstagande

Övrigt:

  • Start: Enligt överenskommelse
  • Omfattning: Heltid, 7-16
  • Placering: På plats hos Ragn-Sells nya fina kontor i Luleå

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: Vi søger en hjertemedicinsk speciallæge til Sjællands Universitetshospital, Nykøbing F.
description:
Er du kardiologisk speciallæge med teamplayer-ånd? Ønsker du at bidrage til fortsat udvikling og innovation på et universitetshospital med brede rammer og fleksible arbejdstider? Så er det dig vi søger!

Vi søger en hjertemedicinsk speciallæge til Nykøbing F.

Da stillingen er nyoprettet, har du god mulighed for at påvirke indhold og arbejdstilrettelæggelse efter ønske og efter aftale med ledende overlæge. Herunder er der efter særinteresse mulighed for at få funktionsansvar efter aftale.

Vi søger en speciallæge eller overlægekvalificeret speciallæge med interesse for udvikling af vores hjerteenhed.

Medicinske Sygdomme i Nykøbing F. består af fire enheder: Lungesygdomme, Ældresygdomme, Mave-, Tarm- og Leversygdomme og Hjertesygdomme.

Om os

Hjertesygdomme, sengeafsnit har 30 sengepladser i sygehusets nyeste bygning. Vi råder over moderne udstyr og en klinik med stor aktivitet. Foruden TTE og TEE, foretager vi hjerte-CT.

Vi har sygeplejeklinikker indenfor hypertension, lipidforstyrrelser og hjertesvigt.

Vi er en arbejdsplads med dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere.

Hjertesygdomme består af et stærkt hold, herunder specialuddannede kardiologiske sygeplejersker. Vi har en stor passion for specialet, og kardiologi har et rigtig godt ry som uddannelsessted for yngre læger.

Vi arbejder tæt sammen med Hjertesygdomme, SUH Roskilde, hvor vi blandt andet har to speciallæger ansat i delestilling. Desuden har vi på alle hverdage to kardiologiske speciallæger fra SUH, Roskilde med udefunktion i SUH, Nykøbing F.

Enhedsledelsen består af en ledende overlæge og to oversygeplejersker, som refererer til cheflægen og chefsygeplejersken.

Afsnittet består af 15-20 læger, inklusive læger under uddannelse. Aktuelt har vi årligt ca. tre hoveduddannelsesforløb i kardiologi, og egne introduktionslæger i rotation med de øvrige medicinske specialer.

Læger i hoveduddannelse er hos os i to år, før de skal videre til SUH, Roskilde.

Vi har ansat en uddannelsesansvarlig overlæge til at varetage de forskellige uddannelsesforløb hos vores yngre læger.

Sygehuset har et godt samarbejde med Københavns Universitet, og bidrager til den formaliserede undervisning af medicinstuderende, der har klinikophold på sygehuset.

Hjerteenheden har to lektorer, og bidrager desuden til nationale og regionale forskningsprojekter.

Afsnittet har det sidste år gennemgået en sund udvikling. Dette omfatter blandt andet formaliseret DC-konvertering med Remimazolam i klinikken med dedikeret yngre læge under speciallægesupervision samt aftenstuegang på hverdagene.

Herudover afholdes onsdagsmøder, som er et ugentligt fagligt mødested for afsnittets læger.

De kardiologiske HU-læger har ansvaret for at planlægge faglig gennemgang i journal club-format en gang om måneden.

Vi har en fremtidig ambition om at oprette et kardiologisk dagafsnit i enheden, og vi ser gerne at få indført en kardiologisk sweeperfunktion, som bemandes af en speciallæge/HU-læge i kardiologi.

Vi har et mål om at især vores 2. års HU-læger i kardiologi tilbydes mesterlære i TEE og at kunne foretage akutte og subakutte kardiologiske tilsyn/ekko.

Vi har desuden indført uddannelsestavler for at synliggøre vores uddannelsestiltag.

Vores forventninger til dig:

  • Du er speciallæge i kardiologi, og ønsker at bidrage til den daglige drift med stuegang på hjerteenhedens sengeafsnit såvel som at se patienter i vores klinik
  • Vi forventer, at du arbejder løsnings- og samarbejdsorienteret med afdelingens øvrige uddannelsesansvarlige overlæger

Er du endnu ikke overlægekvalificereret, vil vi kunne tilbyde en speciallægestilling hos os mhp. overlægekvalificering indenfor ovenstående ansvarsområde.

Vi kan tilbyde en stilling, der indeholder:

  • kontinuitet og afveksling i hverdagen
  • sparring og faglige udviklingsmuligheder
  • godt arbejdsmiljø og et velfungerende tværfagligt samarbejde
  • en fleksibel arbejdstilrettelæggelse, ligesom vi gerne vil imødekomme muligheden for at vedligeholde og udvikle særlige interesseområder
  • mulighed for individuelle aftaler mhp. subspecialisering, herunder med højtspecialiserede forløb i Roskilde/Køge
  • mulighed for at påtage sig ansvarsområder, herunder funktionsledelse og søjleansvar


Praktisk info

SUH, Nykøbing F. tilbyder gode rammer for pendlere fra Køge og København, hvor der på alle ugens dage morgen og aften kører direkte gratis busser.

Derudover er der oprettet et personalehotel, hvor overnatninger kan bookes.

Læs mere på Et arbejdsliv i balance - Sjællands Universitetshospital, Nykøbing F.

Forskning

SUH, Nykøbing F. har en Forskningsstøtteenhed, som kan være behjælpelig med, at man kommer i gang med forskning.

Yderligere oplysninger

Fås hos ledende overlæge Ramshanker Ramanathan, tlf. 93 56 85 17, e-mail: ramra@regionsjaelland.dk

Ansøgning

Du bedes i en motiveret ansøgning forholde dig til de syv lægeroller (Medicinsk ekspert/lægefaglig, Kommunikator, Samarbejder, Leder/administrator/organisator, Sundhedsfremmer, Akademiker/forsker og underviser, Professionel), medsende CV og redegøre for, at dine faglige kompetencer matcher de faglige krav til stillingen.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er vagtbærende. Antal vagter efter individuel aftale.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og tillæg efter forhåndsaftaler.

Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Ansættelse 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale.


Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.

title: Process Operator
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Process Operator

Shift: Days

Location: Mars – Topeka, Kansas

Mars is looking to hire a Process Operator for our state-of-the-art manufacturing plant in Topeka, Kansas! Being a Mars Associate is all about opportunity. The opportunity to do challenging, exciting work that shapes the world’s best-loved brands. To work with real purpose, supported by talented, friendly people from different backgrounds. Access the tools, training, and experience you need to positively impact our business, the planet, and, most importantly, your career. Being a Mars associate is more than a job. It’s the opportunity to start your day tomorrow.


As part of our overall total compensation package, Mars offers a competitive benefits package to all associates: Medical, Dental, Vision & Life Insurance, Short- & Long-Term Disability, and 401k match. Associates are also immediately eligible (based on hire date) for up to three weeks of vacation, 12 Paid Holidays per year, Sick Pay, Maternity & Parental Leave, and annual bonus earning potential, plus many other ancillary benefits not listed here.

Process Operators are system experts in their assigned areas and highly functional in multiple areas. They also ensure efficiency, operational conformance, product quality, and continuous improvement. They function as members of an area team directly responsible for the efficient production of quality products in the required quantities. They operate/change over specified machinery in the assigned area.

Process Operators must have the skill set to train and/or perform the tasks of other associates in the area as needed. This job requires strong communication, interpersonal, and team-building skills to support site objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Performs all assigned activities & job tasks within a line or area.
  • Operates equipment safely and efficiently.
  • Takes corrective actions to solve problems at the root cause level.
  • Able to assess equipment operating reliability and perform routine repairs, adjustments, and malfunction troubleshooting.
  • Performs and/or works with maintenance to complete preventative maintenance of equipment.
  • Able to maintain accurate records of quality control checks, production numbers, or waste performance.
  • Keeps detailed logbooks: Performs all shift support documentation in a quality matter.
  • Performs quality control tasks such as metal checks, inspection of date codes, item numbers, dump logs, etc.
  • High degree of ownership for product quality: Performs all standard quality checks & other quality-related duties.
  • Able to operate a forklift.
  • Able to operate a computer and utilize the basic standard desktop systems (LSS, PSL, MIS, SQCIS, etc.).
  • Understand principles of inventory control.
  • Knows the plant's products and goals.
  • Understand production schedules, production computer systems, and work instructions.
  • Has general knowledge of Mars & the systems used by the business.

Physical/Environmental Requirements:

  • Standing on a concrete floor.
  • Wearing proper personal protective equipment (hair net, bump cap, ear plugs, safety shoes, and uniform).
  • Bending, stooping, twisting, turning, standing for extended time periods, reaching, climbing stairs, and lifting up to 50 lbs.
  • Forklift assignments require OSHA certification and getting on and off frequently.
  • Required to work weekends during peak season.
  • Required to work mandatory overtime during peak season.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School diploma, GED, or equivalent education.
  • Standing on a concrete floor.
  • Wearing proper personal protective equipment (hair net, bump cap, ear plugs, safety shoes, and uniform).
  • Bending, stooping, twisting, turning, standing for extended time periods, reaching, climbing stairs, and lifting up to 50 lbs.
  • Forklift assignments require OSHA certification and getting on and off frequently.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of manufacturing experience operating a variety of machines.
  • Knowledge of inventory control principles.
  • Ability to operate a forklift/OSHA certification.
  • Experience with SAP.

About Mars, Incorporated

Mars is a family-owned business with more than a century of history making diverse products and offering services for people and the pets people love. With almost $35 billion in sales, the company is a global business that produces some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, UNCLE BEN’S®, MARS DRINKS and COCOAVIA®. Mars also provides veterinary health services that include BANFIELD® Pet Hospitals, Blue Pearl®, VCA® and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire its more than 100,000 Associates to create value for all its partners and deliver growth they are proud of every day.

title: DevOps Engineer

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. Responsibilities

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and support SHEPRD releases and operational events.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, or related roles.
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.

title: Senior Creator Acquisition Partner
description:
About Us

At #paid, we’re on a mission to empower creators to do what they love—create. Our marketplace connects vetted creators with some of the world’s most iconic brands, like McDonald’s, Samsung, and Disney, fostering authentic collaborations that drive real business results. We’ve built a marketplace that solves big challenges in the creator ecosystem, from fair pricing to algorithmic matching and content usage rights, ensuring every partnership is seamless and impactful.
With our proprietary technology and an unwavering commitment to trust and transparency, we’re revolutionizing the way brands and creators come together to make magic. Rated #1 for customer support and managed services, #paid is leading the creator marketing space. Through innovative technology and a team of ambitious humans, we're transforming the future of the creator economy.

The Role

#paid's creator network has grown almost entirely through word of mouth. That's worked, but it means the shape of our network reflects who found us — not what our clients are actually buying. We're building a real acquisition function to change that, and this role sits at the center of it.

You'll be sourcing and onboarding creators to fill live rosters for our largest, most complex accounts, where the ask is specific and the timeline is tight.

You'll work closely with the Senior Manager, Creator Acquisition, who owns the overall acquisition strategy and our large-scale growth partnerships. You own the execution: the outreach that actually happens, the funnel that actually moves, and the rosters that actually get filled.

You'll be measured on roster turnaround time, first-round roster approval rate, and roster on-time rate on the reactive side.
This is a build-as-you-go role.

Responsibilities

  • Own sourcing for our biggest programs. Source and onboard creators for live rosters on our largest and most complex accounts, partnering with the Senior Manager on load-sharing across the biggest programs.
  • Deliver on roster performance. You're accountable for roster turnaround time, first-round approval rate, and on-time delivery on the accounts you own — sourcing fast enough and accurately enough that rosters land right the first time.

description:

ABOUT WFP

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of extreme weather shocks.


At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: and follow us on social media to keep up with our latest news: YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, TikTok.


WHY JOIN WFP?

  • WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.
  • WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.
  • WFP invests in the personal & professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.
  • A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.
  • We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the Terms and Conditions section of this vacancy announcement).




GENERAL INFORMATION:

JOB TITLE: Facility Engineer (Civil)
TYPE OF CONTRACT/LEVEL: Fixed Term NOA
SUPERVISOR: Facilities Management Officer
UNIT/DIVISION: Management Services
DUTY STATION (City, Country): Aden, Yemen

DURATION: 12 Months


ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT:

United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) is the world's largest humanitarian organization addressing hunger and food insecurity. WFP's mission is to help achieve Zero Hunger by ensuring that vulnerable populations have access to adequate, safe, and nutritious food. Every day, WFP works globally to support people affected by conflict, disasters, climate shocks, and economic crises, with particular attention to women, children, and other vulnerable groups.

BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:

Provide engineering expertise and project management support for WFP premises, facilities, and infrastructure interventions, while contributing to the planning and implementation of resilience-building and programme-related engineering projects across the Yemen Country Office and its field offices.


Key Responsibilities

1. Engineering and Project Management Support

  • Provide engineering and project management support for WFP facilities, premises and infrastructure projects through the application of best practices, innovative technologies and engineering principles.
  • Conduct technical assessments and develop evidence-based recommendations to improve the suitability, safety, sustainability, functionality, and operational efficiency of WFP infrastructure.
  • Prepare engineering designs, drawings, technical specifications, Bills of Quantities (BoQs), cost estimates and other technical documentation required for structural maintenance, renovation and construction projects.
  • Participate in technical and design reviews and recommend practical, innovative and cost-effective engineering solutions for new and existing facilities including the resilience programme-related facilities.
  • Support the planning, implementation, monitoring and quality assurance of engineering, rehabilitation, maintenance and construction projects within WFP premises.
  • Participate in technical evaluations during procurement processes by developing technical requirements, conducting technical evaluation and analyzing contractors’ and suppliers’ technical proposals.
  • Monitor project implementation progress, identify engineering risks and bottlenecks, and recommend corrective and preventive measures to ensure timely and successful project delivery.
  • Support the preparation, implementation and technical monitoring of School Feeding infrastructure projects, Food For Assets (FFA) programme, Healthy Kitchens projects and other programme-related engineering activities.
  • Prepare technical reports, project updates, engineering analyses and maintain engineering records, databases and documentation to support informed decision-making and reporting requirements.
  • Promote environmental sustainability, energy efficiency, climate-resilient practices, and business continuity considerations in engineering solutions and infrastructure projects.

2. Field Support

  • Provide engineering support and technical guidance to field offices across Yemen Country Office on infrastructure, resilience programme-related projects, and engineering-related matters.
  • Conduct field missions, site assessments, conditions surveys, and technical inspections to evaluate infrastructure conditions and identify engineering requirements.
  • Monitor engineering activities implemented at field locations and provided recommendations to ensure compliance with WFP standards, technical specifications, and operational requirements.
  • Coordinate with field offices and relevant stakeholders to facilitate the implementation, monitoring, and reporting of engineering and infrastructures projects.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, government counterparts, UN agencies, implementing partners and contractors on engineering-related matters.
  • Support knowledge-sharing and capacity-building initiatives by providing technical guidance, training, and coaching relevant staff on engineering practices and standards.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:


Education:

Advanced University degree in Engineering (Civil Engineer) or Architecture from an institution recognized by the ministry of education in Yemen, obtained after a minimum of five years of full-time study in Yemen or abroad.

Experience:


  • Total relevant 5 years of experience including minimum 2 years of professional experience in operations and maintenance systems in large scale buildings (12,000 sqm).
  • Experience in Contract Management.
  • Experience with procurement procedures and practices.

Knowledge & Skills:


  • Demonstrated knowledge of Yemeni legislation and regulations in relation to maintenance and construction planning, management, and implementation.
  • Good knowledge of public and UN procurement procedures, international contract formats, and construction management procedures.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Advanced knowledge of AutoCAD is required.
  • Working knowledge of facilities management softwares (e.g. Archibus)
  • Working knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems.
  • Good knowledge of integrated Facility Management systems.
  • Ability to communicate and understand technical documents in Arabic and English is required.
  • Good technical problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to understand and establish priorities and work by objectives.
  • Ability to work in a team establish effective working relationships and communicate with internal customers (WFP Yemen) and external counterpart (GHQ MSDE) and people from different nationalities, cultural backgrounds, and competencies.
  • Ability to work under stress and work overtime when required.

Languages:

English-Arabic.

title: Product Engineer
description:
A property manager can handle 600 tenants. That's the industry limit. Why? Because the work scales linearly: matching bank transactions to invoices, chasing late payments, answering tenant questions, coordinating repairs, preparing legal notices, renewing leases. More tenants, more of the same manual work.

With AI, that limit disappears. And both landlords and tenants get a better experience.

**About Rumli

**Eight years in property operations. ~1,000 customers across Denmark, the Netherlands, and Germany. We know this industry: the workflows, the pain points, the regulations.

Now we're making a big move: becoming a property manager. Tenant communication, bookkeeping, coordinating repairs. We handle it all. A landlord shouldn't chase late payments or find a plumber at 10 pm. We do it for them.

We're building an entirely new platform to power this. AI-native from day one. Profitable, real customers, expanding across the Nordics.

**Why this is interesting

**Property management is a great domain for a product engineer. Thousands of similar transactions, pattern-based decisions, templated documents. And 1,000 customers who will tell you exactly where it hurts. Years of domain knowledge, ready to turn into a product.

We ship with AI agents built into the workflow. Our codebase has custom skills to improve our workflow. AI writes a lot of the code; we review it. That means the slow part of building isn't writing code anymore. It's knowing what to build. That's what this role is about.

**The role

**You are autonomous and independent, working with the team to solve property managers' pains and make them as efficient as possible.

  • Talk to customers and property managers. Find out what actually slows them down
  • Decide what to build, then build it. Mockup, prototype, ship, measure, repeat
  • Own features end-to-end. Database to API to UI
  • Build AI into core product features
  • Work directly with our co-founder on product direction

We need someone who looks at a messy problem and figures out what to build, and doesn't wait for a spec.

**Tech stack

**TypeScript everywhere. But does it even matter anymore?

  • Frontend: Next.js, React, Shadcn, Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: NestJS, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM
  • Infra: AWS Lambda, CDK, RDS, EventBridge, SQS

**What We're Looking For

**

  • Product thinking. You understand what it takes to build a profitable product. You are not here just to handle tickets.
  • Strong product mindset. Agents can code, but they need scoping and steering.
  • You've shipped things people actually use, and you can show them.
  • Comfortable talking to customers.
  • Experience with coding agents.
  • Work independently.
  • Copenhagen-based (on-site).

Big plus: AWS, AI experience (prompt engineering, RAG, agents), fintech/proptech background, a side project you're proud of.

**Compensation & Benefits

**

  • Compensation: 50–65K DKK, depending on experience and demonstrated competencies
  • Equity: Employee warrants offering real ownership in the company
  • Workspace: Centrally located Copenhagen office
  • Perks: Daily lunch included

**Why Rumli?

**Real customers. Brand-new codebase. Small team where your decisions matter.

We're rebuilding from the ground up with AI as the foundation. If you want to decide what property software should do, not just build what someone else specified, reach out.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:

Dit ga je doen

Als DevOps Engineer werk je binnen onze Business Unit Technology aan uiteenlopende projecten. Je maakt deel uit van een team van 30 IT consultants en werkt voor verschillende soorten organisaties. Dat betekent afwisseling, nieuwe uitdagingen en veel ruimte om je technische én adviesvaardigheden in te zetten. Je schakelt intensief met development en operations teams en speelt een belangrijke rol in het vormgeven van moderne DevOps werkwijzen. Jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Ontwerpen en implementeren van CI/CD pipelines voor diverse projecten.
  • Automatiseren van infrastructuur met tools zoals Terraform, Ansible of Pulumi.
  • Beheren en optimaliseren van cloudomgevingen, zoals Azure en AWS.
  • Adviseren van klanten over DevOps strategieën en best practices.
  • Monitoren en verbeteren van security en compliance binnen DevOps processen.
  • Samenwerken met development en operations teams om een cultuur van Continuous Improvement te stimuleren.

Je bent fit for the job als je...

Je hebt ruime ervaring als DevOps Engineer en voelt je thuis in een dynamische consultancy omgeving. Je kent containertechnologieën en cloudplatformen door en door en schakelt moeiteloos tussen techniek en advies. Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden weet je klanten helder mee te nemen in keuzes, oplossingen en best practices. Je wilt blijven groeien, nieuwe technieken ontdekken en werkt graag in omgevingen waar je impact maakt.

Harde eisen:

  • Hbo opleiding richting business IT & management of een vergelijkbare studie.
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als DevOps Engineer binnen consultancy of een vergelijkbare dynamische omgeving.
  • Diepgaande kennis van Docker en Kubernetes, sterke ervaring met Azure en goede scriptingvaardigheden (bijv. Python, Bash).

Zachte eisen:

  • Je hebt ervaring met Infrastructure as Code en configuratiemanagement en zet dit effectief in.
  • Je communiceert sterk in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk (minimaal C1 niveau).
  • Je schakelt makkelijk tussen klantvragen, technische uitdagingen en adviesrollen.

For international candidates: our consultants must be able to communicate in Dutch at a minimum of C1 level, both spoken and written.

Dit krijg je van ons

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen 6.000 en 7.800 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, kennis en relevante certificaten. Daarnaast krijg je toegang tot meer dan 950 trainingen en cursussen die je onbeperkt kunt volgen.

Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten in een inspirerende consultancy omgeving waar je niet sectorgebonden bent. Binnen de Business Unit Technology werk je samen met 75 consultants, waarvan 30 IT consultants in jouw directe team. De sfeer is business casual: hard werken, veel humor en volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist
Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is Team EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is. Of je nu werkt voor een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis: jij helpt teams slimmer werken en brengt ideeën van papier naar praktijk. Soms voor grote transformaties, soms voor snelle oplossingen. Van startup tot multinational: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Binnen de Business Unit Technology werk je met 75 consultants verdeeld over drie specialisaties: Data & Analytics, IT en GEOS. Als DevOps Engineer maak je deel uit van het IT team, samen met zo’n 30 collega consultants. Omdat we niet sectorgebonden werken, krijg je de kans om in verschillende omgevingen ervaring op te doen. IT raakt alle sectoren, daardoor is er altijd een project dat past bij jouw kennis, ambitie en energie.

Elke vrijdag is onze samenwerkdag in het clubhuis in Arnhem. Die staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega’s en het versterken van de onderlinge verbinding. Moet je opdrachtgever je die dag op kantoor hebben? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.

Team EIFFEL is onderdeel van een community van ruim 3.000 experts, verspreid over 24 kennisdomeinen en meer dan 600 opdrachtgevers. Groot in omvang, maar persoonlijk in cultuur. Ons clubhuis staat open voor iedereen die wil groeien, ontwikkelen en zichzelf scherp wil houden.

Deze skills komen van pas
  • Software testing en automatisering

Je communiceert sterk en weet klanten op een duidelijke, rustige manier mee te nemen in complexe DevOps vraagstukken. Je werkt graag samen en stimuleert teams om continu te verbeteren. Met jouw analytische blik zie je snel waar knelpunten zitten en vind je oplossingen die werken, altijd met aandacht voor security en compliance. Je blijft op de hoogte van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in DevOps en cloudtechnologie en past die kennis toe in je werk. Je houdt van hard werken, maar zeker ook van humor op de werkvloer. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent gericht op groei en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
